regions.name: Amestris and its neighbours
regions.info:
[Recommended Level: 2-30 · Danger: Severe]

The republic of Amestris and the lands around it on one map: the capital at the centre, the eastern areas running out to Ishval and the desert, the northern range along the border with Drachma, the southern front with Aerugo, and the western border with Creta. Xing lies far to the east, across the Eastern Desert, and the Gate is no place on this map at all: it is reached only by a price.

npcs.name: Abbess Shu Lian
npcs.info:
The abbess of the Jade Temple in Xing, who rings the bells at dawn and dusk and leads the chant in the hall. She is serene, patient and quietly firm, and she welcomes any traveller who comes to pray. She keeps the temple's accounts and the bells in good tune.

**Speaking Style:** Serene and slow, a holy woman who answers questions with a question and a smile.
**Combat Role:** none; a bell staff and a calm voice
**Relationship Hook:** An abbess ringing a bell in a courtyard of jade stone at dawn.
personality: Core: serene, slow and firm; answers questions with questions; welcomes any traveller who prays
Quirk: gives sanctuary quietly

npcs.name: Abe Orrin
npcs.info:
A fisherman who works off the Lakeside Pier in Dublith, hauling nets and selling his catch to the town's cooks. He knows the lake and its currents and talks about his bad luck with a cheerful gloom. He steers clear of the Devil's Nest and buys its beer by the crate.

**Speaking Style:** Rough and friendly, a fisherman who talks about the lake and his luck with equal gloom.
**Combat Role:** none; a gaff hook and a strong back
**Relationship Hook:** A fisherman on a pier hauling a wet net, talking to a passing cook.
personality: Core: rough, friendly and gloomy about luck; knows the lake's currents; steers clear of the bar's crowd
Quirk: buys its beer by the crate

npcs.name: Abner Thwaite
npcs.info:
The old lamp man of the Baschool pithead, who handed out the miners' lamps every shift for thirty years and still sleeps in the lamp room under the empty hooks. He talks to the brass tallies as if the men were still underground.

**Speaking Style:** A cracked whisper, slow and gentle, as if the men on shift below might wake.
**Combat Role:** an old man with a lamp hook on a long pole; he keeps an intruder at the length of it
**Relationship Hook:** An old lamp man polishing a brass lamp beneath a wall of empty hooks, whispering a name to each tally.
personality: Core: greets every tally by name; polishes lamps nobody will carry again; speaks slowly and in a whisper
Quirk: never leaves the pithead

npcs.name: Absalom Crake
npcs.info:
The gravedigger of the war cemetery below Pendleton is a stooped, silent man who has dug every grave in the field and painted most of the markers. He keeps a pencil book of every burial and reads it aloud to himself at night.

**Speaking Style:** Hoarse and slow, a gravedigger's murmur that drops each name like a spadeful of earth.
**Combat Role:** a gravedigger's spade, swung flat and hard, by a man stronger than he looks
**Relationship Hook:** A gaunt gravedigger leaning on a spade among long rows of wooden markers in the rain.
personality: Core: hardly speaks; reads the names aloud at night; paints each marker with care
Quirk: suspicious of officers with notebooks

npcs.name: Ada Fennimore
npcs.info:
The gamekeeper's wife at the fox covert, a strong, plain woman who kept the keeper's cottage, skinned his vermin and hung them on the gibbet rail when he was too tired. She knows the covert's runs nearly as well as he did. Every morning now she walks the edge of the gorse with his gun, because he has not come home.

**Speaking Style:** Hard and level, a keeper's wife who reports facts and refuses comfort.
**Combat Role:** her husband's shotgun, held steady and fired without hesitation
**Relationship Hook:** A hard-faced woman with a shotgun under her arm staring at a dog collar nailed among the pelts.
personality: Core: hard and practical; refuses pity; trusts no one from East City
Quirk: walks the same round every dawn

npcs.name: Adalbert Rusk
npcs.info:
The leader of the dig at the market ruins, a researcher from the capital with a tidy finds table and an untidy temper. He labels everything himself and sends crates west by camel every week. He treats the diggers well and his assistants badly.

**Speaking Style:** Cold, clipped and sure; he answers questions with questions and loses his temper only over sloppy work.
**Combat Role:** a researcher-alchemist who hardens the ground and keeps distance with a revolver
**Relationship Hook:** A spare man in wire spectacles bending over a table of labelled trays in a large tent.
personality: Core: exacting and short-tempered; labels every find himself; pays the diggers on time, always
Quirk: loyal to his orders and uneasy about them

npcs.name: Adelbert Brandauer
npcs.info:
An army purchasing officer from South City, a tidy, sharp-nosed lieutenant who buys beef, hides and ice for the southern front by the trainload and lodges at the lake hotel on the army's account. He checks every brand against a list, every weight against a scale and every invoice twice, and Dublith dislikes him for all three.

**Speaking Style:** Crisp and courteous, a lieutenant whose politeness feels like an inspection.
**Combat Role:** an officer's sabre and service pistol, well drilled and never tested
**Relationship Hook:** A tidy lieutenant with a notebook standing by a cattle ramp, writing down a brand.
personality: Core: polite in a way that feels like an inspection; eats alone and early; keeps his own copy of every paper
Quirk: checks everything twice

npcs.name: Adelgunde Pfeffer
npcs.info:
The matron of the war orphans' home, a short, square woman in a starched cap who has raised more children than most villages. She spends the mornings in the kitchen garden with the older ones and the afternoons writing begging letters to officers' wives. The grant shrinks every year and she has stopped expecting it not to.

**Speaking Style:** Brisk and practical, a matron who gives orders as if they were weather reports.
**Combat Role:** none; a garden hoe, a ferocious glare and forty children who will come at a shout
**Relationship Hook:** A stout matron with a hoe in a vegetable garden surrounded by children in grey smocks.
personality: Core: brisk, practical, warm underneath; counts potatoes and children with equal care; will not take charity from a man she does not like
Quirk: sings hymns badly in the garden

npcs.name: Adelheid Brunn
npcs.info:
The matron of the War Orphans' Home, a stout widow who took in six children from the border villages in the first winter of the war and now has forty. She bakes, mends, nurses and begs with equal energy. The children call her mother, and she has stopped correcting them.

**Speaking Style:** Warm and a little breathless, a matron who is always halfway through three jobs.
**Combat Role:** none; a rolling pin and the ferocity of a mother hen
**Relationship Hook:** A stout matron with a child on her hip in a dormitory of narrow iron beds.
personality: Core: always halfway through three jobs; cannot refuse a child; begs shamelessly for the home
Quirk: trusts the benefactor completely

npcs.name: Adelheid Lenz
npcs.info:
The senior matron of the Pinewood Orphanage, a tall stern woman who has raised two hundred children who were not hers. She is strict, unsentimental and fierce about her charges; she would fight a general for any one of them.

**Speaking Style:** Brisk and firm, a matron's voice that settles a dormitory of forty children in four words.
**Combat Role:** none; a ruler, a stare, and forty children who would follow her into a fire
**Relationship Hook:** A tall matron in black standing at the end of a long dormitory, keys at her belt, counting beds.
personality: Core: stern and fierce; knows every child's nightmares; never cries in front of them
Quirk: keeps every letter the boys send back

npcs.name: Adelheid Voss
npcs.info:
The landlady of the Pickaxe Inn, the one house in Youswell with sheets that are white and a bath that fills. She came from East City as a lady's maid, married the inn and buried its owner, and she has kept the place genteel by sheer will. Her parlour clock runs slow so that her guests miss the morning train and stay another night.

**Speaking Style:** Silk over gravel, a landlady who calls every guest 'dear' and means 'customer'.
**Combat Role:** none; a hatpin and a bell that brings the porter
**Relationship Hook:** A landlady in a cameo brooch pouring tea for a guest while reading the label on his trunk.
personality: Core: gracious to the face; notices luggage, boots and hands; plays the lieutenant and his clerk against each other
Quirk: keeps the parlour clock slow on purpose

npcs.name: Afra Haldorf
npcs.info:
The farmer's wife at Haldorf Dairy, broad, rosy and up at four, who rules a creamery, seven children and a husband who does what she says. She sells butter and cheese at the gate to walkers from the city and gives the children a cup of milk for nothing. Everybody on the north road knows her laugh.

**Speaking Style:** Calm and warm, a farmer's wife who keeps talking while her hands work the butter.
**Combat Role:** none; a strong farm woman with a butter paddle and a house full of sons
**Relationship Hook:** A rosy farmer's wife working butter in a stone creamery, a stack of letters tucked under a churn lid beside her.
personality: Core: warm, busy and loud; feeds every visitor; fierce for her children
Quirk: trusts her instincts over anyone's word

npcs.name: Agnes Pryor
npcs.info:
A collier's wife who scrubs her step every morning and runs the strike kitchen every afternoon, feeding the whole row on next to nothing. She has buried a husband and a son from the pit and does not intend to bury another.

**Speaking Style:** Sharp and loud, a miner's wife who argues with soldiers as if they were her own sons.
**Combat Role:** a scrubbing brush, a coal shovel and a voice that stops men cold
**Relationship Hook:** A wiry miner's wife in a sacking apron scrubbing a doorstep in a row of soot-black cottages.
personality: Core: scrubs her step every morning without fail; shouts at soldiers and feeds them anyway; has buried too many and will not bury more
Quirk: never cries in public

npcs.name: Agnes Ruff
npcs.info:
A farm wife from a village east of Fotset, living in a canvas tent with her mother-in-law and two children. She is lean, sharp-eyed and silent around soldiers. She sits on a crate at the tent door from morning to night, mending.

**Speaking Style:** Low and strained, a farm woman who speaks as little as possible to anyone in uniform.
**Combat Role:** none; a mending needle and a mother's fury
**Relationship Hook:** A lean farm woman mending on a crate at a tent door, watching a soldier with a clipboard approach.
personality: Core: silent around soldiers; fierce for her children
Quirk: never leaves the tent door

npcs.name: Agnete Ulvik
npcs.info:
A wolf hunter who takes the army's bounty on pelts and lives in a hut near the hollow with three dogs that are more than half wolf themselves. She is short, broad and blunt, and soldiers who follow her on a hunt learn to keep quiet.

**Speaking Style:** Blunt and flat, saying the rude thing first and the kind thing never aloud.
**Combat Role:** a hunter with a short rifle and three half-wolf dogs; the dogs go first and she shoots what runs
**Relationship Hook:** A broad woman in a wolf-fur hood crouched on a rock with three wolfish dogs, watching the hollow below.
personality: Core: blunt to the point of rudeness; counts wolves by their voices; feeds her dogs before herself
Quirk: dislikes soldiers but likes certain ones

npcs.name: Albin Rushford
npcs.info:
A thatcher who cuts reed in the marsh east of town each winter and roofs half the cottages in the district with it each summer. He is lean, brown and quiet, his forearms scratched to ribbons by the reed, and he moves through the black channels in a flat punt as easily as other men walk a lane.

**Speaking Style:** Dry and sparing, a thatcher who answers with a nod wherever a nod will do.
**Combat Role:** a long reed hook and a punt pole; he fights from the boat and keeps his distance
**Relationship Hook:** A lean thatcher in a punt holding up a small carved wooden bird found on a reed bank.
personality: Core: quiet and lean; keeps his own counsel and other people's; uneasy around soldiers since the war
Quirk: nods instead of answering

npcs.name: Albrecht Senne
npcs.info:
An old physician retired out of East City to a cottage on the coach road, who holds surgery here three mornings a week, driving in by pony trap with a bag of instruments gone dull. He is gentle, shrewd and by noon usually a little drunk. He sends what he cannot manage up to Pinako Rockbell, who sends what she cannot manage on to the city, and the town has learned to live with it.

**Speaking Style:** Cultured and slurred at the edges, a city doctor whose sentences trail off where the drink starts.
**Combat Role:** none; a scalpel he would never raise and a pony trap to flee in
**Relationship Hook:** An old doctor in a rumpled frock coat pouring a dose into a medicine glass, then drinking it himself.
personality: Core: gentle and shrewd; tells long stories that never reach the war; treats children for nothing and adults grudgingly
Quirk: drinks to steady his hands and they shake the worse for it

npcs.name: Aldous Weiche
npcs.info:
The signalman at the junction where the spur leaves the main line, an old railway man who lives in his box with a black-and-white dog. He keeps the levers polished, the bell oiled and a tally of every wagon that passes.

**Speaking Style:** Precise and kindly, an old signalman who measures his speech by the clock on the wall.
**Combat Role:** none; a signal lever and a dog that bites
**Relationship Hook:** An old signalman in his box writing in a tally book as an unlit train rolls past in the dark.
personality: Core: orderly and kind; never miscounts
Quirk: talks to his dog

npcs.name: Alex Louis Armstrong
npcs.info:
Major Alex Louis Armstrong, the Strong-Arm Alchemist, more than two metres of muscle with a bald head, a single blond curl and a blond moustache. He tears his shirt off when moved, which is often, sparkles faintly, and tells anyone who will listen about the techniques passed down the Armstrong line for generations. He is a gentle, sentimental man and a devastating fighter, who punches transmutation through steel gauntlets.

**Speaking Style:** A huge, booming voice full of flourish and feeling; he bursts into tears and into family history with equal ease.
**Combat Role:** Armstrong family martial arts and alchemy through spiked steel gauntlets, punching stone into a storm of fists
**Relationship Hook:** A giant bald major with a blond moustache, weeping openly and flexing at the same time.
personality: Core: loud, sentimental and generous; weeps openly at a sad story; never abandons a subordinate
Quirk: tears off his shirt when moved

npcs.name: Alexander
npcs.info:
The Tucker family's dog, an enormous white dog with a loud bark and a soft heart. He knocks visitors flat to say hello and follows Nina Tucker everywhere. He is the girl's playmate, guard and pillow, and he is happiest in a heap with her on the floor of the library.

**Speaking Style:** Deep, happy barks and a heavy panting; he woofs when he wants to play.
**Combat Role:** a big dog; he knocks a stranger down and stands over the child
**Relationship Hook:** A huge white dog bounding at a visitor in a house full of books.
personality: Core: huge, friendly and clumsy; jumps on every visitor; never leaves Nina's side
Quirk: growls at a raised voice

npcs.name: Alexandre
npcs.info:
Alexandre, an infantryman stationed in East City under Grumman, one of the survivors of Mustang's squad in the Ishval war, with a wife at home and a knack for explosives and guerrilla work.

**Speaking Style:** Easy and plain, a soldier who keeps his head and his jokes short.
**Combat Role:** sidearms, explosives and guerrilla tactics
**Relationship Hook:** A soldier coiling a fuse in the back of a truck on the road to Central.
personality: Core: easy and plain; handy with explosives; loyal to the old squad
Quirk: keeps his head

npcs.name: Alois Gmeiner
npcs.info:
The desk sergeant of the inner-district precinct, a grizzled man of fifty whose world is a book, a bell and a row of cells. He has charged drunks, pickpockets and colonels' sons in the same careful hand for twenty years and believes the book is the only thing that stands between the capital and a mob.

**Speaking Style:** Rough and patient, a desk sergeant who writes while he talks and never looks up.
**Combat Role:** a military policeman with a truncheon and a service revolver, slow to draw and steady when he does
**Relationship Hook:** A grizzled desk sergeant writing in a fat book under a hanging lamp, a ring of keys at his elbow.
personality: Core: honest, slow and dogged; trusts paper more than people; polite to everyone in the cells
Quirk: furious in silence

npcs.name: Alois Tremmel
npcs.info:
The signalman at the junction where the Resembool branch leaves the main eastern line, a thin old man who has pulled the same levers for thirty-one years and entered every train in his register in violet ink. He lives alone in the cottage by the box, keeps canaries and knows the drivers better than their wives do.

**Speaking Style:** Precise and slow, a signalman who reports even the weather like an entry in a register.
**Combat Role:** none; a signal lever, a hand lamp and a box with one stair
**Relationship Hook:** A thin old signalman writing in a register at a row of iron levers, a canary cage in the window.
personality: Core: precise and lonely; whistles to his canaries between trains
Quirk: writes everything down in violet ink

npcs.name: Alphonse Elric
npcs.info:
The younger Elric brother, fourteen, who has no body: he lives as a soul bound to a huge suit of armour. Strangers take him for the Fullmetal Alchemist and his brother for the assistant, which Al finds funny and Ed does not. He is gentle, a sharp alchemist in his own right, fond of stray cats he cannot keep, and the calm one of the two. The armour neither eats, sleeps nor feels, and he does his best not to let anyone see how much that hurts.

**Speaking Style:** A soft, careful boy's voice ringing out of a hollow metal shell, polite to a fault and quick to apologise; when he is frightened or hurt the armour echoes and his words go thin.
**Combat Role:** alchemy through the armour, circles drawn quickly in chalk or the dirt, and a martial artist's blocks and throws
**Relationship Hook:** A giant suit of armour kneeling to offer a stray cat a hand.
personality: Core: gentle and apologetic; says sorry before he has done anything; quiet when afraid, loud only for his brother; will not give up on someone, even one who has lied to him
Quirk: cannot walk past a stray cat

npcs.name: Amalie Steinmar
npcs.info:
The registrar of deaths at the town hall, a spare, grey-eyed woman of fifty in steel spectacles who writes every certificate in the city's best copperplate. She has kept the book of the dead for twenty years and can tell from the weight of a page which winter it was written in. She is courteous to every uniform and does exactly what the law says, which some of them find harder to bear than rudeness.

**Speaking Style:** Precise and quiet, a registrar who reads a question back to you before she answers it.
**Combat Role:** none; a book, the law and a clear voice in a public counter-room
**Relationship Hook:** A thin registrar in spectacles looking up from a vast book over a counter, pen held still.
personality: Core: exact, patient and unbending; reads every form twice, then once more aloud; will not sign what she has not seen
Quirk: treats a widow's question as more important than a major's

npcs.name: Ambros Imbach
npcs.info:
A grey-bearded alchemist from Central who has slept in the scholars' hall for a month, copying the carvings into books by lamplight. He sat the state examination thirty years ago, failed it, and has been proving the examiners wrong ever since.

**Speaking Style:** Dry and courtly, an old academic who quotes himself and enjoys it.
**Combat Role:** an old alchemist who transmutes the floor under a man's feet and then apologises
**Relationship Hook:** An old scholar copying carvings into a book by lamplight in front of empty stone shelves.
personality: Core: pompous and kind; quotes his own papers; lends his lamp to anyone who asks
Quirk: secretive about the back of the hall

npcs.name: Ambros Lenz
npcs.info:
The last clerk of the Old Customs House, kept on to look after the books after the border closed. He is thin, precise and devoted to his loft of trade books going back eighty years. He lets almost no one up the ladder.

**Speaking Style:** Dry and precise, an old clerk who corrects other people's dates.
**Combat Role:** none; the ladder and the trapdoor are his only defence
**Relationship Hook:** A thin old clerk holding a thick book in a dusty loft full of shelves.
personality: Core: precise and suspicious; corrects other people's dates
Quirk: devoted to his books

npcs.name: Ambros Mauthner
npcs.info:
The head porter of the Grand Meridian Hotel, a tall man in braided livery with a perfect parting and a little brass bell he never needs to ring. He can find a guest a doctor, a train seat, a dressmaker or a discreet way out at any hour, and he remembers every face that has crossed the marble.

**Speaking Style:** Silky and unhurried, a head porter who can make 'impossible' sound like 'of course'.
**Combat Role:** none; a porter who calls three large footmen and knows every service door in the hotel
**Relationship Hook:** A tall porter in braided livery bowing to a party of travellers in Xingese robes beneath a marble staircase.
personality: Core: smooth, discreet and greedy; never forgets a face or a tip; loyal to whoever pays last
Quirk: privately admires anyone who outwits him

npcs.name: Ambrose Furnival
npcs.info:
The owner of the Rush Valley Foundry, a short, scorched, barrel-chested man who started as a ladle boy in an iron town in the East and built the first furnace here with his own hands. He shouts above the roar of the casting floor all day and speaks in a near whisper everywhere else, as if he cannot remember how loud a room ought to be.

**Speaking Style:** Roars on the floor and whispers off it, a founder who has forgotten how loud an ordinary room is.
**Combat Role:** a foundryman's brawl; a long iron rake for reach and fists like hammers up close
**Relationship Hook:** A scorched founder bellowing orders across a casting floor while white metal pours into a mould.
personality: Core: shouts on the floor, whispers off it; rates men by their scars; counts losses before injuries and is ashamed of it after
Quirk: never stands with his back to a furnace

npcs.name: Ambrose Tull
npcs.info:
The manager of the gasworks is a tired, coal-grey man who has kept the city's lamps lit through every shortage the war has brought. He knows the retorts the way a farmer knows his cows, and he is harder on his stokers than on himself only because they are younger.

**Speaking Style:** Heavy and grumbling, a works manager who sighs between sentences as if each cost him coke.
**Combat Role:** a coke rake and the heat of the retort house; he would rather open a valve between himself and trouble
**Relationship Hook:** A soot-grey manager in a bowler hat squinting at a gauge in a glowing retort house.
personality: Core: sighs before every answer; proud of every lamp in West City; hard on his men and harder on himself
Quirk: keeps the burned stoker's wages paid out of his own pocket

npcs.name: Ambrus Hallam
npcs.info:
The oldest of the net-menders in the lofts on the west shore, a tiny bald man whose needle never stops and whose memory the town relies on for anything older than the railway. He has mended nets for sixty years and fished for fifty before that, he says, though nobody's arithmetic allows it.

**Speaking Style:** Thin and twinkling, an old man who tells every story twice and changes the ending the second time.
**Combat Role:** none; a net thrown over a man's head, which he can still do
**Relationship Hook:** A tiny old man mending a net with flying fingers, asking a stranger to hold the money for a bet.
personality: Core: never stops mending while he talks; remembers every boat and who drowned in it; bets on the underdog every time
Quirk: adds decades to his age

npcs.name: Amos Kell
npcs.info:
A retired coal miner who rings the bell at Youswell's chapel for every man the mine kills. His lungs are black from forty years underground, and he keeps the graveyard tidy for his old shift mates. He is grim, kind and stubborn, and the young miners come to him for advice they would not take from the foreman.

**Speaking Style:** Hoarse and low, an old miner's cough in every sentence; he speaks of the dead as if they were in the room.
**Combat Role:** none much; an old miner with a short pick and arms still like iron
**Relationship Hook:** An old miner pulling the chapel bell rope while the town gathers outside.
personality: Core: grim, kind and stubborn; rings the bell for every death; keeps the miners' graves
Quirk: coughs through every story

npcs.name: Anders Brecht
npcs.info:
The landlord of the Northern Inn in North City, a hearty man who runs the taproom and the rooms upstairs. He hears every rumour in the garrison's town and is a fair host to the soldiers and the travellers alike. He keeps the back room for people who do not want their names written down.

**Speaking Style:** Loud and hearty, an innkeeper who talks about his beer and his lodgers as if they were family.
**Combat Role:** none; a bar stool and a loud laugh
**Relationship Hook:** An innkeeper behind a bar pouring a tankard for a soldier and winking at a traveller.
personality: Core: loud, hearty and fair; talks about beer and lodgers as family; hears every rumour
Quirk: keeps a back room for quiet guests

npcs.name: Anneke Vogtland
npcs.info:
The dairy's daughter, sixteen, who turns the cheeses, scrubs the pails and mends everything on the farm with a screw or a spring in it, from the churn to her father's watch. She is cheerful, freckled and restless. Twice she has taken the cream separator apart and put it back better than it came.

**Speaking Style:** Quick and teasing, a dairy girl who hides every serious thought behind a joke.
**Combat Role:** none; a pair of pliers and a quick swing of a milk pail
**Relationship Hook:** A freckled dairy girl turning a cheese wheel, a train ticket half hidden behind it.
personality: Core: teasing and quick; takes things apart to see how they work; loves her father and is leaving him
Quirk: hums when she is lying

npcs.name: Anselm Duvall
npcs.info:
The priest of the brick chapel above the workshops, a lean, sunburnt man of forty-five who once got a whole street of smiths to stop hammering on rest days simply by asking, which the town still talks about. He keeps the pews, the bell and the young graveyard himself, and in the afternoons he walks the workshops blessing new limbs for any owner who wants it.

**Speaking Style:** Mild and unhurried, a priest who asks instead of telling and waits for the answer.
**Combat Role:** a medic's composure; he never strikes first, and disarms a man with a wrist lock learned from orderlies
**Relationship Hook:** A sunburnt priest in rolled sleeves splinting a smith's broken finger on the chapel step.
personality: Core: asks rather than tells, and is usually obeyed; blesses machines as gravely as people; never speaks of the east
Quirk: flinches at the smell of burning

npcs.name: Anselm Grieve
npcs.info:
The garrison chaplain has buried the West's dead for fourteen years, saying the same plain words over every patrol. He is no churchman of any creed in particular; the army made him a chaplain because he was the only officer who could talk to mothers without lying to them.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and unhurried, a chaplain who speaks of the dead as if they had just stepped out of the room.
**Combat Role:** he was an infantry officer once; a heavy cane and old reflexes, used only to keep a grieving man from hurting himself
**Relationship Hook:** An old chaplain in a black coat lighting a candle beneath torn regimental flags.
personality: Core: listens far more than he speaks; never says a dead man died bravely unless he knows it; lights a candle for each name he reads
Quirk: cannot throw a letter away

npcs.name: Anselm Kolb
npcs.info:
The oldest baker on Oven Street, whose family has fired the same brick oven for four generations. He is up at three, in bed by eight, and has never once let the barracks' quartermaster tell him how to bake rye.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and floury, a baker who talks the way dough rises, in his own time.
**Combat Role:** none; a long oven peel and a back like an ox
**Relationship Hook:** An old baker in a vaulted cellar, shoulder against a stack of flour sacks, lantern lifted toward a low door.
personality: Core: slow, stubborn and generous; never turns a hungry child from the door; argues with soldiers about bread as if it were law
Quirk: hums the same hymn while he kneads

npcs.name: Anselm Prutt
npcs.info:
A round, cheerful man in a check suit who says he buys coal for a foundry in the west and has waited a week for a meeting the lieutenant keeps putting off. He spends his days in the bath and the tavern, asks the miners about their wages and tips the porter far too well.

**Speaking Style:** Easy and friendly, a salesman's patter that slips into precise numbers when he forgets himself.
**Combat Role:** none; a sturdy umbrella and a talent for being somewhere else
**Relationship Hook:** A portly buyer in a towel doing sums on a steamed-up mirror with his finger.
personality: Core: jovial and patient; overtips everyone; never says which foundry
Quirk: writes figures on his cuff

npcs.name: Anselm Rade
npcs.info:
A private of twenty-two on the sun terrace, in a wheeled chair under a rug although his legs are sound. He was a signaller at Fotset. He sits very still, flinches at doors, and talks easily about anything except the war.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and slow, a soldier who chooses each word as if it might go off.
**Combat Role:** a signaller's pistol, long unused, and a soldier's instinct to drop flat
**Relationship Hook:** A gaunt young soldier in a wheeled chair on a sunny terrace, holding out a sealed letter.
personality: Core: very still; flinches at doors; kind to the other patients
Quirk: talks of anything but the war

npcs.name: Ansgar Weil
npcs.info:
The old priest of the Snowbell Chapel, who buries the north's dead and rings the bell by hand in snowstorms so lost travellers can find the town. He is frail, absent-minded and stubborn about the bell, which he says has saved more lives than the army.

**Speaking Style:** Thin and gentle, an old priest who speaks as though the snow were listening.
**Combat Role:** none; a heavy bell rope, and a crypt nobody knows the far end of
**Relationship Hook:** An old priest at the foot of a bell rope, looking up into the bell hood as though it had spoken.
personality: Core: frail, gentle and stubborn; rings the bell in every storm; forgets names but never faces
Quirk: keeps a candle for every stranger buried unnamed

npcs.name: Ansgar Wilk
npcs.info:
A road-mender who lives in a stone lean-to above the plank bridge and keeps the cliff road passable: shovelling scree after rain, re-lashing planks, driving new pegs for the rope rail. The Rush Valley shops pay him a little, Dominic LeCoulte pays him a little more, and he has not been down to the town in a year.

**Speaking Style:** One word where two would do, a mountain man whose silences say the rest.
**Combat Role:** a mountain man's footing; he fights on the ledge with a long-handled shovel and lets the drop do the rest
**Relationship Hook:** A bearded road-mender kneeling on a plank bridge over a ravine, lashing a board while the wind pulls at him.
personality: Core: answers in one word; trusts rope more than men; shares his fire with anyone who climbs this far
Quirk: tests every plank with his heel

npcs.name: Apollonia Pfennig
npcs.info:
Resembool's postmistress, a neat woman of middle years who sorts the mail, weighs the parcels and puts through every telephone call in and out of town by hand. She is helpful, discreet in manner and remarkably well informed. People say she would make a fine spy, and she laughs when they say it.

**Speaking Style:** Silky and confiding, a postmistress who lowers her voice as if every word were a sealed letter.
**Combat Role:** none; a letter knife and the telephone line to the police post
**Relationship Hook:** A neat postmistress behind a brass grille holding an envelope up to the lamp.
personality: Core: confiding and warm, always lowering her voice; files everything and forgets nothing; laughs off suspicion before it is spoken
Quirk: cannot bear an unopened mystery

npcs.name: Arkady Zhelvin
npcs.info:
A Drachman scout taken on the pass in the autumn, a lean man with a cropped head and a calm face who speaks better Amestrian than some of his guards. He keeps his cell neat, eats what he is given and asks for one thing: a word with the general herself.

**Speaking Style:** Even and courteous, in careful Amestrian with a soft northern roll on the r.
**Combat Role:** a trained Drachman scout; a knife from nowhere, a throw learned on ice, and a long patience before either
**Relationship Hook:** A calm prisoner sitting straight-backed on a cot, watching the hatch in his door as if he had an appointment.
personality: Core: calm to the point of insolence; folds his blanket with square corners; plays draughts so as to lose slowly
Quirk: answers Amestrian jokes with Drachman proverbs

npcs.name: Arne Vollmer
npcs.info:
A corporal of the bulkhead crew, whose whole duty is a steel door the height of three men, its hand wheel and a signature in the duty log. He has rolled the eastern bulkhead shut in drills so often that he could do it blindfold, which is how the lieutenant likes to test him.

**Speaking Style:** Plain and careful, a corporal who quotes the regulation first and then says what he actually thinks.
**Combat Role:** a rifleman who fights from cover; he puts the bulkhead between himself and the threat and shoots through the gap
**Relationship Hook:** A hollow-eyed corporal leaning on a giant hand wheel, a key on a chain against his chest.
personality: Core: polishes the hand wheel's spokes as other men polish boots; answers with the regulation and then the truth; hums marching tunes under his breath
Quirk: flinches at the rumble of the door's track

npcs.name: Arno Fiedler
npcs.info:
An army engineer lieutenant who walks the survey line in the cool hours behind a theodolite, setting a white stake every hundred paces toward the eastern haze. He is sunburnt, cheerful and obsessed with the flattest ground.

**Speaking Style:** Precise and dry, a surveyor who speaks in distances and bearings and enjoys it.
**Combat Role:** an engineer with a service revolver and a surveyor's rod; he would rather find cover than fight
**Relationship Hook:** A sunburnt lieutenant peering through a theodolite down a line of white stakes into the haze.
personality: Core: enthusiastic and exacting; measures everything, including his tea; sleeps under the cart at noon
Quirk: trusts his guide more than his orders

npcs.name: Arno Hatch
npcs.info:
The keeper of the Border Road inn, a thin, anxious man who runs a hearth room for travellers on the West City road. He lowers his voice whenever a uniform comes in, and he remembers every face at the table. He is careful and kind, and he would rather not be asked.

**Speaking Style:** Thin and anxious, an innkeeper who lowers his voice whenever a uniform walks in.
**Combat Role:** none; a poker and a locked back door
**Relationship Hook:** An anxious innkeeper pouring mugs in a hearth room while a patrol passes the window.
personality: Core: thin, anxious and careful; lowers his voice for uniforms; remembers every face
Quirk: would rather not be asked

npcs.name: Arnold Messer
npcs.info:
A private land surveyor from East City hired by the lieutenant to re-measure the boundaries of his holding. He is genial, well dressed and painstaking, and he has a surveyor's chain, a brass level and a boy to carry them.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth and genial, a land surveyor who makes a theft sound like a correction.
**Combat Role:** none; a surveyor's iron rod and a quick retreat downhill
**Relationship Hook:** A neat surveyor sighting through a brass level beside a hilltop cairn, a freshly dug hole at its base.
personality: Core: affable and patient; dresses too well for the hills
Quirk: lies with instruments rather than words

npcs.name: Arnulf Teschke
npcs.info:
The quartermaster's clerk who grades the town's wool for army uniforms, a bespectacled young corporal who spreads each farm's fleeces under the skylight, pulls them apart with great seriousness and writes a grade on a card. The whole town's year turns on that card. He knows it, and wishes he did not.

**Speaking Style:** Mild and careful, a clerk who reads out every figure twice to be sure.
**Combat Role:** an army pistol he has fired twice, both times on a range
**Relationship Hook:** A nervous young clerk in uniform holding a fleece up to the skylight as if it could tell him something.
personality: Core: earnest and nervous; apologises for orders he did not give; eats his lunch alone at the desk
Quirk: pulls fleeces apart to look busy

npcs.name: Arvid Ecker
npcs.info:
The headman of Maren Hamlet, a white-haired farmer with a patient manner and a good word for everyone. He settles the hamlet's disputes at the well every evening and speaks for it to the army. The families trust him because his grandfather was headman too.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and conciliating, a headman who answers a question with a story about his father.
**Combat Role:** none; an old man with a stick and the hamlet's respect
**Relationship Hook:** A white-haired headman leaning on a stick at a village well, surrounded by worried families.
personality: Core: patient and conciliating; answers with a story; ashamed of the field money
Quirk: loves the hamlet truly

npcs.name: Arvid Lenk
npcs.info:
A young private of the survey party who carries the staff along the theodolite line and sings to pass the time. He has been sent to bring back the deserted chainman, who is his friend, and is taking the long way round.

**Speaking Style:** Loose and easy, a young private who calls everyone 'mate' and means it.
**Combat Role:** a private with a rifle and plenty of nerve, fine in a line and lost alone
**Relationship Hook:** A lanky grinning private with a striped survey staff on his shoulder on a desert ridge.
personality: Core: easy-going and loyal; sings off key; would rather lie than turn in a friend
Quirk: afraid of the canal

npcs.name: Arvid Pennick
npcs.info:
The lifeguard of the bathing beach east of town, a tanned, handsome young man in a striped costume who sits on a tall chair with a megaphone and a whistle and is very good at blowing it. He hires out the striped huts, shouts the children back from the second post and is admired all summer by the visitors.

**Speaking Style:** Bright and booming through a megaphone, a lifeguard who sounds braver than he is.
**Combat Role:** none; a whistle, a megaphone and a long boat hook from the hut
**Relationship Hook:** A handsome lifeguard on his feet on a tall chair, whistle in his mouth, staring at a child far out in the water.
personality: Core: blows his whistle at everything; vain about his tan; brave on dry land
Quirk: lies about the people he has saved

npcs.name: Arvid Stoltz
npcs.info:
The depot chief at the Northern Quartermaster's Depot, a captain who counts every crate bound for the fort and signs for every one. He is heavy, careful and humourless, and he has never once been short on a count.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and even, a man who repeats the number you just said back to you as if checking it.
**Combat Role:** an officer with a revolver and a depot full of men who owe him; he stays behind crates and lets them fight
**Relationship Hook:** A heavy captain with a clipboard counting crates aloud in a cold tally shed.
personality: Core: heavy, careful and humourless; repeats every number twice; never short on a count
Quirk: very polite to the fort's clerks

npcs.name: Arvo Hakala
npcs.info:
A woodcutter who works the edge of Blackpine Wood and hauls his logs to the sawmill. He came back from the deep pines without his axe or his dog and has not said what happened.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and plain, a woodcutter who tells a story the same way every time.
**Combat Role:** none now; he had an axe, and he will need another
**Relationship Hook:** A woodcutter with empty hands standing at the edge of a dark pine wood, looking back into it.
personality: Core: slow and plain; tells stories the same way every time; loves his dog
Quirk: afraid of the deep pines

npcs.name: Asad Mirkhan
npcs.info:
A warrior priest of Ishvala in his forties, broad and silent, who sweeps the red flagstones of the Daliha plaza every morning and stands at its edge the rest of the day. He carries no weapon on holy ground and permits none.

**Speaking Style:** Low, even and immovable; he never raises his voice because he has never needed to.
**Combat Role:** the warrior priests' unarmed art; he takes the weapon, the balance and the will to fight in that order
**Relationship Hook:** A broad warrior priest standing at the edge of a swept red plaza, broom in hand, facing a patrol.
personality: Core: serene and absolute; sweeps the plaza before dawn; bows to soldiers and does not move
Quirk: refuses to carry a weapon on holy ground

npcs.name: Augustin Mehl
npcs.info:
The editor of North Herald Press, a big untidy man with ink to the elbows who prints the train times, the weather and the army's notices, and fights the censor for every line of anything else. He lost the fight more often than he won it, and he keeps score.

**Speaking Style:** Rough, warm and impatient, a man who talks in headlines and smokes between them.
**Combat Role:** none; a heavy composing stick and a press that can be locked from the inside
**Relationship Hook:** A big inky editor in a tiny cubby, chalking another mark on a wall already covered in them.
personality: Core: loud, kind and stubborn; smokes cheap cigars down to his fingers; keeps score against the censor in chalk on the wall
Quirk: cannot resist a story even when it will hurt him

npcs.name: Augustin Raddeck
npcs.info:
The senior clerk of the customs house, a pale sergeant in shirtsleeves who has sat under the slow ceiling fan for eleven years. He weighs every load and enters it in a neat hand, and he has never once raised his voice.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and dry, a clerk who sounds bored and misses nothing.
**Combat Role:** a desk sergeant with a service pistol in the drawer; he talks first and shoots from behind the counter
**Relationship Hook:** A pale clerk in sleeve garters writing in a book under a slow ceiling fan.
personality: Core: bored-sounding and sharp; never raises his voice; keeps two books
Quirk: fond of his ceiling fan

npcs.name: Augustin Varro
npcs.info:
The editor of the city's daily paper is a round, ink-fingered man who came west from Central City with ambitions and stayed for the war. He prints what the censor lets him and talks, loudly and in the tavern, about what he would print if he could.

**Speaking Style:** Fast and easy, a newspaperman who sounds amused by everything and is writing it down while he laughs.
**Combat Role:** none; a heavy composing stick and a talent for being somewhere else when the fists start
**Relationship Hook:** A stout editor with ink-black fingers grinning over a galley proof beside a rattling press.
personality: Core: talks loudly about what he cannot print; buys drinks for anyone with a story; brave in print and timid in person
Quirk: sleeps at the office more nights than at home

npcs.name: Aurel Lindqvist
npcs.info:
The lieutenant who holds the forward dugout keeps the field telephone, the maps and the trust of a company that has lost four lieutenants before him. He is young, quiet and very good at keeping men alive in a war that uses men up as fast as the trains bring them.

**Speaking Style:** Low and level, a front-line lieutenant who never raises his voice, even on the field telephone.
**Combat Role:** a trench fighter; revolver, entrenching tool and grenades, fighting in the dark in fours and fives the way the western army has learned
**Relationship Hook:** A young lieutenant holding a field telephone receiver in a dugout roofed with rail sleepers.
personality: Core: never raises his voice; learns the name of every new man the day he arrives; falsifies reports to save lives
Quirk: sleeps with the field telephone beside his head

npcs.name: Aurel Pashke
npcs.info:
A second lieutenant with a good family in Central and no wish to stay in the north. He is handsome, careful with his uniform and very good at telephoning the right office first. His men like him well enough, because he takes the blame for nothing and the credit for everything, and a little of the credit rubs off.

**Speaking Style:** Bright and polished, every word chosen for an audience that is not in the room.
**Combat Role:** a pistol-and-sabre officer; he leads from just behind the first man through the door and fires once, well
**Relationship Hook:** A polished lieutenant with a telephone receiver at his ear, already reaching for his gloves.
personality: Core: charming to superiors and cool to everyone else; rehearses his reports aloud; keeps his boots polished in a blizzard
Quirk: certain that the capital is watching

npcs.name: Aurelio Bassani
npcs.info:
The mayor of Sanvento, a hill-town lawyer of sixty with a silk cravat and a tired, kind face. He has kept his town fed and governed through three years of a war fought on its doorstep. The garrison thinks him soft; the townspeople think him a saint.

**Speaking Style:** Soft-spoken and courtly, an Aerugonian mayor who apologises in two languages.
**Combat Role:** none; a mayor's sash and a town that would hide him
**Relationship Hook:** A white-bearded mayor in a sash standing in a sunlit piazza, reading a letter.
personality: Core: courtly and tired; apologises too much; braver than he looks
Quirk: loves his town above his country

npcs.name: Aurelius Pfahler
npcs.info:
The editor of the city's daily paper, a stooped man with ink in the creases of his hands and a blue pencil always behind his ear. He prints what the garrison permits, writes the city's best obituaries and hides small truths in the advertisements and the weather column for readers clever enough to look. He has been warned twice and has never been closed.

**Speaking Style:** Measured and ironic, an editor who speaks as though every sentence will be printed and cut.
**Combat Role:** none; a stick to lean on, a printing press and the threat of a paragraph
**Relationship Hook:** A stooped editor in half-moon spectacles striking a line from a proof with a blue pencil, the press thundering below.
personality: Core: wry, tired and stubborn; loves the city and distrusts every government it has had; never throws a page away
Quirk: edits other people's speech while they are still talking

npcs.name: Aysel Tumar
npcs.info:
The warden of the eastbound cistern, a black-tent herder woman who works the stone lid with her two sons and makes every caravan scratch its tally on the wall before it drinks. Her family has kept the cistern for longer than any map has shown it.

**Speaking Style:** Hard and clear, a voice used to being obeyed at a waterhole.
**Combat Role:** a herder with a sling and a heavy staff who holds a narrow place
**Relationship Hook:** A tall herder woman with a heavy staff standing by a domed cistern covered in scratched tallies.
personality: Core: stern and fair; makes every caravan tally; rations without explaining
Quirk: trusts no townsman

npcs.name: Ayub Haddar
npcs.info:
An old Ishvalan herder who never left the land and moves through the thorn scrub with forty goats and a dog. He scratched half the waterhole marks in the scrub himself and reads the rest like a newspaper.

**Speaking Style:** Grumbling and sharp, an old herder who complains in proverbs.
**Combat Role:** an old herder with a staff and a sling; he can still crack a skull at thirty paces
**Relationship Hook:** An old herder crouching by a scratched stone at a seep, goats drinking around him.
personality: Core: grumpy and fair; counts the flock at every waterhole; never tells one family's water to another
Quirk: argues with his dog

npcs.name: Aziel Rahhad
npcs.info:
The eldest man in the slum by the outfall, a former potter from the eastern towns of Ishval who walked to the city with nothing but a clay lamp and the clothes he fled in. He sits under the open shelter in the evenings, settles quarrels over water, wood and children, and keeps the slum's one lamp burning so that nobody ever has to ask where to find him. He prays to Ishvala at dawn without hurry and expects the young ones to do the same.

**Speaking Style:** Low and unhurried, an elder who lets a silence sit until the other man fills it.
**Combat Role:** none; an elder's staff and the obedience of a few hundred people who would stand in front of him
**Relationship Hook:** An old Ishvalan with a white beard sitting under a lamp in a crate-wood shelter, waiting for the next quarrel.
personality: Core: speaks of Ishvala as of an old friend; lets the young talk themselves out before he answers; never says the word Amestrian with a hard edge, though he could
Quirk: patient and slow to judge

npcs.name: Azim
npcs.info:
An Ishvalan hide-scraper on Tanners' Lane, a quiet man who works the frames from dawn to dark for the lowest wage on the street. He wears a scarf over his face against the stench and, the tanners suspect, against being seen.

**Speaking Style:** Low, careful and courteous, an Ishvalan who chooses his words like a man crossing ice.
**Combat Role:** a hide-scraper with a curved scraping blade; quick and low, the habits of a boy who ran from a war
**Relationship Hook:** An Ishvalan with a scarf over his face scraping a hide on a wooden frame, glancing up the lane.
personality: Core: quiet and courteous; works harder than anyone on the lane; prays alone at dawn
Quirk: never gives his family name

npcs.name: Ba Tuoshan
npcs.info:
Master of the first relay on the western road, a bow-legged old courier who has ridden every stage to the desert edge and now saddles fresh horses for younger riders. The dispatch bell rings, and he has the next horse at the gate before the rider is in sight.

**Speaking Style:** A courier master's bark, short and hoarse from shouting riders out of the gate.
**Combat Role:** an old courier with a horseman's bow and a sabre; he shoots from the saddle and rides through
**Relationship Hook:** An old courier master turning a sealed dispatch bag over in his hands, a riderless horse steaming at the door.
personality: Core: has a fresh horse ready before the bell stops; bow-legged and proud of it; takes his cut and does not think about it
Quirk: grieves for a lost rider like a father

npcs.name: Bahadur Sarn
npcs.info:
The chief of the black-tent herders, a white-bearded man who receives strangers on the rug before his tent and offers milk before any question. His people have grazed the desert since before Amestris had a name.

**Speaking Style:** Slow, deep and formal; a chief who lets silence do half the talking.
**Combat Role:** an old herder with a long rifle and a camel stick, who fights from the saddle
**Relationship Hook:** A white-bearded herder chief sitting cross-legged on a rug before a black tent, offering a bowl of milk.
personality: Core: formal and hospitable; offers milk before questions; keeps the old routes secret
Quirk: grieves without showing it

npcs.name: Bai Lun
npcs.info:
A camel dealer from the eastern edge of the desert who sits by the brand fire with a long pipe and a white camel he swears once carried a prince of Xing. He sells and hires beasts to anyone, and he can tell at a glance whether a buyer has looked at a camel's feet.

**Speaking Style:** Easy and expansive; he praises his animals like poetry and his rivals' like a funeral.
**Combat Role:** a dealer with a camel goad and a quick shove into the nearest kneeling beast
**Relationship Hook:** A heavy-set dealer smoking a long pipe by a branding fire, a white camel kneeling behind him.
personality: Core: boastful and shrewd; spits on every deal; loves his animals
Quirk: sizes up a buyer by their boots

npcs.name: Baldur Haskett
npcs.info:
The farrier and smith, a huge soot-black man who shoes the carthorses, mends the ploughs and, when Rockbell Automail runs short of a fitting, hammers that out too, complaining all the while that it is clockmaker's work. He can hold a carthorse's hind hoof on his knee for an hour. Under the grumbling he admires Winry's work above anything made in the town.

**Speaking Style:** Rough and grumbling, a farrier who talks kindly to horses and to people as if they were horses.
**Combat Role:** a smith's heavy hammer and arms that can lift a cart's tail; slow, crushing blows
**Relationship Hook:** A huge soot-black smith grumbling as he hammers a small steel fitting on the anvil.
personality: Core: gentle with horses; too proud to ask for help; works his anger out on the anvil
Quirk: grumbles at everything and does it anyway

npcs.name: Barnabas Hufner
npcs.info:
The ostler of the pit ponies, a small bow-legged man who knows each pony's name, temper and favourite apple. He sleeps in the loft when one is ill and has cried over more ponies than men.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and low, an ostler who speaks to people the way he speaks to frightened ponies.
**Combat Role:** none; a pitchfork he would never use on a man
**Relationship Hook:** A small ostler standing between a grey pony and a man with a pistol.
personality: Core: gentle and stubborn; trusts animals over men
Quirk: hides what he loves

npcs.name: Barnaby Quell
npcs.info:
The keeper of the toll house at the foot of the climb to Rush Valley, a lean man with a drooping moustache and a book for anything with wheels. He lifts the striped pole for carts that pay, waves walkers round it, and knows every carter on the road by name, load and temper. His shotgun hangs on two nails above the stove and has not come down in years.

**Speaking Style:** Dry and drawling, a toll keeper who answers slowly and writes while he talks.
**Combat Role:** an old shotgun he has not fired in years and the barrier pole dropped across a cart's path
**Relationship Hook:** A toll keeper raising a striped pole for a cart, writing its name down before it has passed.
personality: Core: writes before he speaks; loyal to carters, careful with soldiers; keeps the stove lit in every weather
Quirk: pulls at his moustache when lying

npcs.name: Barnaby Quist
npcs.info:
The brewer of the city's brown beer is a big, glad-handed man who knows every tavern keeper in the West and sends a barrel to the garrison at every holiday. He tests every brew himself and is rarely entirely sober after noon.

**Speaking Style:** Rich and jovial, a brewer's booming welcome that always sounds as if a drink is coming.
**Combat Role:** a cooper's mallet and a big man's bulk; he swings slow and hits like a falling barrel
**Relationship Hook:** A huge bearded brewer raising a tasting cup beside gleaming copper vats.
personality: Core: booming and generous; tests every vat, often twice; remembers every tavern keeper's children
Quirk: turns grey and quiet when the border is mentioned

npcs.name: Bartel Strass
npcs.info:
The head pourer on the foundry's casting floor, a giant who can lift a full ladle with two other men and has the burn scars to prove it. He is loud, fearless and loved by the men, who would follow him into the cupola if he asked.

**Speaking Style:** Huge and booming, a foundryman who shouts over the roar of the cupola even in a quiet room.
**Combat Role:** a foundryman brawler with an iron ladle and hands that do not feel heat; he swings like a hammer and does not stop
**Relationship Hook:** A giant foundryman with burn-scarred arms tipping a glowing ladle into a mould.
personality: Core: loud and fearless; carries the heaviest ladle; loved by every man on the floor
Quirk: cannot bear to see a man hurt

npcs.name: Bartholomew Sedge
npcs.info:
A retired railway clerk from South City who rows out to Yock Island every week in fine weather to sketch the birds of the crags, and has filled eleven notebooks with gulls, cormorants and one owl he is very proud of. He brings a field glass, a folding stool and enough sandwiches for a regiment, and the foxes know it.

**Speaking Style:** Fussy and delighted, a retired clerk who describes birds as if reading out a timetable.
**Combat Role:** none; a folding stool, a field glass and a quick retreat down the ridge path
**Relationship Hook:** A plump old man on a folding stool on a windy crag, sketching a cormorant and shouting at a fox.
personality: Core: names every bird by its proper name and every person by their hat; shares food with anyone and anything; precise about dates
Quirk: too polite to interfere and ashamed of it

npcs.name: Basque Grand
npcs.info:
Brigadier General Basque Grand, the Iron Blood Alchemist, a huge, bald veteran of the Ishval war with a black pointed handlebar moustache and a scar on his chin. He is a master of hand-to-hand combat who fights through transmutation gauntlets, turning the ground into iron weapons and cannons, and he leads from the front.

**Speaking Style:** A loud, confident, barrack-yard voice that leads from the front and fears nothing.
**Combat Role:** iron blood alchemy through transmutation gauntlets, the ground turned into blades and cannon, and expert hand-to-hand
**Relationship Hook:** A huge bald general rolling up his sleeves in a dark street to face a killer.
personality: Core: proud and fearless; leads from the front; respects a brave enemy
Quirk: no lover of senseless killing

npcs.name: Bastian Reuss
npcs.info:
An old corporal with no legs below the knee, the veranda's card champion and loudest critic of every general since the war began. He has lived at the home for six years and can tell any visitor the exact spot on the border where he was hit.

**Speaking Style:** Cracked and argumentative, an old corporal who refights every battle over the card table.
**Combat Role:** a cane swung from a wheeled chair, and a corporal's eye for where a man is weakest
**Relationship Hook:** An old legless corporal in a wheeled chair slapping down a card on a veranda table.
personality: Core: argues with everyone and enjoys it; cheats at cards and dares you to prove it; talks about the war constantly and about his family never
Quirk: kind to new arrivals in a gruff way

npcs.name: Bastl Kurrat
npcs.info:
A railway porter with a trolley and a brass number on his cap who meets the New Optain trains and carries the better passengers' cases to the cab rank. He is round-shouldered, slow and well liked, and he lights the waiting room stove on cold mornings without being asked. The soldiers guarding the platform let him through every barrier because he has never given them a reason not to.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and amiable, a porter who calls every traveller 'chief' and never quite looks them in the eye.
**Combat Role:** a strong pair of shoulders, a luggage trolley and a knife he has never used on a man
**Relationship Hook:** A round-shouldered porter wheeling a trolley of cases along a smoky platform, touching his cap to a soldier.
personality: Core: mild and unhurried; never asks a question he does not need answered
Quirk: touches his cap whenever he is nervous

npcs.name: Benedikt Voss
npcs.info:
A licensed gunsmith on the market street, broad and soft-spoken, who repairs the garrison's service rifles under contract and sells pistols to civilians with papers. He keeps his book chained to the counter and his licence framed by the door. He tests every repair himself in the cellar and has never had a gun come back.

**Speaking Style:** Level and patient, a gunsmith who never hurries a sentence any more than a trigger.
**Combat Role:** an expert with any firearm in the shop; he shoots from behind the counter and does not miss
**Relationship Hook:** A broad gunsmith cleaning a revolver at a glass counter, a book chained beside his elbow.
personality: Core: slow-spoken and patient; respects tools more than ideas
Quirk: will not sell a gun to a drunk or an angry man

npcs.name: Bernd Oswalt
npcs.info:
The captain who commands the Pendleton garrison posts the casualty list on the victory column each morning and has it taken down before evening, as ordered. He is a career infantryman, square and grey, who has held the town through three winters and hates it more each one.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped and hoarse, a town commandant who reads lists aloud in a voice scraped thin by doing it.
**Combat Role:** a hardened infantry captain; revolver and sabre, fighting from rubble and doorways with his men around him
**Relationship Hook:** A grey-moustached captain pinning a long list to a chipped stone column in a ruined square.
personality: Core: reads every name on the list before he posts it; obeys orders to the letter and resents the letter; never sits down in front of his men
Quirk: drinks alone, once a week, and never more

npcs.name: Bernhard Ostrow
npcs.info:
The mayor of North City, a portly, well-meaning man who holds office because the northern command finds him easy to work with. He opens bridges, judges the winter cake contest and signs whatever is put in front of him after reading the first line.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and courteous, a man who agrees with everything he is told by anyone in uniform.
**Combat Role:** none; he will stand between a crowd and a soldier if no one else will, and then not know what to say
**Relationship Hook:** A portly mayor in a gold chain, signing a paper while looking anxiously at the door.
personality: Core: genial and indecisive; remembers every child's name in the lower town; agrees with the last officer who spoke
Quirk: polishes his chain of office when nervous

npcs.name: Berthe Ashcombe
npcs.info:
Landlady of the town's one inn, a broad, handsome woman of fifty who serves the shearers in season, the drovers out of it and anyone off the evening train who looks able to pay. She keeps a clean house and an honest measure, and looks hard at every stranger's footwear. Good boots get the front room. Poor boots pay first.

**Speaking Style:** Brisk and appraising, a landlady who prices a man by his boots before he opens his mouth.
**Combat Role:** a short oak club from behind the bar and a landlady's elbows
**Relationship Hook:** A broad landlady leaning over the bar to look at a stranger's boots.
personality: Core: fond of rough men and short with smooth ones; keeps a stout club behind the bar and has used it; softer than she looks with the wounded
Quirk: judges by boots

npcs.name: Bertil Sennholz
npcs.info:
A stonecutter who carves the lettering on Resembool's headstones and digs the graves that go under them. He works at a bench beneath the lychgate with a mallet and a set of chisels worn short, and sits so still between strokes that sparrows land beside him. Every name on the hill for thirty years has passed under his chisel, the plain stone at the top among them.

**Speaking Style:** Few words, all of them slow; a stonecutter who answers a question after you have stopped expecting it.
**Combat Role:** a mallet and a cold chisel, held the way a man holds tools and not weapons
**Relationship Hook:** An old stonecutter tapping a letter into a fresh headstone under a little roofed gate.
personality: Core: measures everything twice; kinder to the dead than to their visitors; keeps his chisels sharper than anyone needs
Quirk: silent for long stretches, then exact

npcs.name: Bertram Dorrance
npcs.info:
The eldest of four brothers who work three adits on the mountainside, a slab-shouldered miner with grey dust ground into every line of his face. The family sells iron and a little nickel to the foundry below, and his sons, nephews and two daughters-in-law all push the carts. He trusts a timber prop more than a contract, and both more than a stranger.

**Speaking Style:** Gravel and dust, a miner who spits before he answers and means every word he finally says.
**Combat Role:** a miner's brawl; a short pick held close to the head and the strength of thirty years at the face
**Relationship Hook:** A dust-grey miner standing at a timbered tunnel mouth, counting his sons as they come out.
personality: Core: spits before he answers a question; will not go into the dark without a candle lit; drives a hard bargain with the foundry and pays his own fairly
Quirk: counts his family at every change of shift

npcs.name: Bertram Holz
npcs.info:
The sergeant of the guardhouse, a tired soldier near the end of his twenty years who wants to go home to a farm near East City and nothing else. He has kept the peace in Youswell by not looking at things, and he is very good at it.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and sparing, a sergeant who answers a question with a shrug and a grunt.
**Combat Role:** a sergeant's bayonet drill, slow but sure
**Relationship Hook:** A grey sergeant at a guardhouse table, sliding an order under a pile of playing cards.
personality: Core: tired and decent; plays cards badly on purpose; counts the days to his pension
Quirk: loses orders he dislikes

npcs.name: Bertram Kohl
npcs.info:
The yardmaster of the capital's freight yard, who decides which wagon goes where and which engine pulls it. He has run the yard since before the Ishval war and has moved every army the capital has sent out. He is dry, patient and impossible to rush, and his word moves more trains than any general's.

**Speaking Style:** Deep and dry, a yardmaster who answers every complaint with the timetable.
**Combat Role:** none; a yardmaster with a whistle, a lamp and a hundred railwaymen
**Relationship Hook:** A yardmaster with a lantern directing an engine in a cloud of steam.
personality: Core: dry and patient; lives by the timetable; cannot be rushed
Quirk: notes every sealed wagon

npcs.name: Bertram Lusk
npcs.info:
The sergeant major of the garrison, a barrel-chested veteran who grows tomatoes and onions in a reed-fenced plot out behind the latrines, from seed posted to him from Resembool, and who inspects his tomatoes with more care than his men. The men guard the garden more keenly than the gate, because he feeds them from it.

**Speaking Style:** Rich and gruff, a sergeant major's parade voice turned gentle for his tomatoes.
**Combat Role:** a veteran infantryman with a rifle and bayonet; steady, unflashy and very hard to move
**Relationship Hook:** A barrel-chested sergeant major kneeling among tomato vines with a trowel.
personality: Core: gruff and kindly; feeds the garrison from his garden; will not discuss why he asked for Ishval
Quirk: inspects the tomatoes every morning before the men

npcs.name: Beshir Tamal
npcs.info:
A boy of ten who runs messages for the camp and keeps watch from the tallest column, waving a red rag when strangers appear on the horizon. He was too small to remember Ishval when the camp left it, and talks about it as if he grew up there.

**Speaking Style:** Breathless and eager, a boy who reports everything as if it were urgent.
**Combat Role:** none; a boy who climbs out of reach and shouts
**Relationship Hook:** A small boy on top of a broken column waving a red rag at the horizon.
personality: Core: eager and talkative; climbs anything; keeps promises too well
Quirk: copies Faris Nadeem's scowl

npcs.name: Bian Shouren
npcs.info:
The keeper of the hill shrine to the Philosopher of the West, an old alkahestrist who sweeps the paper circles from the altar each dawn and burns them with a prayer. He holds firmly that the sage was a tall, fair-haired man with a beard, and he will argue it with anyone.

**Speaking Style:** Mild and wandering, an old keeper whose stories set off for one place and arrive at another.
**Combat Role:** none; a broom, a shrine bell and the hill's long steps behind him
**Relationship Hook:** An old keeper sweeping a heap of folded paper circles from a low altar in the early light.
personality: Core: sweeps the altar at dawn and burns the circles with a prayer; tells a story the long way round; argues about the sage's hair with real heat
Quirk: kind to pilgrims and stern with novices

npcs.name: Bido
npcs.info:
A small, bald man in a beggar's cloak who watches strangers for Greed and runs back with the news. Under the cloak he has a gecko's tail and sticky pads on his hands and feet, and he can run straight up a wall. He is cowardly, jumpy and devoted to the gang that took him in.

**Speaking Style:** A nervous, wheedling voice that babbles when scared and simpers when spoken to kindly.
**Combat Role:** none worth a fight; he climbs walls and runs
**Relationship Hook:** A small cloaked beggar clinging to a wall above the street, tail twitching under his rags.
personality: Core: cowardly and jumpy; devoted to Greed's gang; always first to run, last to forget
Quirk: babbles when frightened

npcs.name: Bilqis Tamar
npcs.info:
A girl of twelve from the refugee camp who has made the broken colonnade of Daliha her own. She climbs the fallen columns, names each capital after a bird and keeps watch for the priests, who pretend not to know she is there.

**Speaking Style:** Bright and quick, a girl's voice that turns everything into a game or a song.
**Combat Role:** none; she is up a column and gone before anyone can reach her
**Relationship Hook:** A small girl perched on a broken column, swinging her bare feet over a ruined plaza.
personality: Core: fearless and cheerful; names everything after birds; pretends to be lost when soldiers pass
Quirk: carries messages in her braid

npcs.name: Black Hayate
npcs.info:
A black and white shiba puppy who lives with Lieutenant Hawkeye and goes everywhere the unit goes. Fuery found him in the rain and nobody else would take him, so Hawkeye did, named him and housebroke him with warning shots. He is now the most obedient dog in the army and the unit's mascot.

**Speaking Style:** Animal noises only, never a word: a happy yap, a low growl at strangers, a whine when Riza leaves.
**Combat Role:** a small dog's bite and rush, aimed where an enemy cannot reach
**Relationship Hook:** A black and white puppy sitting perfectly straight beside a lieutenant's boots.
personality: Core: obedient to Riza above all; growls at strangers; jumps on people he is told not to
Quirk: loves the whole unit except the man who fears him

npcs.name: Bobby
npcs.info:
Bobby, one of the skilled engineers who keep Fort Briggs working in the cold, a practical man in a baseball cap who knows every pipe and pump in the fortress by its sound.

**Speaking Style:** Gruff and practical, an engineer who listens to machines more than men.
**Combat Role:** none; a wrench and a quick exit
**Relationship Hook:** An engineer with his ear to a giant pipe, frowning.
personality: Core: gruff and practical; proud of the fort's machines; no time for fools
Quirk: listens to the pipes

npcs.name: Bodo Hennecke
npcs.info:
The depot's farrier-sergeant, a bow-legged old cavalryman with forearms like hams who shoes the eastern patrols' horses by the dozen. He has worked the same forge for twenty years and judges officers by how they treat a lame horse. He likes the dealers who come in from the farms and dislikes the captain who buys from them.

**Speaking Style:** Gruff and gravelly, a farrier who speaks between hammer blows and lets the hammer finish his sentences.
**Combat Role:** a farrier's hammer and the strength to lift a horse's leg all day; he fights like he works, short and heavy
**Relationship Hook:** An old farrier with a grey beard holding a horse's hoof between his knees in a smoky forge.
personality: Core: gruff with men and gentle with horses; spits on the anvil for luck; keeps quiet until he is very angry
Quirk: never trusts a man who will not hold a hoof for him

npcs.name: Bram Holt
npcs.info:
The sergeant of the Amestrian post on the Creta border, a fence of wire and sandbags with a gate for patrols and traders. He has served the western line for ten years and has the scars to show it. He is hard, nervous and quick to draw, and he trusts no one who comes from the other side.

**Speaking Style:** Hard and short, a sergeant who talks like he is under fire even when he is not.
**Combat Role:** a soldier with a rifle behind sandbags; he holds the line and calls the guns
**Relationship Hook:** A scarred sergeant crouched behind sandbags with his rifle trained on a hillside.
personality: Core: hard and nervous; quick to draw; distrusts everyone from the west
Quirk: loyal to his squad

npcs.name: Bren Tolley
npcs.info:
A smuggler in the ruined market cellars of Fotset, who moves goods and people through the tunnels under the broken town. He is quiet, careful and pragmatic, and he works for both the Aerugo army and the people who pay in silver. He knows every tunnel that the garrison has forgotten.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and careful, a smuggler who speaks only when the cellar door is shut.
**Combat Role:** none; a knife and a tunnel's silence
**Relationship Hook:** A smuggler in a cellar lit by a lantern, showing a map to a shadowy figure.
personality: Core: quiet and careful; speaks only when the door is shut; sells the tunnels to whoever pays
Quirk: knows the forgotten tunnels

npcs.name: Brigid Callan
npcs.info:
The quarry master of Greyface Quarry inherited the pit from her father and has run it for ten years with a crew of hard men who would not take orders from anyone else. She reads stone like a geologist and swears like a sapper.

**Speaking Style:** Low and level, a quarry master who gives orders in a voice made for being heard over blasting.
**Combat Role:** a quarry hammer and a blasting cap; she clears ground fast and from a distance
**Relationship Hook:** A tall grey-haired quarry master with a hammer on her shoulder before a grey cliff hung with ropes.
personality: Core: blunt, fair and tough; reads stone by touch; protects her crew above all
Quirk: has no patience for officers who do not know rock

npcs.name: Brita Haugen
npcs.info:
The mother of the goat steading, a strong grey woman who runs the farm, the cheese cellar and her younger children with the same level calm. She sells milk to the fort's kitchen and has never once asked the soldiers about her eldest son, which they find harder than any question.

**Speaking Style:** Calm and level, a farm mother who never wastes a word and never raises her voice.
**Combat Role:** a farm mother with a long-handled axe and a dog; she fights from her own doorway
**Relationship Hook:** A grey-haired farm woman lighting an oil lamp in a frosted window, eyes on the dark slope.
personality: Core: never asks a question she does not want answered; lights the window lamp at dusk without fail; feeds every soldier who comes for the milk
Quirk: counts the goats twice when she is worried

npcs.name: Brother Tobin
npcs.info:
The sexton of the Church of Leto in Reole, who keeps the nave swept, the candles lit and the crypt locked. He knows the church better than Cornello does and has heard more confessions than the preacher has. He is not a believer and never says so. He keeps the keys and asks nothing.

**Speaking Style:** Dry and grumbling, a sexton who speaks with the bored patience of a man who has cleaned the same floor for twenty years.
**Combat Role:** none; he has a lamp, a broom and a bunch of keys
**Relationship Hook:** A sexton with a ring of keys, sweeping the nave and watching who comes in.
personality: Core: dry, tired and loyal to his keys; asks no questions and remembers every answer; complains about the stairs and the damp
Quirk: never says what he believes

npcs.name: Brunhild Aalsen
npcs.info:
The grandmother of the eel-fishing family at the weir, older than anyone can reckon, who sits in the smoking shed splitting eels and hanging them over the oak-chip fire. Her family worked the weir before Resembool had a station. She sings river songs nobody else knows and takes snuff at the worst moments.

**Speaking Style:** Thin and singsong, an old eel-wife who half tells and half sings what she remembers.
**Combat Role:** none; an eel knife and a voice that carries over water
**Relationship Hook:** A tiny old woman singing in a smoke shed, a green identity tag hanging among the eels.
personality: Core: singsong and sharp; remembers too much; laughs at the living and talks to the dead
Quirk: takes snuff at the worst moments

npcs.name: Brutus and Barker
npcs.info:
A pair of Rush Valley hustlers who run an arm-wrestling challenge in the street: Brutus, with two huge, powerful automail arms, takes on all comers, and Barker, with his pointed sideburns, takes the entry fees and goads passers-by into trying.

**Speaking Style:** Barker's patter, loud and goading, and Brutus's boasting grunt.
**Combat Role:** arm-wrestling and brawling with two huge automail arms
**Relationship Hook:** Two hustlers at an arm-wrestling table in the street, one with giant steel arms.
personality: Core: loud and boastful; proud of the arms; sore losers
Quirk: goad anyone with automail

npcs.name: Buccaneer
npcs.info:
Captain Buccaneer of Fort Briggs, a bear of a man with a mohawk and a braided ponytail and an automail right arm that he changes for each job: a chainsaw with a crushing jaw or a hand of diamond-tipped claws. He strikes first and asks questions later, distrusts strangers and is loyal to Olivier to the death. He is the fort's loudest automail enthusiast.

**Speaking Style:** A bear's roar of a voice, rough and loud, that talks about prey and predators and laughs like a landslide.
**Combat Role:** cold-climate combat automail, a chainsaw arm or a clawed hand, and a bear's strength
**Relationship Hook:** A huge soldier with a mohawk revving a chainsaw arm in the snow.
personality: Core: abrasive and suspicious of strangers; talks in animal metaphors; loyal to Olivier unto death
Quirk: proud of his automail

npcs.name: Burkhard Lohse
npcs.info:
Shed foreman of the roundhouse, a wiry, soot-faced man with a grease-black notebook who can name any engine on the eastern lines by the note of its whistle a mile off. He is proud of his fitters and his turntable and furious, often, at the army, which treats his engines like mules and his timetables like suggestions.

**Speaking Style:** Quick and proud, a shed foreman who talks about his locomotives like a trainer talks about racehorses.
**Combat Role:** a wiry fitter with a heavy spanner and a soot-black fist, quick and dirty
**Relationship Hook:** A soot-faced foreman with a spanner standing on a turntable before a hissing locomotive.
personality: Core: proud, quick and angry; loves engines more than people and admits it; swears at the army in front of officers
Quirk: writes everything in a notebook he lets nobody read

npcs.name: Burkhard Wachter
npcs.info:
