The master of Greywall Quarry, a giant of a man with stone dust in every crease, who has cut the blocks that mend the wall for twenty summers. In winter he minds the powder store for the garrison and grumbles that dynamite is wasted on soldiers.

**Speaking Style:** A huge rumbling voice, grumbling without pause and never once unkind to his crew.
**Combat Role:** a quarryman's brawl; a sledgehammer swung two-handed and a fist like a block of granite
**Relationship Hook:** A huge dust-grey quarryman resting a sledgehammer on his shoulder, frowning at a block the size of a cottage.
personality: Core: measures stone with his hand span; grumbles constantly and works harder than anyone; lets nobody but himself light a fuse
Quirk: eats lunch sitting on a block

npcs.name: Cao Sihua
npcs.info:
Head reeler of the silk sheds, a grandmother who has drawn thread off boiled cocoons for fifty years and can tell a worm's health from the sound of the racks. She rules the reeling room with a ladle and a laugh.

**Speaking Style:** Brisk and grandmotherly, scolding and comforting in the same breath.
**Combat Role:** none; a ladle of boiling water and fifty years of nobody arguing with her
**Relationship Hook:** An old reeler drawing a shining thread off a cocoon in a steaming basin, her ear turned to the racks.
personality: Core: listens to the racks like music; scolds and comforts in one breath; never wears the silver comb
Quirk: trusts the worms more than the owners

npcs.name: Carl Brenner
npcs.info:
A veteran of the Ishval war who keeps the bar at the Veterans' Hall in East City and pours for men who served beside him. He lost two fingers and most of his sleep in the desert. He is gruff and generous, and he keeps the peace between drunk men who have more to forget than they have money.

**Speaking Style:** Rough and slow, a veteran who talks to his glass as much as to you.
**Combat Role:** an old soldier with a cudgel kept under the bar; he hits once and hard
**Relationship Hook:** A grey veteran polishing a glass behind a bar, under a wall of old medals.
personality: Core: gruff and generous; keeps the peace among veterans; never talks about the war
Quirk: stands for Grumman's toast

npcs.name: Casimir Dulk
npcs.info:
The man behind the counter of the only store the lieutenant allows, keeper of the brass scales and the chained debt book. He is thin, pale and sorry about everything, and he weighs flour with a thumb that never quite leaves the pan.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and regretful, a shopman who sighs before every lie.
**Combat Role:** none; he ducks behind the counter and shouts for the guard
**Relationship Hook:** A thin shopman sighing over a chained book while a widow jabs her finger at a line in it.
personality: Core: apologetic and immovable; afraid of the lieutenant and of the miners in equal measure; keeps a second book for his own safety
Quirk: thumb on the scale

npcs.name: Casimir Lode
npcs.info:
The mayor's deputy, who runs the permit counter at city hall and decides who may open a shop, a stall or a workshop in North City. He is neat, pleasant and always sorry that the form you need has just run out.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth and regretful, a man who sighs over rules as if they pained him personally.
**Combat Role:** none; a locked drawer, a friend at headquarters and a door at the back
**Relationship Hook:** A neat clerk at a counter raising a rubber stamp, then setting it down with a sorry little sigh.
personality: Core: polite and endlessly regretful; keeps his desk spotless; always has a sweet for a petitioner's child
Quirk: remembers who paid and who did not

npcs.name: Cathrine Elle Armstrong
npcs.info:
The youngest Armstrong daughter, a dainty, beautiful young woman with long blonde hair and the family's single curl and long lashes. She plays the piano, receives suitors and is the picture of a well-bred young lady, and, like every Armstrong, she is monstrously strong: she can pick up the piano and throw it at an intruder without mussing her hair.

**Speaking Style:** Sweet, light and well-bred, a debutante's voice; it never changes, even while she is lifting a piano.
**Combat Role:** none she would call fighting; an Armstrong's strength used to throw furniture
**Relationship Hook:** A dainty blonde girl at a piano, who lifts it without effort when a stranger bursts in.
personality: Core: sweet and polite; plays the piano beautifully; devoted to her family
Quirk: monstrously strong without noticing

npcs.name: Cen Yaqi
npcs.info:
A girl of fourteen who turns the pepper charges on the drying racks and has cried through every shift since she was hired, because the shed makes everyone cry. She is cheerful about it and says her eyes are the cleanest in the city.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and nasal behind a wet mask, apologising before every sentence.
**Combat Role:** none; she knows how to break a pepper shell under a man's nose and run
**Relationship Hook:** A small girl with streaming eyes turning paper shells on a drying rack, humming behind her mask.
personality: Core: cheerful through streaming eyes; hums while she turns the shells; frightened of the foreman and fond of him
Quirk: the kind of honest that shows on her face

npcs.name: Chang Boqin
npcs.info:
An elder of the Chang clan who keeps the ancestor tablets and the clan's dignity, the second rather better than the first. Every caller is received in the narrow tablet room with tea brewed from the same leaves three times and an apology for nothing in particular.

**Speaking Style:** Courteous to the point of pain, each sentence bowing twice before it reaches its meaning.
**Combat Role:** an old court swordsman who has not drawn in twenty years; one clean cut from a seated bow, and then he is out of breath
**Relationship Hook:** An old man in a faded red robe bowing over a cup of thin tea before a wall of ancestor tablets.
personality: Core: bows lower to callers than his rank requires; dusts the tablets every morning himself; speaks of the princess as if she were due home for supper
Quirk: never says the word money

npcs.name: Chang Suyin
npcs.info:
A young warrior of the poor Chang clan who has sat on the cloud stair for nine days, in mist and rain, waiting for the hermit to teach her. She is thin, wet, stubborn and cheerful about all three.

**Speaking Style:** Bright and stubborn, cheerful through cold and hunger and a little too loud for the mountain.
**Combat Role:** a young Chang fighter with a short staff and a few kunai; game, quick, untrained
**Relationship Hook:** A wet young warrior sitting cross-legged on a misty stone stair, grinning stubbornly up into the cloud.
personality: Core: cheerful in the rain; talks to herself on the stair to keep warm; proud of being a Chang
Quirk: refuses every offer of a blanket

npcs.name: Chang Xu
npcs.info:
An elder of the small and poor Chang clan, who keeps the clan's hall in the capital and its accounts with the court. He is formal, careful and old, and he worries about the clan every hour of the day. He counts the days since the clan's princess crossed the desert.

**Speaking Style:** Formal and thin, an old elder whose courtesy cannot hide his worry.
**Combat Role:** an old man with a pulse healer's hands and a few loyal guards
**Relationship Hook:** An old clan elder standing in a modest hall, looking west toward the desert.
personality: Core: formal and careful; worries constantly; proud of the small clan
Quirk: counts the days since the princess left

npcs.name: Charlie
npcs.info:
Sergeant Charlie, a veteran of the Ishval war stationed in East City under Grumman, with lines shaved into his hair and streaks like lightning bolts. He served in Mustang's squad and still calls the column of fire that went before them a flame of trust. He is a family man and an expert with explosives.

**Speaking Style:** A sergeant's bark, rough and cheerful, that threatens a cornered enemy and comforts him in the same breath.
**Combat Role:** sidearms, explosives and guerrilla tactics
**Relationship Hook:** A sergeant with lightning-bolt streaks in his hair lighting a fuse under a bridge.
personality: Core: rough and cheerful; loyal to Mustang; a family man
Quirk: an expert with explosives

npcs.name: Chen Gu
npcs.info:
A porter on the Eastern Harbour Road of Xing, who carries cargo from the ships to the inns and the warehouses. He is loud, cheeky and strong, and he sings the porters' work song to keep the crew in step. He knows which inns pay on time and which ones feed their porters on scraps.

**Speaking Style:** Loud and cheeky, a porter who sings the work song and mocks the men who cannot keep up.
**Combat Role:** none; a carrying pole and a strong back
**Relationship Hook:** A porter singing on a quay with a carrying pole across his shoulders.
personality: Core: loud, cheeky and strong; sings the work song; knows which inns pay
Quirk: mocks the slow porters

npcs.name: Chu Wenbo
npcs.info:
A junior clerk of the imperial granaries, who tallies sacks on long boards in the counting house and dreams of a post at the palace. He is quick with an abacus and quicker to agree with whoever outranks him.

**Speaking Style:** Quick and nervous, a clerk who talks faster the less he wants to say.
**Combat Role:** none; a long tally board swung like a plank and a quick pair of legs
**Relationship Hook:** A young clerk alone in a counting house at night, holding a lamp up to a long tally board.
personality: Core: talks faster when frightened; agrees with anyone senior; recounts at night when no one is there
Quirk: dreams aloud of the palace

npcs.name: Clara Wedekind
npcs.info:
The schoolmistress, a young woman from Central City who answered an advertisement for a teacher in the east and found one room, one stove and forty children with coal in their nails. She has stayed four years. She writes for books every term and receives tax forms.

**Speaking Style:** Clear and patient, a schoolmistress who never needs to raise her voice above a smoky stove.
**Combat Role:** none; a ruler and a voice that stops a room
**Relationship Hook:** A young schoolmistress chalking a tax notice on the blackboard while children copy the sums.
personality: Core: patient and stubborn; writes letters to anyone with an address; will not be frightened by a uniform
Quirk: teaches arithmetic from tax notices

npcs.name: Clara Weissmann
npcs.info:
The schoolmistress of Reole, a young woman from East City who came on a two-year post, stayed through the riots and has no plans to leave. She keeps forty children on benches meant for twenty and a red-circled map on the wall.

**Speaking Style:** Bright, crisp and patient, a schoolmistress who explains twice and then expects you to know.
**Combat Role:** none; she gets the children behind the stove and stands in the doorway
**Relationship Hook:** A young schoolmistress chalking a transmutation circle on a blackboard for a room of children.
personality: Core: clear-headed and kind; answers every question a child asks; draws circles on the board to teach reason
Quirk: keeps a candle in the window for late pupils

npcs.name: Clemens Haufer
npcs.info:
The registrar of the western register is a careful old major who has never transmuted anything in his life and loves alchemy anyway. He knows every licensed practitioner in the West by name, and he keeps their files in a cabinet whose key he wears on his watch chain.

**Speaking Style:** Polished and dry, a clerk of fine manners who asks for papers as if asking after one's health.
**Combat Role:** none; he has not fired his service pistol since his commissioning and would rather call the guard
**Relationship Hook:** An old major in half-moon spectacles bringing a brass seal press down on a form at a dark counter.
personality: Core: courteous to everyone, from farm girls to state alchemists; has a fond story about every file; believes the system is fair because he is fair
Quirk: polishes his seal press when nervous

npcs.name: Clemens Kern
npcs.info:
The preacher of the mission house, a gentle middle-aged man who offers a cup of water and a sermon to every traveller on the road. Since the scandal in Reole, few stay for the sermon, and he has begun to cut it short.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and hesitant; a preacher's cadence with the conviction gone out of it.
**Combat Role:** none; a preacher who stands in the doorway with a water cup
**Relationship Hook:** A thin preacher in a faded white robe holding out a tin cup beside a water barrel on a desert road.
personality: Core: gentle and doubting; keeps the barrel full; shortens his sermons
Quirk: kind to the thirsty

npcs.name: Clemens Rauch
npcs.info:
The auctioneer of the cattle pens beside the sidings, a loud, stringy man in a dusty bowler who sells two hundred beasts on a sale day in a gabble only drovers can follow. He knows the brand of every farm in the south and which farmer will bid against his own neighbour out of spite.

**Speaking Style:** A rattling gabble only drovers follow, then a sudden plain sentence when he wants to be understood.
**Combat Role:** none; a drover's stick and two hundred frightened cattle he can set running
**Relationship Hook:** A stringy auctioneer slapping a rail and gabbling a price while cattle mill round the ring.
personality: Core: talks too fast to be interrupted; remembers every brand and forgets every face; slaps a rail to close a sale
Quirk: sweats whenever an officer stands still near him

npcs.name: Clemens Sorge
npcs.info:
The medical officer of the recruiting hall, a country doctor called up when the war swallowed the south's surgeons. He listens to chests, looks at teeth and signs the forms that turn a boy into a soldier. He is kindly and conscientious and has not slept well in a year.

**Speaking Style:** Mild and tired, a family doctor's voice dressed in an officer's manner.
**Combat Role:** an officer's revolver he keeps unloaded in the drawer
**Relationship Hook:** A tired army doctor with a stethoscope looking at a boy's teeth beside a recruiting desk.
personality: Core: mild and conscientious; hates the quota and meets it; asks every boy what he wants to be after
Quirk: keeps a cough sweet in every pocket

npcs.name: Clemens Varga
npcs.info:
The head surgeon of the North Area Military Hospital, a major with steady hands who has taken off more frostbitten fingers and toes than any man in Amestris. He is gentle with patients and curt with officers, and he sleeps in his office more nights than not.

**Speaking Style:** Steady and kind and very tired, a surgeon who explains bad news slowly so you hear it once.
**Combat Role:** none; a surgeon's steady hands, a scalpel and the authority to throw a colonel off his ward
**Relationship Hook:** A tired surgeon in spectacles bending over a frostbitten hand on a long ward of iron beds.
personality: Core: gentle with patients, curt with officers; never sits down on a ward; keeps a true record in secret
Quirk: drinks his coffee cold because he forgets it

npcs.name: Clement Abel
npcs.info:
An old man from the village who tends the little roofed shrine at the crossroads, sweeping it, setting out dried flowers and lighting a candle stub for any traveller who looks in need of one. He sits on its step most of the day and gives directions to anyone lost at the blank fingerpost: always correct, always roundabout.

**Speaking Style:** Wandering and kindly, an old man who blesses travellers whether they asked or not.
**Combat Role:** none; a broom and the long road he sends enemies down
**Relationship Hook:** A little old man pointing a stranger the long way round from a blank fingerpost, smiling.
personality: Core: kindly and roundabout; blesses every traveller; sweeps when he is thinking
Quirk: lies with directions and with nothing else

npcs.name: Clothilde Brun
npcs.info:
One of the two widows who run the soldiers' orphanage, the one who teaches. She lost her husband on the border in the war's second year and has since raised other women's children on the army's allowance and the older children's wages.

**Speaking Style:** Gentle and tired, a widow's voice that never quite rises even when the whole room is shouting.
**Combat Role:** none; she would stand in a doorway between a child and anything
**Relationship Hook:** A thin widow in black writing on a slate before a cramped room of children.
personality: Core: never shouts, never needs to; keeps a slate for every child's name; writes letters of complaint at night by one candle
Quirk: gives her own supper to the youngest

npcs.name: Coralie Ashdown
npcs.info:
A singer at the music hall, dark-haired and thirty, who has sung comic songs and sentimental ballads on the music hall stage for ten years. The gallery throws flowers when she sings and the boxes pretend not to listen. Lately she has started singing a song of her own about the desert war, and veterans walk out halfway through with their faces turned away.

**Speaking Style:** Low and smoky, a singer's speaking voice that sounds like the last verse of a sad song.
**Combat Role:** none; a hatpin and a voice that can silence a gallery
**Relationship Hook:** A dark-haired singer in velvet standing in the footlights, one gloved hand raised, mid-song.
personality: Core: warm, tired and stubborn; keeps her husband's letters in her dressing room; laughs too loudly at the comedian's jokes
Quirk: sings when she is angry

npcs.name: Cornelia Weatherby
npcs.info:
The secretary of the engineers' hall, a precise woman of forty who builds delicate hands for pianists and clerks and has kept the hall's minutes for twelve years in a shorthand only she can read. She runs the contest rules like a railway timetable and is the one person the loudest masters stop talking for.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped and exact, a secretary who reads out a rule as if it had always been true and dares anyone to argue.
**Combat Role:** none; the gavel, the rules and a room full of men who owe her a favour
**Relationship Hook:** A precise woman rapping a gavel once, and a room of shouting engineers falling silent.
personality: Core: writes everything down and says little of it; prefers fine work to strong work; dislikes contests and runs them perfectly
Quirk: raps the table once, never twice

npcs.name: Cornelius Feld
npcs.info:
The concierge of the Station Hotel, a silver-haired man in a frock coat who knows which train every guest arrived on and which one they will leave by. He can find a room in a full house, a cab in the rain and a discreet doctor at midnight. He treats a colonel and a commercial traveller with exactly the same bow.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth and precise, a concierge's voice pitched exactly to the guest's importance.
**Combat Role:** none; a concierge who calls the porters
**Relationship Hook:** A silver-haired concierge bowing behind a polished hotel desk as a traveller signs the book.
personality: Core: courteous to everyone, warm to no one; remembers every face; tells himself the list is patriotic
Quirk: polishes the bell on the desk when nervous

npcs.name: Cornelius Roeder
npcs.info:
The schoolmaster of the lower town, a mild, shabby man who teaches millers' and tanners' children their letters and sums. He reads them the State Military's notices as lessons in civics, in a voice so flat that the children giggle.

**Speaking Style:** Mild and kindly, a schoolmaster who always asks a question back instead of giving an answer.
**Combat Role:** a half-trained alchemist; a chalk circle drawn fast on the floor, a wall of earth or a stone floor buckled under a foe, if he has time
**Relationship Hook:** A shabby schoolmaster crouched by a child's slate, chalk in hand, staring at a circle he never taught.
personality: Core: mild and patient; answers a question with a question; keeps a box of chalk for any child who asks
Quirk: reads army notices in a flat voice

npcs.name: Cornello
npcs.info:
Father Cornello, founder of the Church of Leto in the desert town of Reole, who calls himself the messenger of the sun god Leto and works miracles in the square: flowers from nothing, statues from stone, a promise to raise the dead. The town believes him and gives him its money, its faith and its young men. He is kindly in his sermons and wears a red stone set in a ring.

**Speaking Style:** Warm, paternal and certain, a preacher's voice full of promises that turns to a coward's shriek when the miracle fails.
**Combat Role:** alchemy through a counterfeit stone, and a crowd of believers between him and any enemy
**Relationship Hook:** A priest in white robes on a church balcony, arms spread, a red ring glinting as a statue rises from the stones.
personality: Core: paternal and kindly in the pulpit; answers doubt with a staged miracle; a coward without his stone
Quirk: contemptuous of his flock in private

npcs.name: Corvin Aspley
npcs.info:
A thin, quick man with a tray of watches on a strap round his neck, who works the junk stalls halfway down the alley and says he only finds things. He never sells to a face he has seen in daylight before and never buys from a child in front of witnesses. The alley's boys run his errands for bread and the first look at anything he throws away.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and amused, a dealer who never raises his voice and never quite finishes a sentence about where a thing came from.
**Combat Role:** a back-alley scrapper; a hidden razor and a shove into the stalls, then up the steps and away
**Relationship Hook:** A thin man with a tray of watches round his neck, smiling as he holds one out to its owner.
personality: Core: smiles with his mouth closed; pays the alley's children fairly and boasts of it; bolts at the sight of a uniform, then strolls back once it has passed
Quirk: never says stolen, only found

npcs.name: Cray
npcs.info:
Brother Cray of Reole, deacon of the Church of Leto and Father Cornello's enforcer, a true believer who keeps the creeds, watches the town for heretics and carries a pistol under his robes. He knows something of his teacher's plan to raise the faithful against the government and thinks it holy work.

**Speaking Style:** Flat and fervent, a believer's voice that goes hard when a heretic is near.
**Combat Role:** a pistol and the faith that he will not miss
**Relationship Hook:** A deacon on the church steps, hand on the pistol under his robe, watching two strangers.
personality: Core: devout, humourless and righteous; believes the state is godless; obeys his teacher in everything
Quirk: reports heretics to Cornello

npcs.name: Cremin
npcs.info:
Brigadier General Cremin of Central Command, one of the generals around the Führer, a harsh officer who cares only about the outcome of an operation and never about its cost.

**Speaking Style:** Harsh, clipped and indifferent; he gives orders about civilians as if he were ordering supplies.
**Combat Role:** none in person; command of Central's troops
**Relationship Hook:** A cold general ordering artillery onto a residential street.
personality: Core: harsh and indifferent to cost; orders civilians shot without a qualm; panics when an operation slips
Quirk: afraid of growing old

npcs.name: Cyrus Pembrook
npcs.info:
The auctioneer at the sheep ring on market days, a dapper little man in a checked suit who can sell four hundred lots before lunch in a patter no stranger follows. Off the box he is chatty and quick to stand a drink. He takes a small cut of every sale, and every farmer in the district believes he is on their side.

**Speaking Style:** Rapid and musical, an auctioneer whose patter runs like a train and stops dead on the word sold.
**Combat Role:** none; a gavel and a crowd that likes him
**Relationship Hook:** A dapper auctioneer with his gavel raised mid-patter over a ring of sheep.
personality: Core: fast-talking and friendly; never forgets a bid or a face; stands drinks to the losers
Quirk: looks away at exactly the right moments

npcs.name: Dagny Rask
npcs.info:
The landlady of the inn on the road below Fort Briggs, who serves soup, bread and hot tea to carters and soldiers on leave. She asks no questions and expects a fair tip. She is broad, tough and unsentimental, and the garrison treats her with the respect it gives its officers.

**Speaking Style:** Flat and cold as the weather, a landlady who answers questions with a price.
**Combat Role:** a strong woman with a poker by the stove and the garrison down the road
**Relationship Hook:** A broad landlady ladling soup for snow-covered soldiers in a warm taproom.
personality: Core: tough and unsentimental; asks no questions; respects the garrison
Quirk: keeps one room locked

npcs.name: Dalia Nadeem
npcs.info:
A girl of nine from the refugee camp, the little sister of Faris Nadeem, who has gone missing from the ruins. Her tracks lead onto the scorpion flats. She is small for her age and braver than she should be.

**Speaking Style:** Small and stubborn, a child who answers in whispers and will not cry.
**Combat Role:** none; a small girl who hides and keeps very still
**Relationship Hook:** A small girl with a swollen hand crouching beside a dead camel in a hollow of flat grey stones.
personality: Core: stubborn and brave; keeps secrets; misses her mother
Quirk: afraid of nothing but being sent back

npcs.name: Damiano
npcs.info:
Damiano, a young infantryman stationed in East City under Grumman, who was transferred into Major Mustang's unit in Ishval only a few days before the war ended, and has respected the man ever since.

**Speaking Style:** Young, earnest and admiring, a soldier who speaks of his old commander with warmth.
**Combat Role:** sidearms and a young soldier's speed
**Relationship Hook:** A young soldier stepping forward first when the old commander asks for volunteers.
personality: Core: young and earnest; eager to help; brave beyond his experience
Quirk: admires Mustang

npcs.name: Dankwart Riepe
npcs.info:
Quartermaster-sergeant and the army's beef buyer at the yards, a plump man in a bowler hat worn over regulations who walks the holding pens at dawn with a stick and a fat purse. Drovers from the eastern farms like dealing with him: he pays on the nail, haggles cheerfully and never makes them wait for a clerk.

**Speaking Style:** Easy and oily, a buyer who calls every drover 'friend' and means it about as far as the purse goes.
**Combat Role:** none; a walking stick, a purse and a gift for being elsewhere when the shouting starts
**Relationship Hook:** A plump quartermaster in a bowler hat leaning on a cattle pen and counting notes into a drover's palm.
personality: Core: cheerful, plausible and greedy; never looks a beast in the eye; panics quietly and goes on smiling
Quirk: tells the same three jokes to every drover

npcs.name: Dario Velli
npcs.info:
The captain of Sanvento's garrison, a young, lean, intense officer whose family estate lies in the ceded strip. He has fought for three years to get it back and has no interest in any peace that does not return it. He is brave, cold and efficient, and his men would follow him anywhere.

**Speaking Style:** Cold and courteous, an Aerugonian captain who speaks slowly so every word lands.
**Combat Role:** a cavalry sabre and a carbine, and a garrison of hill troops; he leads attacks from the front
**Relationship Hook:** A lean Aerugonian captain in a red coat standing in a barrack yard, gloves in one hand.
personality: Core: cold and efficient; brave to recklessness; loyal to his men
Quirk: obsessed with the ceded strip

npcs.name: Darius
npcs.info:
A big, tanned soldier with short dark hair and sideburns who turns into a gorilla-man when the fighting starts. He is gruff, sarcastic and practical, cheerful about being a chimera, and he values a friend he can rely on more than any order.

**Speaking Style:** A gruff, sarcastic rumble, dry and cynical, that warms up for the few he calls friends.
**Combat Role:** a gorilla's fists and reach, a wall-breaking brawl
**Relationship Hook:** A big tanned soldier cracking his knuckles, half a head taller than the doorway.
personality: Core: gruff and sarcastic; follows his instincts; happy with what he is
Quirk: loyal to friends, not to orders

npcs.name: Davor Kresnik
npcs.info:
A captain of the Cretan army who holds a pass on the western border against Amestrian patrols. He knows every gully of his valley and every man in his company by name. He is courteous, patient and cold in a fight, and he has lost a brother to an Amestrian rifle.

**Speaking Style:** Grave and courteous, a foreign officer whose Amestrian is careful and correct.
**Combat Role:** an officer with a rifle and a company on the ridges; he fights from high ground
**Relationship Hook:** A foreign captain on a rocky pass lowering his binoculars to look at the Amestrian line.
personality: Core: courteous and grave; knows his valley by heart; cold in a fight
Quirk: tired of the long war

npcs.name: Den
npcs.info:
The Rockbell family's dog, a black-and-white dog with an automail front left leg. She lost the leg long ago in a road accident while protecting Edward and the other children, and Pinako Rockbell calls her Resembool's best bodyguard. She is loyal, alert and kind, and she knows when someone in the house needs comfort.

**Speaking Style:** Short, alert barks and a low warning growl; she whines softly when someone is sad.
**Combat Role:** a guard dog; she bites and holds, and her steel leg does not tire
**Relationship Hook:** A black and white dog with a steel leg sitting at the workshop door, watching the road.
personality: Core: fiercely loyal; comforts the sad; growls at strangers she distrusts
Quirk: steals cake when no one is looking

npcs.name: Denny Brosh
npcs.info:
Sergeant Denny Brosh, the ever-present partner of Lieutenant Ross in Central, a nosy, somewhat lazy and hopelessly infatuated young soldier with five younger brothers and sisters at home. He is very sensitive to criticism and falls into despair at a harsh word, and he cannot hide a feeling to save his life.

**Speaking Style:** Bright, nosy and easily wounded; he chatters, takes offence at nothing and despairs at the slightest insult.
**Combat Role:** a sergeant's pistol and a loyal heart
**Relationship Hook:** A young sergeant trailing after his lieutenant, sulking because she told him off.
personality: Core: nosy and chatty; a bit lazy; infatuated with his partner
Quirk: crushed by any insult

npcs.name: Detlef Ruhr
npcs.info:
Washmaster at the sheep wash, a barrel-chested man who stands waist deep in the dammed pool for two days every spring, catching each sheep as it is shoved in, scrubbing it and pushing it up the ramp. He does the work of three men, sings rude songs to keep warm and is hoarse for a week after. The rest of the year he hedges and ditches.

**Speaking Style:** Hearty and loud, a washmaster who shouts the sheep through the water like a crowd at a race.
**Combat Role:** bare hands strong enough to hold a ram in deep water; he grapples
**Relationship Hook:** A barrel-chested man waist deep in a river pool, a soaked sheep in his arms, staring at the sluice.
personality: Core: hearty and tireless; takes the hardest place himself; slow to suspect anyone he drinks with
Quirk: sings in the cold water

npcs.name: Dietmar Kehl
npcs.info:
A survey lieutenant of the engineers, camped under the outcrop with a team of four, a plane table and a heliograph. He is mapping where the seam runs under the sand and has been told nothing about why.

**Speaking Style:** Curt and practical, a survey officer who answers questions with orders.
**Combat Role:** an officer's sidearm and a disciplined small team
**Relationship Hook:** A survey lieutenant bent over a plane table under a black-banded cliff, frowning at his own map.
personality: Core: curt and competent; dislikes mysteries in his own orders
Quirk: keeps a private copy of everything

npcs.name: Dietmar Kluge
npcs.info:
The range master of the Northern Drill Field, a sergeant who teaches recruits to fire in mittens before anyone sends them to the fort. He is fierce, precise and the best shot in the North Area, and he has never lost a recruit on his range.

**Speaking Style:** Fierce and clipped, a range master who barks numbers like gunshots.
**Combat Role:** a marksman who shoots in any weather; a rifle from the prone position, a pistol on the move, both deadly
**Relationship Hook:** A hawk-faced range master with a scoped rifle staring down a frozen firing line.
personality: Core: fierce and precise; never loses a recruit; best shot in the north
Quirk: furious at anyone who breaks range rules

npcs.name: Dietrich Faber
npcs.info:
The provost captain who runs the stockade is a sharp-featured man who believes in discipline the way others believe in salvation. He sits as clerk at every court martial and knows the military code better than the judges he advises.

**Speaking Style:** Hard and fast, a provost officer who interrogates as if every pause were a confession.
**Combat Role:** a provost's baton and revolver; he takes men alive, quickly and with no wasted blows
**Relationship Hook:** A hawk-faced provost captain with a red armband reading charges across a bare table.
personality: Core: quotes the military code by article number; never forgets a deserter's face; scrupulously fair inside the rules, and ruthless with them
Quirk: privately tired of hanging men

npcs.name: Dietrich Wessel
npcs.info:
The engineer of the ice works by the rail line, a gaunt man of thirty-five who came down from Central City with the ammonia machine and has nursed it ever since. He wears a wet cloth round his neck in the hissing room and lets the children at the chute take chips of ice when the owner's back is turned.

**Speaking Style:** Dry and hoarse, an engineer who speaks of his machine as a difficult patient and of himself not at all.
**Combat Role:** none; a long valve spanner, and the knowledge of which pipe to open in a man's face
**Relationship Hook:** A gaunt engineer with a wet cloth over his mouth, tightening a hissing valve beside a great flywheel.
personality: Core: talks to the machine like a nurse; gives ice to children; obeys the owner and hates himself for it
Quirk: dry as dust about everything else

npcs.name: Ding Tanfu
npcs.info:
A charcoal burner with a black face and a white grin, who watches the smoking mounds on the ridge in shifts and sleeps in a bark hut between them. He is small, lively and dishonest in small ways, and everyone on the ridge likes him.

**Speaking Style:** Cackling and quick, a charcoal burner who laughs at everything including himself.
**Combat Role:** none worth the name; a shovel, a handful of hot ash and a fast pair of legs into the pines
**Relationship Hook:** A soot-blackened burner grinning by a smoking mound, a shovel over his shoulder.
personality: Core: laughs at everything; steals small things and gives them away; black from hair to heel and proud of it
Quirk: brave in the dark and nervous of uniforms

npcs.name: Dolcetto
npcs.info:
A short, stocky swordsman in a white keikogi who keeps the door at the Devil's Nest and draws a katana faster than most men draw a pistol. He has a dog's nose and, he says, a dog's loyalty. He is touchy about his strength after losing a few fights in a row, and he knows when not to kill.

**Speaking Style:** Short-tempered and blunt, a swordsman's clipped bark that sulks when he is teased about losing.
**Combat Role:** a fast katana and a dog's senses, cuts aimed to disarm
**Relationship Hook:** A short swordsman in white at a bar door, sniffing the air with his hand on his katana.
personality: Core: blunt and touchy about his strength; loyal to Greed like a dog, he says; grateful to be alive at all
Quirk: smells trouble before he sees it

npcs.name: Dominic LeCoulte
npcs.info:
A gruff, anti-social old automail engineer who lives in the mountains outside Rush Valley with his son Ridel and daughter-in-law Satella. He is little known and wants it that way, refuses every would-be apprentice, and builds limbs of a quality nobody in the valley can match. He dreams of building weapons into automail without changing a limb's shape or weight.

**Speaking Style:** Gruff and anti-social, a grumbling old craftsman who barks at visitors and melts at his grandson.
**Combat Role:** none; a master's tools
**Relationship Hook:** A scowling old mechanic slamming the door on a girl who wants to be his apprentice.
personality: Core: gruff and anti-social; refuses apprentices; kind under the scowl
Quirk: terrified of Pinako Rockbell

npcs.name: Dora Siedel
npcs.info:
The bath keeper, a broad old woman who stokes the boiler, mops the black water from the floors and knows more of the town's secrets than the priest. Men talk in the steam because they think nobody can hear them. She can.

**Speaking Style:** A broad, burring old voice that grumbles about everything and means none of it.
**Combat Role:** a coal shovel and a stoker's arms
**Relationship Hook:** An old woman in a steamy cellar tapping a stuck brass gauge with her knuckle.
personality: Core: grumbles and helps in the same breath; hears everything in the steam
Quirk: thinks the boiler is alive

npcs.name: Dora Wickham
npcs.info:
A scrap dealer from East City who runs a mule team out to the abandoned railhead by night and loads the stacked rails onto sledges. She calls it salvage, and since the army forgot the rails were there she may even be right.

**Speaking Style:** Broad, sharp and cheerful; she haggles like it is a sport and enjoys losing almost as much as winning.
**Combat Role:** a mule driver with a crowbar and a voice that can halt a team at fifty yards
**Relationship Hook:** A sturdy woman with a crowbar and a lantern beside a stack of rusty rails at night, mules waiting.
personality: Core: cheerful and shameless; haggles for sport; works by night
Quirk: fond of her mules

npcs.name: Dorian Rook
npcs.info:
A pale young man with ink on his fingers who keeps the Sunwheel Inn's books in the attic and is not seen in the courtyard by daylight. Guests who glimpse him on the stair are told he is a nephew with weak lungs.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and careful, a man who has learned to speak below the level of floorboards.
**Combat Role:** a trained rifleman out of practice; he fires from cover and freezes after the first shot
**Relationship Hook:** A pale young man writing by a candle under the eaves, listening to the floor below.
personality: Core: guilty and meticulous; adds every column twice; will not look out of the window by day
Quirk: flinches at the sound of the square bell

npcs.name: Doss Mallory
npcs.info:
A scrapper of Baschool who strips the dead rail line for iron and sells it to the town's smiths. He is rough, hoarse and practical, and he knows every rusted bolt on the line. He has seen the soldiers come and go and keeps his distance from both sides.

**Speaking Style:** Rough and hoarse, a scrapper who speaks about metal as if it were alive.
**Combat Role:** none; a crowbar and a cart
**Relationship Hook:** A scrapper pulling rusted iron from a dead rail line beside a cart.
personality: Core: rough, hoarse and practical; knows every rusted bolt; keeps clear of both sides
Quirk: talks about metal as if it were alive

npcs.name: Dou Yaoshan
npcs.info:
Kiln master of the celadon hill, a silent, smoke-dried man who stokes the long kiln for days without sleep and judges the glaze by the colour of the flame through a spy hole. The court's green ware has come from his kiln for twenty years.

**Speaking Style:** Few words, long pauses, the voice of a man who listens to a kiln for days at a time.
**Combat Role:** none; a stoking iron and a kiln yard full of potters
**Relationship Hook:** A smoke-dried kiln master peering through a spy hole into the flame of a long stepped kiln.
personality: Core: silent for days at a firing; judges everything by its colour; fears the funeral order more than the crack
Quirk: keeps a perfect bowl from his first firing on a shelf

npcs.name: Dov Sable
npcs.info:
A pawnbroker on Market Row's Pawn Corner who buys almost anything and sells it back to the same people for more. He is quiet, thin and careful, and he asks no questions of anyone who is in a hurry. He keeps a locked back room full of pieces other people have pawned for their lives.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and thin, a pawnbroker who speaks in low offers and never raises his price.
**Combat Role:** none; a locked back door and a shop knife
**Relationship Hook:** A pawnbroker behind a counter making a low offer for a dented pocket watch.
personality: Core: quiet, thin and careful; never raises his price; asks no questions in a hurry
Quirk: keeps a locked room of other people's pieces

npcs.name: Dr. Knox
npcs.info:
Dr. Knox, a military pathologist in Central who specialises in autopsies, especially burn deaths. He is gruff, tired and blunt, and claims he has forgotten how to treat the living. He served with Mustang in Ishval, and he will cover for him.

**Speaking Style:** Gruff, tired and blunt, an old doctor who talks to a corpse more easily than to the living.
**Combat Role:** none; a scalpel and a steady hand
**Relationship Hook:** A tired old doctor bent over a burned body, signing a false report.
personality: Core: gruff, tired and blunt; haunted by Ishval; loyal to old comrades
Quirk: more at ease with the dead

npcs.name: Drachman Commander
npcs.info:
The commander of the Drachman army on the Briggs front, whose name nobody in Amestris knows. He trusts a great train of artillery to break the northern wall and expects the snow to open the pass for his men. He is cold, certain and dismissive of the soldiers who die for him.

**Speaking Style:** Cold and contemptuous, a commander who announces his attack like a verdict and berates the survivors when it fails.
**Combat Role:** artillery command from behind the line
**Relationship Hook:** A Drachman commander on a snowy ridge above a line of artillery, looking towards the fort.
personality: Core: cold, certain and dismissive; gives orders through aides; never admits a mistake
Quirk: trusts the guns over his men

npcs.name: Dragan Vuk
npcs.info:
A Cretan sergeant of the hill fort who walks out into the strip at night more often than his officers know. He is a big, bearded mountain man with a laugh like a landslide and a deep dislike of both generals and lice.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and heavily accented in Amestrian, warm and gruff, laughing at his own mistakes.
**Combat Role:** a mountain fighter with a carbine and a long knife; he stalks, waits, and closes fast
**Relationship Hook:** A burly bearded Cretan sergeant in a red sash crouching in a dark cellar with a lantern.
personality: Core: laughs loudly, even when it is dangerous; hates generals on both sides; loyal to a friend across the line
Quirk: speaks Amestrian badly and gladly

npcs.name: Duan Yingtai
npcs.info:
The food taster of a minor princess's pavilion, a soft-spoken man of forty who has eaten the first mouthful of every meal she has had since she was six. He is plump, mild and very careful, and he chews a long time.

**Speaking Style:** Mild and unhurried, a man who chews his words as carefully as his food.
**Combat Role:** none; he throws the dish, shouts the alarm and sits down before his legs go
**Relationship Hook:** A plump taster holding a morsel on his chopsticks while three other tasters watch him chew.
personality: Core: chews slowly and swallows only when sure; watches the other tasters' faces more than his own plate; fond of his princess as of a niece
Quirk: gentle with the cooks, who are as frightened as he is

npcs.name: Eberhard Imhoff
npcs.info:
The captain who commands the North City Stockade from a timber watch platform above the huts. He runs it by the book, including the parts of the book that nobody has read for years, and his prisoners clear the city's snow by day in perfect lines.

**Speaking Style:** Measured and cold, a captain who speaks only in instructions.
**Combat Role:** an officer with a rifle on the watch platform; he commands a firing line from height and fires himself only once he is certain
**Relationship Hook:** A gaunt captain on a timber platform watching a line of prisoners shovel snow below.
personality: Core: cold, correct and exact; never shouts; inspects the huts at midnight unannounced
Quirk: has begun to doubt his own orders

npcs.name: Eckhart Varnhagen
npcs.info:
A wool dealer from East City who comes out on the morning train every market day in a grey coat with a fur collar, carrying a notebook bound in red leather. He is pleasant, well dressed and free with his cigars, and he bids freely too. The farmers like him, because he makes the bidding lively.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth and unhurried, a city dealer who compliments a fleece while he undercuts it.
**Combat Role:** none; a sword cane he carries for show and a hired man on the train
**Relationship Hook:** A sleek city dealer raising one gloved hand at a sheep auction, smiling at nobody.
personality: Core: pleasant and generous; writes in his red notebook mid-conversation; flatters before he bargains
Quirk: never takes off his gloves

npcs.name: Edda Marten
npcs.info:
A military nurse at the eastern hospital who runs Ward Three like a drill sergeant. She is quick, unflappable and hard to fool, and she has patched up soldiers from the drill ground, the rail lines and the desert. She is kind to her patients and merciless to anyone who disturbs them.

**Speaking Style:** Low, firm and tired, a nurse who never raises her voice and never has to.
**Combat Role:** none; a nurse with steady hands and a sharp voice
**Relationship Hook:** A stern nurse standing between a sick bed and an officer at the ward door.
personality: Core: calm, firm and quick; protects her patients; cannot be bullied by rank
Quirk: remembers every wound she has dressed

npcs.name: Edda Pflug
npcs.info:
A farm wife from downstream of the wash, who has walked up its stone bed with a jar of black water to show someone what the coal heaps send down every storm. Her beans have died twice and her cow is sick.

**Speaking Style:** Flat and weary, a farm wife who has given up expecting anyone to listen.
**Combat Role:** none; she walks away
**Relationship Hook:** A farm wife in a dry riverbed holding up a jar of black water toward the town as storm clouds gather.
personality: Core: weary and dogged; refuses to hurry for anyone
Quirk: ashamed of her husband and loyal to him

npcs.name: Edeltraud Marwitz
npcs.info:
An operator on the exchange's military board, chosen for a steady hand, a clean record and a family in the north who vouch for her. She works the locked room upstairs with two other women, plugs the generals' lines and listens when she is told to. Downstairs the girls think her proud; she is only tired.

**Speaking Style:** Low, clear and very polite, the voice that says 'connecting you' a thousand times a day.
**Combat Role:** none; an operator whose only weapon is a cut line at the wrong moment
**Relationship Hook:** A composed operator in a headset at a switchboard, one hand on a cord and the other writing in a small black notebook.
personality: Core: polite, guarded and very observant; remembers voices better than faces; trusts no officer twice
Quirk: writes things down to stop herself thinking about them

npcs.name: Edison
npcs.info:
Brigadier General Edison of Central Command's top brass, a high-ranking officer trusted with the army's darkest affairs, who follows the Führer with complete confidence.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth and sycophantic, a bureaucrat's voice that offers a bribe the moment it is threatened.
**Combat Role:** none; rank and a bribe
**Relationship Hook:** A general cowering behind a desk, offering a housewife a salary to protect him.
personality: Core: sycophantic and trusting of power; confident in Bradley; cowardly in danger
Quirk: offers a bribe when cornered

npcs.name: Edmund Brusk
npcs.info:
The sergeant in charge of the town's military police post, a thickset man of forty-five who came out from an East City barracks to a quiet posting and has worked hard to keep it quiet. His usual business is stolen ewes, festival drunks and the odd fistfight at the auction. He knows every farmer by name and most of their dogs.

**Speaking Style:** Gruff and plain, a country sergeant who would rather settle a quarrel than write it down.
**Combat Role:** an army rifle and a sergeant's truncheon; solid, unhurried, by the book
**Relationship Hook:** A thickset sergeant writing very little in a very large book beside a cold stove.
personality: Core: gruff but fair; prefers a word to a cell; fond of the Rockbell household and careful to hide it
Quirk: does his paperwork badly on purpose

npcs.name: Edric Moss
npcs.info:
Head shepherd at the lambing bothy, a rangy, silent man who stays out with the flocks from the first lamb to the last and keeps the peat fire alight six weeks without a break. He can turn a breech lamb in the dark by touch and shoot a fox through the eye by moonlight. The younger shepherds would follow him anywhere, and mostly have.

**Speaking Style:** Rough and quiet, a head shepherd who keeps his voice low so as not to wake the ewes.
**Combat Role:** a double-barrelled shotgun and a long shepherd's knife; patient, from cover, by night
**Relationship Hook:** A rangy shepherd crouched by a peat fire with a shotgun, turning a scrap of numbered leather in his fingers.
personality: Core: silent and watchful; keeps bad news from the town until he is sure; gentle with ewes, merciless with vermin
Quirk: never lets the fire die

npcs.name: Edvin Marsk
npcs.info:
A civilian prisoner in the stockade huts, once a corporal in the eastern war and lately a pedlar, held for striking a military policeman on the road from the east. He shovels snow with the others, tells the worst jokes in the north and shares his tobacco with anyone.

**Speaking Style:** Dusty and sardonic, an old soldier's drawl full of jokes nobody else finds funny.
**Combat Role:** an old infantryman with whatever is to hand; a snow shovel, a bunk leg, dirty and effective
**Relationship Hook:** A grinning prisoner in a grey jacket leaning on a snow shovel outside a long hut.
personality: Core: sardonic and generous; shares tobacco with anyone; jokes at funerals
Quirk: pretends not to care what happens to him

npcs.name: Edward Elric
npcs.info:
The Fullmetal Alchemist, fifteen years old and the youngest State Alchemist the country has ever licensed. He is short for his age and furious about it, wears a red coat and a gold braid, and carries a silver pocket watch that marks his rank. His right arm and left leg are automail, which Winry Rockbell builds and he keeps breaking. He travels with his younger brother Alphonse in a suit of armour, chasing every rumour of the Philosopher's Stone across Amestris, and he can transmute without drawing a circle, by clapping his hands.

**Speaking Style:** Quick, sharp and loud, a teenager's voice that snaps at small things and goes very quiet when something truly hurts him; he shouts down anyone who calls him small and jokes in the same breath.
**Combat Role:** clap transmutation at the speed of thought, the ground and his own automail turned into weapons, and a street-brawler's kicks
**Relationship Hook:** A short boy in a red coat clapping his hands together, the street rising into a wall in front of him.
personality: Core: quick to anger and quick to laugh at himself; reads everything, then acts before he has finished thinking; protective of Alphonse to the point of rage
Quirk: explodes at anyone who calls him short

npcs.name: Edwin Strand
npcs.info:
A corporal of the garrison, once a staff clerk to Brigadier General Fessler, who walks out to the ruined field command on his rest days and sits at the sand-buried map table. He is thin, nervous and very careful with paper.

**Speaking Style:** Plain and halting; a former staff clerk who keeps correcting the dates in his own story.
**Combat Role:** a clerk with a rifle; competent on the range and useless in a crisis
**Relationship Hook:** A thin corporal sitting at a sand-buried map table in a roofless ruin, reading an old order.
personality: Core: anxious and conscientious; checks every date twice; sits at the map table as if on duty
Quirk: cannot hear a single shot without flinching

npcs.name: Edwin Wehr
npcs.info:
The doctor of the canvas clinic, a quiet man in his forties who treats heat sickness, snakebite and broken legs for whoever comes and takes whatever they have in payment. He uses a crate as a desk and keeps his instruments boiled.

**Speaking Style:** Low, tired and gentle; a doctor's voice that never hurries a frightened patient.
**Combat Role:** none; a surgeon with a scalpel who would rather stitch a man than cut one
**Relationship Hook:** A tired doctor in a stained apron bending over a canvas cot under a flapping roof.
personality: Core: gentle and tired; boils everything; drinks too much after dark
Quirk: asks no names

npcs.name: Egbert Kettler
npcs.info:
The manager of the Westbank Gasworks, a stout man in a frock coat with soot on the cuffs he pretends not to see. He reads the gasholders the way a captain reads the sky and can say to the hour when the city's kitchens light their stoves. He is proud of the works, contemptuous of the council and cold to the stokers, whom he counts as tonnage.

**Speaking Style:** Measured and flat, a manager who quotes figures instead of answering questions.
**Combat Role:** none; a manager who calls the yard's watchmen and stands behind the gate
**Relationship Hook:** A stout manager in a frock coat staring up at a rising gasholder, a clipboard pressed to his chest.
personality: Core: proud, exact and cold; talks in cubic feet; afraid of inspectors and of officers alike
Quirk: rewards any man who keeps his mouth shut

npcs.name: Egon Brachvogel
npcs.info:
The musketry sergeant of the capital's rifle range, a long-armed, weathered man with a whistle on a chain who has turned ten thousand recruits into soldiers who can hit a target at four hundred yards. He shouts, curses and is genuinely proud of every one of them. Farmers on the heath dislike his red flag and like the man.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, flat and carrying, the voice of a musketry sergeant heard across a heath.
**Combat Role:** a marksman and drill sergeant; rifle at long range, bayonet and boot when the enemy closes
**Relationship Hook:** A rangy sergeant with a whistle in his teeth standing over a line of prone recruits, a red flag snapping behind him.
personality: Core: loud, fair and proud of his recruits; respects a good shot whoever fires it; follows orders and hates the closed van
Quirk: never forgives a careless muzzle

npcs.name: Eino Askvik
npcs.info:
The lieutenant of the gun gallery, a long-legged, silent officer who walks the valley below the wall alone after every thaw to correct the range cards. The gunners say he can drop a shell on a sledge at three miles, and he has never told them otherwise.

**Speaking Style:** Very low and spare, speaking in distances and bearings, as if every sentence were a firing order.
**Combat Role:** an artillery officer and a fine rifle shot; he ranges first, fires once and moves before the reply
**Relationship Hook:** A tall lieutenant at a gun port with field glasses raised, correcting a range card with a pencil stub.
personality: Core: corrects a range card with a stub of pencil kept behind his ear; walks with a long, soundless stride; speaks in distances; eats with the gunners, not the officers
Quirk: touches each gun's breech as he passes

npcs.name: Elder Halim
npcs.info:
The headman of an Ishvalan refugee camp on the edge of the war zone. He keeps the camp's rations, its water carts and its list of the dead. He is polite to soldiers and to travellers, and he is never fooled by either. He wants his people to be left in peace while the Amestrian garrison counts its prisoners.

**Speaking Style:** Tired and courteous, a man who speaks in careful full sentences and never raises his voice in front of the children.
**Combat Role:** none; he has his list, his water and his camp's respect
**Relationship Hook:** A headman at a water cart counting names in the morning light.
personality: Core: courteous, tired and firm; keeps a careful list of the living and the dead; lets nobody cut the water line
Quirk: speaks to every child by name

npcs.name: Elfriede Mahnke
npcs.info:
A spinner of twenty from a hill village east of the city, who minds four frames at once, answers the overseer back and has never been sacked for it because she is the fastest hand on the floor. She lodges with five other girls over a baker's and sends a third of her wage home every week. When she says the floor will stop, the floor stops.

**Speaking Style:** Sharp and carrying, a mill girl's voice built to cut through a hundred looms.
**Combat Role:** none worth naming; fast hands, a shuttle and a floor of girls who walk out at her word
**Relationship Hook:** A red-haired mill girl standing between rows of spinning frames with her arms folded, staring down an overseer.
personality: Core: fearless and quick-tempered; laughs loudest when she is most afraid; keeps her accounts to the last coin
Quirk: fierce about the younger girls

npcs.name: Elias Hadad
npcs.info:
The eldest novice left at the Seminary of the Sun, a tall young man of nineteen in a yellow robe that has been let out at the hems twice. He rises before dawn to lead the greeting of the sun for the six boys who stayed, and in the afternoons he sits alone in the library.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, earnest and well trained; a young preacher's voice that falters when he means what he says.
**Combat Role:** none; a novice who stands between the younger boys and whatever comes
**Relationship Hook:** A tall novice at an east-facing lectern, reading a sermon's margins with a stricken face.
personality: Core: earnest and torn; leads the dawn greeting though he no longer believes it; protects the younger novices
Quirk: reads the margins again every night

npcs.name: Elias Lind
npcs.info:
The priest of Resembool's little church, a kind old man who rings the one bell, buries the town's dead and knows the names on every stone in the churchyard. He is gentle with the grieving and a little frightened of strangers, especially ones in uniform. He married half the town and christened the other half.

**Speaking Style:** Mild and hesitant, a country priest who clears his throat before he speaks to a stranger.
**Combat Role:** none; an old priest with a lamp and a prayer book
**Relationship Hook:** An old country priest at the chapel door, peering anxiously at a stranger.
personality: Core: kind and nervous; remembers every name in the churchyard; afraid of soldiers
Quirk: offers tea to anyone who sits down

npcs.name: Elias Rook
npcs.info:
The night sentry at the powder magazine, a serious young private who takes the red flag and the hundred paces seriously and reads his rule card by moonlight. The other privates laugh at him. He does not mind.

**Speaking Style:** Earnest and over-formal, a young sentry who salutes the dark just in case.
**Combat Role:** a rifle and bayonet by the drill book, every movement correct
**Relationship Hook:** A young sentry at a wire fence peering at footprints under a stone hut's eaves by moonlight.
personality: Core: earnest and literal; brave in a quiet way; lonely
Quirk: follows the rule card

npcs.name: Elicia Hughes
npcs.info:
The three-year-old daughter of Maes and Gracia Hughes, born in 1911, the apple of her father's eye and the subject of every photograph in his pockets. She has sandy blonde pigtails tied with blue beads and green eyes, and she is cheerful, precocious and enthusiastic about birthday parties.

**Speaking Style:** A tiny, delighted toddler's voice that stumbles over numbers and calls everyone big brother or sister.
**Combat Role:** none
**Relationship Hook:** A tiny girl in pigtails holding up three fingers at her own birthday party.
personality: Core: cheerful and enthusiastic; adores her father; takes visitors as big sisters
Quirk: fumbles her numbers

npcs.name: Elmar Starck
npcs.info:
The patient in the end bed of the fort's ward, a wiry man with a new automail left leg and a cheerful way of not answering questions. The orderlies call him the lodger, because nobody can remember him being admitted.

**Speaking Style:** Easy and joking, always one quip ahead of the question he does not want to answer.
**Combat Role:** an old Briggs rifleman on a new leg; a crutch swung low and a kick from a steel foot nobody expects
**Relationship Hook:** A grinning man on the edge of an iron bed, flexing a steel knee and pretending not to watch the door.
personality: Core: walks the ward at night to test the new knee; tucks in the other patients' blankets; goes silent when an officer from the south comes in
Quirk: jokes before anyone can ask him something real

npcs.name: Elsa Lindqvist
npcs.info:
The owner of Lindqvist Alchemy Supply, who sells chalk, minerals, glassware, reagents and reference books to the north's alchemists. She knows chemistry better than half her customers and asks every one for a State Alchemist's certificate or a teacher's letter before selling anything stronger than chalk, a rule of her own.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped and dry, a shopkeeper who asks for your papers before she asks your name.
**Combat Role:** a trained alchemist who never sat the examination; a chalk circle on the counter and the shop's own reagents turned to smoke or glass
**Relationship Hook:** A sharp shopkeeper in pince-nez holding a certificate up to the light across a counter of glass jars.
personality: Core: exacting and dry; asks for papers first; keeps her shop spotless
Quirk: reads alchemy texts at the counter

npcs.name: Elsbeth Marchbank
npcs.info:
A cheerful, round-faced woman who sells figs, lemons and cut flowers from a barrow in the Dublith Market, with a brass bell she rings when the fruit is fresh and a song she sings when it is not. Her brother owns the orchards west of town; she married a fishmonger and kept her own money, which Dublith still discusses.

**Speaking Style:** Sing-song and sunny, a market woman who rings her bell between sentences.
**Combat Role:** none; a heavy barrow shoved hard and a market that takes her side
**Relationship Hook:** A round-faced woman ringing a brass bell over a barrow of figs and singing about how fresh they are.
personality: Core: rings her bell at strangers; proud of her own money; covers for her brother by reflex
Quirk: sings when the fruit is bruised

npcs.name: Elsbeth Rau
npcs.info:
The city waterworks' turncock for the promenade quarter, who walks the mains with a long iron key and opens or shuts the valves under the street. She is thick-armed, unsentimental and good with a wrench. Children dare each other to steal her key and never manage it.

**Speaking Style:** Flat and dry, a waterworks woman who has heard every complaint about pressure there is.
**Combat Role:** a long iron valve key swung two-handed
**Relationship Hook:** A thick-armed waterworks woman resting a long iron key on her shoulder beside a splashing lion fountain.
personality: Core: blunt and practical; keeps a tally nobody asked for
Quirk: fond of the fountain lions, which she calls by names

npcs.name: Emeric Rautenberg
npcs.info:
The bandmaster of the garrison band, a round, cheerful sergeant with a waxed moustache who conducts the rest-day concerts in the park and drills his musicians as hard as any infantry company. He loves the old eastern marches best of all and plays them with tears in his eyes.

**Speaking Style:** Hearty and musical, a bandmaster who taps out the beat of whatever he is saying.
**Combat Role:** none worth the name; a baton and a band who would follow him anywhere
**Relationship Hook:** A round bandmaster with a waxed moustache raising his baton in a green iron bandstand.
personality: Core: cheerful, emotional and proud; taps the beat with his foot
Quirk: cries at marches

npcs.name: Emmerich Pottle
npcs.info:
Proprietor of the dry goods store, a mild, bald man in sleeve garters who sells flour, nails, lamp oil and sweets and will send to East City for anything else. He gives credit easily and remembers it precisely. Children like him because the sweet jar sits low on the counter; their parents like him less by the end of each winter.

**Speaking Style:** Mild and obliging, a shopkeeper whose kindness always arrives with a book.
**Combat Role:** none; a shotgun under the counter he has never fired
**Relationship Hook:** A mild bald shopkeeper writing in a book while a child reaches into the sweet jar.
personality: Core: mild and obliging; writes everything down; gives sweets to children whose parents owe him
Quirk: never raises his voice or forgives a debt for nothing

npcs.name: Emmet Hall
npcs.info:
A miner's son with a head for figures who keeps Youswell's books and writes the town's letters to the lieutenant's office on the square. He is polite, careful and slightly afraid of the people he writes to, and he is one of the few townsmen who can read a contract.

**Speaking Style:** Polite and careful, a clerk who counts every coin twice and never raises his voice.
**Combat Role:** none; a pen and a book
**Relationship Hook:** A clerk at a square table writing a letter to the lieutenant's office.
personality: Core: polite and careful; counts every coin twice; writes the town's letters
Quirk: afraid of the people he writes to

npcs.name: Engelbert Stoss
npcs.info:
Foreman of the retort house, short, broad and missing most of both eyebrows, who has fed coal to the furnaces that light East City for twenty-five years. His stokers call him the old man to his face and worse behind it, and every one of them would walk into a burning bench after him. He tells the time by the gasholders like the children do.

**Speaking Style:** A furnace-hall bark, loud from habit; he has to remember to lower it in a parlour.
**Combat Role:** a short broad man with a stoker's shovel he swings like an axe, and twenty men at his back
**Relationship Hook:** A short broad foreman with a pipe clenched in his teeth glaring down a hall of glowing furnaces.
personality: Core: loud, loyal and suspicious; knows the birthday of every stoker's child; trusts no hand who has worked less than five years
Quirk: chews his pipe stem when he thinks

npcs.name: Ennis Faulk
npcs.info:
A private of nineteen who has stood at the east end of the iron bridge for most of a year, rifle shouldered, lamp at his boots, a field telephone in the box behind him that has rung twice. He knows every carter, fisherman and washerwoman who crosses and asks after their families by name. The sergeant thinks him soft. The carters bring him apples.

**Speaking Style:** Chatty and warm, a lonely sentry who starts every conversation with the weather and ends it with a joke.
**Combat Role:** recruit's rifle and bayonet drill, fresh and stiff, good enough to frighten a drunk off the bridge
**Relationship Hook:** A lanky young sentry stamping his boots beside a sentry box at the end of an iron bridge.
personality: Core: friendly to everyone who crosses; stamps his feet and sings under his breath against the cold; afraid of heights, which nobody has noticed
Quirk: looks carefully at the river at certain hours

npcs.name: Enzo Calvi
npcs.info:
A lieutenant of twenty-three in the Aerugonian encampment, handsome, eloquent and impatient. His elder brother died at Fotset in the first winter. He thinks the general has grown old and timid, and he says so to anyone who will listen.

**Speaking Style:** Fiery and fast, a young officer whose speeches run ahead of his sense.
**Combat Role:** a sabre and a revolver, and forty volunteers who would follow him over the wire
**Relationship Hook:** A young officer in a red coat pointing north as he addresses a crowd of soldiers on a dusty parade ground.
personality: Core: fiery and eloquent; impatient with old men; grieves his brother through anger
Quirk: brave and reckless

npcs.name: Ephraim Brecht
npcs.info:
A quiet pawnbroker on a side street who has taken the medals, watches and wedding rings of the city's veterans for thirty years and given them back whenever the pension came. He is patient, fair and sad, and he has the best collection of service decorations in the east in his back shelves.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and kindly, a pawnbroker who says 'of course' before every refusal.
**Combat Role:** none; a wire grille, a bell to summon the police and a heavy safe
**Relationship Hook:** An old pawnbroker behind a wire grille, holding a silver watch up to the light.
personality: Core: kind and slow to judge; never haggles with a man in uniform
Quirk: keeps every pledge a year longer than the law says

npcs.name: Erich Dahl
npcs.info:
The captain of the battery on Gun Line Ridge, a hard, capable gunner who has held the ridge for two years. He spends his days in the observation post with a periscope and a field telephone. He is respected, short-tempered and increasingly unsure of his orders.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped and urgent, a battery captain used to shouting fire orders over guns.
**Combat Role:** a battery of field guns and a pistol in the post; on the ground, a soldier's rifle drill
**Relationship Hook:** A broad battery captain with a telephone at his ear peering through a slit in a sandbagged observation post.
personality: Core: hard and capable; short-tempered under pressure; respects his men's skill
Quirk: afraid of the staff more than the enemy

npcs.name: Erich Danzer
npcs.info:
The billeting sergeant of Pendleton finds beds for every company that rotates through the town and knows every chalked door by its number. He is a born fixer, cheerful and well liked, and he can find tobacco in a town that has none.

**Speaking Style:** Easy and wry, a billet sergeant who makes a joke of everything and a deal of the rest.
**Combat Role:** a sergeant's carbine and a knife in the boot; he fights dirty, fast and from the side
**Relationship Hook:** A wiry grinning sergeant chalking a number on a battered door, a carbine on his back.
personality: Core: cheerful and endlessly resourceful; knows everyone and owes everyone; jokes in the worst moments
Quirk: keeps a Cretan cigarette case and never says where it came from

npcs.name: Erland Fiske
npcs.info:
The old man who runs the sulphur baths with his wife, scrubbing the pools, stoking the stove and treating every soldier on leave like a grandson. He has a bad leg and a good laugh, and he talks without stopping.

**Speaking Style:** Fussy and talkative, an old host who chatters on and quietly misses nothing.
**Combat Role:** an old man with a scrubbing brush and a bucket of scalding water
**Relationship Hook:** A bald old man with a thermometer crouched by a steaming pool, squinting at the mercury.
personality: Core: talks without stopping; hides his notebook in the towel stove; treats every private like a grandson
Quirk: pretends to be deafer than he is

npcs.name: Erwin Gosse
npcs.info:
The farmer who has chaired the town meeting on the village green for eleven years, mostly because nobody else will. He runs the biggest flock on the north side, wears his good waistcoat to every gathering and settles quarrels over fences, strays and water with a patience that maddens both parties. People call him fair. He likes being called fair more than he likes being it.

**Speaking Style:** Round and reasonable, a farmer who chairs meetings and lets every argument run a minute too long.
**Combat Role:** a big farmer with a blackthorn stick who would rather shout than swing it
**Relationship Hook:** A big farmer in his best waistcoat banging a stick on a trestle to bring a meeting to order.
personality: Core: patient to the point of stubbornness; quotes the meeting minutes from memory; buys a round after every vote he wins
Quirk: cannot leave a quarrel alone once he has been asked into it

npcs.name: Erwin Tessmer
npcs.info:
The lieutenant's under-manager at the pits, a young engineer in a clean collar with a degree he mentions often. He drew the plans for the new galleries at Mine Number Eight and the budget for its timber, and he is proud of both.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth and quick, an under-manager who answers safety with savings.
**Combat Role:** none; a revolver in his coat he has never drawn
**Relationship Hook:** A young engineer with rolled plans telling a crowd of miners that the creaking is only settling.
personality: Core: confident and glib; quotes his training; polite to the miners and contemptuous of them
Quirk: cannot admit an error

npcs.name: Eskil Brann
npcs.info:
The weather observer at the Range Weather Station, a corporal who reads the barometer, the wind and the snow three times a day and wires them to the fort and to headquarters. He lives alone in the hut and likes it.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and wry, a weatherman who forecasts doom with a little smile.
**Combat Role:** a mountain scout with a carbine; he knows the ridge and the snow and fights from both
**Relationship Hook:** A wry observer in a fur hat writing in a notebook beside a white instrument box on a snowy rise.
personality: Core: wry and solitary; trusts the barometer more than officers; talks to the weather
Quirk: loyal to the fort

npcs.name: Eugen Pfaff
npcs.info:
The telegraph clerk at the post office, a narrow young man with sleeve garters, a green eyeshade and a habit of tapping out other people's conversations on the counter with one finger. He sends forty words a minute and reads the key by ear across a noisy room.

**Speaking Style:** Polite and eager, a young clerk who repeats a message back word for word before he is asked to.
**Combat Role:** none; he ducks behind the brass grille and rings the bell for help
**Relationship Hook:** A young clerk in a green eyeshade tapping a stranger's words on the counter as the stranger says them.
personality: Core: blushes when caught listening; copies everything, from habit; boasts of his speed on the key
Quirk: taps out what he hears

npcs.name: Eusebius Ostermann
npcs.info:
The old tailor who cuts the uniforms of every new officer posted east, a small bald man with a tape round his neck and a mouthful of pins. He has measured half the colonels in the army, never repeats a word said in his fitting room and can tell a man's character from the way he stands in front of the mirror.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and courtly, an old tailor who calls everyone 'sir' and measures them while he says it.
**Combat Role:** none; tailor's shears and a heavy pressing iron, neither used in anger in fifty years
**Relationship Hook:** A small old tailor with pins in his mouth chalking a line on blue wool across a broad table.
personality: Core: courtly, discreet and very proud; measures everyone without asking; sighs at a badly pressed sleeve
Quirk: can keep a pin in his mouth for a whole conversation

npcs.name: Ewald Harr
npcs.info:
A colonel of the southern staff who spends more evenings at the billiard table of the Southern Officers' Club than at his desk. He is handsome, well connected in Central and a superb shot with a cue and a pistol both. Lieutenants want to be noticed by him. The wiser ones learn not to be.

**Speaking Style:** Silken and amused, a colonel who makes every remark sound like a joke the listener is not in on.
**Combat Role:** a duellist's pistol, drawn fast and fired once; he fences too, and well
**Relationship Hook:** A handsome colonel chalking a cue under a green lamp, smiling at a nervous lieutenant.
personality: Core: charming and cold underneath; never loses at billiards; treats lieutenants as horses
Quirk: remembers every debt owed to him

npcs.name: Ewald Prinz
npcs.info:
The captain in charge of the depot is a quartermaster to his bones, a heavy patient man who can tell you the weight of a crate of boots without lifting it. He runs the weighbridge office himself and signs every book in green ink so no forger can match it.

**Speaking Style:** Deliberate and figure-heavy, a quartermaster who gives every answer as a sum.
**Combat Role:** a heavy service revolver he fires slowly and accurately, from behind a desk he has already planned to overturn
**Relationship Hook:** A heavyset captain in sleeve protectors writing in a book in green ink beside a weighbridge.
personality: Core: answers everything with a number; signs in green ink and nothing else; generous in secret and mean in public
Quirk: trusts a weighbridge more than a man

npcs.name: Ewald Strick
npcs.info:
The leader of the raiders in the hollow, a hard-faced former sergeant of the Desert Road Fort who walked out with five men and the fort's best rifles last year. He robs caravans, takes their water and leaves them enough to reach the crossing.

**Speaking Style:** Rough and low, a sergeant's growl gone ragged at the edges.
**Combat Role:** a veteran sergeant with a rifle and a long knife who sets ambushes from the ridges
**Relationship Hook:** A hard-faced deserter with a rifle across his knees sitting by a fire ringed with stolen saddles.
personality: Core: hard and fair by his own rules; never leaves a caravan without water; despises the fort's commander
Quirk: stalls on hard choices

npcs.name: Ewald Tapp
npcs.info:
The postmaster and telegraph clerk, a fussy man in sleeve protectors who sends the mine's orders to East City and the miners' letters to their mothers. He is proud of his key and his speed, and proud that he has never lost a parcel.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped and fussy, a postmaster's voice that pronounces every word as if spelling it.
**Combat Role:** none; a heavy brass sounder and a desk to hide behind
**Relationship Hook:** A fussy clerk under a green eyeshade tapping a telegraph key with a stack of yellow forms beside him.
personality: Core: fussy and proud; burns what he is told to burn
Quirk: says 'regulations' instead of 'no'

npcs.name: Ewald Weissbeck
npcs.info:
An Amestrian in a wooden cage in the magistrate's gaol, the foreign smuggler the whole court is arguing over. He is sunburnt, unshaven and cheerful in the way of a man who has nothing left to lose, and he has taught the gaoler to play cards.

**Speaking Style:** Broad and rough, Amestrian vowels mangling the few Xingese words he has, then a laugh at himself.
**Combat Role:** an old infantryman; fists, a stool leg and every dirty trick of the trenches
**Relationship Hook:** A sunburnt Amestrian grinning through the bars of a wooden cage, a hand of cards fanned in his fingers.
personality: Core: learns the Xingese for every card game; never names his buyer; homesick for bread and pretends otherwise
Quirk: cheerful in a cage

npcs.name: Ewan Lusk
npcs.info:
A shepherd in his forties with a crude iron hand strapped to his left wrist, who brings his pony to be shod every few weeks and stays longer than the shoeing takes. The hand is a hook with fingers in name only, black and heavy, and he uses it to open gates and carry a lantern. He does not complain. He never did.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and slow, a shepherd who apologises for the clank of his hand.
**Combat Role:** a shepherd's crook and an iron hand that hits harder than it grips
**Relationship Hook:** A shepherd with a crude iron hand holding his pony steady while a smith hammers on a shoe.
personality: Core: gentle and apologetic; tucks the iron hand into his coat when strangers pass; loyal past sense
Quirk: talks to his pony more than to people

npcs.name: Ezra Wendling
npcs.info:
