The keeper of the last halt on the branch line is a mild, balding man who keeps the stove lit, the lamp trimmed and the stretchers stacked. Troops getting down for the march and wounded men waiting to go back both know his tea.

**Speaking Style:** Mild and unhurried, a halt keeper who offers tea before he answers anything.
**Combat Role:** none; a stove poker and a calm voice
**Relationship Hook:** A mild balding man offering a mug of tea beside a pot-bellied stove in a railway hut.
personality: Core: offers tea to everyone; talks gently to the wounded; believes the best of people
Quirk: taps his fingers in rhythm when he is thinking

npcs.name: Ezzat Harun
npcs.info:
A desert guide born to the black-tent herders, who hires out to caravans between the crossing and the ruins. He knows every well that is real and every one that only looks it. He will make camp anywhere in the desert except inside the walls of Bonath, and he sleeps at the gate stump instead.

**Speaking Style:** Low and rolling, a guide's voice that tells the time by the sun and the danger by the wind.
**Combat Role:** a guide with a long knife and a sling, who strikes from the dark and leads the enemy into soft sand
**Relationship Hook:** A desert guide in an indigo robe sitting against a half-fallen arch, looking at burned streets he will not enter.
personality: Core: calm and wary; never camps inside the walls; reads the wind before breakfast
Quirk: charges fairly and argues hard

npcs.name: Fabian Lisle
npcs.info:
The night porter of the lake hotel, a smooth young man with brilliantined hair who knows which guests want waking, which want their shoes polished and which want things the hotel does not officially provide. He sleeps through the afternoons in a room behind the kitchen and is, by his own account, the only man in Dublith who has read a novel.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth and discreet, a night porter who murmurs and quotes novels he has only half read.
**Combat Role:** none; a quick tongue, a passkey to every room and a back stair
**Relationship Hook:** A sleek young porter on a moonlit terrace, holding a lantern out over the water and trying not to look worried.
personality: Core: discreet about everything except himself; quotes novels badly; takes trouble lightly until it is his own
Quirk: notices shoes before faces

npcs.name: Fang Liqun
npcs.info:
A Xingese caravan mistress who brings tea and medicines west and has camped her string in the red canyon for the shade, against the advice of her guide. She is generous, quick and sure of her own luck.

**Speaking Style:** Cheerful and loud, a caravan mistress who laughs at danger until it arrives.
**Combat Role:** a caravan mistress with a whip and a knife who keeps her camels between herself and trouble
**Relationship Hook:** A laughing caravan mistress in a bright blue jacket among camels in the floor of a red canyon.
personality: Core: bold and cheerful; trusts her luck; generous with tea
Quirk: dismisses local warnings

npcs.name: Fang Tiesheng
npcs.info:
Master of the upriver foundry, a restless, clever man who runs the furnace day and night and the river barges by the season. He is proud of his waterwheel, and prouder of the machine he keeps under canvas behind it.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, quick and sure, every sentence a forge blow.
**Combat Role:** a foundryman with a long iron rake; he fights by a furnace and makes the heat his ally
**Relationship Hook:** A soot-dark foundry master lifting the corner of a canvas cover to show a gleaming foreign engine.
personality: Core: talks faster the more worried he is; pats the canvas over the engine like a horse; proud and quick to boast
Quirk: hungry for anything from the west

npcs.name: Farid Halun
npcs.info:
The Ishvalan who owns the shuttered house on the back lane, a quiet carpenter with a lame foot who sits on a crate by his alley door most evenings, whittling. He lends the house to people the army is looking for and asks them nothing.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and slow, a carpenter's patience in every word, never asking anything back.
**Combat Role:** a lame carpenter with a hatchet and a house he knows in the dark; he fights from behind his own doors
**Relationship Hook:** A quiet Ishvalan carpenter whittling on a crate by an alley door, his eyes on the mouth of the lane.
personality: Core: whittles while he watches the lane; asks his guests nothing; limps more when soldiers pass
Quirk: keeps a lamp burning low at all hours

npcs.name: Faris Nadeem
npcs.info:
A broad-shouldered young Ishvalan who was a boy when his family's street in Ishval burned. He keeps the camp's knives sharp, stands at the front when strangers come, and argues with the elder in public, which nobody in the camp did before him. Half the young people listen to him now.

**Speaking Style:** Hot and fast; he speaks in challenges and lowers his voice only when he names the dead.
**Combat Role:** an Ishvalan knife-fighter; short blade, low stance, close and fast
**Relationship Hook:** A young Ishvalan with a scarred brow standing in front of canvas shelters with his arms crossed.
personality: Core: proud and angry; stands between the camp and every stranger; argues with the elder and regrets it at night
Quirk: loves his little sister more than his anger

npcs.name: Faris Sefir
npcs.info:
A herder from the dry country with a flock of fat-tailed sheep and a dun camel, who gives the town gate an Amestrian name and a farm that does not exist. He wears a deep headcloth even at night.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and deliberate; he waits after each sentence to see if it has been understood.
**Combat Role:** an Ishvalan herder's crook and sling; he fights only to get his animals clear
**Relationship Hook:** A tall herder in a deep headcloth leaning on a crook among his sheep, eyes down.
personality: Core: patient and proud; counts his flock twice before selling; keeps his eyes lowered at the gate
Quirk: never haggles with another herder

npcs.name: Fausto Mirelli
npcs.info:
The customs officer at the Aerugonian post below the pass, a heavy, ironic man who stamps passes for the few who still cross under a white flag. He drinks bad coffee, reads old newspapers and sees everything that moves on the road.

**Speaking Style:** Dry and ironic, a customs man who treats the whole war as a paperwork error.
**Combat Role:** none; a customs officer with a sentry and a striped barrier
**Relationship Hook:** A heavy customs officer with a coffee cup in a tiled hut, eyeing a cart at the barrier.
personality: Core: dry and ironic; drinks bad coffee by the pot
Quirk: paid twice and loyal to neither

npcs.name: Felix Bramm
npcs.info:
The telegraph operator at the end of the line, a young corporal who taps out convoy reports and weather and reads cheap adventure novels between messages. He is lonely and glad of anyone who will talk about the novels.

**Speaking Style:** Chatty and quick; he talks the way he taps, in bursts, and laughs at the end of each one.
**Combat Role:** none worth naming; a signaller with a pistol he has never fired
**Relationship Hook:** A skinny freckled soldier at a telegraph key with a cheap novel open beside him.
personality: Core: lonely and chatty; reads cheap novels; copies every message
Quirk: frightened of the dark beyond the hut

npcs.name: Felix Rumm
npcs.info:
A private of the garrison who runs the card table in the smoky room at the end of the block and wins more cigarettes than any man could smoke. He is cheerful, sharp-eyed and posted to Ishval because no other post would have him.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth and teasing, a card sharp's easy patter that never quite stops.
**Combat Role:** a barracks brawler with a broken bottle and no shame
**Relationship Hook:** A grinning private fanning a hand of cards across a felt table in a cloud of smoke.
personality: Core: charming and lazy; cheats only officers; remembers every card played that night
Quirk: sends his mother a letter every week

npcs.name: Feng Mao
npcs.info:
An archivist of the Xing imperial house, who keeps the scroll room and the reading desks where court scholars read the old records. He is precise, dry and devoted to the scrolls, and he corrects every reader who touches them without gloves. He knows which records the court wants forgotten.

**Speaking Style:** Precise and dry, an archivist who corrects every reader and loves every scroll.
**Combat Role:** none; a brush and a sharp mind
**Relationship Hook:** An archivist in a scroll room, correcting a young reader who has touched a scroll without gloves.
personality: Core: precise and dry; corrects every reader; devoted to the scrolls
Quirk: knows what the court wants forgotten

npcs.name: Fenja Rothkirch
npcs.info:
The night supervisor of the switchboard girls, a sharp-eyed young woman who walks behind the row of stools with a pencil and catches a crossed line before the caller has noticed. She has worked the exchange since it opened and can find any number in the city from memory. The soldier standing behind the army's two boards brings her coffee and is trying, so far without success, to make her laugh.

**Speaking Style:** Clear and practised, an operator's voice that says 'number please' even when she is only asking the time.
**Combat Role:** none; a sharp tongue, a long pencil and the ability to cut off any call in the city
**Relationship Hook:** A young operator in a headset walking behind a row of switchboard girls, pencil raised to point at a lamp.
personality: Core: quick, crisp and hard to fluster; keeps a list of her girls' debts
Quirk: hears everything and repeats nothing

npcs.name: Fenna Dross
npcs.info:
One of the few women on the coaling stage, black to the eyebrows by noon and stronger than most of the men who joke about her. She took the job when her husband went to the border and has kept it since his name went up on the casualty column.

**Speaking Style:** Flat and dry, a coal-heaver who says the worst thing in the room without changing her tone.
**Combat Role:** a coal shovel and a heaver's arms; a flat swing and a shove off the stage edge
**Relationship Hook:** A coal-blackened woman leaning on a shovel on the coaling stage, one eyebrow raised.
personality: Core: says what everyone thinks and nobody says; works through the jokes without looking up
Quirk: gives away what is not hers if it keeps someone warm

npcs.name: Fenna Lark
npcs.info:
A goat girl of twelve who grazes her family's small herd in the old olive grove. She is barefoot, sunburnt and almost silent with grown-ups, but sings to the goats all day. She knows every hollow trunk in the grove.

**Speaking Style:** Shy and whispery, a goat girl who speaks to adults as if they might bolt.
**Combat Role:** none; a goat girl who can climb any tree and vanish
**Relationship Hook:** A barefoot goat girl among old olive trees, glancing toward a hollow trunk.
personality: Core: shy with adults; keeps secrets well
Quirk: sings to her goats

npcs.name: Ferdinand Gaul
npcs.info:
The sergeant in charge of the Gate Ward Guardhouse, where the military police check papers on the road out of the city. He has stood at the desk for nine years and has seen every forgery, every bribe and every sob story at least once.

**Speaking Style:** Short and heavy, each sentence a stamp coming down on a form.
**Combat Role:** a military policeman with a truncheon and revolver; he fights in doorways, uses his weight and cuffs before he talks
**Relationship Hook:** A heavy sergeant at a papers desk holding a passport up to the lamp, rubber stamp waiting.
personality: Core: blunt and unshockable; never hurries a stamp; lets a mother with a child through first
Quirk: reads his private notebook every night

npcs.name: Ferdinand Lader
npcs.info:
A coal loader at the depot, a giant young man who tips tubs into wagons all day and arm-wrestles the train crews for beer every evening. He is the town's strongest man and the gentlest drunk.

**Speaking Style:** Loud and good-humoured, a loader who shouts everything because the depot is always loud.
**Combat Role:** bare fists and a strength that tips a coal tub alone
**Relationship Hook:** A giant loader chalking a mark on a coal wagon at night while no one is looking.
personality: Core: loud and gentle; arm-wrestles for beer
Quirk: uneasy about easy money

npcs.name: Ferdinand Thiel
npcs.info:
A young lieutenant from East City sent to buy optical glass, who wears his uniform as if it were a suit and talks about rifle sights the way other men talk about wine. He has been at the kilns a week.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth and friendly, a young officer who smiles before he threatens.
**Combat Role:** an officer with a pistol and a sword he wears for show
**Relationship Hook:** A neat young officer holding a glass lens up to the light beside a glowing kiln.
personality: Core: smooth and ambitious; smiles before he threatens; dresses well in any heat
Quirk: hates being refused

npcs.name: Ferdl Hupka
npcs.info:
A clay digger at the brick pits, twenty-three, who has cut clay since he was fourteen and lives with his mother in the brickmakers' cottages. He is strong, lazy when the foreman is away and the best whistler on the row. Since he left the job he sits on his mother's step all day and will not say why.

**Speaking Style:** Easy and cheerful when he forgets himself, and quiet as a stone when he remembers.
**Combat Role:** a strong young labourer with a clay spade and no idea how to fight
**Relationship Hook:** A young labourer sitting on a cottage step with his cap in his hands, staring toward the flooded pits.
personality: Core: cheerful, idle and scared; whistles when he is nervous; loves his mother more than he admits
Quirk: cannot keep a secret long

npcs.name: Ferris
npcs.info:
A tram driver at the East City depot, who drives the city's tram lines and keeps his cars running in the car shed. He is slow, easy and content, and he knows every engine and every track. He sees the army's convoys pass his depot and he has an opinion about each one.

**Speaking Style:** Easy and slow, a driver who likes machines more than people and says so.
**Combat Role:** none; a spanner and a grease rag
**Relationship Hook:** A tram driver in a car shed, listening to an engine with his head on one side.
personality: Core: slow, easy and content; knows every engine by its noise; has an opinion about each convoy
Quirk: keeps a grease rag in every pocket

npcs.name: Ferris Volkmann
npcs.info:
The sergeant of the military police post, a heavy, sleepy-eyed man who reads the newspaper on the step most mornings and lets the bad side keep its own order so long as it keeps it quietly. He has two privates, one telephone and a lock-up that holds drunks on market nights.

**Speaking Style:** Heavy and tired, a sergeant who sounds bored until money or a superior officer comes into it.
**Combat Role:** an army pistol and a truncheon, and the habit of shooting first when frightened
**Relationship Hook:** A heavyset military police sergeant on a step, lowering his newspaper to look at a stranger.
personality: Core: reads the newspaper aloud to nobody; salutes anyone above him twice; calls every civilian citizen in a weary voice
Quirk: sleepy-eyed until he smells money

npcs.name: Fessler
npcs.info:
Brigadier General Fessler, in command of the Kanda region of Ishval in the civil war, a petty, ignorant officer more interested in his own reputation than his soldiers' lives. He makes hasty decisions to clear his sector first, and he berates any man who breaks under the strain.

**Speaking Style:** Petty and boastful, a commander who calls his own men's deaths home runs.
**Combat Role:** a pistol and the garrison at his back
**Relationship Hook:** A pinched general shouting at his men to get back into the fighting.
personality: Core: careless with his men's lives; berates the broken; wants credit above all
Quirk: petty and boastful

npcs.name: Florentin Kaltwasser
npcs.info:
The manager of the best hotel in the east, a sleek man in a frock coat with a carnation and a smile for everyone who comes through the revolving door. He knows which officials from the capital like the trout, which like the girls from the music hall and which like to be left alone, and he arranges all three without a word written down.

**Speaking Style:** Silken and assured, a hotel manager who agrees with you before you have finished speaking.
**Combat Role:** none; porters, a telephone, and a talent for being somewhere else
**Relationship Hook:** A sleek hotel manager adjusting his carnation at a marble reception desk.
personality: Core: smooth and obliging; never forgets a guest's preferences; afraid of real trouble and good at avoiding it
Quirk: adjusts his carnation when he is lying

npcs.name: Florian Moll
npcs.info:
The caretaker of Stag Ridge Lodge, an old man who lives in a room off the kitchen and keeps the lodge's stag heads dusted for the generals' shooting parties. He opens the lodge with a great deal of fuss whenever someone important comes north.

**Speaking Style:** Creaking and servile, an old caretaker who agrees with everyone and remembers everything.
**Combat Role:** none; a hunting lodge full of guns he knows how to clean but not to fire
**Relationship Hook:** An old caretaker dusting a stag head in a grand trophy hall.
personality: Core: servile and observant; dusts the stag heads daily; afraid of the generals and loyal to none
Quirk: remembers every word said at dinner

npcs.name: Focker
npcs.info:
Captain Focker of Central, who works in the same administrative office as Lieutenant Colonel Hughes and Sheska. He is a competent, bespectacled officer with brown eyes who knows the office's routine and its people.

**Speaking Style:** A dry, careful officer's voice, quick through a report and short on comfort.
**Combat Role:** a sidearm and a desk
**Relationship Hook:** A bespectacled captain laying out a thin file on a murdered friend.
personality: Core: dry and careful; loyal to his office; short on comfort
Quirk: competent at a desk

npcs.name: Fort Briggs Doctor
npcs.info:
The doctor and automail engineer of Fort Briggs, an expert in the cold's effects on the body and in cold-climate automail. She keeps the garrison alive and its metal limbs working, and she likely helped build Buccaneer's arms. She grew up with three brothers and a little sister and is not easily shocked.

**Speaking Style:** Calm, practical and warm, a doctor who explains frostbite as cheerfully as the weather.
**Combat Role:** none; a doctor's hands and a toolkit
**Relationship Hook:** A doctor in a white coat refitting a soldier's steel arm while the wind howls.
personality: Core: calm and practical; unshockable; kind to the wounded
Quirk: expert on cold and automail

npcs.name: Fox
npcs.info:
Brigadier General Fox, one of the most powerful men in the State Military and a prominent face of Central Command, a ruthless and practical officer.

**Speaking Style:** Hard and blunt, used to orders being followed and impatient when they are not.
**Combat Role:** a pistol and Central's soldiers
**Relationship Hook:** A general with a pistol trained on another general, his hand shaking a little.
personality: Core: ruthless and practical; panics when threatened; certain of his side
Quirk: used to obedience

npcs.name: Fritz Amsel
npcs.info:
An orphan of eleven with his dead father's forage cap pulled down over his ears, who has decided he is old enough to fight. He drills the younger children in the yard with a stick for a rifle and salutes everybody in uniform.

**Speaking Style:** High and fierce, a boy who announces everything as if to a parade.
**Combat Role:** a stick, a slingshot and a boy's fury
**Relationship Hook:** A skinny boy in an oversized army cap marching across a dirt yard with a stick on his shoulder.
personality: Core: proud and furious; salutes every uniform; bosses the younger children and protects them too
Quirk: will not cry where anyone can see

npcs.name: Fritzi Marlow
npcs.info:
A shepherd's daughter of nine with grazed knees and a pocket full of chalk, who spends every break drawing circles on the flagstones by the schoolyard pump. Quiet, stubborn and much cleverer than she lets the other children see, she wants to be like the brothers in the stories and knows exactly which desk was theirs.

**Speaking Style:** Small and serious, a girl who explains things very carefully, as though grown-ups are slow.
**Combat Role:** none; a stick of chalk and a quick pair of legs
**Relationship Hook:** A small girl blowing chalk dust off a circle on the flagstones, frowning in concentration.
personality: Core: serious beyond her years; hides her best work; listens to every story about the brothers twice
Quirk: draws circles on anything flat

npcs.name: Fu
npcs.info:
Ling Yao's senior bodyguard and Lan Fan's grandfather, a small, wiry old man with spiky grey hair and a bushy moustache who fights in black with kunai, a sword and Xingese explosives. He is stern, wise and frighteningly skilled, a strategist who values his prince's life above his own and his granddaughter's.

**Speaking Style:** A stern old voice, low and sparing, that turns gentle only for his granddaughter and only in private.
**Combat Role:** a master Xingese martial artist with kunai, sword and explosives, able to hold off a swordsman no man can match
**Relationship Hook:** A small old man in black at a gatehouse, kunai already in his hand.
personality: Core: stern, wise and sparing with words; puts his prince before his own blood; never wastes a movement
Quirk: hard on his granddaughter because he loves her

npcs.name: Gamelan
npcs.info:
An officer of the third sovereign battalion in Central City, a keen, dutiful soldier who leads his platoon where Central sends it.

**Speaking Style:** A brisk field officer's voice, keen and certain, used to leading from the front of a platoon.
**Combat Role:** a rifle and a platoon
**Relationship Hook:** An officer leading his platoon at a gate, about to meet one small old man.
personality: Core: leads from the front; never questions the order; brave but outmatched
Quirk: keen and dutiful

npcs.name: Gao Tian
npcs.info:
The trading house's porter and guard, a big quiet Xingese who sits on a stool before the locked silk store with a short sword across his knees and a bowl of seeds to crack. He has been at the crossing for six years and still speaks only enough Amestrian to refuse things.

**Speaking Style:** Short and flat, a guard who answers in grunts until something interests him.
**Combat Role:** a Xingese soldier with a short sword and a round shield, steady in a doorway
**Relationship Hook:** A big shaven-headed guard on a stool cracking seeds in front of a locked door.
personality: Core: silent and loyal; cracks seeds all day; refuses in two languages
Quirk: sends money to his old garrison

npcs.name: Gardner
npcs.info:
Lieutenant General Gardner, one of the most powerful men in the State Military and a high-profile member of Central Command. He is calm, confident and entirely sure of the side he has chosen.

**Speaking Style:** Cool and confiding, a general who tells a newcomer the deepest secrets as if offering her a drink.
**Combat Role:** none in person; command and the hidden army below
**Relationship Hook:** A grey-haired general leading a colleague down into a vault of motionless soldiers.
personality: Core: calm and confiding; sure of his side; fond of showing a newcomer how things really work
Quirk: underestimates the woman across the table

npcs.name: Garfiel
npcs.info:
The owner of Atelier Garfiel in Rush Valley, a big, muscular automail engineer with effeminate, effusive manners and real skill. He takes on clients' service calls across the valley and is delighted by talent wherever he finds it.

**Speaking Style:** Effusive, sing-song and fussy, a mechanic who coos over a pretty limb and a pretty apprentice alike.
**Combat Role:** none; a mechanic's strength
**Relationship Hook:** A muscular mechanic clasping his hands in delight over a beautifully made automail arm.
personality: Core: effusive and fussy; generous to an apprentice; serious about his craft
Quirk: delighted by talent

npcs.name: Gaspard Lunn
npcs.info:
A wiry old poacher from the hamlet on the far shore who rows across to Yock Island at dusk to work the rabbit runs by the toad pool, with snares of plaited grass so fine a keeper would never spot them. He sells the rabbits in the Dublith market as tame stock from his own hutches, and the market pretends to believe him.

**Speaking Style:** Cackling and sly, an old poacher who laughs at his own lies before anyone can catch them.
**Combat Role:** a poacher's ambush; a weighted cosh from the long grass, and gone before his man gets up
**Relationship Hook:** A gap-toothed poacher crouched by a rabbit run at dusk, plaiting grass into a snare.
personality: Core: never sets a snare the same way twice; generous with rabbits, mean with secrets; keeps well clear of the butcher's wife
Quirk: cackles at his own lies

npcs.name: Ge Lianshou
npcs.info:
One of the keepers of the emperors' tombs, a gaunt man who lives in the lodge at the end of the spirit road and sets out the offerings every new moon. He has a dry way of telling visitors exactly how the three emperors died, and he enjoys their faces.

**Speaking Style:** Low and deadpan, a keeper of the dead who finds the living faintly ridiculous.
**Combat Role:** a keeper's guard with a long-handled axe; he fights on the spirit road among the stone beasts, using them as cover
**Relationship Hook:** A gaunt keeper at a low lodge door, holding a cup in two shaking hands and smiling at the grass mounds.
personality: Core: tells the emperors' deaths to every visitor with relish; holds his cup in both hands; fond of the stone beasts on the road and names them
Quirk: distrusts anyone who asks about elixirs

npcs.name: Gebhard Kalm
npcs.info:
The depot sergeant, a thickset man who makes every patrol sign for its water and checks the signatures himself. He is feared at the depot and liked by nobody, and he does not seem to mind.

**Speaking Style:** Blunt and rapid, a sergeant who barks to hide that he is worried.
**Combat Role:** a sergeant with a rifle and a hard voice, firing from the tank ladders
**Relationship Hook:** A thickset sergeant with a wrench glaring at a broken pump engine in a hot shed.
personality: Core: blunt and unloved; checks every signature; terrified of the north
Quirk: a fair hand with an engine

npcs.name: Gerd Stiller
npcs.info:
A young hewer who taught himself to write properly at the schoolhouse at night, and has written a letter to the papers in East City about the thin props, the short wicks and the levy. He has sealed it with candle wax and his thumbprint.

**Speaking Style:** Plain and steady, a miner who has rehearsed what he is going to say.
**Combat Role:** a miner's fists, used rarely
**Relationship Hook:** A young miner in his best collar holding a sealed letter at a post office counter, refusing to let go of it.
personality: Core: dogged and literal; proud of his handwriting
Quirk: trusts nobody with the letter

npcs.name: Gerda Kuhn
npcs.info:
The matron of the hillside convalescent home, a nursing officer of fifty who runs her terraces like a ship. She is strict about mealtimes, fresh air and letters home. Her patients are a little afraid of her and would follow her into a fire.

**Speaking Style:** Calm and exact, the voice of a nursing matron who has never once needed to shout.
**Combat Role:** none worth the name; a matron's stare and two orderlies
**Relationship Hook:** A tall matron in a starched veil reading a soldier's letter at an office window.
personality: Core: strict and fair; takes the terrace walk with each patient once a day; has never been seen to sit down
Quirk: reads every letter and burns almost none

npcs.name: Gereon Sollmann
npcs.info:
One of the two doctors of the Weber Street Free Clinic, a broad, untidy man of forty-five who resigned from the army hospital and took his instruments with him. He treats anyone who joins the queue, smokes on the back step between patients and has no patience for paperwork, officers or pity.

**Speaking Style:** Deep, dry and unimpressed, a doctor who makes jokes nobody laughs at while he stitches.
**Combat Role:** none by choice; a big surgeon with a steady hand, a scalpel and an army man's memory of a brawl
**Relationship Hook:** A heavy-set doctor stitching a man's arm by lamplight, a cigarette unlit between his lips.
personality: Core: blunt, tired and kind underneath; smokes when he should sleep; hates questions about the war
Quirk: never refuses a patient

npcs.name: Gerlach Ruess
npcs.info:
Weighmaster of the coal wharf for fifteen years, a heavy man gone grey-black with dust who stands at the crane berth with a clipboard and a pencil stub and calls out every barge's tonnage as the grabs swing it ashore. Bargemen curse his scales on the quay and buy him gin in the shelter afterwards, which he accepts as the natural order of things. His daughter keeps his books in a neat hand he cannot match.

**Speaking Style:** A growl from somewhere under the coal dust; he rounds his words down the way he rounds a load.
**Combat Role:** a heavy, slow man with an iron counterweight on a short chain, swung once and hard
**Relationship Hook:** A coal-blackened weighmaster with a clipboard squinting up at a crane grab swinging over a barge.
personality: Core: greedy in a small, steady, unambitious way; cannot bear to be hurried at the scales; frightened of the mine's owners and of nobody else
Quirk: treats every bargeman as an old friend and every miner as a stranger

npcs.name: Gernot Thwaite
npcs.info:
Foreman of the goods yard behind the passenger platform, a broad, slow man in a railway waistcoat who loads the wool wagons, unloads the farm machinery and knows the weight of everything that passes his gate. He has worked the yard since before the bombing and helped dig out the platform after it.

**Speaking Style:** Steady and confiding, a railway foreman who talks low because the sentry is always in earshot.
**Combat Role:** a loader's iron bar and a strong back; he would rather swing a crate than a punch
**Relationship Hook:** A broad railway foreman tapping a crate stencilled plough parts, frowning.
personality: Core: slow and steady; weighs everything with his eyes; loyal to his loaders before the railway
Quirk: keeps his voice low around uniforms

npcs.name: Gerold Gries
npcs.info:
The town's smith, a heavy grey man who draws out picks, mends cage chains and fits the pit ponies' shoes. Every miner owes him a favour and he has never called one in. He went to East City as a young man to apprentice to an alchemist and came home without a word about it.

**Speaking Style:** Deep and unhurried, a smith's voice that drops lower when he talks about the books he burned.
**Combat Role:** a smith's hammer swung short and heavy, and a chalk circle as a last resort
**Relationship Hook:** A grey smith shutting his forge door before kneeling to draw a chalk circle round a cracked iron hook.
personality: Core: slow-spoken and generous; never calls in a favour; grieves something he will not name
Quirk: shuts the door before he does anything unusual

npcs.name: Gerolf Krall
npcs.info:
The lieutenant in charge of the railhead, who meets every train from North City with a clipboard, a flask of coffee and a temper. He has to turn a freight car into lorry loads before the pass closes for the night, and he has done it every day for two winters.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped and impatient, a man who speaks in loads, minutes and last light.
**Combat Role:** a junior officer with a revolver and a loading crew who follow him; he fights from behind the stacked sacks
**Relationship Hook:** A lieutenant with a clipboard glaring at a sealed freight car, his breath steaming.
personality: Core: checks his watch every few minutes; swears at the crane and apologises to its driver; drinks his coffee boiling
Quirk: keeps two sets of figures

npcs.name: Gertrud Sallow
npcs.info:
Keeper of the drinking house on the south lane, a lean, sardonic woman who serves shepherds and their dogs, keeps the dartboard honest and settles fights by taking away the beer. Twice widowed, she says she is done with husbands but not with company. Her tavern is rougher than the inn, and warmer.

**Speaking Style:** Low and amused, a tavern keeper who has heard every story twice and lets you tell it anyway.
**Combat Role:** none; she takes the beer away, and that ends most fights
**Relationship Hook:** A sardonic tavern keeper chalking a score on a slate while dogs sleep under the tables.
personality: Core: dry and amused; ends fights at the beer tap; greets the dogs by name before the men
Quirk: lies for family without blinking

npcs.name: Gerwin Tasch
npcs.info:
The bath attendant at the garrison baths, a big young ex-private with a towel over his shoulder who stokes the boiler, hands out the soap and rubs down the veterans' bad legs for a tip. He was invalided out with weak lungs and found the steam helps. He is friendly to everyone and remembers nothing anyone says in the hot room.

**Speaking Style:** Easy and drawling, a bath attendant who calls everyone 'mate' whatever their rank.
**Combat Role:** a big man with a wet towel and a slippery floor; he grapples and lets the floor do the rest
**Relationship Hook:** A big young attendant with a towel over his shoulder waving away steam in a tiled hot room.
personality: Core: easy-going and strong; coughs in the cold
Quirk: hums marching songs while he works

npcs.name: Gesa Lorne
npcs.info:
The civilian cook who runs the barracks mess hall makes thin soup on the army's allowance and good bread on her own account. She calls every soldier by a nickname of her choosing and remembers which ones like the crust.

**Speaking Style:** Brisk and cheerful, a cook's patter of nicknames and threats with a laugh under every one.
**Combat Role:** a ladle, a hot pot and a cook's elbow; no training at all and no fear either
**Relationship Hook:** A plump cook in a white cap waving a ladle down a long mess table of soldiers.
personality: Core: feeds anyone who looks thin; nicknames everyone within a minute; asks no questions about where the flour comes from
Quirk: hits soldiers with a ladle and they thank her for it

npcs.name: Gesche Wust
npcs.info:
The loading foreman on the depot siding, a broad woman who runs a crew of loaders and gets a freight train empty faster than anyone in the north. Her crew is mostly widows and boys, and she will hear no word against any of them.

**Speaking Style:** Gravelly and short, a loader foreman who talks in shouts even when she whispers.
**Combat Role:** none; a cargo hook and a crew of loaders who would swing a crate for her
**Relationship Hook:** A broad foreman with a cargo hook shouting a crew of loaders across a snowy siding.
personality: Core: loud and fair; protects her crew; works harder than any of them
Quirk: keeps notes on what she should not

npcs.name: Gesine Senn
npcs.info:
A collier's widow with four children and a long memory, who checks every line of her family's slate against a scrap of paper she keeps in her bodice. She is not afraid of the shopman or of the soldier at the door, and she says so.

**Speaking Style:** Loud and certain, a voice raised in the shop that carries out to the square.
**Combat Role:** a widow's fury and a market basket swung hard
**Relationship Hook:** A widow in faded black slapping a paper receipt on a store counter.
personality: Core: keeps every receipt; would die before she let the children go hungry for a lie
Quirk: fearless and loud

npcs.name: Gideon Harkwell
npcs.info:
The stationmaster of Reole, a heavy man in a railway waistcoat with a pocket watch he trusts more than the timetable. He sells the tickets, rings the bell, fills the engine tank and guards the telegraph key under a cloth in the back room, as if it were a canary that might catch cold.

**Speaking Style:** Dry, unhurried and amused at everyone's urgency but his own; he taps the desk while he talks.
**Combat Role:** none; he locks the office door and talks through the ticket window
**Relationship Hook:** A heavy stationmaster tapping out a message with one hand and checking his watch with the other.
personality: Core: genial and venal; answers questions with the time of day; reads every telegram he sends
Quirk: keeps a biscuit tin nobody may touch

npcs.name: Gideon Sauerbrey
npcs.info:
The fellmonger downstream of town, a tall, stooped man with lime-burned hands who takes the skins of dead sheep, soaks them until the wool slips and sells pelts and wool apart. The smell keeps visitors off, which suits him. He is polite, unhurried and a good deal better off than his trade suggests.

**Speaking Style:** Low and reasonable, a fellmonger who talks about rot as if it were the weather.
**Combat Role:** a long pit pole with an iron hook, and a man untroubled by blood
**Relationship Hook:** A tall stooped fellmonger hooking a dripping sheepskin out of a lime pit.
personality: Core: polite and unhurried; counts coin with lime-white fingers; talks of disease without fear
Quirk: never shakes hands

npcs.name: Gido Rusk
npcs.info:
A charcoal burner in the holm oak wood, a black-faced, slow-moving man who watches his smoking stacks for days at a time. He fought in the border wars as a young man and has wanted nothing to do with armies since. He lives alone with a lurcher dog.

**Speaking Style:** Rumbling and smoky, a charcoal burner whose voice sounds cured in the stack.
**Combat Role:** an old soldier with a woodsman's axe and a lurcher at his heel
**Relationship Hook:** A soot-blackened charcoal burner with an axe and a lurcher beside a smoking mound in an oak wood.
personality: Core: slow and watchful; talks mostly to his dog; despises both armies equally
Quirk: honest about his price

npcs.name: Gil Haddon
npcs.info:
A bookie who takes wagers on Forge Street in Rush Valley, where the automail mechanics, the travellers and the street hustlers all bet. He is quick, jovial and always after the next bet, and he knows every wager in town. He is not a bad man, only a greedy one.

**Speaking Style:** Fast and jovial, a bookie who talks odds over everything.
**Combat Role:** none; a pair of dice and a quick mouth
**Relationship Hook:** A bookie on a bench on Forge Street taking a wager from a mechanic.
personality: Core: fast, jovial and greedy; knows every wager in town; always after the next bet
Quirk: losing money hurts more than it should

npcs.name: Giolio Comanche
npcs.info:
Major Giolio Comanche, the Silver Alchemist, an elderly, tiny State Alchemist with a long moustache and a peg for a left leg, whose thirst for battle hides behind a grandfather's face. He moves nimbly on the peg and fights with blades he transmutes on the spot.

**Speaking Style:** A merry, grandfatherly chuckle over a voice that relishes a fight.
**Combat Role:** silver alchemy, a storm of transmuted blades, hopping and balancing on a peg leg
**Relationship Hook:** A tiny old man on a peg leg grinning at a killer in the dark.
personality: Core: grandfatherly and merry; hungry for a fight; nimble on his peg leg
Quirk: holds a grudge for his leg

npcs.name: Gisbert Haller
npcs.info:
The dairy farmer's only son, twenty-six, who went east with his regiment at nineteen and came home after the war without a word left in him. He milks the herd before dawn and after dusk, hands steady, face blank, and the cows settle for him as they will for nobody else. His mother sings to fill the silence. His father has stopped trying.

**Speaking Style:** Barely there; when he speaks at all it is a few words, low, and never about himself.
**Combat Role:** a soldier's rifle drill, half buried, that comes back all at once if anyone corners him
**Relationship Hook:** A hollow-eyed young man on a milking stool, forehead against a cow's flank, eyes closed.
personality: Core: silent and steady; gentle with animals, stiff with people; walks at night when the dreams come
Quirk: flinches at the smell of burning

npcs.name: Giuliana Orsi
npcs.info:
The widow who runs the largest farm on the cypress lane, a square, sun-dark woman with five sons at the front and twenty hired hands at home. She feeds a division and knows it, and the army's buyers treat her with care.

**Speaking Style:** Heavy and deliberate, a farm widow who never says a word she has not weighed.
**Combat Role:** none; a farm woman with twenty hands and a shotgun over the door
**Relationship Hook:** A square farm widow in black standing among grain sacks in a sunny courtyard, watching carts leave.
personality: Core: heavy and deliberate; weighs every word
Quirk: loves her sons and hates the war that took them

npcs.name: Glotz
npcs.info:
The owner of the pawn shop in Rush Valley's west alley, a round, soft-handed man who buys anything and asks nothing. His shop is crowded with tools, jewels and one very valuable vase he never lets anyone near. He is greedy, careful and polite, and he can price a thing faster than its owner can name it.

**Speaking Style:** Oily and soft, a pawnbroker who praises a thing while he talks its price down.
**Combat Role:** none; a pawnbroker with a heavy cane and a bell to call the street
**Relationship Hook:** A round pawnbroker peering through a loupe at a pocket watch across his counter.
personality: Core: greedy and polite; never asks where a thing came from; fussy about the vase
Quirk: remembers every face that sold to him

npcs.name: Gottfried Lehm
npcs.info:
The kiln master of the brickworks, a quiet man with clay in every crease who has built half the chimneys in town. He fires the slack nobody else will buy and turns out a red brick the whole district wants.

**Speaking Style:** Unhurried and thoughtful, a kiln master who weighs every word like a brick in his palm.
**Combat Role:** none; arms that shift brick all day and a kiln door he can slam
**Relationship Hook:** A kiln master turning a red brick in his clay-caked hands, his eyes on the far corner of the yard.
personality: Core: slow and thoughtful; proud of his bricks; keeps finds to himself
Quirk: curious despite his caution

npcs.name: Gottfried Vennholt
npcs.info:
The chief surgeon of the field hospital is a major who has operated by lamplight behind the Pendleton front for seven years. He is fast, brilliant and very tired, and the orderlies say he has not slept a full night since the war began.

**Speaking Style:** Deep and tired, a surgeon-major who speaks in short orders and longer silences.
**Combat Role:** an officer's revolver he has rarely fired; in a pinch he is steady-handed and coldly accurate
**Relationship Hook:** A gaunt surgeon-major in a stained gown working under a lamp in a canvas tent.
personality: Core: fast, precise and curt; sleeps sitting up between operations; remembers every man he has passed fit
Quirk: drinks, but never before surgery

npcs.name: Gottfried Wexler
npcs.info:
The senior sergeant of the North Area Barracks, who has drilled two generations of city troops on the swept square. He is broad, grey at the temples and slow to praise, and recruits learn his rules before they learn their officers' names. Lieutenants come and go; Gottfried Wexler stays, and the barracks runs on his book of who can be trusted with what.

**Speaking Style:** A parade-ground bark worn smooth by twenty winters; he never raises it indoors and never lowers it outside.
**Combat Role:** a veteran rifleman and bayonet drillmaster; he holds a line, picks his shot and closes only when the other man has emptied his gun
**Relationship Hook:** A grey sergeant on a swept parade square, rifle at his side, staring down a line of shivering recruits.
personality: Core: slow to praise and quick to notice; keeps a book of every man's habits in his head; takes the cold without a word and expects the same of others; dislikes officers who want to be seen
Quirk: drinks one glass at the winter feast and no more

npcs.name: Gottlieb Stamm
npcs.info:
The roadmender of the coach road between the village and the town, a wiry, sunburned man who lives beside his heap of road stone, breaks it to size with a long hammer and fills the ruts the carts leave. By order he shuts the field gate across the road at dusk, and he grumbles at anyone who wants it open. He knows every traveller by the marks their wheels leave.

**Speaking Style:** Chatty and sly, a roadmender who complains about every cart and knows which ones to forget.
**Combat Role:** a long stone-breaking hammer, swung like a scythe
**Relationship Hook:** A wiry roadmender kneeling in the road, measuring a deep rut with his fingers.
personality: Core: chatty and complaining; never refuses a share; plays stupider than he is
Quirk: reads wheel ruts like a newspaper

npcs.name: Gottlob Harzer
npcs.info:
A charcoal burner who lives alone in a turf hut in the Grauwald, black to the elbows, with a stack of wood, a smoking clamp and a dog. He came out of the army after the eastern war and has not been back to the city since. Woodcutters buy his charcoal and leave him alone.

**Speaking Style:** Few words, low and slow, from a man who has spent years talking only to his fire.
**Combat Role:** an old infantryman with a service rifle and a woodsman's patience; he fires once from cover and moves
**Relationship Hook:** A soot-black charcoal burner standing in the smoke of his clamp, his dog at his knee and a rifle against the hut.
personality: Core: silent, wary and steady; trusts dogs more than people; keeps his old service rifle oiled
Quirk: sleeps badly in the rain

npcs.name: Gracia Hughes
npcs.info:
The kind-hearted wife of Lieutenant Colonel Maes Hughes and mother of little Elicia, who keeps a warm house in Central and bakes pies and cakes for any visitor, the Elric brothers and Winry included. She bears her husband's endless doting with patient good humour.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, kind and patient, the voice of a woman who makes everyone feel welcome at her table.
**Combat Role:** none
**Relationship Hook:** A kind woman at her door with a pie, a toddler clinging to her skirt.
personality: Core: kind and welcoming; patient with her husband's doting; quietly strong
Quirk: bakes for every guest

npcs.name: Greed
npcs.info:
The boss of the Devil's Nest bar in Dublith, a tall, grinning man in round sunglasses and a fur-collared jacket who says he wants everything: money, women, power and eternal life. He calls himself the Ultimate Shield because his skin hardens into a black carbon plate nothing can cut. He has gathered a crew of runaway human chimeras around him and treats them as his own possessions, which with Greed means he will not let anyone take them.

**Speaking Style:** Cocky and easy, with a grin in every line; he drawls, teases and laughs at the people he is about to rob, and there is steel under the jokes.
**Combat Role:** a carbon shield that spreads over his skin, a hardened claw and a laughing brawl
**Relationship Hook:** A grinning man in sunglasses and a fur collar lounging at a bar, a girl on each side and a chimera at the door.
personality: Core: cocky, teasing and always hungry for more; calls his crew his possessions and defends them; turns every debt into a bet
Quirk: never lies, he says, and means it

npcs.name: Gregor Vogt
npcs.info:
The old priest of the chapel on the hill above Dublith, where the fishermen hang plaques for those who came home. He remembers every boat on the lake by name and every man who sailed one. He is gentle, slow and wise, and he has buried more fishermen than he has married.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and grave, an old priest who remembers every boat by name.
**Combat Role:** none; an old priest with a bell rope and a lantern
**Relationship Hook:** An old priest lighting a lantern before a wall of brass plaques in a hilltop chapel.
personality: Core: gentle, slow and wise; knows every boat on the lake; keeps the plaques polished
Quirk: never pries

npcs.name: Grete Hollmer
npcs.info:
The landlady of the single men's lodging house, a big laughing woman who rents each bunk twice a day and feeds forty young men on potatoes and nerve. She darns their socks, reads their letters home to them and throws them out for fighting.

**Speaking Style:** Big and hearty, a landlady who calls every lodger 'my lad' whatever his age.
**Combat Role:** none; a rolling pin and forty lodgers who would take her side
**Relationship Hook:** A big landlady blocking a doorway with her arms folded while a soldier waits with a pencil.
personality: Core: mothers everyone; throws out fighters, takes them back next day; sings while she cooks
Quirk: lies cheerfully to authority

npcs.name: Grumman
npcs.info:
Lieutenant General Grumman, about seventy, commanding officer of the eastern command in East City and Mustang's superior. He is a skinny old man with grey hair and a moustache who plays chess, wears disguises for fun and teases Mustang about marrying his granddaughter. He has been kept in the east for years, away from Central's top table.

**Speaking Style:** A light, wry, grandfatherly voice that jokes and teases; the cunning underneath only shows in what he does next.
**Combat Role:** none in person; a general's command of the eastern army and a long game
**Relationship Hook:** An old general moving a chess piece and suggesting the colonel should marry.
personality: Core: jovial and teasing; enjoys a good disguise; ambitious under the jokes
Quirk: plays chess and plays people

npcs.name: Gu Fenglin
npcs.info:
Keeper of the Sand Rim Caravanserai, a big, genial man who meets every caravan at the gate with water, dates and a question about the crossing. He has kept the last walled stop on the western road for twenty years, as his father did before him, and he holds the only key to the storeroom behind his quarters.

**Speaking Style:** Warm as an uncle and twice as interested in what is in your bags.
**Combat Role:** a heavy man with a heavy cudgel and twenty drivers who owe him favours; he shouts first and swings second
**Relationship Hook:** A big keeper in a sand-coloured robe holding out a water dipper to a dust-caked driver at the gate.
personality: Core: greets every driver by name and every camel by its temper; laughs from the belly at his own jokes; never asks what is inside anything
Quirk: keeps the storeroom key on a cord round his neck, even in the bath

npcs.name: Guan Zhengyi
npcs.info:
The magistrate of the capital, who comes out of his hall whenever the petition drum is beaten, as the law binds him to, and hears cases standing at the gate if he must. He is upright, careful and very tired.

**Speaking Style:** Grave and measured, a magistrate's voice that fills a courtyard without effort.
**Combat Role:** none; a court's guards at his word and a magistrate's seal that ends most fights
**Relationship Hook:** A magistrate in a winged hat stepping out under the gate roof as the great drum is still shaking.
personality: Core: comes out for every beat of the drum; reads a petition aloud before he judges it; keeps a locked box of cases he could not hear
Quirk: gentle with the poor and cool with stewards

npcs.name: Gudmund Ellingboe
npcs.info:
The foreman of the ice cutters on the tarn, a big, slow-moving man who has sawn ice there for thirty winters and buys the red flags for thin ice out of his own pocket. His crews haul the blocks down to the ice houses of North City by horse sled.

**Speaking Style:** Big and booming, bellowing across the ice and murmuring once he is close.
**Combat Role:** a big man with an ice saw and a pike pole; he keeps a fight on the ice, where he knows the footing
**Relationship Hook:** A big bearded foreman running across a frozen lake toward a horse sled, a red flag in his fist.
personality: Core: walks the ice alone each dawn; grumbles about the flags and buys them anyway; tests every block with his thumb
Quirk: sings work songs badly

npcs.name: Gundel Hornby
npcs.info:
A big laughing woman who sells mutton pies and apple cake from the trestles at every fair, market and funeral in the district, and once, they say, at a wedding she was not asked to. Her pastry is famous and her gossip better. Whatever happened in town last night, she knows it by the second batch.

**Speaking Style:** Cheerful and loud, a pie-seller who calls everyone love and remembers who still owes her.
**Combat Role:** none; a rolling pin and a voice that brings the whole field running
**Relationship Hook:** A laughing woman holding a tray of hot pies over a trestle, shouting to a passer-by.
personality: Core: trades gossip for gossip, never for free; laughs loudest at her own jokes; worries in private and bakes in public
Quirk: calls everyone love

npcs.name: Gundel Kellerhof
npcs.info:
The brewer's daughter, twenty-two, who keeps the books at the family brewery and has made it pay for the first time in a decade. She wears her father's old apron over a good skirt and carries a pencil she has worn to a stub. The draymen take orders from her now and pretend they are still taking them from him.

**Speaking Style:** Brisk and even, a young woman who answers before the question is finished.
**Combat Role:** none; a strong young woman with a cooper's mallet who knows the cellar in the dark
**Relationship Hook:** A young woman with a book on her hip and a pencil in her teeth, tasting from a copper vat with a frown.
personality: Core: sharp, practical and proud; counts everything twice; covers for her father's mistakes
Quirk: laughs only when the books balance

npcs.name: Gunhild Sotberg
npcs.info:
The eldest of the charcoal burners, a soot-black woman of sixty who has tended mounds in the clearing since she was a girl and can tell a burn's heat by the colour of its smoke. Her charcoal goes to the forges of North City and the fort.

**Speaking Style:** Cracked and sharp, an old woman who spits before anything important and enjoys the pause.
**Combat Role:** an old burner with a long rake and a shovel of live coals
**Relationship Hook:** An old soot-black woman leaning on a rake beside a smoking mound, watching the road.
personality: Core: reads smoke like a newspaper; sells gossip and gives away bread; never sleeps more than four hours
Quirk: spits before she says anything important

npcs.name: Gunnar Hesse
npcs.info:
The landlord of the Bear's Head Tavern, a huge bearded man who served fifteen years at Fort Briggs and lost two fingers to frostbite and none of his loyalty. His tavern is where the fort's men drink when they come down; city troops who wander in are served, slowly.

**Speaking Style:** A rumble from somewhere under the beard, unhurried and final, like a door closing in a snowstorm.
**Combat Role:** a frontier brawler with a cudgel under the bar; he hits once, very hard, and the fight is over
**Relationship Hook:** A huge bearded landlord with a missing finger leaning on the bar, watching a city corporal hold his beer too carefully.
personality: Core: huge, slow and courteous; serves city troops last and fort men first; keeps a fort mug on the shelf for every friend who died
Quirk: breaks up fights by lifting both men off the floor

npcs.name: Gunther Stell
npcs.info:
A hewer past his best who has the same stool at the end of the counter every evening and the same complaint about the beer. He is a fixture rather than a customer, and the regulars measure the night by how many stories about the old owner he has told.

**Speaking Style:** A rasp worn down by thirty years of dust, broken by a laugh that turns into a cough.
**Combat Role:** a hewer's short pick and a shoulder like a pit prop
**Relationship Hook:** An old miner on a tavern stool sliding a brass lamp token across the counter as if it were a coin.
personality: Core: tells the same three stories; laughs at his own jokes until he coughs
Quirk: frightened and hiding it in noise

npcs.name: Gustav Mellish
npcs.info:
The weigher of the fish hall, a pink, clean-shaven man in a white coat who rings the bell for the dawn auction and reads every boat's catch on his brass scale. He is good company, sings in the chapel and lends the fishermen money between seasons, and nobody has ever seen a fish scale on his coat.

**Speaking Style:** Bright and sing-song, a weigher who is cheerful at dawn and knows nobody forgives him for it.
**Combat Role:** none; a brass weight on a cord, swung, and a hall full of men who owe him
**Relationship Hook:** A plump man in a spotless white coat ringing a hand bell over slabs of fish on ice.
personality: Core: cheerful at dawn, which nobody forgives; lends money and remembers the date; sings while he weighs
Quirk: keeps his coat spotless in a fish hall

npcs.name: Gustav Merl
npcs.info:
The customs lieutenant on the old trade road is a plump, genial officer who reads every paper slowly and keeps merchants waiting for days. He is never rude and never in a hurry, and everyone at the barrier pole knows what he wants.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and genial, a customs officer who sounds sympathetic until the moment he says no.
**Combat Role:** none if he can help it; a service pistol he keeps in a drawer and a sergeant he can call
**Relationship Hook:** A plump customs lieutenant holding a stamp over a paper, smiling at a waiting merchant.
personality: Core: genial, slow and unhurried; never says the price aloud; counts favours owed like coins
Quirk: afraid of his superiors and contemptuous of them

npcs.name: Gustav Penner
npcs.info:
The railway inspector of the North Line Trestle, a precise, anxious man who walks the iron trestle every day with a hammer, tapping each rivet. He reports every fault. Lately nobody reads his reports.

**Speaking Style:** Precise and anxious, an inspector who lists faults as if reciting a prayer.
**Combat Role:** none; a long rivet hammer and a terror of falling
**Relationship Hook:** An anxious inspector tapping a rivet on an iron trestle high above a snowy ravine.
personality: Core: precise and anxious; taps every rivet; keeps copies of everything
Quirk: has a terror of heights he hides

npcs.name: Gustav Rehn
npcs.info:
The owner of the Limb Works of the South, a broad automail engineer who learned his trade in Rush Valley and came south when the war made a market of men without arms and legs. He fits soldiers on the army's contract by day and officers on their own purse by night. He talks constantly while he connects the nerves, because it helps.

**Speaking Style:** Rough and cheerful, a smith's voice that talks the patient through every turn of the wrench.
**Combat Role:** a heavy wrench and a smith's arm; he has knocked down a drunk officer with one blow
**Relationship Hook:** A bearded automail engineer tightening a bolt on a soldier's steel knee in a cluttered fitting room.
personality: Core: talks through the pain so the patient does not; fits the poor man's leg as well as the colonel's; keeps two sets of books
Quirk: proud of every limb he has made

npcs.name: Gustl Rademacher
npcs.info:
An old slaughterman at the stockyards, sixty and still swinging the poleaxe, who has blood on his boots and a joke for every drover. He has worked the killing floor since he was a boy and knows every butcher who ever bought at the ring. He drinks with the drovers and tells the same stories every pay night.

**Speaking Style:** Gruff and gossipy, an old slaughterman who leans close to tell anything worth hearing.
**Combat Role:** an old slaughterman with a poleaxe and a lifetime of heavy lifting
**Relationship Hook:** An old slaughterman with a poleaxe on his shoulder, staring at a huge boot print in the mud of an empty pen.
personality: Core: gossipy, rough and good-hearted; tells the same story every week; afraid of the dark since the murders
Quirk: proud of a clean kill

npcs.name: Gärtner
npcs.info:
Major General Gärtner of Central Command, a bespectacled, moustached officer of the capital's staff who goes where Central sends him and expects every garrison to obey the paper he carries.

**Speaking Style:** Stiff, officious and certain of his authority; he reads an order as if the paper made it true.
**Combat Role:** none worth the name; an order from Central
**Relationship Hook:** A bespectacled general reading out his orders to a hall of hostile Briggs soldiers.
personality: Core: stiff and officious; out of his depth in the north; obeys Central to the letter
Quirk: trusts paper over people

npcs.name: Haakon Sundqvist
npcs.info:
The country doctor of the back lane clinic, who sets bones, stitches cuts and pulls teeth for whoever knocks. He keeps no appointment book and accepts firewood from patients who cannot pay.

**Speaking Style:** Gruff and gentle, a country doctor who scolds his patients while he mends them.
**Combat Role:** none; a scalpel and steady hands, and a clinic full of people who owe him their lives
**Relationship Hook:** An old doctor in rolled sleeves setting a bone on a scrubbed table under a hanging lamp.
personality: Core: gruff and gentle; scolds patients while he mends them; accepts firewood as payment
Quirk: asks no questions

npcs.name: Hagen Wurm
npcs.info:
A platelayer who walks the line from the junction to the viaduct every morning with a long hammer, tapping keys back into their chairs and listening to the rails ring. He is a big, quiet northerner with two frost-scarred fingers, and he lodges in a hut at the foot of the piers.

**Speaking Style:** Heavy and plain, a railway labourer from the north who says little and means all of it.
**Combat Role:** a long-handled platelayer's hammer, swung low and heavy
**Relationship Hook:** A big railway labourer with his palm pressed flat to a stone pier, listening.
personality: Core: quiet and dutiful; stubborn about his reports; slow to anger and hard to calm
Quirk: listens to iron and stone the way a doctor listens to a chest

npcs.name: Hakon Hjelm
npcs.info:
An old bear hunter who has worked the Briggs range for forty years and is said to have killed more grizzlies than the fort has killed Drachmans. He lives alone, sells his hides at the pelt post and talks of the bears as neighbours.

**Speaking Style:** Deep and unhurried, an old hunter who speaks of bears with more respect than he gives most men.
**Combat Role:** an old hunter with a heavy single-shot rifle and a boar spear; one shot, and if that fails, the spear braced against the ground
**Relationship Hook:** An old white-bearded hunter in a bearskin coat crouching to lay his hand inside an enormous paw print.
personality: Core: speaks of bears as neighbours; never fires twice; eats his meat half raw
Quirk: trusts no rifle but his own

npcs.name: Hal Wendt
npcs.info:
The miller of the Rain River, a widower who grinds the district's wheat and knows every cart on the road and who drives it. He is broad, floury and in no hurry, and he will talk the afternoon away with anyone who leans on his door. Nothing moves along the river without him seeing it.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and friendly, a miller's voice dusted with flour; he likes a long chat at the door.
**Combat Role:** none much; a strong old man with a flour sack and a shovel
**Relationship Hook:** A floury miller leaning on his door and watching a cart cross the river.
personality: Core: friendly and slow-spoken; watches the road from his door; works through the night
Quirk: gives flour on credit to widows

npcs.name: Halcrow
npcs.info:
Major General Halcrow, stationed in a town in the east, outranked by Grumman and openly resentful of Colonel Mustang's quick rise. He bullies and belittles the Flame Alchemist whenever he can and never gets the better of him. He travels with his family.

**Speaking Style:** Pompous, peevish and loud, a general who sneers at juniors and blusters when he is cornered.
**Combat Role:** none worth noting; rank and complaint
**Relationship Hook:** A peevish general berating a colonel for taking too long to catch a killer.
personality: Core: pompous and petty; blusters when cornered; fond of his family
Quirk: resents Mustang's rise

npcs.name: Haldor Brekke
npcs.info:
The traffic sergeant of the main tunnel, who stands where the side galleries meet the lorry lane with a red lamp in one fist and a whistle in his teeth. Every lorry, sledge and stretcher party that moves through the wall moves on his signal, and a driver who ignores it walks back down to the motor pool on foot.

**Speaking Style:** Short and flat, a man used to being heard over three engines; he finishes most orders with the whistle instead of a word.
**Combat Role:** a heavy-shouldered brawler with a lamp pole and a sidearm; he blocks the lane with his own body and lets the bulkhead crews do the rest
**Relationship Hook:** A bearded sergeant swinging a red lamp in a vaulted tunnel as a lorry grinds to a halt at his boots.
personality: Core: never shouts when a whistle will do; eats standing up at his post; judges a driver by the state of his chains
Quirk: counts lorries the way other men count sheep

npcs.name: Halvar Sund
npcs.info:
The mess cook of the barrack tiers, a huge, soft-spoken man who feeds the garrison on cabbage, black bread and whatever the stores tunnels send up. He keeps the samovar going all night for the sentries and knows each man's sugar by heart.

**Speaking Style:** Deep, slow and kind, the voice of a big man who has learned to speak softly.
**Combat Role:** a big man with a cleaver and a ladle; slow to start and very hard to stop
**Relationship Hook:** A huge cook ladling soup into a private's bowl and adding an extra crust when nobody is looking.
personality: Core: gentle with everyone and terrifying with a cleaver; hums at the stove; slips extra bread to the youngest
Quirk: keeps the samovar hot through the night

npcs.name: Halvard Brix
npcs.info:
An inspector of the eastern railway sent down to check the spur's tonnage after the main-line receipts kept coming up short. He has a frock coat, a gold watch, a book of regulations and the steady conviction that rules apply to lieutenants too.

**Speaking Style:** Booming and formal, an inspector who addresses a coal wagon as if it were a committee.
**Combat Role:** none; a heavy cane and the authority of the railway
**Relationship Hook:** A whiskered railway inspector checking his watch beside a siding of coal wagons.
personality: Core: pompous and upright; cannot be bribed and says so loudly
Quirk: quotes regulations by number

npcs.name: Halvard Dross
npcs.info:
The innkeeper of the caravanserai, a big bald East City man who came out to the crossing twenty years ago with a mule and a cask of beer and built the place around a courtyard. He knows every caravan master by name and every camel by its temper.

**Speaking Style:** Big and genial, a host's voice made for shouting across a yard full of camels.
**Combat Role:** an innkeeper with a cudgel and a roar who throws men out by the collar
**Relationship Hook:** A big bald innkeeper in a leather apron shouting greetings across a courtyard of camels.
personality: Core: genial and loud; greets every caravan at the gate; looks away from the cellar
Quirk: waters the tamarisks himself

npcs.name: Hamid Zayyat
npcs.info:
Reole's gravedigger, a thin old man with a spade worn to a crescent and a register of every burial since his grandfather's time. He dug the graves of both sides of the town's quarrel and wrote them in the same book in the same hand.

**Speaking Style:** Mild and slow, a gravedigger who speaks of the dead as tenants and of the living as visitors.
**Combat Role:** none; he leans on his spade until trouble leaves
**Relationship Hook:** An old gravedigger leaning on a spade in a shed doorway, watching a figure among the stones.
personality: Core: gentle and unbothered; keeps the register in perfect order; talks to the graves as he passes
Quirk: lets the scraper work and says nothing

npcs.name: Hana Belkacem
npcs.info:
The clerk of the Reole council, a former cloth guild bookkeeper with ink on her cuffs who keeps the minutes, rings the bell and chalks the blackboard. She votes last and says least, and the council quietly waits for her to speak.

**Speaking Style:** Level and deliberate, a clerk who reads aloud as if every word were being written down.
**Combat Role:** none; she gathers the minutes and leaves by the back stair
**Relationship Hook:** A tall clerk chalking another family's name onto a long blackboard list.
personality: Core: exact and reserved; keeps a copy of every letter; votes last on every motion
Quirk: chalks names in perfect copperplate

npcs.name: Hannes Tisdale
npcs.info:
A red-faced dairy farmer at the lake's western edge, whose cows wade into the shallows on hot afternoons and whose cheese is sold at Curtis Meats and on the trains north. He is a cheerful worrier, up at four every morning, and talks about his cows by name, all thirty of them.

**Speaking Style:** Kindly and anxious, a farmer who apologises to his cows and worries aloud at people.
**Combat Role:** none; a pitchfork and a farmer's strength, used only for his family
**Relationship Hook:** A red-faced dairy farmer kneeling beside his fevered son in a cheese room, shouting for a cart.
personality: Core: names every cow and forgets every person; blames himself for the weather; won't take charity, will take a trade
Quirk: worries out loud, works in silence

npcs.name: Harald Zeiss
npcs.info:
The captain commanding the powder magazine is a careful, nervous man who has his guards searched for matches twice a day and checks the copper hinges personally. He is the only officer in the West who has never been late for anything.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and tense, a magazine officer who speaks softly as if a loud word might set something off.
**Combat Role:** a careful pistol shot who will not fire within a hundred paces of the magazine; outside it he is accurate and quick
**Relationship Hook:** A slight anxious captain in felt overshoes checking a register before a heavy door set in a hillside.
personality: Core: speaks softly always; checks everything twice; terrified of fire and of failure
Quirk: punishes carelessness harshly

npcs.name: Harris
npcs.info:
A young officer of the northern forces at North City headquarters, keen to make an arrest and not very good at recognising the people he is looking for.

**Speaking Style:** Young, eager and officious, a soldier reading out a description he does not quite understand.
**Combat Role:** a rifle and an arrest party
**Relationship Hook:** A young soldier reading out a description of a short fugitive to the man himself.
personality: Core: eager and officious; unobservant; follows the description to the letter
Quirk: says the wrong thing

npcs.name: Harro Tiedje
npcs.info:
Ganger of the clay pit at the brickworks, a wiry man with red clay ground into every crease of his hands, who leads the diggers down the narrow track at first light and decides where the day's cut will go. He came west from the coal pits of Youswell after his lungs began to rattle and says clay is a kinder master than coal, though a duller one.

**Speaking Style:** Plain and wary, a ganger who says 'well now' before anything he would rather not say.
**Combat Role:** a pick swung by a man who has cut rock all his life, short strokes and no flourish
**Relationship Hook:** A wiry ganger with a pick on his shoulder standing beside a half-buried carved slab in a red pit.
personality: Core: wary, superstitious and stubborn; cannot read and remembers everything; loyal to his diggers before his employer
Quirk: spits on the track before he goes down

npcs.name: Hartmut Selz
npcs.info:
The adjutant of the railhead camp, a captain with a neat moustache and a briefcase that never leaves his hand. He meets every train, counts every crate and signs every strength return that goes north to South Command Headquarters. He is efficient and admired, and his returns are always on time.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth and precise, a staff officer whose every sentence ends with a number.
**Combat Role:** an officer's pistol and a platoon at his call; he does not fight himself
**Relationship Hook:** A neat captain checking his pocket watch on a crowded railhead platform beside a sealed freight car.
personality: Core: efficient and polished; never lets go of his briefcase; ends sentences with numbers
Quirk: blames the dead

npcs.name: Hartwig Bloch
npcs.info:
The overseer of the coke ovens and the coal screens, a former quartermaster sergeant the lieutenant brought in to drive the works harder. He measures everything in tons and hours and has never once asked a man how he is.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped and urgent, an overseer who talks in deadlines.
**Combat Role:** a heavy cane and a quartermaster's well-placed threats
**Relationship Hook:** An overseer with a pocket watch shouting over the hiss of quenched coke.
personality: Core: impatient and hard; covers up accidents; afraid of the lieutenant's arithmetic
Quirk: measures men in tons

npcs.name: Hartwig Lomond
npcs.info:
Owner of the carding house on the leat, a lean, dry man who runs three secondhand carding engines off one waterwheel with four hands to help. He cards the coarse fleeces the army will not take into yarn for the town's knitters and makes a thin, honest living from it. He oils the engines himself and knows each one by its noise.

**Speaking Style:** Dry and level, a mill owner who answers every worry with arithmetic.
**Combat Role:** none; a long oil can and a spanner the length of his forearm
**Relationship Hook:** A lean mill owner with his ear pressed to a shaking carding engine, an oil can in his hand.
personality: Core: dry and careful; pays on time to the hour; cannot throw anything away
Quirk: listens to machines more than to people

npcs.name: Hartwin Eichler
npcs.info:
The brewer at the city gate, a broad, bald veteran with a beard like a doormat whose pale beer is drunk in every barracks and bar from the gate to the garrison. He sends the veterans' hall its beer at cost and has never charged a man with a missing limb for a glass in his yard. He served in the east as a sergeant and lets that be the end of it.

**Speaking Style:** Rich and hearty, a brewer who talks about his beer the way other men talk about their sons.
**Combat Role:** a broad old sergeant with a barrel mallet who remembers exactly how bayonet drill went
**Relationship Hook:** A broad bald brewer with a mallet standing very still in front of a locked door in a barrel cellar.
personality: Core: generous and quietly brave; treats every old soldier as a member of his family; never talks about his own war
Quirk: drinks one of his own at noon and one at dusk

npcs.name: Hassan Tiref
npcs.info:
A lean Ishvalan with an army rifle who lives on the mesa's flat top for weeks at a time, watching the fort's tower, the crossing and the road. Nobody in the crossing knows he is there; the refugee camp knows only that someone warns them when the patrols turn south.

**Speaking Style:** Low and still; he speaks rarely and never above a murmur.
**Combat Role:** an Ishvalan marksman with an army rifle, one shot from impossible range
**Relationship Hook:** A lean Ishvalan lying prone on a mesa top with a long rifle, watching a fort far below.
personality: Core: patient and silent; watches more than he acts; has sworn off killing
Quirk: loyal to Shan's camp

npcs.name: Hayat Barakah
npcs.info:
A young farmer from the refugee camp who climbs the terrace stair before dawn with her uncle, carrying water to one green line of wheat on the topmost shelf, where the garrison's glasses do not reach. She carries water up in a goatskin and knows every step by feel.

**Speaking Style:** Easy and unhurried, a farmer's daughter who talks to plants and people in the same voice.
**Combat Role:** none; she knows the terrace walls and drops out of sight behind them
**Relationship Hook:** A young woman watering a single row of green wheat at dawn on a high stone terrace.
personality: Core: patient and hopeful; climbs the stair in the dark; tells the truth too quickly
Quirk: counts the wheat heads every morning

npcs.name: Hedwig Laue
npcs.info:
A widow from the capital, in black that the dust has turned grey, who took the train east and hired a camel to stand at her husband's grave. She found his name misspelled on the marker and has not moved from the gate since.

**Speaking Style:** Clear, tight and correct; she keeps her voice steady by sheer manners.
**Combat Role:** none; a lady with a parasol and the army's own regulations by heart
**Relationship Hook:** A woman in dusty mourning black standing at a cemetery gate, holding a bundle of letters.
personality: Core: proper and determined; will not raise her voice; carries her husband's letters
Quirk: believes he is alive

npcs.name: Heinkel
npcs.info:
A tall soldier with slicked blond hair, a moustache and glasses who goes where he is sent and does the job. He is calm, practical and not blindly loyal: he follows the people who treat him well. In a fight he becomes a lion-man with a mane and claws, and he sees in the dark.

**Speaking Style:** A quiet, practical voice, dry and unhurried; he trusts his gut and says so.
**Combat Role:** a lion-man's claws, bite and strength, best in snow or darkness
**Relationship Hook:** A tall soldier in glasses watching the snow, nostrils flared, a growl in his chest.
personality: Core: quiet and practical; follows whoever treats him well; not one for speeches
Quirk: trusts his animal instincts

npcs.name: Helga Morrow
npcs.info:
The doctor of the free clinic trained in Central City, was offered an army commission, and turned it down to treat bargemen and laundresses for nothing. She is small, grey before her time and never tired in front of a patient.

**Speaking Style:** Low and steady, a doctor who speaks to a frightened man the way one talks to a nervous horse.
**Combat Role:** none; a scalpel held steady and a voice that has talked men out of worse
**Relationship Hook:** A small grey-haired doctor in a white apron leaning over a cot in a whitewashed ward.
personality: Core: calm in any emergency; never asks a patient for papers; argues with officers as an equal
Quirk: spends her own money and pretends it is donations

npcs.name: Hennes Brack
npcs.info:
A farmer's son of fifteen from the dry country west of the city, broad for his age and burnt dark by the sun. He has walked in with his father's signature on a form and a story about being eighteen. His older brother went to Fotset in the autumn and has not written since.

**Speaking Style:** High and earnest, a boy trying very hard to sound like a man.
**Combat Role:** a farm boy's fists and a pitchfork if he has one
**Relationship Hook:** A sunburnt farm boy twisting his cap at a recruiting desk, lying about his age.
personality: Core: stubborn as a mule; loves his brother more than he fears the war
Quirk: a terrible liar

npcs.name: Hennig Stroh
npcs.info:
A barley farmer of the western plain with blue shutters on his house, bread in the oven and a long list of grievances against the army, which buys his barley, took his horses and wants his son next. He is generous to strangers and impossible to bully.

**Speaking Style:** Dry and stubborn, a farmer's slow drawl that turns every complaint into a joke at the army's expense.
**Combat Role:** a farmer with a shotgun and a pitchfork; he fights from his own doorway and will not give a step
**Relationship Hook:** A weathered bearded farmer with a shotgun standing in the doorway of a blue-shuttered farmhouse.
personality: Core: generous with bread and stingy with respect; complains about the army in every sentence; will not be bullied by anyone in a uniform
