Quirk: softer about his daughter than he lets on

npcs.name: Henrietta Saalfeld
npcs.info:
The headmistress of the school by the river, a tall widow in grey who lost her husband in the eastern war and turned the grief into a timetable. She teaches the oldest class herself, keeps the stove going with coal she pays for, and knows every child's father's regiment and every mother's troubles. The boys are afraid of her; the girls adore her.

**Speaking Style:** Warm but firm, a headmistress who never raises her voice because she has never needed to.
**Combat Role:** none; a ruler, a straight back and the authority to send any child in the city home
**Relationship Hook:** A tall headmistress in grey turning from a blackboard of sums to look calmly at the class.
personality: Core: kind, strict and very brave; corrects grammar in the street; speaks of her husband only in the present tense
Quirk: keeps a drawer of spare boots and mittens

npcs.name: Henrik Dauber
npcs.info:
The wheelwright's elder son, twenty-two, who works the tyring platform by day and by night locks himself in the back shed with a half-built motor carriage, a pile of catalogues and parts sent by post. He is clever, impatient and black with grease to the elbow, and he tells the tavern Resembool will have motor roads inside ten years.

**Speaking Style:** Fast and excited, a young mechanic who talks in horsepower and apologises for it.
**Combat Role:** a heavy wrench and a young man's reach; scrappy and fast
**Relationship Hook:** A grease-streaked young man pulling the dust sheet off a half-built motor carriage.
personality: Core: draws engines on napkins; embarrassed by his own ambition; too proud to ask his father anything
Quirk: excited and impatient

npcs.name: Henrike Brückner
npcs.info:
A tracer in the drawing office of the locomotive works, twenty, the first woman the office ever hired and still the only one. She copies engineers' drawings in ink onto linen, line by line, with a steadier hand than any man in the room. She walks home along the rails and knows the works whistle better than her own clock.

**Speaking Style:** Clear and quick, a young woman who apologises before she disagrees and then does it anyway.
**Combat Role:** none; a slight young woman who knows every alley and ladder in the works
**Relationship Hook:** A slight young woman bent over a drafting table under a skylight, inking a locomotive plan with a fine pen.
personality: Core: careful, quiet and clever; remembers any drawing she has traced; bristles when the men talk over her
Quirk: afraid of losing the job her family needs

npcs.name: Henrike Faltz
npcs.info:
A private alchemist from East City who failed the state examination twice and came east to study the one thing no examiner in Central has seen. She camps beside the carved slab with charcoal, rice paper and a drawing board, taking rubbings in the low morning sun.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped and careful, a researcher who stops mid-sentence to check a figure.
**Combat Role:** an alchemist who draws a quick circle in the sand and throws up a wall of stone
**Relationship Hook:** A woman in spectacles pressing paper against a carved stone slab with a charcoal stick.
personality: Core: methodical and proud; checks every line twice; keeps her notes in a cipher
Quirk: will not walk across the slab's shadow, and says it is superstition

npcs.name: Henrike Morgen
npcs.info:
A schoolmaster's widow in good black who comes to the new rows of the war cemetery every morning with fresh flowers. Her husband was a reserve lieutenant, called up at forty and killed in his second week at Fotset. She is composed, educated and very stubborn.

**Speaking Style:** Steady and low, a widow who has done her crying and now wants answers.
**Combat Role:** none; a lawyer's letter and a straight back
**Relationship Hook:** A widow in black standing before a fresh wooden grave marker with flowers in one hand and a spade in the other.
personality: Core: composed and immovable; polite in a way that frightens clerks
Quirk: brings flowers to the unvisited graves too

npcs.name: Henrike Sorrel
npcs.info:
The schoolmistress of Dublith, a tall, untidy woman of thirty with chalk on her sleeves, who teaches forty children their letters and sums in one room. She went to Central City at eighteen to study alchemy, lasted two years and came home without a licence and without saying why.

**Speaking Style:** Warm and enquiring, a teacher who answers a question with a better one and lowers her voice for a secret.
**Combat Role:** a half-trained alchemist; a chalk circle drawn fast and a simple transmutation that raises a low wall of earth or knocks a man off his feet
**Relationship Hook:** A tall schoolmistress kneeling in a dusty yard beside a pupil, studying a circle scratched in the dirt.
personality: Core: answers a question with a better question; defends her pupils to anyone; goes quiet when Central City is mentioned
Quirk: untidy with chalk, neat with circles

npcs.name: Henry Douglas
npcs.info:
Colonel Henry Douglas of the military police headquarters in Central, a severe-faced, bespectacled officer who builds a case and makes it stick.

**Speaking Style:** Severe and procedural, an interrogator's voice that lays out evidence like a hand of cards.
**Combat Role:** a sidearm and the military police
**Relationship Hook:** A stern colonel in glasses placing a bullet on the table in front of a prisoner.
personality: Core: severe and procedural; does as he is ordered; rebukes excess
Quirk: builds a case from paper

npcs.name: Henschel
npcs.info:
Second Lieutenant Henschel of Fort Briggs, one of Olivier's loyal officers, an honest soldier who will argue with a general to save his comrades. He is brave, plain-spoken and proud of the Briggs way.

**Speaking Style:** Honest and plain, a young officer who speaks up when he thinks an order is wrong.
**Combat Role:** a rifle and a squad, steady in the snow
**Relationship Hook:** A young lieutenant arguing with a general at the mouth of a tunnel, refusing to seal it.
personality: Core: honest and plain-spoken; proud of the Briggs way; brave under fire
Quirk: argues for his comrades

npcs.name: Hermine Ollendorf
npcs.info:
The schoolmistress, who has taught every child in town their letters for sixteen years in one room with one stove. She is small, upright and impossible to shock. She remembers two brothers who finished their sums in half the time and covered their slates in circles, and she no longer encourages that sort of thing, which is not the same as stopping it.

**Speaking Style:** Clear and even, a schoolmistress whose quietest word carries to the back row.
**Combat Role:** none; a ruler, a stare and the schoolhouse bell
**Relationship Hook:** A small schoolmistress holding a smoking slate at arm's length, lips pressed thin.
personality: Core: upright and unshockable; never raises her voice; keeps every child's first slate
Quirk: distrusts the state and teaches its map anyway

npcs.name: Heymans Breda
npcs.info:
Second Lieutenant Heymans Breda of Mustang's unit, a stocky, red-haired officer with a shaggy crew cut and the sharpest strategic mind in the room. He knows the foreign powers' politics, plays chess like a general and gathers information the way other men gather debts. He is terrified of dogs, which the unit's own dog finds very interesting.

**Speaking Style:** Plain, quick and clever, the voice of a man who has already worked out the answer and is waiting for you; it climbs an octave when a dog appears.
**Combat Role:** a pistol and a plan; he wins the fight before it starts
**Relationship Hook:** A stocky red-haired lieutenant moving a chess piece and then leaping onto a chair to escape a puppy.
personality: Core: clever and fast with a plan; plays chess to win; eats like two men
Quirk: terrified of dogs, even small ones

npcs.name: Hieronymus Wexler
npcs.info:
A big, bearded supplier of minerals, chalk and inks for the alchemists of the east, who has no talent for alchemy himself and can name any compound by its smell. He will not sell to anyone under sixteen and does not care whether the alchemist across the counter is licensed. He keeps the State Alchemists' accounts on blue paper and everyone else's on white.

**Speaking Style:** Deep and slow, a shopkeeper who names minerals with the relish other men keep for wine.
**Combat Role:** none; a heavy brass weight, a jar of quicklime and a shop full of things not to break
**Relationship Hook:** A big bearded shopkeeper sniffing a jar at a counter of labelled minerals and brass weights.
personality: Core: genial and nosy; proud of knowing more than the alchemists; keeps two account books
Quirk: smells every jar before he sells it

npcs.name: Hilde Norrel
npcs.info:
A furrier in North City's Fur Row who sells pelts and coats to the soldiers and the townsfolk. She is brisk, kind and direct, and she has made coats for half the garrison. She is always in a hurry, and she always has time for a child who needs a scarf.

**Speaking Style:** Brisk and kind, a furrier who speaks to her customers as if they were late for a train.
**Combat Role:** none; a pair of shears and a quick hand
**Relationship Hook:** A furrier at a counter fitting a fur coat on a soldier, a child waiting with a scarf.
personality: Core: brisk, kind and direct; always in a hurry; makes time for children
Quirk: made coats for half the garrison

npcs.name: Hilke Vollrath
npcs.info:
Secretary, treasurer and in practice the whole of the sheep festival committee: a farmer's widow with a clipboard and a gift for getting other people to carry trestles. She has run the spring festival nine years and can name each year's winning ram. Her own ewes have never won, and she says she prefers it so.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped and organising, a committee woman who makes lists aloud and ticks people off them.
**Combat Role:** none; a sharp tongue and a clipboard held up like a shield
**Relationship Hook:** A tall woman with a clipboard counting hurdle pens aloud in a field strung with bunting.
personality: Core: organises anyone who stands still; pretends not to care about winning; loves the festival more than she trusts anyone in it
Quirk: ticks things off aloud

npcs.name: Hiltrud Ambach
npcs.info:
A big, red-armed greengrocer whose stall stands under the awning at the crossing and has done for nineteen years. She swept the glass from her own doorstep the morning after the street broke open and had the turnips out again by eight, because a cave-in is no reason to let good roots go soft. Soldiers buy apples from her and pay; officers buy apples from her and are reminded to.

**Speaking Style:** Broad and cheerful, a greengrocer who prices a turnip and passes judgement on the weather in the same breath.
**Combat Role:** none; a heavy scale weight thrown with real aim, and a voice that brings the whole crossing running
**Relationship Hook:** A stout greengrocer leaning on her crates under a dripping awning, staring hard at the rope cordon across the road.
personality: Core: loud, generous and nosy; weighs everything twice and rounds down for children
Quirk: will not be hurried by a uniform

npcs.name: Hob Garrity
npcs.info:
The owner of the soldiers' tavern lost his left arm at the border wall in the war's first winter and opened the bar with his discharge money. His automail hand opens a bottle by the neck, ends a fight by the collar, and taps the bar in time when the old songs start.

**Speaking Style:** Rough and slow, a barman's growl that softens only for soldiers just back from the line.
**Combat Role:** a bar brawler with an automail fist; he takes the first punch, catches the second and ends it with the steel hand
**Relationship Hook:** A burly ginger-bearded barman opening a bottle with a steel automail hand, sandbags for seats behind him.
personality: Core: slow to anger and fast to settle it; never asks a soldier what he did out there; keeps a shelf of bottles for men who did not come back
Quirk: taps the bar with his steel fingers when he is thinking

npcs.name: Hob Kettering
npcs.info:
A coal miner from Youswell with black still worked into the creases of his knuckles, who walked east after the pits laid men off and decided to become a farmer in the one place nobody else would try. He digs test holes through the drifted sand and rubs the old soil between his fingers.

**Speaking Style:** Rough, plain and good-humoured; he laughs at his own bad luck before anyone else can.
**Combat Role:** a miner's brawl, shovel first and fists after
**Relationship Hook:** A stocky man in a flat cap kneeling over a row of tiny green seedlings in a sea of sand.
personality: Core: cheerful and stubborn; talks to his seedlings; will share his last biscuit
Quirk: owns one shovel and loves it

npcs.name: Hobb Carraway
npcs.info:
The town's sewerman, a small, stooped man in waders who has cleared the old brick drains under the bad side for twenty years and knows each culvert by its echo. Respectable people cross the street to avoid his smell; the men from the bar on the corner buy him drinks, and he does not ask himself why.

**Speaking Style:** Mumbling and grateful, a sewerman who apologises for his smell before anyone mentions it.
**Combat Role:** none; he knows the drains, so he runs, and anyone who follows him into the dark is lost
**Relationship Hook:** A stooped sewerman in waders holding up a lantern where four drains meet, humming to himself.
personality: Core: finds his way by echo with his eyes shut; hums in the tunnels to keep the rats moving; never looks up at a grating
Quirk: grateful for any kindness, loyal past sense

npcs.name: Hollis Greaver
npcs.info:
A young lieutenant fresh from the academy, given charge of the old encampment and ordered to strike half its tents. He drinks his tea in the mess tent where the State Alchemists once sat and asks the older men about the war, which they do not answer.

**Speaking Style:** Brisk, cheerful and a touch too loud; a young officer who fills silences before they can settle.
**Combat Role:** an academy-trained officer with a sabre and a revolver; textbook and quick
**Relationship Hook:** A young lieutenant writing in a notebook at a trestle table in an empty mess tent.
personality: Core: eager and naive; asks the questions everyone else avoids; keeps the mess tidier than any soldier wants
Quirk: writes every evening in a fat notebook

npcs.name: Hong Shuisheng
npcs.info:
Master of the Yellow Silt Ferry, from the family that has worked the crossing for six generations. He knows every face that uses his ferry and the business of most of them, and he splices the great rope himself.

**Speaking Style:** Deep and slow, the voice of a man hauling a rope across a river every day of his life.
**Combat Role:** a ferryman with a boat pole and arms like rope; he fights on a deck that only he can stand on
**Relationship Hook:** A broad ferry master running a cut rope through his scarred hands in a shed full of coils.
personality: Core: splices the rope himself and trusts no one with it; knows every regular by face and business; loyal to the Yao clan like a debt
Quirk: reads the river's colour every morning

npcs.name: Hou Zhenwu
npcs.info:
The bodyguard of the fifth prince: a tall, silent man who sleeps across his master's threshold and walks the raked paths of the garden twice a night. He has killed four men inside the pavilion walls and has never been asked to explain one.

**Speaking Style:** Low and level, never louder than the man beside him needs.
**Combat Role:** a royal guard with a straight sword and a short spear; he fights in the doorway he keeps and never takes a step he does not need
**Relationship Hook:** A tall guard crouched over raked gravel at dawn, reading a line of footprints that should not be there.
personality: Core: sleeps sitting up with his sword across his knees; reads raked gravel like a page; speaks only when his prince speaks to him
Quirk: admires skill in an enemy

npcs.name: Hu Zhenyi
npcs.info:
A dyer and cloth trader from Xing who came in with a caravan across the desert and has rented a pole at the end of the row. She has a deep red that nobody on the river can match and is happy to show it to anyone, but not how it is made.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth and amused, accented Amestrian with careful pauses; she prices everything by looking at it.
**Combat Role:** a Xingese street style with a folded fan and quick feet; she disarms and slips away
**Relationship Hook:** A Xingese trader holding up a length of deep red cloth against the sun.
personality: Core: shrewd and friendly; trades a secret for a secret, never for coin; drinks tea at noon whatever is happening
Quirk: laughs at Amestrian manners

npcs.name: Hua Jin
npcs.info:
A silk merchant on the capital's market street, whose stall runs to three awnings and whose prices are a matter of negotiation. She knows which clan buys what colours and which court officials owe her money. She is charming, shrewd and ruthless at the scale.

**Speaking Style:** Silky and quick, a merchant who flatters while she counts.
**Combat Role:** none; a merchant with hired guards and a sharp tongue
**Relationship Hook:** A silk merchant flicking her abacus beads under a row of bright awnings.
personality: Core: charming and shrewd; flatters every buyer; knows the court's debts
Quirk: never sells too cheap

npcs.name: Hubert Orme
npcs.info:
Landlord of the coaching inn halfway along the road from East City, a portly, genial man with a gift for faces, who changes the coach horses, feeds the passengers who could not get a seat on the train and tells every traveller the road is safer than it was. His stables are better kept than his dining room, and he says the horses deserve it.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth and hospitable, an innkeeper who asks your name, regiment and destination in one friendly breath.
**Combat Role:** none; a coach horn to rouse the yard and a pistol in the till
**Relationship Hook:** A portly innkeeper writing a name in his book while a passenger in uniform eats at his table.
personality: Core: genial and curious; keeps his stables better than his kitchen; sweats when he lies
Quirk: remembers every face and name

npcs.name: Hubert Waage
npcs.info:
The weighman, who sits in the hut by the spur and reads the beam as each coal wagon rolls on the scale. He writes the figure in two books, one bound in red and one in black, and has done so for eleven years without a blot.

**Speaking Style:** Measured and heavy, a weighman who speaks as if reading figures off the beam.
**Combat Role:** none; a stout door and a scale beam he can jam
**Relationship Hook:** A heavy weighman in a hut, one hand on a red book and one on a black, as an inspector knocks.
personality: Core: methodical and silent; has never blotted a page; afraid of losing the hut
Quirk: lies only in numbers

npcs.name: Hubertus Prell
npcs.info:
The night sergeant of the stockade, heavy, slow and bored, who walks the corridor of iron doors with a ring of keys and a cup of coffee and opens each eye slot on the hour. He has guarded deserters, drunks and rebels for eleven years and treats them all the same: badly fed, rarely beaten, never spoken to more than needs be.

**Speaking Style:** A tired rasp, a jailer who sighs before every answer as if the question had cost him something.
**Combat Role:** a heavy man with a truncheon and a key-ring the size of a fist; he blocks a corridor and waits for help
**Relationship Hook:** A heavy jailer holding a tin cup in a dim corridor, one hand on an eye slot in an iron door.
personality: Core: slow, tired and hard to surprise; drinks coffee cold and complains about it; keeps his word to prisoners more than to officers
Quirk: counts his keys every time he sits down

npcs.name: Hugo Brandl
npcs.info:
The foreman of the filling shed at the ordnance works, where shells are packed with powder by women in wooden clogs. He is careful to the point of obsession: no iron, no matches, no hurry. Nobody has died in his shed in four years, and he is proud of it.

**Speaking Style:** Plain and even, a works foreman who explains everything once and expects it remembered.
**Combat Role:** none; a foreman who keeps his men out of fights
**Relationship Hook:** A careful foreman in clogs and a canvas apron checking shell racks in a long shed.
personality: Core: careful to the point of obsession; proud of his safety record; speaks to every worker by name
Quirk: keeps a sample nobody knows about

npcs.name: Hugo Brandt
npcs.info:
The foreman of the snowplough sheds, who keeps the plough engines fired up all winter and leads the crews that dig the line open when it closes. He has been buried in a drift twice and dug himself out both times.

**Speaking Style:** Patient and solid, a railway foreman who talks about engines with the tenderness of a farmer for cows.
**Combat Role:** none; a coal shovel and a plough engine that can push through anything
**Relationship Hook:** A frosty-bearded foreman beside a plough engine with a huge iron blade, steam rising around him.
personality: Core: patient and solid; first out into any storm; keeps a flask of hot tea for his crew
Quirk: talks about engines as if they were alive

npcs.name: Hugo Selvig
npcs.info:
A sergeant of the garrison, once one of the army's finest marksmen, who asked to be posted back to Ishval and spends his rest days lying in the old scrapes along the ridge over Kanda, without a rifle, looking down.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and level, a marksman who speaks as he shoots: slowly, and only once.
**Combat Role:** a master marksman who will not take a shot; with a rifle again he would hit anything he can see
**Relationship Hook:** A marksman lying unarmed in a scrape on a ridge, looking down over a ruined district.
personality: Core: quiet and haunted; lies in the old scrape without a rifle; counts the brass on the cairn
Quirk: is the best shot in Ishval and never shoots

npcs.name: Huo Shanzi
npcs.info:
A jade digger on the cliff terraces, from one of the poorest clans, who owes the masters his wages a year ahead and his father's before that. He is careful, patient and very good at finding the green under the grey.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and careful, a debtor's voice that keeps everything level.
**Combat Role:** none; a digger's chisel and a cliff face only he knows how to climb
**Relationship Hook:** A ragged digger on a narrow cliff terrace, one hand on a rope ladder and his eyes on the terrace above.
personality: Core: careful with every word; touches the rock before he cuts it; thinks of the debt every hour
Quirk: shares his rice with the youngest diggers

npcs.name: Ida Brenning
npcs.info:
A post rider of the camel station, a short-haired woman who carries the mailbags between the fort, the crossing and the ruins. She has ridden the desert route for three years and never lost a bag.

**Speaking Style:** Flat and dry; she says frightening things in the same voice as the weather.
**Combat Role:** a mounted rider with a carbine, firing from the saddle and outrunning anything on foot
**Relationship Hook:** A wiry rider with cropped hair leaning on a corral fence, watching an empty saddle.
personality: Core: dry and stubborn; never loses a bag; loyal to her partner
Quirk: smokes at the corral fence

npcs.name: Ida Schell
npcs.info:
A civilian geologist hired from a Central City college to advise the survey, the only woman in the camp and the only one who enjoys the work. She chips the seam, labels her samples and writes long letters to her professor about the strata.

**Speaking Style:** Quick and delighted, a geologist who turns every rock into a story.
**Combat Role:** none; a geologist's hammer and good boots
**Relationship Hook:** A young geologist in a pith helmet chipping at a band of coal in a desert cliff, delighted.
personality: Core: cheerful and tireless; impatient with secrecy; underestimates danger
Quirk: talks about rocks to anyone

npcs.name: Ida Schenk
npcs.info:
A lance corporal who commands the four-soldier guard at the windpump station on the dry road to the front. She is hard, suspicious and thorough. Every water cart that leaves her tank leaves sealed, and she tastes the water first, every morning, in front of her men.

**Speaking Style:** Sharp and short, a guard who tells people what to do before they ask.
**Combat Role:** a rifle from the top of the pump tower; she shoots well and early
**Relationship Hook:** A wiry soldier on a windpump tower lowering a canteen and watching the empty road.
personality: Core: hard and suspicious; keeps her men on short leash
Quirk: tastes the water every morning

npcs.name: Idris Qaren
npcs.info:
A tinsmith of the row, a lean, scarred Ishvalan who learned metalwork in the bazaars of Ishval before the war and now makes stovepipes and buckets for a town that pays and does not thank. He works fast, talks little and sings at the anvil.

**Speaking Style:** Low and even, a man who sings at his anvil and says little else.
**Combat Role:** a smith who fights with tin shears and a hammer; quick, close, and aimed at hands
**Relationship Hook:** A lean Ishvalan smith hammering a tin sheet on an anvil, singing under the noise.
personality: Core: sings at the anvil; never haggles with another Ishvalan; keeps the scar on his arm covered
Quirk: argues with the elders and loses gracefully

npcs.name: Ignaz Brunner
npcs.info:
The master of Brunner's Military Tailors, the tailoring house that has cut officers' blue for forty years, a silver-haired man with a tape measure round his neck and three sons at the cutting tables. He makes a general's greatcoat in a month and a lieutenant's tunic in a week, and he can tell a man's rank from his walk before the man reaches the counter.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and courteous, a tailor who speaks with pins in his mouth and never drops one.
**Combat Role:** none; an old tailor with shears who has never had to use them on a man
**Relationship Hook:** An old tailor with a tape measure round his neck, holding a half-cut blue tunic to the light and frowning at its size.
personality: Core: courteous, exact and discreet; judges men by their seams; loyal to the army and afraid of it
Quirk: never forgets a customer's measurements

npcs.name: Ignaz Morell
npcs.info:
The parish priest of Fotset, an old, broad man who refused to leave when the town was evacuated and now lives in the cellars of the ruins. Soldiers of both armies know him by his white beard and his patched black coat, and neither side has shot at him yet.

**Speaking Style:** Deep and gentle, a country priest's voice that fills a ruin without being raised.
**Combat Role:** none; a priest who walks into gunfire and is not shot
**Relationship Hook:** An old bearded priest with a lantern in a roofless chapel beneath a cracked bell.
personality: Core: gentle and immovable; jokes about his own funeral; never takes sides aloud
Quirk: blesses both armies' dead

npcs.name: Ignaz Pohl
npcs.info:
The station master at Halden Junction has run the junction for twenty-six years and can name any train on the line by its whistle a mile off. He is a small, neat widower who keeps canaries in the station house and a timetable on a nail by the door, corrected in red pencil every morning.

**Speaking Style:** Precise and fussy, an old station master who names trains by their whistles and sighs at lateness.
**Combat Role:** none; he would throw a points lever and send trouble down the wrong line
**Relationship Hook:** A small old station master in a peaked cap checking his pocket watch beside a water tower.
personality: Core: knows every train by its whistle; corrects timetables in red pencil; fussy, kindly and deeply nosy
Quirk: talks to his canaries more than to people

npcs.name: Ignaz Wurzel
npcs.info:
A middle-aged hewer who grows the best beans on the hill and was the first to refuse the new allotment rent. He did not make a speech about it. He simply did not pay, and went on hoeing.

**Speaking Style:** Mild and immovable, a man who says no the way other men say good morning.
**Combat Role:** a hoe and a hewer's shoulders, if pushed far enough
**Relationship Hook:** A quiet miner leaning on his hoe between bean rows as a soldier with a spade climbs the hill.
personality: Core: mild and stubborn; says little
Quirk: loves his beans more than is sensible

npcs.name: Ilyas Marrouk
npcs.info:
A retired water carrier with a bent back who comes to the square at first light with a bucket and a rag and scrubs the chalk off the plinth of the stone god. He was among the first in Reole to follow the prophet and among the last to stop, and he has not stopped believing in the sun, only in the man who preached it.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and reverent, an old believer who lowers his voice near the statue as if it could hear.
**Combat Role:** none; an old man who sits down where he is and will not be moved
**Relationship Hook:** An old man scrubbing chalk off the foot of a giant stone god before anyone else is awake.
personality: Core: patient and devout; scrubs the chalk away without a word of complaint; greets the statue before he greets people
Quirk: keeps a knotted string in his breast pocket

npcs.name: Imke Dannhauer
npcs.info:
A seamstress in her forties who keeps the geraniums in the stone trough beneath the bronze plate by the station, and has done so every week since her husband's name went up on it. She still wears mourning seven years on, faded now to grey. The town thinks her devoted. She is mostly angry.

**Speaking Style:** Flat and tired, a widow who has said the same thing to every official and expects no answer.
**Combat Role:** none; dressmaker's shears and a hatpin
**Relationship Hook:** A woman in faded mourning watering geraniums beneath a bronze list of the dead, glaring at one name.
personality: Core: tends the flowers with her jaw set; answers kindness with suspicion; sews faster when she is angry
Quirk: never says her husband's name aloud

npcs.name: Imra Seleh
npcs.info:
A girl of about fourteen from the refugee band who carries water up the stepwell's flights twice a day, a jar on each shoulder. She knows every step by its wobble and counts them aloud. Travellers who ask her for a drink pay in news.

**Speaking Style:** Quick and teasing, a girl who races her own words and laughs when she trips over them.
**Combat Role:** none; a quick girl who runs up stairs faster than any grown soldier
**Relationship Hook:** A girl climbing a stepwell's stone flights with a water jar on each shoulder.
personality: Core: bold and teasing; counts steps aloud; trades water for stories
Quirk: is more frightened than she lets on

npcs.name: Imre Vashko
npcs.info:
The lieutenant who runs troop movements through the yard is a thin, exact man with a pencil behind his ear and a pocket watch he consults more than his men. He can load a battalion and its guns in under two hours, and he has done it so often that the companies sleeping in the carriages know him by the click of his watch lid.

**Speaking Style:** Measured and quiet, a transport officer who reads schedules aloud like verse and never hurries a word.
**Combat Role:** a trained officer's pistol work; he fights from cover between carriages, firing in pairs and moving after each
**Relationship Hook:** A thin lieutenant with spectacles checking his watch beside a row of troop carriages at night.
personality: Core: precise to the minute, and expects others to be; courteous to privates and cold to colonels; turns his watch over and over when he is uneasy
Quirk: would rather resign than move troops on an order he cannot read

npcs.name: Ina Stroud
npcs.info:
A tenement landlady in Central City's Eastern Tenements, who keeps the yard's taps running and its rents collected. She is tired, firm and fair, and she has seen the army's raids in the yard more times than she can count. She knows every tenant and every debt, and she keeps a cat.

**Speaking Style:** Tired and firm, a landlady who lends money and collects it on time.
**Combat Role:** none; a broom and a set jaw
**Relationship Hook:** A landlady in a tenement yard collecting rent under a line of washing.
personality: Core: tired, firm and fair; lends money and collects on time; hides tenants the army wants
Quirk: talks to her cat more than her tenants

npcs.name: Ingrid Halvorsen
npcs.info:
The engineer who runs Frostworks Automail, the north's own workshop for limbs that do not freeze to the skin. She trained in Rush Valley and came north because the problems were harder, and she has made the lightest cold-proof arm in Amestris.

**Speaking Style:** Cool and exact, an engineer who describes a stripped joint the way others describe a sunset.
**Combat Role:** an automail engineer with a heavy spanner and an engineer's knowledge of where any steel limb is weakest
**Relationship Hook:** An engineer with a spanner bent over a stripped automail arm, frost on the workshop window behind her.
personality: Core: cool and absorbed; talks to a limb as she strips it; never fits a port without explaining every step
Quirk: loses track of time completely

npcs.name: Irmgard Varga
npcs.info:
The captain in charge of the survey, a careful officer who keeps the map tent spotless and the chains and theodolites in strict order. She does the work exactly as ordered and asks no questions out loud.

**Speaking Style:** Precise and cool; she speaks in coordinates when she is tired.
**Combat Role:** an officer with a service pistol who fights from cover and gives clear orders
**Relationship Hook:** A straight-backed officer bent over a map table, marking a long curving line.
personality: Core: exact and reserved; keeps her questions private; neat to a fault
Quirk: protective of her career

npcs.name: Irmgard Vinter
npcs.info:
A secretary sent up from Central Command to keep the Requisition Hall in order whenever an agent from the capital is in residence. Between visits she pins and unpins the maps of the north, keeps the stove lit, and answers no questions about who used the hall last.

**Speaking Style:** Low and level, never a word wasted, the voice of someone who has taken dictation from generals.
**Combat Role:** none; a desk drawer pistol she has never drawn and a gift for being somewhere else
**Relationship Hook:** A secretary in a capital uniform pinning a red string across a map of the northern mines.
personality: Core: impeccably correct; never sits while an officer stands; removes every pin at night and replaces it at dawn
Quirk: has a dry laugh she seldom lets anyone hear

npcs.name: Isaac McDougal
npcs.info:
Isaac McDougal, the Freezing Alchemist, a former State Alchemist and major who deserted after the Ishval war. He is a muscular man in his mid thirties with long black hair tied back, who works with water: he freezes it, boils it and drives it through a building. He is gruff, pragmatic and a little unhinged.

**Speaking Style:** Gruff, blunt and contemptuous, a voice that turns to a manic laugh when his ice takes hold.
**Combat Role:** water alchemy, freezing the moisture in the air and a body into ice, or boiling it
**Relationship Hook:** A cloaked man freezing a whole avenue of soldiers solid with his hand on the ground.
personality: Core: gruff and contemptuous; pragmatic about killing; certain the country is doomed
Quirk: laughs when the ice takes

npcs.name: Isidor Penk
npcs.info:
The pawnbroker, a courteous old man with a jeweller's glass in his eye who holds half the watches and wedding rings in Youswell until payday. He never cheats on a valuation and never gives an inch on interest. He reads poetry between customers.

**Speaking Style:** Courteous and dry, an old pawnbroker who apologises for the interest as he writes it down.
**Combat Role:** none; an iron grille and a shotgun under the counter he has never fired
**Relationship Hook:** An old pawnbroker behind an iron grille turning a war medal in the lamplight with a jeweller's loupe.
personality: Core: polite to a fault; fair on valuation, hard on terms; collects debts on people, not things
Quirk: reads poetry between customers

npcs.name: Ismail Rahmat
npcs.info:
A young Ishvalan with a burned hand who walks into Kanda by night and pulls up the army's numbered stakes one at a time. He lays them out in a line pointing east and leaves before the patrol comes.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped, fierce and young; every sentence sounds like the start of an argument.
**Combat Role:** a desperate street fighter with a stake for a club; fast, untrained and hard to stop
**Relationship Hook:** A young man carrying a numbered army stake across a field of stakes under the moon.
personality: Core: angry and devoted; speaks of Scar as if he were a saint; cannot sit still for long
Quirk: works only in the dark

npcs.name: Isolde Wren
npcs.info:
A State Alchemist posted to the southern front, a major in her thirties whose speciality is the transmutation of metals: she bends rails, seals trench walls and makes bridges out of wreckage. She is cool, exacting and very private. Her silver watch is always in her hand.

**Speaking Style:** Low and level, an alchemist who weighs every word as she would a reagent.
**Combat Role:** metal transmutation through a circle tattooed inside her wrist; she turns wire, rails and helmets into walls and spikes
**Relationship Hook:** A tall alchemist in a field coat kneeling by a stretcher, a glow of alchemy under her gloved hands.
personality: Core: cool and exacting; kind only in the dark; breaks rules with great care
Quirk: turns her silver watch over and over

npcs.name: Ivar Stenmark
npcs.info:
The corporal of the spotting post on Eaglehead Crag, a wiry climber who mans the telescope with one other soldier and a stove for a week at a time. His reports reach the general before the fort's own towers have seen anything.

**Speaking Style:** Breathless and bright, a climber's voice that never quite comes down from the top.
**Combat Role:** a climber with a carbine; he fights from above and never where he can be reached
**Relationship Hook:** A wiry corporal at a telescope on a crag top, eagles wheeling beneath him.
personality: Core: climbs anything on a dare; talks to the eagles; keeps his reports short and exact
Quirk: sings on the climb

npcs.name: Ivo Brask
npcs.info:
An escort sergeant from Fort Briggs who brings the fort's sledges down to the yard and takes visitors back up the road. He says little, watches everyone, and has a team of dogs that like him more than any person does. The yard waits on his schedule, and he does not apologise for it.

**Speaking Style:** Low and deadpan, saying the worst news as though remarking on the weather, which it usually is.
**Combat Role:** a mountain scout with a short carbine and a knife; he fights from cover in snow, low and silent, and lets the cold do half the work
**Relationship Hook:** A tall scout in a white fur hood unhitching sledge dogs and glancing, unimpressed, at the waiting room window.
personality: Core: deadpan and patient; talks to his dogs more than to people; judges men by how they wait
Quirk: shares his flask with whoever helped stoke the stove

npcs.name: Ivo Stannard
npcs.info:
The keeper of the beacon on the spit south of town, a gaunt, one-eyed man who climbs the squat tower at dusk every evening to light the lamp the night boats steer home by, and trims it again at midnight. He lives in the hut at its foot with a brindled dog and has kept the light for eighteen years.

**Speaking Style:** Hoarse and grudging, a keeper who talks more to his dog than to visitors and turns his blind side to questions.
**Combat Role:** none much; a heavy lamp-trimming hook and a steep stair a stranger cannot climb fast
**Relationship Hook:** A one-eyed keeper climbing a stone stair at dusk with a can of oil, his dog at his heels.
personality: Core: lights the lamp at the same minute every day; drinks only on the nights he is paid to; talks to his dog about the boats
Quirk: turns his blind side to questions

npcs.name: Izumi Curtis
npcs.info:
A housewife of Dublith, by her own description, who keeps the butcher's shop with her husband Sig and happens to be a master alchemist and martial artist. She took the Elric boys as students when they were children, left them on an island for a month to learn one lesson, and beat the rest into them. She despises the army and the dogs of the state, and she has a bad cough she hides from everyone.

**Speaking Style:** A hard, barking voice, quick and unsentimental, that stops people in their tracks; when she is moved she goes flat and quiet, and when she is ill she will not admit it.
**Combat Role:** brutal close-range martial arts and clapless alchemy, a throw followed by a transmuted fist from the floor
**Relationship Hook:** A stern woman at a butcher's counter, cleaver in hand, staring down two boys who have come back.
personality: Core: harsh, sharp and direct; praise from her is rare; calls herself a housewife and means it; despises the army and its alchemists
Quirk: coughs blood and waves it away

npcs.name: Jabir Hassun
npcs.info:
A thin Ishvalan widower from the refugee band who climbs the palace terraces each morning and sweeps the throne room of a dead king. Nobody asked him to. He says a hall where people once knelt deserves a clean floor, and he chases goats and caravan boys out of it with the same broom.

**Speaking Style:** Hoarse and unhurried; he talks to the broom as often as to a visitor, and he hums between sentences.
**Combat Role:** none; an old man with a broom who backs away from trouble
**Relationship Hook:** An old Ishvalan sweeping sand off a throne-room floor while light falls through a cracked dome.
personality: Core: gentle and stubborn; chases off anyone who spits in the hall; speaks of his dead wife as if she had just stepped out
Quirk: sweeps the same floor every morning

npcs.name: Jakob Spahn
npcs.info:
The timber yard foreman, a careful man with one finger missing who has run the steam saw for fifteen years. He cuts the props to the order and the order to the inch, and he keeps every order he has ever been given.

**Speaking Style:** Steady and sparing, a sawyer who talks over the blade only when he must.
**Combat Role:** a felling axe, handled like a tool
**Relationship Hook:** A sawyer in a yard of pine logs reading two sheets of paper side by side, an envelope of money beside them.
personality: Core: careful and exact; keeps every scrap of paper
Quirk: honest and frightened of it

npcs.name: Jalal Hamdawi
npcs.info:
A tall, gaunt Ishvalan at the lime pits of the tannery, with forearms burned grey from the work no one else will do. Before the war he cut and stitched saddles in an Ishvalan market town, and he still knows a good hide by the feel of it better than the tanner who pays him half a man's wage. He prays at noon at the edge of the pits and does not care who watches.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and held in, an Ishvalan worker who weighs each sentence before he lets it out.
**Combat Role:** a tall man with burned hands and a fleshing knife, who fights only when there is no way out
**Relationship Hook:** A gaunt Ishvalan with burned arms hauling a dripping hide out of a stinking pit.
personality: Core: proud and unbending; works harder than any man on the floor and says so to no one; gentle with the slum's children
Quirk: will not lower his eyes to an Amestrian

npcs.name: Jamal Sabri
npcs.info:
An Ishvalan herder hired as a guide by the army surveyors, against their orders, because nobody else alive can lead a mule from one eastern well to the next. He sits in the cart's shade with a cloth over his face and wakes the instant a mule shifts.

**Speaking Style:** Few words and long silences; he answers a question with a direction.
**Combat Role:** a desert scout's knife and sling; he would rather vanish into the scrub
**Relationship Hook:** A guide in a face cloth resting in a mule cart's shade, one eye open.
personality: Core: silent and watchful; never shows all the wells; drinks only after the animals
Quirk: likes the lieutenant despite himself

npcs.name: Jaspar Nolle
npcs.info:
The boatbuilder of the lake shore, a big, slow, soft-spoken man who bends oak planks over a steam box and can tell whose boat is whose by the sound of its leak. Every fishing boat in Dublith was built or patched in his yard, and he names each one after a bird.

**Speaking Style:** Deep and slow, a boatbuilder who speaks after a long breath and never in a hurry.
**Combat Role:** a big man's shove and an adze held near the head; he would rather put a boat between himself and trouble
**Relationship Hook:** A big quiet boatbuilder running his palm along a new hull, listening to the wood.
personality: Core: names boats after birds; slow to speak and slower to anger; never asks a question he does not want answered
Quirk: listens to wood

npcs.name: Jasper Corwin
npcs.info:
A painter from the capital who dragged an old fishing boat out across the dry lake with two hired camels so he could paint it under the noon mirage. He lives in a tent beside it, burnt brown, and paints the same canvas over and over.

**Speaking Style:** Cheerful and vague, an artist who forgets the end of his sentences.
**Combat Role:** none; a painter with a palette knife and no sense of danger
**Relationship Hook:** A tanned painter at an easel beside the ribs of a boat in the middle of a white cracked lake bed.
personality: Core: dreamy and friendly; paints at noon; forgets to eat
Quirk: sees things in the mirage

npcs.name: Jean Havoc
npcs.info:
Second Lieutenant Jean Havoc of Mustang's unit, a tall, blond, easy-going soldier who is never without a cigarette and never lucky with women, who keep leaving him for his commander. He is a good shot with a carbine, steady under fire and loyal to the colonel, and he grumbles about everything without meaning a word of it.

**Speaking Style:** Laid-back and cheerful, a cigarette in every sentence; he complains about women leaving him for the colonel and then gets the job done.
**Combat Role:** a carbine and a cool head, a soldier's aimed fire from cover
**Relationship Hook:** A tall blond lieutenant lighting a cigarette and complaining that his girlfriend has left him.
personality: Core: laid-back and cheerful; unlucky in love and says so; steady when the shooting starts
Quirk: never without a cigarette

npcs.name: Jens Albrecht
npcs.info:
A corporal on the lookout crag, a quiet countryman with the best eyes in his company, who has spent more weeks on the crag than any man rotated through it. He signals the valley with the heliograph and writes everything in a log.

**Speaking Style:** Sparse and dry, a lookout who reports what he sees and nothing else.
**Combat Role:** a long-range rifleman who picks his shot from high ground and never misses twice
**Relationship Hook:** A lean corporal with field glasses beside a tripod heliograph on a bare crag, eagles above.
personality: Core: says only what he has seen; keeps an exact log; patient as the crag
Quirk: starting to distrust his own command

npcs.name: Jeremias Faltin
npcs.info:
An eel-catcher and wildfowler who has lived in a hide on stilts in the reed marsh below the city for twelve years, since he left the army's scouts with a fowling gun and no wish to see a road again. He sells eels and ducks at the tannery gate and the brewery yard, says as little as he can and can cross the whole marsh by night in a punt without touching a light.

**Speaking Style:** A low rasp, never above a murmur, as if the reeds might be listening.
**Combat Role:** an old army scout with a long fowling gun and a gutting knife; he fights from the reeds, shoots once, moves, and is never where the reply lands
**Relationship Hook:** A lean bearded man in an oilskin coat poling a flat punt through tall reeds at dusk, a long gun across his knees.
personality: Core: silent, watchful and patient; trusts the marsh more than any man; eats what he catches and nothing else
Quirk: keeps every promise and makes very few

npcs.name: Jerso
npcs.info:
A soldier who looks quiet and dangerous on duty and turns out to be friendly, talkative and funny off it. In a fight he becomes a squat, toad-like creature with a spitting tongue. He has a wife and a daughter he has not let himself go back to.

**Speaking Style:** Talkative and jokey once he relaxes, needling his partner; on duty he goes quiet and serious.
**Combat Role:** a frogfish-like chimera form, sticky spit and a heavy leap
**Relationship Hook:** A stocky soldier with a deadpan face, then a sudden grin at his partner's expense.
personality: Core: friendly and talkative once he trusts you; ashamed to face his family; loyal to friends over orders
Quirk: pokes fun at Zampano

npcs.name: Ji Shaoqing
npcs.info:
A barefoot boy of thirteen who runs messages through the Clan Quarter for any house that tips him and a few that do not. He knows every back gate, every guard dog and every porter who can be talked past, and he is rarely still long enough to be caught.

**Speaking Style:** Fast and bright, words tumbling over one another, then suddenly word-perfect when he recites a message.
**Combat Role:** a street runner; he ducks, throws a handful of grit and is over the wall before the second blow
**Relationship Hook:** A barefoot boy vaulting a low clan wall with a rolled message clenched in his teeth.
personality: Core: never walks when he can run; grins at threats; carries every message word for word and never opens a sealed one
Quirk: fiercely loyal to the clan that let his father go

npcs.name: Jia Manchuan
npcs.info:
A boatman of the willow lake who rows courtiers out to drink and write verse, very slowly, because he is paid by the hour. He has heard more secrets than any priest in the capital and remembered none of them, or so he says.

**Speaking Style:** Oily and agreeable, a boatman's voice that rows slowly in conversation too.
**Combat Role:** none; an oar in the water and the knowledge of where the lake is deep
**Relationship Hook:** A boatman leaning on his oar beneath the willows, smiling as if he has heard nothing at all.
personality: Core: rows slowly on purpose; agrees with every passenger; claims a terrible memory
Quirk: remembers everything and charges for it

npcs.name: Joachim Hesse
npcs.info:
The smith of Larch Hollow shoes horses in the forge below and teaches the village's children in the schoolroom above it, climbing the ladder between the two several times a day. He is the village's unofficial headman because nobody else will argue with him.

**Speaking Style:** Measured and patient, a smith who teaches children the same way he shoes horses: one nail at a time.
**Combat Role:** a smith's hammer and tongs; slow heavy blows from a man who has swung iron all his life
**Relationship Hook:** A broad-shouldered smith climbing a ladder from a glowing forge to a schoolroom above.
personality: Core: calm, slow and immovable; teaches sums with horseshoe nails; keeps both armies at arm's length
Quirk: protects the village's children before anything

npcs.name: Joakim Lindahl
npcs.info:
The private posted at the deepest valve of the boiler deck with a stool, a lamp, a doctor's stethoscope and an order to listen. He was picked because he was the quietest man in his platoon, and he has grown quieter since.

**Speaking Style:** Barely above a whisper, with long pauses, as if he were still listening for something under the words.
**Combat Role:** a poor shot and a stubborn one; he stays at his post with a carbine across his knees and fires at whatever comes up the pipe gallery
**Relationship Hook:** A thin soldier on a stool with a stethoscope pressed to a cold valve, eyes shut, listening.
personality: Core: speaks only when the furnaces are banked; presses an ear to cold iron without thinking; keeps tally marks on scraps of lagging
Quirk: does not laugh at the stokers' ghost stories

npcs.name: Jobst Grieshaber
npcs.info:
The senior mechanic of the motor pool, a private so black with oil that nobody can read the badges on his collar. He knows every lorry in the shed by its cough, sleeps under one when the night shift is quiet and can get a staff car started in a frost by methods the manual does not describe. Officers who need a car at short notice learn to bring him tobacco.

**Speaking Style:** Grease-thick and grinning, a mechanic who swears at engines lovingly and at officers carefully.
**Combat Role:** a wrench, a tyre lever and a willingness to fight dirty in a shed full of things to hide behind
**Relationship Hook:** A grinning mechanic black with oil, head and shoulders inside an old motor lorry's engine.
personality: Core: cheerful and crooked in small ways; always has a rag in one hand and a cigarette unlit behind his ear; honest about the big things, which nobody believes
Quirk: talks to engines

npcs.name: Jonah Albers
npcs.info:
The private on sentry at the goods yard gate, a big, amiable farm boy from the south of the district who joined the army for the boots and the regular meals. He stands in his striped box, waves the carts through, signs where he is told and chats to anyone who stops. He has never fired his rifle at anything but a target.

**Speaking Style:** Easygoing and a little slow, a young private who says right you are to everything.
**Combat Role:** an army rifle and bayonet, drilled but never tested
**Relationship Hook:** A big young sentry squinting at the stencil on a crate, lips moving.
personality: Core: friendly and slow; ashamed of what he cannot do; proud of his boots
Quirk: says right you are to everything

npcs.name: Jonas Kirk
npcs.info:
A private of the Briggs garrison down from the fort with a new automail arm, learning to grip again on the fitting ward. He lost the arm to frostbite on a patrol he will not describe, and he is desperate to get back up the mountain.

**Speaking Style:** Rough and cheerful, a mountain soldier who jokes about his arm before you can look at it.
**Combat Role:** a Briggs rifleman relearning his grip; he fights with his new steel arm as a club when the rifle is too slow
**Relationship Hook:** A young soldier on a hospital bed flexing a new steel arm and grinning through the pain.
personality: Core: cheerful and stubborn; makes jokes about his own arm; loyal to the fort past sense
Quirk: angry when he is alone

npcs.name: Jonas Oake
npcs.info:
A private of eighteen on night watch at the empty stockade, posted to guard rolls of wire. He has a lantern, a rifle and a schoolboy's notebook, and from the lookout he can see every post of the fence.

**Speaking Style:** Young, soft and serious; a boy soldier's voice that has not finished breaking.
**Combat Role:** a raw recruit with a rifle; steady on the range, untried anywhere else
**Relationship Hook:** A boy soldier on a watch platform, copying names off a fence post by lantern light.
personality: Core: solemn and gentle; hums hymns from home to stay awake; has never fired his rifle at anyone
Quirk: copies one post's names every watch

npcs.name: Joost Valdemar
npcs.info:
The automail fitter whose name is on the sign, a thick-armed man of forty who served his apprenticeship in Rush Valley and came to the capital because that was where the wounded were. His clinic is two rooms and a lathe, and the waiting benches are full of veterans from Ishval. He charges what a man can pay and remembers every limb he has fitted.

**Speaking Style:** Easy and patient, a fitter who talks a patient through the pain as if it were the weather.
**Combat Role:** a strong mechanic with a heavy spanner and a fitter's knowledge of where automail breaks
**Relationship Hook:** A thick-armed fitter bent over a steel arm at his parts bench, a loupe in one eye and a bolt between his lips.
personality: Core: kind, steady and stubborn; talks to the limbs as he works on them; will not ask a patient where he lost the arm
Quirk: hates the army's pension clerks more than any enemy

npcs.name: Jorg Pahl
npcs.info:
The barracks quartermaster, a lieutenant who has never been to the front and runs his store like a counting house. Boots, blankets and cartridges leave his hatch only against signatures, and he can tell a forged one across the room. He is tidy, patient and quietly funny. He likes the men and despises the paperwork he makes them do.

**Speaking Style:** Dry and measured, a supply officer who answers every request with a form number.
**Combat Role:** an issue revolver he has fired twice, both on the range
**Relationship Hook:** A tidy lieutenant at a supply hatch checking a signature through his spectacles.
personality: Core: answers with form numbers; despises paperwork and does it perfectly; feeds the men first, explains later
Quirk: never raises his voice

npcs.name: Jorik Haberl
npcs.info:
A smallholder who works three strips of rye, a few goats and a cow, and is the nearest thing the village has to a headman. He is weathered, slow-spoken and polite to strangers in a way that tells them nothing whatever. Before the doctor came, half his family was too sick to work. Now all of them do.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and stubborn, a smallholder who never says anything twice and nothing useful to strangers.
**Combat Role:** a pitchfork, and the whole village behind him
**Relationship Hook:** A weathered smallholder leaning on a pitchfork, smiling politely at a stranger and saying nothing.
personality: Core: slow and polite; puts the village before his own house; keeps the goats as an excuse to watch the track
Quirk: tells strangers nothing in many words

npcs.name: Jorin Kessel
npcs.info:
The engineer of the town pump, a short man with oil to the elbows who has kept the old steam engine running since before most of Reole was born. When it stops, the town carries buckets; when he is sick, it stops.

**Speaking Style:** Rough and fond, a machine man who swears at the engine like a brother.
**Combat Role:** a mechanic with a long spanner who knows where to stand when steam lets go
**Relationship Hook:** A wiry old engineer feeding a chair leg into a boiler by the glow of its firebox.
personality: Core: stubborn and practical; talks to the engine by a pet name; will not let anyone else touch the valves
Quirk: keeps a list of every chair he burned

npcs.name: Jory Kalt
npcs.info:
A lineman who climbs the telegraph poles of the north in spikes and a safety belt, splicing what the frost and the wind break. He is young, bony and fearless on a pole, and terrified of the senior operator.

**Speaking Style:** Easy and cheerful, a lineman who whistles between sentences and swears gently at the weather.
**Combat Role:** a lineman with climbing spikes and a coil of wire; he goes up where others cannot follow and comes down fast
**Relationship Hook:** A lanky lineman with spikes on his boots, a coil of wire on his shoulder, looking up at an iced pole and sighing.
personality: Core: cheerful in any wind; chews liquorice root on the poles; spends his wages on gloves he loses
Quirk: cannot lie to a woman over thirty

npcs.name: Jory Mabbs
npcs.info:
The yardman of the scrap yard, a gnarled old man with a clay pipe, a limp and two mongrels who sleep under the cart scale. He lets the town's boys dig in the heaps so long as they show him their finds first, and he buys the good ones for a few coins and a lesson in what they are.

**Speaking Style:** Wheezy and patient, an old yardman who names each part as if introducing it at a funeral.
**Combat Role:** none much; two mongrels at his whistle and a crowbar from the nearest heap
**Relationship Hook:** An old yardman weighing a rusted steel arm on a scale while two dogs watch.
personality: Core: teaches boys the names of parts as payment; talks to his dogs in full sentences; will not look at a headstone
Quirk: knows the weight of everything

npcs.name: Josef Tannhof
npcs.info:
The track walker of the snowshed section, an old man who walks the line through the dark gallery twice a day, tapping each rail with a long hammer and listening to the ring. He is deaf in one ear and swears the other is better for it.

**Speaking Style:** Thin, cranky and precise, an old man who turns his good ear toward you before he answers.
**Combat Role:** an old man with a long track hammer; one swing at the knees and a retreat into the dark gallery
**Relationship Hook:** An old track walker with a lantern tapping a rail with a long hammer in a dark timber gallery, head cocked.
personality: Core: taps every rail he passes; turns his good ear to whoever speaks; carries his lunch in a tin box he never shares
Quirk: has opinions about railway clerks

npcs.name: Josefa Lindt
npcs.info:
The dresser to the opera's leading soprano, sixty, tiny and fierce, who has laced, pinned and comforted prima donnas for forty seasons. She lives in the wings among the costumes, knows every trapdoor in the stage and has opinions about every voice in the capital, all of them low.

**Speaking Style:** Sharp-tongued and quick, an old dresser who mutters through a mouthful of pins.
**Combat Role:** none; a tiny old woman with long hatpins and a stage full of trapdoors
**Relationship Hook:** A tiny old dresser standing among costume racks in the wings, a note clutched in her hand and pins in her mouth.
personality: Core: fierce, gossipy and devoted; notices every face in the stalls; trusts no man in evening dress
Quirk: sews when she is frightened

npcs.name: Josefine Arndt
npcs.info:
The bandleader of the little brass band at Lantern Music Hall, who plays the cornet herself and conducts with it between solos. She has been leading the band since her husband's lungs gave out, and she has never missed a night.

**Speaking Style:** Lilting and warm, a bandleader who half-sings when she talks and counts time with her fingers.
**Combat Role:** none; a brass cornet swung like a club and a band that will stand up when she does
**Relationship Hook:** A bandleader with a cornet raised high, the brass band behind her, footlights glowing below.
personality: Core: warm, brisk and musical; counts time in everything she does; plays louder when she is angry
Quirk: feeds the band's drummer, who is twelve

npcs.name: Joss Harlan
npcs.info:
The sergeant who runs the checkpoint on the road out of East City, searching carts, checking papers and turning back anyone whose story does not hold. He is blunt, thorough and hard to bribe. Since the Blue Squad's train business, he searches every eastbound load twice.

**Speaking Style:** Short and loud, a gate sergeant who barks for papers before he says good morning.
**Combat Role:** a soldier with a rifle and a squad at his back; he holds the gate
**Relationship Hook:** A gate sergeant holding up his hand to stop a cart on a dusty road.
personality: Core: blunt and thorough; searches every cart twice; hard to bribe
Quirk: soft about children

npcs.name: Joss Mehlmann
npcs.info:
The baker, a soft floury man who has the shift's loaves on the sill before dawn and lets children warm themselves against his oven door. He is the gentlest man in Youswell and the most ashamed.

**Speaking Style:** Mild and apologetic, a baker who speaks quietly so as not to wake anyone at four in the morning.
**Combat Role:** none; a bread peel held like a shield
**Relationship Hook:** A floury baker staring into an empty flour bin by the glow of his oven.
personality: Core: gentle and ashamed; gives the burnt loaves away
Quirk: talks to his oven

npcs.name: Jost Marrell
npcs.info:
A lodger who signed on at the pit a year ago and works harder than anyone, keeps his bunk spotless and never goes near the guardhouse or the tavern on collection night. The other single men like him and know nothing about him.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and careful, a man who answers only the question asked and never volunteers a name.
**Combat Role:** an infantryman's bayonet drill, done with a pick handle, and a rifleman's eye
**Relationship Hook:** A lean miner on a bunk quietly rolling a shirt into a bag while the room snores around him.
personality: Core: self-contained and watchful; sleeps facing the door; kind to the youngest lodgers
Quirk: stands to attention when startled

npcs.name: Jude
npcs.info:
The Blind Alchemist, a skilled alchemist in the service of the wealthy Hamburgang family, who lost both eyes and carries scars down both sides of his face. He is calm, courteous and devoted to the family, and he is rumoured to be the only man alive who has brought someone back from the dead.

**Speaking Style:** Calm, gentle and courteous, a blind man who listens to the answer before he replies.
**Combat Role:** none; alchemy by touch
**Relationship Hook:** A blind man with scarred eyes listening to a girl he believes is his master's daughter play in the garden.
personality: Core: calm, gentle and courteous; devoted to the family; trusts his hands over his lost eyes
Quirk: proud of his one success

npcs.name: Kadir
npcs.info:
A spice seller in Reole's covered market, with baskets from the trade road heaped in every colour. He is loud in the morning and asleep by noon, and he knows the price of every spice from the east. He went to the church's sermons for the crowds, not the faith, and said so.

**Speaking Style:** Quick and cheerful, a spice seller who haggles like it is a game he enjoys losing.
**Combat Role:** none; a spice seller who throws pepper in a thief's face and runs
**Relationship Hook:** A spice seller scooping red powder from a heaped basket and calling to the passing crowd.
personality: Core: cheerful and loud; loves to haggle; never believed the miracles
Quirk: keeps his head down when it matters

npcs.name: Kaija Mehrlein
npcs.info:
The mother of the charburner family who keeps the mounds smouldering in the clearing. She is smoke-dark, quiet and fierce, and she has raised six children in a turf hut and lost none of them.

**Speaking Style:** Low and smoky, a charburner's voice rough from a life spent in smoke.
**Combat Role:** none; a charcoal rake and a clearing of fire and smoke
**Relationship Hook:** A smoke-darkened woman with a rake watching a mound burn too fiercely in a forest clearing.
personality: Core: quiet and fierce; smoke-dark from head to foot; lost none of her six children
Quirk: will lie to protect them

npcs.name: Kain Fuery
npcs.info:
Master Sergeant Kain Fuery of Mustang's unit, a small, bespectacled young man in his early twenties who keeps the radios, telephones and cables working and can tap a line in minutes. He is kind, cheerful and timid-looking, and the colonel chose him for the way he looks after the men under him. He found Black Hayate in the rain.

**Speaking Style:** Young, kind and earnest, a little nervous in front of rank and happy to explain a radio to anyone.
**Combat Role:** a rifle from cover and a field radio; he wins by hearing first
**Relationship Hook:** A small bespectacled sergeant with his head inside a radio set, humming.
personality: Core: kind and cheerful; timid in front of rank; braver than he looks
Quirk: happiest with a broken radio

npcs.name: Kang Shitou
npcs.info:
A mountain porter who carries loads for the clans' training parties up to the snowline and back. He is huge, patient and superstitious, and he has carried up more warriors than he can count.

**Speaking Style:** Big, slow and blunt, a porter's voice that finishes every sentence with a grunt.
**Combat Role:** a porter with a carrying frame and a staff; he swings the frame like a door and does not stop
**Relationship Hook:** A huge porter crouched by a dead fire pit below the snowline, staring up at the ledge.
personality: Core: huge, slow and gentle; carries more than any two men; counts his steps on the climb under his breath
Quirk: superstitious about the high snow and ashamed of it

npcs.name: Karim Mirza
npcs.info:
Reole's druggist, a small neat man in a starched coat who tells every patient he is not a doctor and then sets their bone anyway. In the riots his back room was the only surgery in town, and his scrubbed table took the wounded of both sides.

**Speaking Style:** Low, calm and careful; he names what he is about to do before he does it.
**Combat Role:** none; a small man who will hold a door shut with his whole weight
**Relationship Hook:** A small druggist in a white coat binding a splint on a scrubbed table under a lamp.
personality: Core: careful and discreet; washes his hands before and after any talk; writes nothing down that could hurt anyone
Quirk: keeps a stool for the waiting by the door

npcs.name: Karley
npcs.info:
Karley, the chief communications man at Fort Briggs, a soldier with a pencil moustache and a short goatee who carries a radio transmitter on his back into every fight and relays Olivier's orders to the line. He is easy-going in the mess and exact on the set.

**Speaking Style:** Relaxed and drawling off duty, crisp and quick on the radio.
**Combat Role:** a rifle and a radio pack, relaying orders under fire
**Relationship Hook:** A soldier with a radio on his back crouching in the snow, calling coordinates.
personality: Core: easy-going off duty; exact on the radio; steady in a crisis
Quirk: never without his transmitter

npcs.name: Kasimir Brehm
npcs.info:
The machine-gunner of the forward trench has held the same firing step for two years, longer than anyone else on the line. He keeps his gun cleaner than his face and has scratched a tally into the clay beside it that he never speaks of.

**Speaking Style:** Flat and quiet, a machine-gunner who talks about his gun like a sick animal he is nursing.
**Combat Role:** a heavy machine-gunner; he holds a trench with sustained fire and moves the gun only when he must
**Relationship Hook:** A hollow-eyed gunner crouched behind a water-cooled machine gun in a red clay trench.
personality: Core: talks to his gun, not to people; never leaves the firing step if he can help it; keeps a tally he will not explain
Quirk: carries a letter that is not his

npcs.name: Kasimir Eichel
npcs.info:
Dublith's doctor, a white-haired, quick-moving man who has stitched the town's hooked hands, butchers' slips and summer fevers for thirty years from three rooms behind a brass plate near the market. He charges the bad side double and the fishermen half and sees no need to explain either.

**Speaking Style:** Quick and precise, an old doctor who hums while he works and stops humming when it matters.
**Combat Role:** none; a scalpel and a doctor's calm, and half the town would come if he shouted
**Relationship Hook:** A brisk white-haired doctor threading a needle over a wounded man who will not say who he is.
personality: Core: moves fast and talks faster; keeps a confidence like a locked box; charges by who you are
Quirk: hums opera while stitching

npcs.name: Kaspar Linn
npcs.info:
The forge boy who turns the grindstone, pumps the bellows and runs to the pit with sharpened picks. He is thirteen, too small for the screens and too clever for the grindstone, and he follows the smith about like a duckling.

**Speaking Style:** Eager and too loud, a boy who asks the next question before the last one is answered.
**Combat Role:** none; a grindstone crank and a fast pair of feet
**Relationship Hook:** A boy at a grindstone hiding his bandaged hands when the smith looks his way.
personality: Core: copies what he sees; worships the smith; hides his burns badly
Quirk: curious about everything

npcs.name: Kaspar Lumm
npcs.info:
The labour boss of the dig, a broad ex-corporal who hires drovers and refugees by the day and pays them out of a tin box. He wears a pith helmet with a bullet hole in it and tells a different story about the hole each week.

**Speaking Style:** Loud and short, a gang boss who gives orders in single words.
**Combat Role:** a brawler with a pick handle who gets the first blow in
**Relationship Hook:** A heavy man in a holed pith helmet blowing a whistle over a row of diggers.
personality: Core: loud and genial; hires anyone who can carry a barrow; tells tall tales
Quirk: gambles his pay

npcs.name: Kaspar Ollen
npcs.info:
One of the two signallers on top of the red mesa, a quiet young man who works the heliograph by day and has begun working it at night as well, by lantern, flashing into the dark at nothing the other man can see.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and dreamy, a signaller who speaks in short bursts like a message being flashed.
**Combat Role:** none; a signaller with a rifle he has never needed
**Relationship Hook:** A young signaller at the edge of a mesa at night, flashing a lantern into the dark.
personality: Core: dreamy and curious; flashes at the dark when he cannot sleep; logs the day's signals perfectly and the night's not at all
Quirk: talks to the hawks

npcs.name: Kaspar Teal
npcs.info:
A young clay-digger at the kilns north-west of town, red to the knees from the pit, who barrows clay up the planks all day and sings in a big flat voice that carries to the road. He has dug since he was thirteen and means to save enough to go to sea, though he has never seen one.

**Speaking Style:** Loose and loud, a young digger who sings flat and talks about the sea he has never seen.
**Combat Role:** a young labourer's brawl; a spade swung flat and a barrow tipped into a man's legs
**Relationship Hook:** A gangly clay-digger knee-deep in red mud, holding up a brass plate and for once not singing.
personality: Core: dreams of the sea; superstitious about bones; loyal to the other diggers before the owner
Quirk: sings flat and loud

npcs.name: Kasper Haugen
npcs.info:
A young man living in a dugout under a fallen pine deep in the wood, with an oil lamp, a pair of skis and a beard that is not yet a beard. He trades firewood with the charcoal burners and gives no name.

**Speaking Style:** Nervous and too quick, then pouring out everything at once to anyone he trusts.
**Combat Role:** a deserter with a carbine and a skier's speed; he shoots once and is gone among the pines
**Relationship Hook:** A gaunt young man with a patchy beard crouched by a fallen pine, carbine in his hands, listening.
personality: Core: jumps at every cracking branch; talks too much once he trusts someone; keeps his cut-off uniform buttons in a tin
Quirk: never lights the lamp until full dark

npcs.name: Ke Yuanshan
npcs.info:
The cousin who has run the Yao retainers' training since the hall's two best went west with the young lord. Ke Yuanshan is broad, loud and honest about his limits, and he drives the children harder for knowing he is no Fu.

**Speaking Style:** A drill-floor roar for the count and a near whisper for praise, nothing in between.
**Combat Role:** a Yao retainer with a broad sword and a fistful of kunai; heavier than the old master, he wins by pressing and never giving ground
**Relationship Hook:** A broad man with a mask pushed up on his brow, shouting the count while children spar on scarred boards.
personality: Core: shouts the count of a drill and whispers the praise; measures himself against an absent old man and always comes short; touches the empty pegs before he locks the hall at night
Quirk: eats with his students, never apart

npcs.name: Keeper Hollis
npcs.info:
The keeper of the boats on the shore of Kauroy Lake, who looks after the moorings and the fishing shelters and sends word to Dublith when strangers row out to the island. He is slow, wry and sensible, and he would rather be left alone with his lake and his dog.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and wry, a lake keeper who speaks to his dog more than to visitors.
**Combat Role:** none; an oar and a shotgun for foxes
**Relationship Hook:** A lake keeper on a jetty, watching a boat come in with a dog at his heel.
personality: Core: slow, wry and sensible; talks to his dog more than to visitors; sends word when strangers row out
Quirk: reads all the mail he carries

npcs.name: Kesh
npcs.info:
A mountain guide of the Creta village who leads traders and runners over the border passes in the snow and the dark. He is dry, sure and patient, and he knows every crack in the pass. He is neutral about the war and paid by whoever is walking.

**Speaking Style:** Dry and sure, a guide who talks about the mountain as if it were a stubborn horse.
**Combat Role:** none; a staff and a sure foot
**Relationship Hook:** A mountain guide on a snowy path, leading a line of travellers with a rope.
personality: Core: dry, sure and patient; talks about the mountain like a stubborn horse; neutral about the war
Quirk: paid by whoever walks

npcs.name: Kilian Reinsch
npcs.info:
A junior reporter on the capital's big daily, nineteen and hungry, who covers fires, fêtes and railway timetables and dreams of a front page. He chases ambulances on a bicycle and talks his way past any doorman who is tired enough. The older men in the newsroom find him tiresome and secretly admire his nerve.

**Speaking Style:** Fast and eager, a young reporter whose sentences trip over each other when he is excited.
**Combat Role:** none; a quick young man on a bicycle who runs before anyone can catch him
**Relationship Hook:** A gangly young reporter scribbling in a notebook at a newsroom desk while a proof sheet with a red line through it hangs from his typewriter.
personality: Core: eager, nosy and brave; always carries two pencils; cannot leave a locked door alone
Quirk: believes the truth gets printed in the end

npcs.name: King Bradley
npcs.info:
King Bradley, the Führer of Amestris, fifty-nine, who has ruled for twenty years and sent the army into one war after another. He is an older man with an extraordinary physique, slicked black hair, a black moustache and an eyepatch over his left eye, and he is the finest swordsman in the country. In public he is affable, informal with soldiers and fond of his wife and son; his enemies tend to die.

**Speaking Style:** A deep, courteous voice that is often warm and even playful with subordinates; when it goes quiet, someone dies.
**Combat Role:** five sabres and an eye that sees every move, a swordsman fast enough to cut bullets
**Relationship Hook:** An eyepatched Führer stepping off a train with a sabre at his side, smiling at a frightened lieutenant.
personality: Core: courteous and informal with soldiers; fond of his wife; speaks softly when most dangerous
Quirk: enjoys a worthy opponent

npcs.name: Kiri
npcs.info:
A little girl of the Nameless Village, the hamlet the maps leave blank, who is fond of the kindly village doctor, Dr. Mauro, and brings him flowers for his clinic.

**Speaking Style:** Small, bright and shy, a girl's voice that goes very quiet when she is frightened.
**Combat Role:** none
**Relationship Hook:** A little girl at a clinic door with a bunch of wildflowers.
personality: Core: bright and affectionate; shy with strangers; brave for a moment when it counts
Quirk: brings the doctor flowers

npcs.name: Kit Varley
npcs.info:
A barefoot girl of fourteen who runs the tin roofs of Rush Valley faster than anyone but Paninya, and lifts purses on the main streets for a living. She knows every chimney, every loose sheet and every plank over the gaps, and she sleeps in an attic whose window opens straight onto the roofs.

**Speaking Style:** Breathless and cheeky, a street girl who talks in a rush between jumps and never admits she is out of breath.
**Combat Role:** a runner, not a fighter; she leaps a gap a pursuer cannot and kicks a loose sheet into his face
**Relationship Hook:** A barefoot girl leaping a two-storey gap between tin roofs with a stolen wallet in her teeth.
personality: Core: never walks where she can climb; pays her debts in stolen sweets; envies Paninya's legs and would never say so
Quirk: guilty about one thing and brazen about everything else

npcs.name: Klara Faber
npcs.info:
