A young baker's wife who keeps the shop front of a bakery three doors down from the oldest oven, wrapping loaves for a queue that never seems to end. She married into the street last spring and is still learning who gets credit and who does not.

**Speaking Style:** Gentle and a little breathless, a young baker's wife who apologises to customers for the weather.
**Combat Role:** none; a bread knife she would never use and a crowd of regulars who would
**Relationship Hook:** A young baker's wife in a steamy shop window, arms full of rye loaves, smiling at a queue in the cold.
personality: Core: cannot refuse a child; remembers every face in the queue; laughs when she is nervous
Quirk: gentle and anxious

npcs.name: Klara Orth
npcs.info:
A young woman from Reole who walked out across the edge of the desert to ask the mission preacher to come home. She believes in the sun god still, the scandal notwithstanding, and she believes in Clemens Kern more.

**Speaking Style:** Bright and earnest, a believer who speaks as if every sentence were a hymn.
**Combat Role:** none; a pilgrim who prays and hopes
**Relationship Hook:** A young believer in a dusty white robe sitting on a chapel bench with a sun-disc pendant in her hands.
personality: Core: earnest and hopeful; sings while she works; believes the best of people
Quirk: out of money

npcs.name: Klara Stein
npcs.info:
A lieutenant of engineers sent out with a survey party to see whether the Fotset rail bridge can be rebuilt. She is twenty-five, brilliant, sunburnt and cheerful, with a notebook full of loads and stresses. She has never seen a battle and is too busy measuring to worry.

**Speaking Style:** Bright and quick, a young engineer's voice that turns everything into a problem to be solved.
**Combat Role:** a pistol she has fired only on the range; she relies on her escort
**Relationship Hook:** A young engineer leaning out over the twisted end of a broken rail bridge, measuring tape in hand.
personality: Core: turns everything into a problem; fearless out of inexperience
Quirk: brilliant and cheerful

npcs.name: Klara Wenzl
npcs.info:
A teacher at the red-brick grammar school, twenty-six, who teaches sums, letters and the history of Amestris to the children of clerks and soldiers. She studied alchemy for two years before her father's death sent her to work, and she still draws circles in the margins of her lesson plans. The children adore her; the headmistress watches her.

**Speaking Style:** Bright and encouraging, a teacher's voice that makes a wrong answer sound like a good start.
**Combat Role:** a novice alchemist; she draws a quick circle in chalk and throws up a wall of brick from the schoolyard
**Relationship Hook:** A young teacher kneeling beside a child's desk, drawing a small circle on a slate while the class leans in.
personality: Core: warm, curious and stubborn; believes alchemy belongs to everyone; blames herself for the burned hand
Quirk: draws circles without noticing

npcs.name: Konstantin Harr
npcs.info:
The owner of the Northbank Sawmill, a big cheerful man who buys logs from every cutter in the north and saws them into planks. He is generous with drinks and very vague about paperwork.

**Speaking Style:** Bluff and easy, a sawmill owner who laughs off every question as a joke between friends.
**Combat Role:** none; a cant hook and a mill full of saws
**Relationship Hook:** A burly sawmill owner on a frozen river bank, hook in hand, laughing at a jam of logs under the bridge.
personality: Core: bluff and generous; laughs off questions; vague about paperwork
Quirk: loves his mill above everything

npcs.name: Konstantin Reiff
npcs.info:
The State Alchemist of the survey party, a big cheerful major who specialises in land and stone and spends most of his days freeing his motor car from the sand. He shifts dunes with a clap of a circle and swears when they shift back.

**Speaking Style:** Heavy and amused, a big man who laughs at his own misfortunes and at no one else's.
**Combat Role:** a State Alchemist of earth and stone who throws up walls and opens pits under the enemy
**Relationship Hook:** A burly officer in goggles clapping his hands over a chalk circle beside a motor car buried in sand.
personality: Core: jovial and shrewd; loves his motor car; asks one question too many
Quirk: kind to the privates

npcs.name: Konstantin Ruhl
npcs.info:
The collier who speaks for the colliery men is a broad, coal-scarred hewer of forty who has worked the seam since he was ten. He led them out when the props came down and has stood at the pithead every morning since to keep them out.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and heavy, a collier's speech, every word dug out and set down hard.
**Combat Role:** a collier's pick and a hewer's strength; he fights in close, in the dark if he can
**Relationship Hook:** A broad coal-scarred miner with a safety lamp standing at a pithead between soldiers and his men.
personality: Core: speaks rarely and for everyone; has never crossed a picket; keeps his temper on a short chain
Quirk: trusts his own men and no one above ground

npcs.name: Kord Vogtland
npcs.info:
The dairyman of the east lane, a weathered widower who milks forty ewes twice a day and makes a hard, salty cheese that keeps a year and sells in the city. He is patient, unhurried and proud of his daughter in ways he never says aloud. His back is going and he hides it.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and gentle, a dairyman who chooses his words the way he chooses a ewe, carefully.
**Combat Role:** none; a milking stool and a farmer's grip
**Relationship Hook:** A grey-bearded dairyman pausing at the milking stand, one hand pressed to the small of his back.
personality: Core: slow and gentle; proud of his cheese and prouder of his girl; hides pain the way a sheep does
Quirk: says what needs doing, never what he feels

npcs.name: Kuai Lianhu
npcs.info:
Chief of the red-banner bandits, a lean man in a red sash who sits on the lookout rock above the western road and decides which caravans reach the sand. He is polite to his captives, generous with his men, and has never been taken.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and amused, a bandit's voice that sounds most dangerous when it is most polite.
**Combat Role:** a bandit master with twin hook swords and a horse; he strikes from the ravine walls and is gone before the dust settles
**Relationship Hook:** A bandit in a red sash sitting easy on a high rock, watching a distant caravan with a faint smile.
personality: Core: polite to captives; generous to his men; keeps every letter his paymaster sends
Quirk: watches the road from the rock for hours without moving

npcs.name: Kunigunde Rademacher
npcs.info:
A widow who keeps four long glasshouses on the river flats and takes her cart into the eastern market before light every day but the rest day. She is plump, slow-moving and stronger than she looks, and her cucumbers are the first in the city every spring. She talks to her plants and claims they answer.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and comfortable, a gardener who talks to tomatoes and customers in the same tone.
**Combat Role:** none; a hoe and a voice that carries over the cabbage rows
**Relationship Hook:** A plump gardener in a straw hat setting a loaf of bread on a bench in a glasshouse.
personality: Core: kind and unhurried; talks to plants
Quirk: feeds anything hungry that crosses her path

npcs.name: Kuno Ashby
npcs.info:
A loud ten-year-old who claims the best seat on the fallen log every time the Elric brothers come home, and narrates their sparring to the smaller children with sound effects. Between visits he picks fights of his own on the bare circles and loses most of them. He means to be a State Alchemist, a soldier or a sheep thief, depending on the day.

**Speaking Style:** Loud and boastful, a boy who narrates every fight as if he were in it.
**Combat Role:** wild swings and a kick he copied from Edward Elric, badly
**Relationship Hook:** A gap-toothed boy on a fallen log mimicking a punch for an audience of smaller children.
personality: Core: loud and boastful; narrates fights with sound effects; loses fights and starts new ones
Quirk: cannot keep a secret for an hour

npcs.name: Kuno Flick
npcs.info:
A one-time army carter turned smuggler who runs goods out of Youswell through the old drift and past the checkpoint: coal sold off the books, the widows' cheeses, letters the post office would burn. He is likeable, unreliable and always paid in advance.

**Speaking Style:** Friendly and oily, a smuggler who calls everyone 'friend' a moment before naming his price.
**Combat Role:** a short cudgel and a carter's dirty tricks, then a fast retreat
**Relationship Hook:** A grinning smuggler leading a laden mule into a black tunnel mouth by lantern light.
personality: Core: charming and slippery; never carries a weapon openly; loyal only to his mule
Quirk: works for both sides

npcs.name: Kunz Abeling
npcs.info:
The range warden, a grey sergeant with one ear deafened by thirty years of rifle fire, who runs the seasonal qualifications and the shooting hut with complete authority. He can tell a man's breathing from his first group on the paper and fix it in an afternoon. He pinned Hawkeye's scores up in the hut himself and dares any officer to beat them.

**Speaking Style:** Low and wry, a range warden who says 'again' instead of 'good' and 'good' about once a year.
**Combat Role:** a master rifleman; he shoots from cover at long range, moves once, and shoots again before the first man has found him
**Relationship Hook:** A grey sergeant kneeling on a sandbagged mat, squinting downrange at a far target through field glasses.
personality: Core: sparing with praise and lavish with corrections; listens with his good ear turned toward you; talks to rifles as though they were horses
Quirk: keeps the night-shooters' secret without being asked to

npcs.name: Kuo Han
npcs.info:
The senior soldier of the rammed-earth well tower, a scarred veteran who keeps the banner up and the well clean though nobody has paid him in a year. He sells water to anyone who passes and asks for food in return.

**Speaking Style:** Gruff and weary, an old sergeant who talks like he is reading out a list of complaints.
**Combat Role:** a Xingese spearman who holds the gate and calls his men into line
**Relationship Hook:** A scarred Xingese soldier in faded red armour standing beside a well sweep under a tattered banner.
personality: Core: dutiful and bitter; keeps the banner flying; shares his food with his men first
Quirk: proud and hungry

npcs.name: Kyle Halling
npcs.info:
The young son of Mr. Halling, a brash boy who runs errands at the mine and works in his father's tavern, steering rich travellers there as walking piggy banks. He is well loved in town, hates the army and its State Alchemists, and saves most of his hatred for Lieutenant Yoki.

**Speaking Style:** Brash and quick, a boy who talks back before he thinks and calls rich travellers piggy banks.
**Combat Role:** none; a runner who ducks through the crowds
**Relationship Hook:** A boy steering two travellers toward his father's tavern, grinning at what they will pay.
personality: Core: brash and quick; hates Yoki; loyal to the town
Quirk: calls rich travellers piggy banks

npcs.name: Lambert Grell
npcs.info:
The sexton of South City Cathedral, a bent man of sixty who has rung, swept and locked the great church for thirty years. He lights the candles before dawn, keeps the burial register in a fair round hand and knows which pew every old family sits in. Visitors take him for a sleepy caretaker. Soldiers' widows know better: he is the one who tells them when the next coffins are due in from the station.

**Speaking Style:** Low and unhurried, a churchman's murmur that drops further whenever a coffin is in the nave.
**Combat Role:** none; a heavy ring of church keys and the dark of a building he knows blind
**Relationship Hook:** An old sexton lighting candles beside a row of trestles in a dim stone nave.
personality: Core: unhurried in everything, even grief; kinder to the mourners than to the clergy; distrusts anyone in a clean uniform
Quirk: counts under his breath while he works

npcs.name: Lambrecht Brenner
npcs.info:
The farmer whose house the lieutenant's men burned for rent, believed by the town to have gone west with his family. He sent the family to his wife's people and stayed. He lives in his root cellar, eats what he can snare and watches the road.

**Speaking Style:** Low and harsh, a voice that has spoken to nobody for months and has forgotten how to be polite.
**Combat Role:** a farmer's shotgun and an ambusher's patience
**Relationship Hook:** A gaunt farmer crouched at a hidden cellar door among weeds, watching the road over the barrels of a shotgun.
personality: Core: bitter and watchful; half wild; tender about his children
Quirk: remembers every face from the night of the fire

npcs.name: Lambrecht Tilney
npcs.info:
Resembool's stationmaster, a neat grey man in a railway cap who has met every train into the town for twenty-two years and still checks his watch against the engine's whistle. He was on the platform the morning of the bombing in 1907 and came away with a ringing in one ear that has never stopped. He keeps the waiting room swept, the timetable brass polished and a bucket of sand by every door for reasons he will not discuss.

**Speaking Style:** Precise and a little pompous, a stationmaster who announces the time as if it were news.
**Combat Role:** none; a heavy brass signal lamp and the authority of the platform whistle
**Relationship Hook:** A stationmaster holding his watch up to an arriving engine, one hand cupped behind his ear.
personality: Core: fussy about minutes, forgiving about everything else; proud of the station, prouder of its clock; jumps at a slammed door and pretends he did not
Quirk: taps his deaf ear when he does not want to hear a question

npcs.name: Lan Fan
npcs.info:
A young bodyguard of the Yao clan, Fu's granddaughter and Ling's personal guard. On duty she wears a red and white mask with half of the yin-yang sign and fights in black with kunai and grenades; off it she is shy in front of her prince. She is fiercely loyal and hot-tempered, and she can sense the chi of anyone nearby.

**Speaking Style:** Cool, clipped and quiet behind a mask; insult her prince and the calm snaps into fury.
**Combat Role:** Xingese martial arts with kunai and flash grenades, fast, masked and silent
**Relationship Hook:** A masked girl in black dropping from a roof between her prince and a stranger.
personality: Core: cold and efficient behind the mask; shy without the mask; would give her life for her prince
Quirk: flies into a rage when Ling is insulted

npcs.name: Lanz Ebert
npcs.info:
The corporal at the road barrier, a cheerful, idle man who stamps passes, pockets fees and searches carts with more interest in the cargo than the law. He knows every carter by name and every coach by its timetable.

**Speaking Style:** Lazy and pleased with himself, a corporal who stamps papers like he is dealing cards.
**Combat Role:** a rifle he leans on more than fires, and the striped pole
**Relationship Hook:** A paunchy corporal frozen with his stamp in the air as an officer steps down from a coach.
personality: Core: idle and greedy; jovial with carters; knows the barrier is not lawful
Quirk: panics under real authority

npcs.name: Lao Pingshan
npcs.info:
The keeper and cook of the inn on the far side of the sand, a round man with flour to the elbows whose noodles are famous on both sides of the desert. He gives a bed and a bowl to anyone who reaches him, and he talks while he cooks.

**Speaking Style:** Warm and teasing, a cook who feeds a guest before he asks a single question.
**Combat Role:** a cook with a cleaver and a ladle, faster than his belly suggests
**Relationship Hook:** A round cook pulling long noodles over a steaming pot in a low wooden inn.
personality: Core: generous and nosy; feeds before he asks; sings over the noodle pot
Quirk: never writes his notes in front of a guest

npcs.name: Lars Odegaard
npcs.info:
The senior private on the bridge guard is a quiet northerner who has checked carts on the road deck for three years and found nothing worse than a crate of contraband plums. He likes the bridge, the river and the long silences between trains.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and sparing, a sentry who answers in single words and seems to weigh each one first.
**Combat Role:** a rifleman who fights from the girders; patient, a single aimed shot and a long silence
**Relationship Hook:** A tall pale sentry with a rifle under iron girders, a train thundering across the bridge above him.
personality: Core: says as little as possible; likes the river more than most people; notices small things and keeps them to himself
Quirk: honest to the bone and wary of what honesty costs

npcs.name: Lasse Ebbe
npcs.info:
The driver of the plough engine, who sleeps on a cot in the plough shed so that his engine is never more than a minute from steam. He has cleared the line to the railhead every winter for fifteen years.

**Speaking Style:** Gruff and wry, talking about snow the way old sailors talk about the sea.
**Combat Role:** a railwayman with a coal shovel and the weight of an engine behind him
**Relationship Hook:** A soot-faced driver leaning out of the cab of a steaming plough engine, peering up the line.
personality: Core: sleeps in his overalls; speaks of snow as a living thing; pats the boiler like a horse's neck
Quirk: argues with railway clerks by letter

npcs.name: Layla Nasrallah
npcs.info:
A young woman whose family has climbed the same three palms in the old stand for five generations. She goes up barefoot with a basket on her back and a rope around the trunk, faster than any man in the grove.

**Speaking Style:** Calm and certain, a farmer's daughter who never argues twice about the same thing.
**Combat Role:** none; she goes up a palm where nobody can follow
**Relationship Hook:** A barefoot young woman halfway up a date palm with a basket on her back.
personality: Core: patient and proud; climbs before dawn when the trunks are cool; keeps the paper sewn in her sash
Quirk: shares the first dates with the gravedigger

npcs.name: Leberecht Dunkel
npcs.info:
The gatekeeper of the military cemetery, a one-legged veteran on a wooden peg who lives in the lodge by the gate, keeps the burial book on its lectern and rakes the gravel walk every morning. He lost his leg on the eastern front and was given the lodge instead of a pension. He talks to the dead more easily than to the living.

**Speaking Style:** Short and slow, an old gatekeeper who answers in as few words as the question allows.
**Combat Role:** none; a crutch, a peg leg and a lodge door that bolts
**Relationship Hook:** A one-legged old gatekeeper leaning on a rake at the end of a long row of white headstones.
personality: Core: silent and patient; keeps the gravel perfect
Quirk: salutes the Ishval rows every dawn

npcs.name: Lei Datong
npcs.info:
Master smith of the lane, a barrel-chested man who balances each finished knife on one finger before he lets it go. His mark at the base of a blade is a small lightning stroke, and alkahestrists of a dozen clans buy their circle knives from nobody else.

**Speaking Style:** A hammer-bench growl, loud from years of shouting over anvils.
**Combat Role:** a smith with a hammer and a rack of his own knives; strong arms, a straight throw and no grace
**Relationship Hook:** A barrel-chested smith balancing a finished throwing knife on one fingertip in the steam of a quench trough.
personality: Core: balances every knife on one finger; shouts over an anvil even where there is none; proud of his mark above all else
Quirk: slow to anger and slower to forgive

npcs.name: Leif Ancker
npcs.info:
A Briggs corporal sent down to the depot to count the fort's crates against the fort's own list. He is polite, patient and impossible to hurry, and the depot men have already learned to hate him.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and level, a corporal who asks politely and does not move until he has his answer.
**Combat Role:** a Briggs rifleman with a short carbine; he fights from cover and patiently, like the fort fights
**Relationship Hook:** A quiet Briggs corporal sitting on a stack of tarpaulin crates with a clipboard, counting.
personality: Core: quiet and polite; counts twice and writes once; impossible to hurry
Quirk: eats alone on the tarpaulin stacks

npcs.name: Lem
npcs.info:
A canal boatman who carries cargo and passengers along the Main Canal in East City, through the ward's locks and under its footbridges. He knows every lock and every shortcut under the city, and he will take anyone who pays. He is sardonic and quick, and he watches the soldiers on the bridges.

**Speaking Style:** Easy and sardonic, a boatman who talks about the weather and means the city.
**Combat Role:** none; a boathook and a strong back
**Relationship Hook:** A boatman poling a flat barge under a footbridge while a soldier watches from above.
personality: Core: sardonic and quick; knows every lock and shortcut; watches the bridges for soldiers
Quirk: will carry anything for the right fare

npcs.name: Lenard Hollweg
npcs.info:
A young corporal discharged from the eastern garrison with his right arm gone below the elbow and the sleeve pinned across his chest. He came off the evening train with a kitbag, his discharge papers and a scrap of paper with one name on it, and he has been asking the taproom whether anybody in this town truly builds limbs. He is polite, careful and very tired.

**Speaking Style:** Polite and careful, a young ex-soldier who keeps his voice as level as his pinned sleeve.
**Combat Role:** a soldier's left-handed pistol shooting, slow and steady
**Relationship Hook:** A young ex-soldier with a pinned sleeve smoothing out a scrap of paper on his knee.
personality: Core: polite to a fault; counts his money every night; hopes too hard and is ashamed of it
Quirk: hides the empty sleeve when children stare

npcs.name: Lene Dorn
npcs.info:
A filling-shed girl of nineteen, one of the ones the town calls canaries for the yellow the powder stains into their skin. She is quick, cheeky and saving for a sewing machine. She has been sent home sick and has come back to the gate to argue for her job.

**Speaking Style:** Quick and cheeky, a factory girl who laughs most when she is frightened.
**Combat Role:** none; she can kick and she can run
**Relationship Hook:** A slight factory girl with yellowed skin arguing with a gatekeeper at an iron works gate.
personality: Core: cheeky and quick; saving every coin for a sewing machine
Quirk: laughs when she is frightened

npcs.name: Lene Hartigan
npcs.info:
A fisherman's widow from Dublith who rows out to Heron Islet each evening at low water with a spade and a lantern, and digs. She says she is after bait worms. Her boat is old and leaks; her spade is new.

**Speaking Style:** Low and guarded, a widow who gives short answers and watches your hands while she gives them.
**Combat Role:** none; a spade, and the soft mud that swallows a pursuer to the knee
**Relationship Hook:** A widow knee-deep in grey mud at dusk, digging beside a black boat rib while herons watch.
personality: Core: rows alone and prefers it; keeps the family story like a will; shy of company and fierce if crowded
Quirk: says worms when she means anything else

npcs.name: Lennart Brandvold
npcs.info:
The senior telegraphist of the fort, a quiet man with nicotine-yellow fingers and a habit of tapping out messages on the table while he talks. Every wire from Central passes under his hand before it reaches the keep, and the general chose him for that herself.

**Speaking Style:** Low and tired, broken by small pauses where his finger taps out what he is not saying.
**Combat Role:** an operator with a desk revolver and a headset cord; he cuts the line before he loses it
**Relationship Hook:** A tired sergeant with his eyes shut at a telegraph bench, one finger tapping in time with a sounder.
personality: Core: taps out words on any table he sits at; smokes in a room where smoking is forbidden, and nobody stops him; listens with his eyes closed
Quirk: never repeats a message aloud

npcs.name: Lenore Thurnau
npcs.info:
A private of nineteen seconded to the colonel's staff as typist, filing clerk and runner, which mostly means she carries papers from Hawkeye's desk to the colonel's and back again. She types faster than anyone in the building and has learned that forms marked urgent can wait until the end of the week. Black Hayate sleeps under her chair.

**Speaking Style:** Bright and quick, a typist who says 'right' at the start of every sentence and means it as a promise.
**Combat Role:** none worth naming; basic rifle drill from her training and a typewriter she could probably throw
**Relationship Hook:** A young typist in uniform rattling at a typewriter while a small black-and-white dog snores at her feet.
personality: Core: cheerful and tireless; thinks Lieutenant Havoc is wonderful and is embarrassed by it; keeps her desk tidier than the colonel's
Quirk: notices patterns and cannot leave one alone

npcs.name: Lenz Obermann
npcs.info:
A cadet of eighteen, top of his class in map work and bottom in discipline, who talks his way out of more punishment than any cadet in the school's memory. He is the one who issued the dare, and his bunk is the only one not slept in.

**Speaking Style:** Bright and eager, a cadet who talks quickly and grins at his own daring.
**Combat Role:** a cadet's rifle and bayonet drill, crisp on the range and untested in earnest
**Relationship Hook:** A dark-haired cadet sitting on a neatly made iron cot, boots by his feet, looking towards the window.
personality: Core: charming and too quick; brave about everything except owning up; treats the commandant as a hero
Quirk: writes poetry he hides in his boots

npcs.name: Leonhard Esch
npcs.info:
A wine merchant who rents the old weighing hall as his warehouse, the third of his family to deal in southern wines. He is courteous, generous and well liked, and he never says a hard word about Aerugo, which some of his neighbours hold against him.

**Speaking Style:** Warm and persuasive, a merchant whose voice makes a bad deal sound like a fair one.
**Combat Role:** none; a merchant with a cart and a good story
**Relationship Hook:** A well-dressed merchant rolling a wine barrel across a stone weighing hall.
personality: Core: courteous and generous; never says a hard word about Aerugo
Quirk: brave in a quiet, foolish way

npcs.name: Leonhard Lattermann
npcs.info:
A market gardener of sixty with a walled plot south of the last tram stop, who grows leeks, cabbages and the best early radishes on Market Row. He is a widower with no children of his own, gentle, slow-moving and very good at being underestimated.

**Speaking Style:** Kindly and slow, a gardener who answers questions with questions about the weather.
**Combat Role:** none; an old gardener with a hoe and a long memory for faces
**Relationship Hook:** An old gardener leaning on his hoe beside a scarecrow in an army coat, smiling vaguely at two soldiers at the gate.
personality: Core: gentle, slow and shrewd; plays the fool for strangers; loves his nephew like a son
Quirk: talks to his plants when he is worried

npcs.name: Leopold Fink
npcs.info:
The keeper of East City's clock tower, an old clockmaker who winds the great clock every morning and oils its gears every week. From the top of his tower he can see the whole city and the road east, and he notices what changes. He is precise, private and very proud of the clock.

**Speaking Style:** Precise and dry, a clockmaker who measures his words like seconds.
**Combat Role:** none; an old man with a heavy winding key
**Relationship Hook:** An old clockmaker winding a great clock high above a city square.
personality: Core: precise and private; proud of the clock; watches the city from above
Quirk: keeps a log of everything

npcs.name: Leopold Harn
npcs.info:
A retired army surgeon who runs the dispensary with the red cross on its door: bones, boils, burns and lungs. He served in field hospitals in the west and in the east, and he chose Youswell because he wanted somewhere no one would salute him. Miners trust him because he never lies about a cough.

**Speaking Style:** Dry and weary, an old surgeon who makes jokes at the worst moments, gently.
**Combat Role:** a field surgeon's steadiness and a scalpel he would rather not use
**Relationship Hook:** An old surgeon listening to a miner's chest with a stethoscope and saying nothing for a long time.
personality: Core: never lies about a diagnosis; refuses to be saluted; drinks one glass a night, exactly
Quirk: dry humour at bad moments

npcs.name: Leopold Vantreck
npcs.info:
The doctor of the Rush Valley Nerve Clinic, a tall, stooped man from Central City who came south to study automail ports for a year and has stayed nine. He joins nerve to metal with a patience the engineers lack, sits with patients through the worst nights of a fitting and keeps a chart of every port he has set, with its date and its maker.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and level, a doctor who gets quieter the angrier he is and never once promises a date.
**Combat Role:** none; a surgeon's steady hands and a bottle of ether he will use on anyone who threatens his ward
**Relationship Hook:** A stooped doctor sitting on the edge of an iron bed, holding a crying boy's steel ankle still.
personality: Core: speaks more slowly the angrier he gets; keeps a chart of everything; never promises a patient a date
Quirk: sits up with the frightened ones himself

npcs.name: Leyla Omari
npcs.info:
The refugee band's midwife and healer, a round-faced woman in her thirties who sits at Shan's right hand under the awning and keeps the camp's few medicines in a leather case. She has delivered every child born in the ruins.

**Speaking Style:** Warm and brisk, a midwife's voice that soothes and gives orders in the same breath.
**Combat Role:** none; she stays with the hurt and lets others fight
**Relationship Hook:** A round-faced Ishvalan woman opening a leather medicine case under a canvas awning.
personality: Core: brisk and kind; loyal to Shan without bowing to her; keeps count of every birth and death
Quirk: scolds anyone who wastes water

npcs.name: Liam Roach
npcs.info:
Liam Roach, a young soldier of Fort Briggs serving under Major Miles, one of the many hard men of the north and eager to prove himself one. He is a good shot and a dependable comrade.

**Speaking Style:** Young and eager, a quick voice that tries to sound tougher than it is.
**Combat Role:** a rifle and a Briggs soldier's endurance
**Relationship Hook:** A young soldier in a heavy coat walking a girl to the station, rifle ready.
personality: Core: eager and earnest; tries to sound tough; dependable
Quirk: protective of anyone put in his charge

npcs.name: Liang Haibo
npcs.info:
The harbour master of the sea road, an ex-sailor who has climbed his tower every dawn for fifteen years to look at the harbour mouth through a brass spyglass. He passes every junk out and in with the signal gong, and he reads every clan pass twice, once with each eye.

**Speaking Style:** Full and easy, a seaman's voice made for calling across water, softened for the land.
**Combat Role:** an old sailor with a boarding hook and a short sword; he fights on stairs and gangways and knows how to put a man in the water
**Relationship Hook:** A harbour master lowering his spyglass at the top of a square tower, a signal gong at his elbow.
personality: Core: climbs the tower every dawn without fail; talks about the sea as if it were a difficult relative; looks away kindly and on purpose
Quirk: keeps a spyglass more polished than his boots

npcs.name: Liesl Amberg
npcs.info:
The senior operator who supervises the switchboard floor, a precise woman of forty with perfect posture and a headset she rarely takes off. She trained half the girls on the floor and can tell which of them is on which line by the sound of the plug going in.

**Speaking Style:** Clear and even, the trained voice of a switchboard supervisor; she says 'connecting you' as if it were a kindness.
**Combat Role:** none; she would sooner pull a plug on a line than lift a hand, and a hatpin is her only weapon
**Relationship Hook:** A composed woman in a headset sitting very straight before a switchboard of plugs and cords.
personality: Core: composed in every crisis; corrects grammar without thinking; notices everything and remarks on nothing
Quirk: keeps her shorthand notebook in her stocking

npcs.name: Liesl Dorn
npcs.info:
The owner of the Kettle and Stove Café, a round, cheerful woman who lets clerks and junior officers sit all afternoon over one coffee because a full room keeps the heat in. She knows how everyone takes their cup and who they came in with.

**Speaking Style:** Cosy and teasing, a café keeper who calls everyone 'dear' and means it about half the time.
**Combat Role:** none; a coffee pot of boiling water and a broom she swings like a halberd
**Relationship Hook:** A round café keeper pouring coffee for a clerk while watching two officers by the window.
personality: Core: cheerful, teasing, shrewd; remembers every customer's cup; keeps the stove roaring whatever coal costs
Quirk: has a soft heart for underfed clerks

npcs.name: Liesl Grau
npcs.info:
The youngest widow in the yard, married eight months before the cage cable snapped. She pegs out the shirts and sings while she does it, and the older women love her and worry about her in equal parts.

**Speaking Style:** Light and nervous, a young widow who laughs when she is frightened.
**Combat Role:** none; she would only cry and then fight like a cat
**Relationship Hook:** A young widow pegging out shirts with her back carefully turned to the copper yard.
personality: Core: sings at the lines; too proud to ask for help
Quirk: laughs when frightened

npcs.name: Lina Saffi
npcs.info:
An Ishvalan refugee in the Asbec slum outside Fort Briggs, a seamstress who sews clothes for the refugee families and takes in children whose parents did not come back from the war. She is quiet, tough and proud, and she teaches the children the old prayers in secret.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and tough, a woman who speaks softly and sharp when someone insults her people.
**Combat Role:** none; a sewing needle and a hard stare
**Relationship Hook:** A seamstress in a refugee slum sewing a child's coat by a fire.
personality: Core: quiet, tough and proud; sews for the refugee families; takes in children without parents
Quirk: teaches the old prayers in secret

npcs.name: Ling Yao
npcs.info:
The twelfth prince of Xing, fifteen, heir of the Yao clan and one of the Emperor's many sons competing for the throne. He is cheerful, shameless about cadging a meal, and far sharper than his narrow, smiling eyes suggest. He means to cross the great desert to Amestris and bring home the secret of immortality, because the son who brings it will be named heir. Two bodyguards follow him everywhere.

**Speaking Style:** Bright, cheeky and easy, a smiling drawl that turns cold and steady when he is serious; he begs for food without shame.
**Combat Role:** a Xingese martial artist with a dao, fast and acrobatic, who senses chi and knows where a foe is before he moves
**Relationship Hook:** A smiling prince collapsing in the street from hunger and asking a stranger for lunch.
personality: Core: far cleverer than he looks; carries his clan's weight without complaint; gives up anything but his people
Quirk: cheerful, shameless and hungry

npcs.name: Lisbet Corran
npcs.info:
The postmistress's niece, seventeen, who minds the telephone nook and the switchboard while her aunt is at the counter. She means to be an operator on the exchange in East City, where girls sit in rows with headsets and a hundred lines, and she practises her telephone voice on the farmers who come in to ring the wool buyers.

**Speaking Style:** Quick and bright, a girl on the switchboard who says number please even off duty.
**Combat Role:** none; she would pull the plug on the line and run
**Relationship Hook:** A freckled girl with a telephone earpiece to her ear, frowning at what she has just heard.
personality: Core: bright and eager; loyal to her aunt and growing suspicious of her; taps out the time on the switchboard
Quirk: practises a city accent under her breath

npcs.name: Liv Tormey
npcs.info:
A miner's daughter of sixteen who stayed behind when Baschool emptied and lives by scavenging copper wire and tools from the dead galleries. She knows the maze under the town better than the company's own maps and chalks her marks as she goes.

**Speaking Style:** Quick and cheeky, laughing in the dark to prove she is not afraid of it.
**Combat Role:** a scavenger who never stands to fight; a pick handle, a blown-out lamp, and a crawl through a gap no grown man fits
**Relationship Hook:** A small coal-smudged girl chalking an arrow on a tunnel wall by the light of her helmet lamp.
personality: Core: chalks a mark on every wall she passes; laughs in the dark to show she is not afraid; trades before she trusts
Quirk: talks to her dead father in the tunnels

npcs.name: Logue Lowe
npcs.info:
The Grand Cleric of Ishval, spiritual leader of the faith of Ishvala and a man his people hold to be the god's prophet. When the war began he went into hiding in the wilderness to keep the faith's structure alive. He is wise, grave and grieving, and he has watched the army take his people's towns one by one.

**Speaking Style:** Deep, grave and patient, a holy man who speaks in measured lines and prophesies without anger.
**Combat Role:** none; a prophet's word and his people's faith
**Relationship Hook:** An old cleric in white walking out of the desert toward the army's lines, hands empty.
personality: Core: grave and patient; prays before every decision; prophesies without hatred
Quirk: will trade his own life for his people's

npcs.name: Lorens Kvist
npcs.info:
The private who keeps the garrison graveyard: he burns the names into the wooden markers, guards the ice house where the winter dead wait for the thaw, and plays the bugle at the summer burials. Slow, gentle and untroubled by the cold company.

**Speaking Style:** Gentle and slow, the voice of a man who talks to the dead and finds them good company.
**Combat Role:** a gentle soldier who fights only to hold the ice house door; a rifle butt and his whole weight
**Relationship Hook:** A gangly private burning a name into a wooden marker with a hot iron, breath steaming in the snow.
personality: Core: speaks to the dead by name as he passes; polishes the bugle every evening; burns each name with the same care
Quirk: never hurries anything

npcs.name: Lorenz Abt
npcs.info:
A records lieutenant up from the capital, who arrived with a single trunk and has not unpacked it. He is polite, tired and very hard to draw into conversation, and he goes out each morning to stand at the station and watch the southbound train leave without him.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and exact, a few words at a time with a long pause before the important one.
**Combat Role:** a clerk with a service pistol he cleans more than he fires; he takes cover first and shoots second
**Relationship Hook:** A tired officer sitting on a packed trunk in a cold room, a pen above a letter he will not finish.
personality: Core: courteous and closed; writes letters he never sends; flinches at a telephone bell
Quirk: watches doors

npcs.name: Lorenz Haverkamp
npcs.info:
The miller at the head of the river that drains the lake, a big floury man with a booming laugh who grinds grain for Dublith and every farm round the water. He talks over the thunder of the stones without raising his voice, keeps a cat for every corner of the mill and is famous for giving credit to nobody.

**Speaking Style:** Booming and jovial, a miller who laughs loudest when he is lying.
**Combat Role:** a strong man's brawl; a flour sack swung like a club and a grip that lifts a man off the floor
**Relationship Hook:** A big floury miller laughing over the thunder of the millstones with a sack on his shoulder.
personality: Core: refuses credit to everyone, friends first; names his cats after customers who owe him; never lets anyone into the wheelhouse alone
Quirk: laughs loudest when lying

npcs.name: Lotte Brand
npcs.info:
A nurse at South City's military hospital, where the wounded from the Aerugo front come first. She works shifts that run into one another and still remembers each man's name. She is gentle, brave and worn thin, and she writes letters home for the men who cannot.

**Speaking Style:** Gentle and quick, a nurse who hums when the ward is too quiet.
**Combat Role:** none; a nurse with bandages and a steady voice
**Relationship Hook:** A tired nurse writing a letter at a soldier's bedside on a crowded ward.
personality: Core: gentle and brave; remembers every name; writes letters for the wounded
Quirk: bends rules for her patients

npcs.name: Lou Dachun
npcs.info:
A lock-keeper of the grain canal, a big, easy-going young man who works the winding gear and the pennant board with equal laziness. Barges wait at his gate for days, and he does not see why that should spoil anyone's lunch.

**Speaking Style:** Loose and easy, a lock-keeper's drawl that has never been in a hurry.
**Combat Role:** a lock-keeper with a long boathook; he keeps men off the gates and puts them in the water
**Relationship Hook:** A big lock-keeper leaning on a boathook with a bun in his hand while two barge crews shout below.
personality: Core: never hurries; eats while he works the gear; takes a little on the side and calls it fairness
Quirk: afraid of the senior keeper and of nobody else

npcs.name: Lu Hao
npcs.info:
A tea master on the Xing tea terraces, who tends the bushes on the lower terrace and sells the tea to the court and the inns. He is gentle, unhurried and proud of his leaves, and he has a pot ready for anyone who sits down. He knows the water channels and which pickers are paid by which clan.

**Speaking Style:** Gentle and unhurried, a tea master who talks about leaves as if they were friends.
**Combat Role:** none; a pair of shears and a calm hand
**Relationship Hook:** A tea master on a terrace pouring tea for a traveller among the bushes.
personality: Core: gentle, unhurried and proud; talks about leaves as friends; a pot ready for any guest
Quirk: knows which clan pays the pickers

npcs.name: Lucan Mehrab
npcs.info:
A former deacon of the church who leads a handful of the prophet's last loyalists in a cellar under a burned house. They light candles under a painted sun and talk about the day it will rise again over Reole.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, fervent and coaxing; he speaks as if to one person even in a room full.
**Combat Role:** none of his own; he keeps two big believers between himself and any trouble
**Relationship Hook:** A thin preacher in a worn yellow robe lifting a candle toward a sun painted on a cellar wall.
personality: Core: fervent and ambitious; remembers every face that comes down the cellar stair; quotes the prophet word for word
Quirk: keeps the anonymous letters in his robe

npcs.name: Lucia Fanetti
npcs.info:
The keeper of the café on Sanvento's piazza, a handsome widow of forty who pours coffee for the garrison, the mayor's clerks and the smugglers alike. She hears everything and repeats what is useful.

**Speaking Style:** Bright and knowing, a café keeper whose every remark sounds like gossip.
**Combat Role:** none; a coffee pot and a back door
**Relationship Hook:** A handsome café keeper pouring coffee at a piazza table, glancing at soldiers across the square.
personality: Core: bright and knowing; fond of foreigners who tip
Quirk: repeats only what is useful

npcs.name: Ludger Thiel
npcs.info:
The sergeant of the railway police at Halden Junction is a heavy, red-faced man who checks the papers of every traveller who changes trains there. He is thorough, rude and very hard to bribe, which makes him unpopular with nearly everyone.

**Speaking Style:** A big flat bellow that turns heads on the platform; he never asks twice.
**Combat Role:** a railway policeman's truncheon and his weight; he wades in and pins men to the platform
**Relationship Hook:** A big red-faced sergeant checking a traveller's papers on a crowded junction platform.
personality: Core: rude to everyone equally; cannot be bribed and is offended by the attempt; obeys orders and resents most of them
Quirk: secretly fond of the station master

npcs.name: Ludo Pirsch
npcs.info:
The sergeant who leads the garrison band on the promenade every evening: marches, waltzes and the anthem to close. He has a fat, happy face, a baton he never puts down and a gift for remembering the songs each regiment likes. The city loves him. Mothers bring children to watch him swing the baton like a sabre.

**Speaking Style:** Brassy and cheerful, a bandmaster who counts time even in conversation.
**Combat Role:** a sergeant's drill sabre, rarely drawn, and a parade-ground bellow
**Relationship Hook:** A plump bandmaster raising his baton on a bandstand while the crowd turns toward a distant train.
personality: Core: jolly in public, sour in the band room; taps time on any surface; remembers every child's name; ashamed of the orders and keeps them anyway
Quirk: drinks with the trombones

npcs.name: Ludwig Haberl
npcs.info:
The quartermaster sergeant of the garrison, the most obliging man in Ishval if a request comes on the right form. He is soft-spoken, spectacled and stout, and keeps the depot's ration scale polished like a family heirloom.

**Speaking Style:** Courteous and unhurried, a supply sergeant who makes every refusal sound like help.
**Combat Role:** none worth the name; a stout man with a revolver he keeps locked in a drawer
**Relationship Hook:** A stout sergeant weighing a sack on a polished scale with a book open beside it.
personality: Core: obliging and cunning; loves a properly completed form; polishes the ration scale every morning
Quirk: never lies outright, only in arithmetic

npcs.name: Lukas Raske
npcs.info:
A gaunt, sunburnt man who lives somewhere in the reed marsh at the west end of the lake, on eels, stolen bread and whatever the herons leave, and is never seen unless he wants to be. The eel-catchers call him the reed man and leave a loaf at the marsh's edge in hard weather. He moves through the channels without a sound.

**Speaking Style:** Rusty and clipped, a man who has not spoken in months and falls into drill commands when frightened.
**Combat Role:** a trained infantryman gone feral; a bayonet lashed to a reed-cutter's pole, ambush from the water and no noise
**Relationship Hook:** A gaunt man rising out of black water between the reeds, a bayonet on a pole held level.
personality: Core: flinches at thunder; repays every kindness in eels; would kill to stay free and hates that he would
Quirk: silent for days, then talks to himself in drill commands

npcs.name: Lukas Renn
npcs.info:
A private of eighteen in the ready room, coat buttoned wrong, boots already laced, waiting for the duty telephone to ring. He joined to see the fort and was sent to sweep the city's streets instead, and he means to be noticed before the year is out.

**Speaking Style:** Quick and breathless, every sentence leaning forward as if it were already running for the door.
**Combat Role:** a green rifleman; he shoots straight on the range and too early in the street
**Relationship Hook:** A boy soldier half off the ready-room bench, staring at a silent telephone.
personality: Core: eager, and ashamed of how eager he is; laughs too loudly at officers' jokes; first out of the door when the telephone rings
Quirk: keeps a pressed flower from the orphanage yard in his pay book

npcs.name: Lutz Ammer
npcs.info:
A pit boy of ten who carries his father's and uncles' dinner pails along the approach road at noon, because the road behind the mine is shorter than the lanes. He is quiet, stubborn and very good at noticing things lying in the sand.

**Speaking Style:** A slow, serious boy who answers questions with exactly as many words as they need.
**Combat Role:** none; he runs, and he knows every gap in the mine fence
**Relationship Hook:** A small boy kneeling on a sandy roadside, holding a tin pail out to a figure lying face down.
personality: Core: solemn for his age; shares food before he is asked; afraid of soldiers
Quirk: keeps secrets very well

npcs.name: Lutz Kohler
npcs.info:
A charcoal burner on the dry edge of the alder wood across the river, who stacks wood into turf-covered mounds and tends them for days while they smoulder. He lives in a turf hut in the clearing, black from head to foot, and comes into town twice a year. His charcoal goes to the farrier, and his best to a man from the city.

**Speaking Style:** Rough and slow, a charcoal burner whose voice is as smoky as his clearing.
**Combat Role:** a long charcoal rake and an axe, heavy and patient
**Relationship Hook:** A soot-black charcoal burner holding up a melted belt buckle from a collapsed mound.
personality: Core: rough and solitary; smells of smoke and knows it; afraid of fire in the wrong place, never of fire
Quirk: asks no questions of good customers

npcs.name: Ma Deshi
npcs.info:
A lean young Xingese who arrived at the envoys' camp alone and has been rebuilding its cairn stone by stone. His grandfather's grandfather guarded an envoy who died on the way west, and the family has always known where the guard was buried.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and deliberate, a fighter who speaks in short level sentences and means each one.
**Combat Role:** a Xingese martial artist; open hand, low kicks and a short staff, fast and quiet
**Relationship Hook:** A lean young man in black kneeling to set a stone back on a pulled-apart cairn.
personality: Core: calm and relentless; keeps a vow he made at the grave; polite to everyone
Quirk: practises forms at dawn

npcs.name: Madame Christmas
npcs.info:
Chris Mustang, known as Madame Christmas, owner of a hostess bar in Central where Colonel Roy Mustang is a regular. She is a gruff, heavy-set woman with a mole and a cigarette always to hand, and she is the colonel's aunt: she took him in as a small boy when his parents died and raised him, she says, to be a good man.

**Speaking Style:** Gruff, low and smoky, sharp with everyone and sharpest with her nephew, whom she calls by his first name in front of anyone.
**Combat Role:** none in the open; her network and a cool head
**Relationship Hook:** A heavy-set madame behind a bar counter, smoke curling from her cigarette as two officers talk.
personality: Core: gruff and blunt; misses nothing said at her counter; keeps her girls safe
Quirk: sharp with Roy and proud of him

npcs.name: Madeline
npcs.info:
One of the hostesses at Madame Christmas's bar in Central, a sociable young woman who goes shopping with her friends on her pay and is seen out on the town with Colonel Mustang now and then.

**Speaking Style:** Light, flirtatious and sociable, a hostess who laughs at a colonel's jokes and remembers every word.
**Combat Role:** none; charm and a good memory
**Relationship Hook:** A hostess on a colonel's arm, whispering a report between laughs.
personality: Core: sociable and light-hearted; loyal to the madam; spends her pay with her friends
Quirk: remembers every word said over a drink

npcs.name: Maes Hughes
npcs.info:
Lieutenant Colonel Maes Hughes of the investigations office in Central, Roy Mustang's best friend since the military academy and his strongest supporter. He is tall and lean, with black spiky hair, rectangular glasses and a scruffy chinstrap beard, and he never stops showing everyone photographs of his wife Gracia and three-year-old Elicia. He drags friends home for dinner whether they like it or not.

**Speaking Style:** Warm, loud and cheerful, rambling about his daughter at every opportunity; when it matters, sharp and quick.
**Combat Role:** concealed throwing knives, thrown faster than a man can draw
**Relationship Hook:** A grinning officer in glasses holding up a photograph of his daughter to a reluctant colleague.
personality: Core: warm, cheerful and rambling; drags friends home for dinner; a brilliant investigator under the jokes
Quirk: shows everyone his daughter's photographs

npcs.name: Magda Fenn
npcs.info:
A salt raker with cracked hands and squinting, reddened eyes, who scrapes the brine pans into cones from dawn until the glare is too much. She came out from Youswell with her brothers, and she is the one the rakers listen to.

**Speaking Style:** Hoarse and fierce; her voice carries across the pans and does not waver.
**Combat Role:** a raker with a long salt rake and the whole crew at her back
**Relationship Hook:** A wiry woman in a salt-crusted hat leaning on a long rake among blinding white pans.
personality: Core: fierce and fair; keeps the sums; squints at everything
Quirk: fears for her brothers

npcs.name: Mahmud Kassar
npcs.info:
A lean, quiet Ishvalan who walks the dry wash at night and brings people into the ruins without papers: families coming back to look, mourners, the odd smuggler. He takes no fee and asks no questions.

**Speaking Style:** Low and gentle, a night guide's whisper that rarely rises above the sound of feet on stones.
**Combat Role:** a night guide's long knife and a staff; he hides first and fights only to cover others
**Relationship Hook:** A lean guide standing in a dry riverbed at dusk, sniffing the wind while lightning flickers to the south.
personality: Core: quiet and careful; carries the smallest child himself; never guides a crossing in rain
Quirk: watches the southern sky before every crossing

npcs.name: Maike Dunstan
npcs.info:
A shepherdess of eighteen at her first lambing on the ridge, who spends her nights in the fold among the ewes with a lantern, a bottle of warm milk for the weak lambs and a song for every one. Shy in the bothy among the men, she is fearless in the fold, and every orphan lamb on the ridge trails after her.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and unhurried, a young shepherdess who sings to the ewes and talks to people the same way.
**Combat Role:** none; a lantern swung at a face and a whistle for the dogs
**Relationship Hook:** A young shepherdess holding a lantern over a straw fold, a lamb's head poking out of her jacket.
personality: Core: shy indoors, bold outdoors; sings to the ewes; hides what she has seen because she half pities it
Quirk: carries orphan lambs inside her coat

npcs.name: Mara Dell
npcs.info:
A produce seller on South City's Produce Row who sells vegetables and fruit to the garrison and the families. She is cheerful, quick and sharp at a price. She knows which soldiers pay on time and which ones owe her for a month.

**Speaking Style:** Cheerful and quick, a produce seller who talks prices and weather in the same breath.
**Combat Role:** none; a knife for the vegetables and a loud voice
**Relationship Hook:** A produce seller at a stall of apples and cabbages, calling prices to a soldier.
personality: Core: cheerful, quick and sharp at a price; knows who pays on time; talks prices and weather together
Quirk: sells food to deserters in secret

npcs.name: Marco Ferrante
npcs.info:
A lieutenant of the Aerugo army taken in the trenches before Fotset a year ago. He is a schoolteacher's son from a hill town, cheerful in captivity, and he has taught half the guards to play his card games. He keeps the prisoners' spirits up and their complaints short.

**Speaking Style:** Warm and wry, an Aerugonian officer whose careful Amestrian is full of jokes at his own expense.
**Combat Role:** an officer's training with a sword and pistol, and a hut full of men who answer to him
**Relationship Hook:** A bearded prisoner in a faded red tunic shuffling a deck of cards outside a whitewashed hut.
personality: Core: cheerful in captivity; teaches card games to his guards; speaks for the men in his hut
Quirk: homesick for the smell of lemon trees

npcs.name: Mareike Sturmfels
npcs.info:
The owner's daughter at the coffee house under the linden trees, a quick, pretty girl who remembers every regular's order and nobody's debts. She carries trays to the officers at the marble tables, takes their cards when they lose, and laughs at their jokes when they are funny and sometimes when they are not.

**Speaking Style:** Light and teasing, a waitress who calls out orders like a song and remembers every one of them.
**Combat Role:** none; a tray, a quick tongue and a kitchen door
**Relationship Hook:** A bright young waitress balancing a tray of coffee cups between marble tables by a window.
personality: Core: bright, quick and bold; remembers every order
Quirk: teases officers she likes

npcs.name: Maren Aske
npcs.info:
An old shepherd of the Grey Wolf Hills who grazes her flock on the bare slopes in summer and winters in a stone hut. She is tough, solitary and has outlived two husbands and a great many wolves.

**Speaking Style:** Hard and wind-dried, an old shepherd whose words come out like stones off a slope.
**Combat Role:** a shepherd with a crook and an old rifle; she shoots wolves at a hundred paces
**Relationship Hook:** An old shepherd with a crook and a rifle on her back watching smoke rise from a distant hut.
personality: Core: tough and solitary; outlived two husbands; remembers everything
Quirk: talks to her dog more than people

npcs.name: Margarethe Pfalz
npcs.info:
The senior operator of the city telephone exchange, twenty years at the board and the fastest hands in the north. She runs the room of girls with a look and a cough, and every officer at headquarters is a little afraid of her without knowing why.

**Speaking Style:** Silken and amused, a voice built to say 'connecting you now' and to mean something else by it.
**Combat Role:** none; a sharp hatpin and the ability to cut a man's line at the worst moment
**Relationship Hook:** A senior operator at a wall of cords, headset on, one jack held still in mid-air as she listens.
personality: Core: unhurried, amused and very observant; remembers every voice on the board; hands out favours like sweets
Quirk: pretends not to understand questions she dislikes

npcs.name: Margery Cobb
npcs.info:
A wiry old woman in a man's coat who breeds and trains the black-and-white collies that work every flock in the district. Half the dogs on the lane are hers or her dogs' grandchildren, and she calls any of them off a sheep with two notes of a whistle. She has no patience for people and endless patience for a slow pup.

**Speaking Style:** Brisk and whistling, an old woman who talks to people the way she talks to dogs, short and kind.
**Combat Role:** none; three collies who come at a whistle and a stout shepherd's crook
**Relationship Hook:** An old woman whistling two sharp notes while a collie drops flat in the lane.
personality: Core: short with people, gentle with dogs; judges a stranger by how a dog takes to them; never sits down indoors
Quirk: whistles instead of calling names

npcs.name: Margit Sauer
npcs.info:
A senior cataloguer at the National Central Library who has spent twenty years among its shelves. She can find any book in the building and tell a reader which ones are missing. She is quiet, precise and devoted to the catalogue, and she has no patience for a reader who bends a spine.

**Speaking Style:** Hushed and exact, a librarian who speaks in a whisper that somehow carries.
**Combat Role:** none; a librarian with a ladder and a heavy book
**Relationship Hook:** A librarian on a rolling ladder pulling a book from a high shelf.
personality: Core: quiet and exact; loves the catalogue; notices every missing book
Quirk: suspicious of officers with lists

npcs.name: Maria Ross
npcs.info:
Second Lieutenant Maria Ross of Central, under Major Armstrong, an exemplary soldier with a spotless record, short dark hair and a beauty mark under her left eye. She is brave, mature and honest, and she believes in trust. With her partner Sergeant Brosh she is assigned to guard the Elric brothers in Central.

**Speaking Style:** Clear, steady and kind, with a firm edge; she can be strict or gentle as the moment needs.
**Combat Role:** a soldier's pistol and rifle, steady and professional
**Relationship Hook:** A dark-haired lieutenant with a beauty mark under one eye, standing guard over two boys in a hospital.
personality: Core: honest and steadfast; strict or kind as needed; brave in the face of a frame-up
Quirk: trusts and expects trust

npcs.name: Marianne Kloss
npcs.info:
The town's baker, a soft-spoken widow who lights her oven at three so the smell of bread reaches the station before the first train. She bakes apple pie at the end of every week, and every child in Resembool learns the hour it comes out. Forty years of hot tins have scarred her hands until she no longer seems to feel heat at all.

**Speaking Style:** Warm and drowsy, a baker who has been up since three and talks as if it were still the middle of the night.
**Combat Role:** none; a long wooden baker's peel and an oven door she can slam on a hand
**Relationship Hook:** An old baker drawing loaves from a brick oven before dawn, an envelope tucked under the flour sack.
personality: Core: sleepy-voiced and kind; feeds children who ought to be in school; asks no questions of her suppliers
Quirk: keeps her word once given, even when she should not

npcs.name: Marlene Brun
npcs.info:
A nurse on the hospital's fitting ward, where soldiers learn to use their new automail. She coaxes men through the first agonising days after the nerves are connected and teaches them to hold a spoon, then a rifle, then a pen to write home.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and practical, a nurse who talks men through pain one small instruction at a time.
**Combat Role:** none; steady hands and a ward of men who would stand up for her
**Relationship Hook:** A young nurse holding a soldier's steel hand and guiding it toward a spoon.
personality: Core: patient and practical; talks men through pain; writes letters for the men who cannot
Quirk: keeps a list of every patient's birthday

npcs.name: Marlene Dross
npcs.info:
The innkeeper's wife, a handsome woman with a deck of cards always in her hands, who runs the game in the cellar every night. She is charming to winners and patient with losers, and she keeps a book of debts in her apron pocket.

**Speaking Style:** Low and pleasant, a dealer's voice that never rises and never stops.
**Combat Role:** none in the open; a hidden derringer and a room full of debtors
**Relationship Hook:** A handsome woman shuffling cards at a table in a lamplit cellar.
personality: Core: charming and ruthless; never forgets a debt; protective of her husband
Quirk: shuffles while she talks

npcs.name: Marta Geiss
npcs.info:
The head of the goatherd family on the stone steading north of town, a widow with three grown sons, a hundred goats and a deed older than the lieutenant's. She sells milk and cheese in the lane and has paid not one coin of rent.

**Speaking Style:** Hard and carrying, a herd-wife who can stop a dog or a soldier with one word.
**Combat Role:** a shepherd's crook and three large sons
**Relationship Hook:** A grey herd-wife leaning on a crook beside two dead goats, looking toward the town.
personality: Core: trusts paper older than her; protects her herd like children; suspects everyone in uniform
Quirk: proud and unbending

npcs.name: Marta Holm
npcs.info:
The forewoman of the wool sheds by Resembool station, who grades every fleece the district sends to the train. She can tell a ewe's age by touching its wool and a man's honesty by how he bales it. She is strict, fair and loud, and the shearers both fear and love her.

**Speaking Style:** Sharp and quick, a forewoman who barks numbers and never repeats herself.
**Combat Role:** none; a strong woman with a baling hook who will use it on a thief
**Relationship Hook:** A forewoman holding a fleece up to the window while the shearers wait for her verdict.
personality: Core: strict, fair and loud; grades by touch; protects her shearers
Quirk: distrusts buyers from the city

npcs.name: Marta Sellouk
npcs.info:
The owner of the Sunwheel Inn, a widow in her fifties with flour on her apron and keys on her belt. In the pilgrim years she fed three hundred guests on a feast day; now she feeds soldiers, salesmen and families with no roof, and takes payment from those who have it.

**Speaking Style:** Brisk, warm and loud enough to carry across a courtyard; she never finishes a sentence without an order in it.
**Combat Role:** none; a rolling pin and a voice that clears a courtyard
**Relationship Hook:** A stout innkeeper laying a long table under a fig tree, keys jangling at her hip.
personality: Core: generous and sharp-eyed; feeds anyone who sits at her long table; never says aloud who sleeps upstairs
Quirk: keeps every key on her own belt

npcs.name: Martel
npcs.info:
A lithe woman of Greed's gang who can twist her body like a snake: she bends her neck and limbs into impossible shapes, slips through gaps a cat would refuse and holds a dagger in a coil. She is sharp, sardonic and fiercely loyal to the friends she escaped with. A tattoo runs along her arm.

**Speaking Style:** A flat, dry voice with a sneer at the edges, unimpressed by everyone; she drops it to a hiss when she means it.
**Combat Role:** a dagger and a snake's body, striking from coils and odd angles and squeezing inside a gap
**Relationship Hook:** A lithe woman uncoiling from a space far too small for her, dagger in hand.
personality: Core: sardonic and unimpressed; hides in places no one thinks to look; never wastes a word
Quirk: loyal to her friends to the end

npcs.name: Marthe Engle
npcs.info:
The midwife of the hamlet on the far shore of the lake, a sturdy, unhurried woman who also pulls teeth, sets goats' legs and sews up fishermen, since no doctor lives within an hour's sail. She keeps her bag packed by the door and her boat drawn up in front of her cottage.

**Speaking Style:** Unhurried and plain, a midwife who says the hard thing first and kindly.
**Combat Role:** none; steady hands and a heavy medical bag, and a whole hamlet that would row out for her
**Relationship Hook:** A sturdy midwife wading out to a boat in the dark with her bag held above the water.
personality: Core: unhurried in any emergency; packs her bag before she is asked; speaks to the dying plainly
Quirk: will not set foot on a train

npcs.name: Marthe Fallow
npcs.info:
The range instructor of the cadet school is a captain who learned her shooting in the border hills and her patience nowhere at all. She can put five rounds through one hole at two hundred paces, and she expects every cadet to try until they can manage three.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped and hard, a range officer who counts aloud and finishes sentences with 'again'.
**Combat Role:** a sniper; she picks a firing point, waits, and drops a target before it knows she is there
**Relationship Hook:** A cropped-haired captain sighting down a scoped rifle on a range of splintered targets.
personality: Core: praises no one, ever, and means it as respect; counts every spent cartridge; fiercely protective of cadets she has called hopeless
Quirk: plays dice with the sergeants and wins

npcs.name: Marthe Losch
npcs.info:
A laundress from the lower town in a borrowed black dress, waiting on the cathedral steps for the funeral of her only son. She cannot read, and she has been too proud to say so to the clerk who handed her the coffin plate. Her hands are red from the wash-house and she keeps them hidden in her sleeves.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and plain-spoken, a laundress who apologises for taking up anyone's time.
**Combat Role:** none; she would only run
**Relationship Hook:** A woman in borrowed black holding out a brass coffin plate to a passer-by on the church steps.
personality: Core: proud and ashamed in the same moment; thanks people twice
Quirk: hides her hands

npcs.name: Martje Ebner
npcs.info:
A village widow who keeps house for the doctor everyone in the Nameless Village calls Mauro: she weeds his herb garden, boils his linen and chases off patients who come after dark. She is plump, busy and fiercely protective, and twice a day she tells him he eats too little and sleeps less.

**Speaking Style:** Warm and fussing, a village widow who mothers the doctor as if he were her own son.
**Combat Role:** none; a kitchen knife in her apron and a loud voice at the gate
**Relationship Hook:** A plump widow straightening up from a herb bed to stare hard at a stranger at the gate.
personality: Core: busy and fussing; chases off late visitors; swears oaths and keeps them
Quirk: mothers the doctor

npcs.name: Mason
npcs.info:
Sig Curtis's assistant at Curtis Meats, a muscular, good-humoured man who works the cold store, runs the deliveries and knows the Elric boys from their training days. He is easy company, handy with a club and good in the wild. He is fond of the boys and helps Izumi with whatever she asks, from deliveries to finding a missing child.

**Speaking Style:** Easy, cheerful and upbeat, a shop hand who greets everyone by name and changes the subject fast when it turns to his employers' private business.
**Combat Role:** a strong man with a club, a survivalist who knows the island and the lake
**Relationship Hook:** A cheerful shop hand hauling a side of meat out of the cold store and waving at the boys.
personality: Core: cheerful and easy-going; fond of the Elric boys; works without complaint
Quirk: changes the subject when the Curtises' past comes up

npcs.name: Mathias Glut
npcs.info:
An oven tender at the coke bank, a man of forty who looks sixty, with no eyebrows and burn-shined hands. He opens the doors, rakes the hot coke and keeps the fires alive through nights so hot the sand around the ovens glows.

**Speaking Style:** Rough and dry, a voice cooked hoarse by twenty years in front of oven doors.
**Combat Role:** a long iron rake and a man who does not feel heat
**Relationship Hook:** A sweating oven tender with no eyebrows raking glowing coke from a brick oven at night.
personality: Core: tough and laconic; no eyebrows left
Quirk: talks to the ovens by number

npcs.name: Mathis Ober
npcs.info:
A grizzled sergeant from the Desert Road Fort who tends the patrol cemetery on his own time, repainting the white markers each spring and keeping a book of the names. He knows how every man there died, or says he does.

**Speaking Style:** Low and kindly; he speaks of the dead by their first names.
**Combat Role:** an old sergeant with a rifle and a bayonet who has done it all before
**Relationship Hook:** A grizzled sergeant repainting a white wooden grave marker in a desert cemetery.
personality: Core: kind and weathered; repaints the markers every spring; keeps the book of names
Quirk: tells gentle lies to mothers

npcs.name: Mattea Corvo
npcs.info:
The keeper of the one-lamp den on the bad side's waterfront, a tall Aerugonian woman of forty with a knife scar through one eyebrow and a laugh people remember. She came over the border before the fighting started and stayed. Her den is one room, one lamp and one bottle, and the men who drink there do not talk to the men who drink anywhere else.

**Speaking Style:** Low and amused, an Aerugonian accent that thickens when she is angry and a laugh people remember.
**Combat Role:** a knife fighter; a long blade held low, quick feet on wet planks and no interest in fair play
**Relationship Hook:** A tall scarred woman behind a bar lit by one lamp, pouring a drink without looking at the bottle.
personality: Core: laughs at threats, never at debts; swears in Aerugonian when she is angry; pays her share on time and resents every coin of it
Quirk: keeps one lamp lit so she can see every face

npcs.name: Matteo Corvi
npcs.info:
The trader in the wide straw hat who built a shack past the border gate and sells whatever the road needs: water by the cup, flatbread, tobacco, bootlaces, lamp oil. The gate soldiers are his best customers, and he knows each of them by his vice.

**Speaking Style:** Warm, voluble and Aerugonian-accented; he sells you water as if it were a favour between brothers.
**Combat Role:** an old Aerugonian soldier's bayonet drill, rusty but real
**Relationship Hook:** A stocky trader in a wide straw hat leaning on a plank counter under a tin awning, grinning.
personality: Core: generous and evasive; never opens a letter; sings southern songs at the counter
Quirk: tells a different life story to every customer

npcs.name: Mattheus Crumb
npcs.info:
Keeper of the railway water tank west of town, a wiry little man who nurses the coughing pump engine that fills the tank from the river and sleeps on a cot beside it. He is cheerful, grimy and hoarse from the steam. The shearers and engine crews like him. The railway's inspectors do not.

**Speaking Style:** Wheezy and conspiratorial, a pump keeper who winks at the end of every sentence.
**Combat Role:** none much; a heavy spanner and a door he can bolt from inside
**Relationship Hook:** A grimy little man winking over a tin cup in a steaming pump shed.
personality: Core: cheerful and wheezy; generous with his spirit, careful with his secrets; talks to the pump engine by name
Quirk: winks at the end of his sentences

npcs.name: Matthis Ehrlich
npcs.info:
The pastor of the Linden Street Church, thirty years old, thin, earnest and short of money. He preaches to a dwindling congregation of old families and spends more of his week ladling soup than writing sermons. He believes the capital has forgotten the poor and says so from the pulpit, which the old families do not enjoy.

**Speaking Style:** Gentle and a little hoarse, a young pastor who sounds as if he has been up all night, because he has.
**Combat Role:** none; a thin young pastor who will stand in a doorway and refuse to move
**Relationship Hook:** A thin young pastor ladling soup into bowls at a long table, glancing up at the ceiling when the bell rope sways.
personality: Core: earnest, tired and brave; cannot turn away a hungry face; a poor liar who lies anyway for others
Quirk: argues with his own sermons

npcs.name: Matthis Gronau
npcs.info:
The commander of the trial crew, a compact, cheerful sergeant who lived through the burning of the first prototype and laughed about it from his infirmary bed. Between trials he sits on the turret of the grey shape under the tarpaulin and eats his lunch there.

**Speaking Style:** Cheerful and quick, laughing at exactly the moments other men go quiet.
**Combat Role:** a vehicle commander; inside, the machine's turret gun and armour, outside, a pistol and a fast climb back through the hatch
**Relationship Hook:** A grinning sergeant with a burn-scarred cheek eating bread on top of a grey turret in a bowl of churned snow.
personality: Core: laughs at the moment others fall silent; sleeps with his boots on; pats the hull every time he climbs in; ties the tarpaulin with knots only he can undo
Quirk: trusts his crew of three and no one else

npcs.name: Mattias Brennig
npcs.info:
The blacksmith of the Sun Street Forge, a huge man with a leather apron and a scarred left hand, who shoes the carters' mules and makes the hinges and latches for half the new doors in Reole.

**Speaking Style:** Gruff, sparing and hoarse from the forge smoke; he answers in single words if he can.
**Combat Role:** a heavy brawler with a smith's hammer; slow, but every swing lands like the anvil
**Relationship Hook:** A huge smith turning a hinge on the anvil, refusing to look at the pike heads hanging in the corner.
personality: Core: taciturn and remorseful; shoes a mule more gently than he speaks; keeps the forge lit even when there is no work
Quirk: refuses any work with a point or an edge

npcs.name: Mattie Kroll
npcs.info:
A primary schoolteacher of twenty-four who brings her pupils to the old memorial to learn the names of a war eighty years past. She is bright, earnest and argumentative and has opinions about the current war that she keeps out of her classroom with difficulty.

**Speaking Style:** Bright and quick, a young teacher's voice used to being heard over a class.
**Combat Role:** none; a sharp tongue and fast legs
**Relationship Hook:** A young teacher with chalk on her fingers looking up at a weathered stone memorial.
personality: Core: earnest and argumentative; teaches history as if it matters
Quirk: brave until she has time to think

npcs.name: Mattis Ekdahl
npcs.info:
The sledwright, who makes and mends sledges, snowshoes and skis for the farms, the post and the army. He steams his runners in a long box by the stove and bends them by hand, and his sledges last thirty winters.

**Speaking Style:** Few words, all of them about wood, said as though measuring them.
**Combat Role:** none; a drawknife, and a yard of steam and timber he knows blind
**Relationship Hook:** A grey sledwright bending a steaming runner over a form by the stove.
personality: Core: silent and exact; measures twice; hates paint on good wood
Quirk: keeps a sledge for every child in his family

npcs.name: Maud Ferrier
npcs.info:
The goods clerk at Halden Junction is twenty, quick with a weighing beam and quicker with gossip, and she runs the goods shed while the porters smoke. She has a sweetheart at the border and writes to him every night on the backs of waybills.

**Speaking Style:** Chirpy and quick, a goods clerk who calls everyone 'love' and never stops counting.
**Combat Role:** none; a weighing beam's iron weight in a pinch
**Relationship Hook:** A curly-haired young clerk in a straw boater writing on a waybill beside a weighing beam.
personality: Core: chatty, cheerful and sharp; counts sacks without looking; writes letters on anything with a clean side
Quirk: hides worry behind good humour

npcs.name: May Chang
npcs.info:
The seventeenth princess of Xing, a small girl of the poor Chang clan with dark braids ending in two buns and a tiny panda, Shao May, on her shoulder. She is a gifted practitioner of alkahestry, the Xingese art that reads the flow of the earth and heals as well as harms, and she throws kunai to draw her circles at a distance. She has an overactive imagination and a romantic picture of the Fullmetal Alchemist she has never met.

**Speaking Style:** Bright, cheeky and quick, a girl's voice that swings from a squeal over a handsome prince to a sharp, serious lecture on alkahestry.
**Combat Role:** alkahestry thrown through kunai at a distance, and Xingese martial arts close in
**Relationship Hook:** A tiny princess with a panda on her shoulder, kunai fanned in one hand, lecturing a man twice her size.
personality: Core: impulsive and quick to like or hate; fierce about her clan; kind to anyone hurt in front of her
Quirk: imagines everyone as a prince or a villain

npcs.name: Mechthild Spurling
npcs.info:
A spare, sharp-eyed widow who sells steel cable by the yard in the covered market, cutting it with shears as long as her forearm. She came to Rush Valley with one drum of wire and now has six. She will not haggle, will not gossip and will not serve a man who has been drinking, and the trade respects all three.

**Speaking Style:** Flat and final, a widow who states the length and the price and does not say either twice.
**Combat Role:** none; long cable shears held point out, and a reach that keeps a man at arm's length
**Relationship Hook:** A widow in black cutting steel cable with long shears, refusing to name a lower figure.
