personality: Core: refuses drunks on principle; keeps her debts in her head like a book; softens only for apprentices with burnt hands
Quirk: measures twice, cuts once and talks never

npcs.name: Meinrad Imsel
npcs.info:
The station master of Asbec, a neat grey man with a gold watch and a bell he rings with ceremony for every train, even the ones that do not stop. He knows every face that gets off and remembers the ones that do not belong.

**Speaking Style:** Tidy and courteous, every sentence buttoned up like his uniform.
**Combat Role:** a railway official with a signal lamp and a whistle; he calls for help and bars the waiting-room door
**Relationship Hook:** A tidy grey station master ringing a hand bell on a timber platform as a train steams in.
personality: Core: rings the bell for every train; checks his watch against the sun; writes his reports in his slowest hand
Quirk: tips his cap to Ishvalans and townsfolk alike

npcs.name: Menny
npcs.info:
A little girl of Dublith whose cat Chiko has just died giving birth, and who believes Izumi Curtis can fix anything. She is earnest and polite, and she carries her grief in both hands. When she is told that a life cannot be mended like a broken pot, she understands it better than many grown alchemists.

**Speaking Style:** Small and tearful, a girl who sniffs between words and tries very hard to be brave.
**Combat Role:** none; a small child
**Relationship Hook:** A little girl in the market holding a wrapped bundle and asking where the alchemist lives.
personality: Core: earnest and polite; believes the grown-ups can fix things; tries not to cry in public
Quirk: loves animals

npcs.name: Mick Murray
npcs.info:
Mick Murray, a soldier of Fort Briggs serving under Major Miles, calm, steady and willing to do whatever odd job the officers think up, including hiding inside a dummy suit of armour.

**Speaking Style:** Calm and good-humoured, a soldier who takes odd orders without complaint.
**Combat Role:** a rifle and a cool head
**Relationship Hook:** A calm soldier climbing out of an empty suit of armour and stretching.
personality: Core: calm and good-humoured; steady under pressure; loyal to his partner
Quirk: takes odd orders without complaint

npcs.name: Mila Dorn
npcs.info:
A girl of nine who draws circles in the mud by the creek and makes the mud do things. She does not know it is alchemy; she thinks it is a game she invented, and she plays it when her mother is busy.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and solemn, a little girl who explains her drawings very seriously.
**Combat Role:** none; she can make the mud rise into a little wall if she is frightened
**Relationship Hook:** A small girl in a patched coat drawing a circle in creek mud with a stick, the mud stirring.
personality: Core: solemn and curious; draws circles in everything; trusts strangers too quickly
Quirk: does what her mother says, mostly

npcs.name: Miles
npcs.info:
Major Miles, Olivier Mira Armstrong's adjutant, a serious, efficient officer who never takes off his snow goggles. He is a realist, cold on first meeting, respected by every soldier at Briggs, and hard on anyone who has done harm to Ishval.

**Speaking Style:** Measured, serious and quiet; he says what needs saying and nothing else, and it carries.
**Combat Role:** a staff officer's pistol and a commander's tactics in the snow
**Relationship Hook:** A goggled major at the general's shoulder, already carrying out an order she has not finished giving.
personality: Core: serious and efficient; cold to strangers, warm to comrades; proud of his Ishvalan blood
Quirk: quietly furious at the war's killers

npcs.name: Mina Hartl
npcs.info:
A girl of eleven at Pinewood Orphanage, the daughter of a soldier who did not come back from the border. She is small, serious and watchful, and she keeps the orphanage yard's snow shovelled into a perfect wall nobody asked her to build.

**Speaking Style:** Small and serious, a child who chooses each word with great care.
**Combat Role:** none; a snowball packed with ice and a voice that can reach the matron's window
**Relationship Hook:** A small girl in red mittens patting snow into a wall at the edge of an orphanage yard.
personality: Core: serious and watchful; builds snow walls that nobody asked for; asks soldiers if they knew her father
Quirk: keeps secrets better than adults

npcs.name: Mina Lutt
npcs.info:
The clay digger's daughter, six years old, who slides down the yellow sides of the pit in summer and brings her father his bread. She collects interesting stones, feathers and, lately, bones.

**Speaking Style:** High and earnest, a little girl who explains things very carefully.
**Combat Role:** none; she is six
**Relationship Hook:** A small girl in a clay-stained pinafore proudly holding up a pale bone at the edge of a yellow pit.
personality: Core: earnest and fearless; collects things
Quirk: tells everybody everything

npcs.name: Mina Ostreich
npcs.info:
A young assistant on the dig who runs the sieve lines, writes the labels Adalbert Rusk dictates and copies the finds table each evening. She came for adventure and has found mostly sand.

**Speaking Style:** Bright and nervous, she says sorry before she says anything else.
**Combat Role:** none; she hides behind the sieves and throws sand
**Relationship Hook:** A young woman with a notebook squinting at a sieve full of potsherds.
personality: Core: eager and anxious; apologises constantly; keeps careful copies
Quirk: braver than she believes

npcs.name: Minna Lohm
npcs.info:
A baker's widow from Fotset who runs the soup kitchen in the refugee tents. She lost her shop and her husband to the first shells, and since then she has fed the whole camp twice a day on whatever the army sends. She is small, fierce and tireless.

**Speaking Style:** Bustling and kind, a cook who scolds and feeds in the same breath.
**Combat Role:** none; a bread knife and a camp that would riot for her
**Relationship Hook:** A small fierce woman ladling soup from a huge pot for a queue of refugees.
personality: Core: fierce and tireless; scolds and feeds together
Quirk: signals with the bread

npcs.name: Mira Kessel
npcs.info:
An automail engineer of Rush Valley who runs a small shop on Automail Row and enters every street contest. She grabs the sleeve of anyone with steel under it and offers an upgrade on the spot. She is bright, brash and talented, and she has never won a contest against the old masters.

**Speaking Style:** Fast and cheerful, a street engineer who pitches while she talks.
**Combat Role:** none much; an engineer with a heavy wrench and fast hands
**Relationship Hook:** A young engineer grabbing a stranger's sleeve on a busy street of workshops.
personality: Core: bright and brash; grabs every steel sleeve; hungry to beat the masters
Quirk: generous with tips to apprentices

npcs.name: Miriam Dalton
npcs.info:
A dyer of indigo with blue to the elbow and a grey headscarf pulled low, who runs three vats at the end of the row and sells her cloth in the market hall under the name on her stall board.

**Speaking Style:** Low, polite and careful; she pronounces Amestrian words a shade too correctly.
**Combat Role:** none; she knows every alley behind the vats and is gone before trouble arrives
**Relationship Hook:** A dyer with blue arms stirring a stone vat, her scarf pulled low over her eyes.
personality: Core: quiet and watchful; keeps her scarf low and her sleeves long; teaches the indigo recipe to no one
Quirk: hums an old song over the vats when she thinks she is alone

npcs.name: Mo Qinglan
npcs.info:
The keeper of the Silent Lantern House pours bad tea with perfect grace and has never been heard to raise her voice. Mo Qinglan wears plain grey, sits by the back booths and keeps an abacus she seldom needs.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and pleasant, never asking a question she does not already know the answer to.
**Combat Role:** a blade hidden in a teapot handle and a flash bomb under the counter; she ends a fight before it starts and leaves through the kitchen
**Relationship Hook:** A woman in grey pouring tea behind a bamboo blind, a folded paper tucked under the tray.
personality: Core: pours with both hands and great ceremony; never reads a paper in front of the customer who left it; clicks the abacus to think, not to sum
Quirk: has a horror of loose ends

npcs.name: Morag Tulloch
npcs.info:
The head shepherd of the ridge station is a leathery woman of sixty who has walked these slopes with her flocks since she was a child and regards the border as a rumour. Her dogs obey her whistle across a whole hillside.

**Speaking Style:** Brisk and wind-roughened, a shepherd who talks to strangers and dogs in exactly the same tone.
**Combat Role:** a shepherd's crook and two dogs; she hooks a leg and lets the dogs do the rest
**Relationship Hook:** An old shepherd in a shawl leaning on a crook among sheep in a drystone fold, a dog at her side.
personality: Core: talks to her dogs as equals; has no patience with borders; never hurries, even in a storm
Quirk: fiercely loyal to anyone who has helped her flock

npcs.name: Moritz Daub
npcs.info:
The soldier posted at the company store's door, who pretends not to hear arguments and helps himself from the back shed when the shopman is busy. He is small, sly and always eating something he did not pay for.

**Speaking Style:** Wheedling and sly, a private who giggles at his own petty thefts.
**Combat Role:** a rifle butt for a cornered miner and quick legs for anything bigger
**Relationship Hook:** A wiry private munching a stolen apple in a back shed full of sacks, listening for footsteps.
personality: Core: petty and sly; always eating; blames others
Quirk: giggles when nervous

npcs.name: Moritz Hale
npcs.info:
The old shepherd's grandson, twelve, who spends every hour he can at the hill oak, swinging on the frayed rope or lying along the low bough reading anything with print on it. He is thoughtful, solemn and a little lonely. He can name every set of initials in the trunk and most of the hands that cut them.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and careful, a boy who weighs his words as if someone were checking them.
**Combat Role:** none; up the tree and out of reach in three seconds
**Relationship Hook:** A solemn boy lying along an oak bough with a book, a frayed rope swing turning below him.
personality: Core: solemn and bookish; proud and lonely; knows every name in the bark
Quirk: keeps watch from the bough

npcs.name: Mott Grisel
npcs.info:
A former private of Eastern Command who left the army after Ishval and now scrapes bat dung out of the back rooms of the lanes to sell at the crossing as fertiliser and powder stock. He smells of it and does not care. He calls the lanes his estate.

**Speaking Style:** Gravel and smoke; he swears softly and keeps his jokes short.
**Combat Role:** a drifter with a rifle butt and a short spade, who fights dirty and runs
**Relationship Hook:** A gaunt man with a cloth over his face filling a sack by lantern light in a dark back room.
personality: Core: sour and harmless; works at night; talks to the bats
Quirk: will not speak about the war

npcs.name: Mr. Halling
npcs.info:
A coal miner of Youswell who runs a tavern with his wife and his son Kyle and speaks for the town as its unofficial chief in fruitless talks with the mine's owner, Lieutenant Yoki. He is friendly and kind-hearted, the kind of man who takes a loss to help a friend, and he dabbled in alchemy as a boy without the talent to go on.

**Speaking Style:** Warm, steady and clear-headed, a man who speaks plainly and listens longer than he talks.
**Combat Role:** none; a miner's strength and a tavern keeper's good sense
**Relationship Hook:** A miner in a meeting hall talking calmly to a crowd of angry men.
personality: Core: amicable, clear-headed and fair; hates the army for Yoki's sake; forbids his son revenge
Quirk: takes a loss for a friend

npcs.name: Mr. Han
npcs.info:
A Xingese smuggler with glasses and a goatee who specialises in moving people across the great desert between Xing and Amestris without anyone at either border knowing. He is discreet, reliable and expensive, and he does not ask a client's business.

**Speaking Style:** Quick, businesslike and unflappable, a smuggler who quotes the route before he quotes the fee.
**Combat Role:** none; a smuggler's routes and a fast camel
**Relationship Hook:** A bespectacled smuggler checking water skins in a caravan yard at dusk.
personality: Core: discreet and businesslike; knows every well on the desert road; unflappable at a checkpoint
Quirk: never asks a client's business

npcs.name: Mrs. Armstrong
npcs.info:
The matriarch of the Armstrong family and mother of Olivier, Alex and three other daughters, a very tall, thin woman with a severe expression and a large blonde bun with the family curl. She dresses well, sparkles faintly like the rest of them, and takes the family's dramas to heart.

**Speaking Style:** A refined, delicate voice, very proper; she sighs, swoons and recovers in the same breath.
**Combat Role:** none; a household's command and the family's money
**Relationship Hook:** A tall thin lady swooning onto a sofa as her children argue.
personality: Core: proper and refined; practical when it counts; proud of her children
Quirk: swoons at family quarrels

npcs.name: Mrs. Bradley
npcs.info:
The wife of the Führer, King Bradley, and the mother of their adopted son Selim. She is kind, trusting and easily charmed, and she likes to tell anyone who will listen how her husband courted her. She is often seen with Selim on her arm and a pearl at her throat, and she has never doubted her family for a moment.

**Speaking Style:** Warm and a little breathless, a wife who laughs while she tells a story about her husband.
**Combat Role:** none; she is a gentle woman with no weapon and no training
**Relationship Hook:** A warm-faced woman in pearls walking along a grand avenue with her son's hand in hers.
personality: Core: kind, trusting and talkative; dotes on her son; tells her love story to anyone
Quirk: steadier in a crisis than anyone expects

npcs.name: Mrs. Halling
npcs.info:
The wife of the town's spokesman and the cook behind the tavern's one good dish, a mutton stew that has kept half of Miners' Row alive through two bad winters. She runs the kitchen, the upstairs rooms and her husband's temper, and she is the reason Kyle Halling washes his hands before he eats.

**Speaking Style:** Brisk and low, a cook who talks to the stewpot as much as to the customers.
**Combat Role:** none; a ladle and a kitchen full of heavy pans
**Relationship Hook:** A cook in a hot back kitchen ladling stew while she listens to the argument in the taproom through the hatch.
personality: Core: calm in a crisis, sharp after it; feeds a stranger before asking his business; scolds Kyle in the same breath she praises him
Quirk: keeps her own counsel about money

npcs.name: Mrs. Hamburgang
npcs.info:
The lady of the wealthy Hamburgang household, a soft-spoken, red-haired woman in her thirties who dresses finely and keeps a warm house. She is devoted to the family's alchemist, Jude, and treats him as one of the family.

**Speaking Style:** Soft-voiced and gracious, a lady who speaks gently even when the words are hard.
**Combat Role:** none
**Relationship Hook:** A red-haired lady watching from a window as her adopted daughter leads a blind man through the garden.
personality: Core: gracious and soft-spoken; devoted to Jude; grieves in private
Quirk: keeps a hard secret out of kindness

npcs.name: Mrs. Oakes
npcs.info:
A fishmonger in the East City market hall, loud, cheerful and sharp at a bargain. She knows the soldiers from the barracks by their appetites and their debts. She sells them fish on credit and collects on market days. She is kind to strangers and tougher than most of the officers.

**Speaking Style:** Loud and cheerful, a market woman who sells everything with a joke.
**Combat Role:** none; a fish knife and a loud voice
**Relationship Hook:** A fishmonger holding up a fish and laughing at a soldier's haggling.
personality: Core: loud, cheerful and sharp; sells on credit and collects on market days; charges the army triple
Quirk: kind to strangers

npcs.name: Mrs. Pell
npcs.info:
A miner's widow who keeps Youswell's boarding house on the square, feeding the travellers, the miners and the lieutenant's clerks alike and scolding them all for mud on her floor. She knows every rumour in town because every man in town talks at her table. She is loyal to the miners and fair to the soldiers.

**Speaking Style:** Kind but sharp-tongued, a landlady who scolds and feeds in the same breath.
**Combat Role:** none; a broom and a sharp tongue
**Relationship Hook:** A landlady scolding a miner for mud on her floor and feeding him anyway.
personality: Core: sharp-tongued and kind; feeds everyone and scolds everyone; knows every rumour in town
Quirk: keeps a spoon ready for mischief

npcs.name: Mrs. Teague
npcs.info:
The cook at the Devil's Nest bar in Dublith, who feeds the regulars and shouts at them for mess on the tables. She has cooked there for twenty years and knows every man who has come through the door. She is loud, uncompromising and fiercely loyal to whoever pays for her kitchen.

**Speaking Style:** Gruff and loud, a cook who shouts orders at the regulars and never looks up from her pan.
**Combat Role:** none; a cleaver and a loud voice
**Relationship Hook:** A cook in a smoky bar shouting at a regular for spilling soup.
personality: Core: gruff, loud and uncompromising; feeds the regulars and shouts at them; knows every face that comes through
Quirk: never looks up from the pan

npcs.name: Mu Dalang
npcs.info:
A camel driver who sleeps beside his animals in the stables and talks to them more than to people. He has crossed the sand to the old ruins and back so many times that he navigates by the taste of the wind.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and dusty, a camel driver who says three words where others say thirty.
**Combat Role:** a driver with a goad and a knife; he keeps a kneeling camel between himself and trouble
**Relationship Hook:** A camel driver sitting in the straw beside his kneeling beast, rolling a green bead between his fingers.
personality: Core: talks to his camels as to old friends; says little and remembers everything; sleeps in the straw by choice
Quirk: superstitious about the ruins of Xerxes and never camps inside them

npcs.name: Murad Sef
npcs.info:
A black-tent drover who brings herds of goats and strings of camels to the crossing for the caravan masters. He lost his season's wages in the cellar game last night and is shouting in the courtyard that the cards were marked.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, wounded and fast; he repeats himself when no one believes him.
**Combat Role:** a herder with a sling and a camel stick, fast and wild
**Relationship Hook:** A young drover shouting in a caravanserai courtyard, waving a camel stick.
personality: Core: hot-headed and honest; repeats himself; will not leave the courtyard
Quirk: frightened of his father

npcs.name: Musa Kareem
npcs.info:
A qanat digger, the last of his trade in Ishval, who goes down the shafts with a lamp, a short spade and a rope held by a priest at the top. He knows the tunnel from the hills to Daliha as other men know their own street.

**Speaking Style:** Earthy and good-humoured, a digger who talks with his hands and laughs into the dark.
**Combat Role:** a digger with a short spade in a tunnel where nobody else can swing
**Relationship Hook:** A powerful digger climbing out of a collapsed shaft, lamp in his teeth.
personality: Core: cheerful and fearless underground; trusts the man on his rope with his life; will not leave the work for long
Quirk: sings to judge the tunnel's echo

npcs.name: Nadira Asfour
npcs.info:
The master of the refugee weaving sheds, a tall woman who rescued two looms from the ruins of her house and built the trade back from them. She sets the patterns, checks every cloth and decides which go to the Reole market.

**Speaking Style:** Calm and exact, a master weaver who corrects a thread or a person in the same even tone.
**Combat Role:** none; a strong woman with a shuttle bar who protects the sheds
**Relationship Hook:** A tall weaver at an upright loom, holding a strange cloth up to the light.
personality: Core: exacting and warm; reads a cloth's border before its colour; never lets a flawed cloth leave the shed
Quirk: teaches the girls to weave and the boys too

npcs.name: Nasira
npcs.info:
An Ishvalan woman who keeps the date palms of the oasis with her family and sells the fruit to the caravans. She fled the war as a girl and has made a life at the edge of the desert where the army rarely comes. She is calm, practical and generous with shade.

**Speaking Style:** Low and calm, a palm keeper who speaks slowly in the heat.
**Combat Role:** none; a palm keeper with a hooked knife and the desert at her back
**Relationship Hook:** An Ishvalan woman carrying a basket of dates through a palm grove beside a green pool.
personality: Core: calm and practical; generous with shade and water; wary of soldiers
Quirk: prays at dusk

npcs.name: Nasreen Abboud
npcs.info:
A widow of the fighting who took over the brick kiln because nobody else knew how to keep its fire even. She has burned forearms, a man's work gloves and the memory of who carried bricks for whom, which is the only book the yard has.

**Speaking Style:** Short, practical and impatient; she gives orders like a foreman and thanks like a sister.
**Combat Role:** a strong labourer with a fire iron; she swings hard and does not back up
**Relationship Hook:** A widow with burned forearms raking the coals of a brick kiln at dusk.
personality: Core: tireless and blunt; remembers every barrow anyone has carried; will not let a child near the fire
Quirk: keeps her grief for after dark

npcs.name: Ned Bascombe
npcs.info:
An orderly of the field hospital, a bricklayer's son with big hands and a gentle manner who has carried more men off the field than anyone in his company. He sorts the wounded in the triage tent and sleeps standing up.

**Speaking Style:** Steady and kind, an orderly who talks to the wounded in a low, unbroken stream.
**Combat Role:** none by choice; he shields the wounded with his body and drags them out of the line of fire
**Relationship Hook:** A big young orderly with a white armband kneeling beside a stretcher in a lamplit tent.
personality: Core: talks to every wounded man as if they were friends; never runs, always walks quickly; cannot shoot a man and has made peace with it
Quirk: sleeps anywhere, any time

npcs.name: Neil
npcs.info:
One of the chief engineers of the research and development section at Fort Briggs, and Buccaneer's own automail mechanic. He knows cold-climate metals better than anyone in the north and loves to show visitors what the fort has built. He is laid-back, friendly and a little lovesick around any skilled mechanic who shares his passion.

**Speaking Style:** Easy and chatty, an engineer who loses track of the time talking about metals.
**Combat Role:** none much; an engineer who keeps the fort's limbs and machines running
**Relationship Hook:** An engineer in a winter uniform waving a wrench at a crocodile-jawed automail arm.
personality: Core: friendly and easygoing; talks about metal alloys for hours; brings coffee to prisoners
Quirk: admires good work openly

npcs.name: Nel Garrow
npcs.info:
A radio announcer at Radio Capital's broadcast studio in Central City, reading the news and the programmes to the city's listeners. She is crisp, quick and careful with her words, and she has learned to read what the censors leave out. She keeps a list of the stories she was not allowed to read.

**Speaking Style:** Clear and crisp, an announcer's voice that carries; she sounds like she is reading the news to a crowd.
**Combat Role:** none; a microphone and a sharp tongue
**Relationship Hook:** A radio announcer at a microphone, reading from a script with a line crossed out.
personality: Core: crisp, quick and careful; reads between the censors' lines; keeps a list of banned stories
Quirk: never raises her voice on air

npcs.name: Nils Abend
npcs.info:
An army post rider held in the raiders' cave, his hands tied in front of him and his boots taken. He is a mild, round-faced man who has spent his three days as a captive talking the raiders out of their worse ideas.

**Speaking Style:** Mild and careful; he talks to his captors the way he would talk to a skittish camel.
**Combat Role:** a post rider with a carbine, now without it; he waits
**Relationship Hook:** A round-faced soldier with tied hands sitting against a cave wall among crates of stolen goods.
personality: Core: mild and patient; talks his captors down; worried about his partner
Quirk: makes no threats

npcs.name: Nils Jettel
npcs.info:
A picker boy of nine who stands at the belt with his hand bound in rag, picking slate with the other. He lost two fingers in the gears a week ago and was back the next morning because the family needs the wage.

**Speaking Style:** Small and flat, a boy who answers as if the question were not about him.
**Combat Role:** none; he is nine
**Relationship Hook:** A small boy at a coal belt picking slate one-handed, his other hand wrapped in a rag.
personality: Core: uncomplaining and silent; picks faster than the older boys
Quirk: frightened of the gears

npcs.name: Nils Ober
npcs.info:
A recruit of seventeen, three weeks in uniform, who still writes to his mother in a farmhouse north of the city every night. He is all elbows and enthusiasm, polishes his boots twice and believes every poster he has ever seen. The older men like him and keep the worst stories from him.

**Speaking Style:** Eager and quick, a boy's voice that cracks when he is trying to sound older.
**Combat Role:** a recruit's rifle, loaded carefully and fired too high
**Relationship Hook:** A gangly recruit on a bunk writing a letter with his cap pushed back.
personality: Core: eager to please; polishes everything twice; believes the posters
Quirk: homesick and hiding it

npcs.name: Nina Tucker
npcs.info:
The young daughter of Shou Tucker, the Sewing-Life Alchemist, who lives with him and the family's big white dog Alexander in a house full of books. Her mother is gone and her father is always at his work, so the dog is her best friend. She is happy, playful and lonely, and she will love anyone who plays with her for an afternoon.

**Speaking Style:** Small and bright, a little girl who giggles and calls older boys big brother.
**Combat Role:** none; a small child who hides behind her dog
**Relationship Hook:** A small girl with long braids hugging a huge white dog in a library full of books.
personality: Core: sweet, playful and trusting; calls the brothers big brother; never leaves her dog's side
Quirk: waits up for her father every night

npcs.name: Ning Cuifen
npcs.info:
One of the two maids of the Chang consort's wing, a farm girl of the clan who has polished the same floors every day for four years. The wing has so few callers now that she can tell from the feet in the colonnade whether someone is coming to her door or walking past it.

**Speaking Style:** Small and careful, a maid's murmur that stops dead at a footstep outside.
**Combat Role:** none; she knows the wing's second door and every cupboard a girl can hide in
**Relationship Hook:** A young maid kneeling on a polished floor with her cloth gone still, listening to footsteps in the colonnade.
personality: Core: listens to footsteps the way others listen to music; devoted to the consort and too shy to show it; counts the day's callers on her fingers each evening, and lately needs none
Quirk: polishes when she is frightened

npcs.name: Nino Garra
npcs.info:
A smuggler who works the high saddle west of the pass, a small, wiry, cheerful man with mule-bells and a dozen pockets. He carries coffee north and tobacco south and, when the price is right, rifles and people either way.

**Speaking Style:** Cackling and nimble, a mountain smuggler whose talk jumps like a goat on scree.
**Combat Role:** a knife, a mountain pistol and the high ground; he never fights where he cannot run
**Relationship Hook:** A wiry, grinning smuggler with mule bells on his belt standing among stone cairns on a windy mountain saddle.
personality: Core: cheerful and nimble; carries anything for a price; proud of his code
Quirk: laughs at danger

npcs.name: Nura Haddani
npcs.info:
An old woman of Gunja who came back with her son's family and swept one courtyard clean of six years of sand. She planted a row of beans there and sits beside them in the afternoons, reciting.

**Speaking Style:** Dry, slow and singing; an old woman who recites more than she talks.
**Combat Role:** none; she sits where she is and dares anyone to move her
**Relationship Hook:** An old woman beside a single row of bean shoots, lips moving over a list of names.
personality: Core: serene and stubborn; recites the names of the dead to her beans; will not leave Gunja again
Quirk: gives every visitor water before a word

npcs.name: Odile Graves
npcs.info:
A farm girl of nineteen from south of the town who taught herself alchemy from a primer sent by post and wants, more than anything, to sit the State Alchemist examination. She is small, wiry and fearless in water. She talks about the brothers the way other girls talk about actors, and she knows to the month how old Edward Elric was when he passed.

**Speaking Style:** Bright and rushing, a young alchemist who explains a theory faster than anyone can follow.
**Combat Role:** none; she would turn the ground under a foe to mud and run
**Relationship Hook:** A wiry young woman surfacing in a green quarry pool, holding up a lantern in a jar.
personality: Core: lectures people who did not ask; fearless in cold water; idolises the Fullmetal Alchemist
Quirk: bright and reckless

npcs.name: Odo Lindgren
npcs.info:
The ferryman below the bridge, a huge, slow, tattooed man who hauls the flat ferry across the Rain River on its chain for carts, flocks and anyone who rings the bell on the landing post, eventually. He lives in a hut on stilts with his nets and a lamp. He has pulled more drowned sheep, and two drowned men, out of the river than anyone alive.

**Speaking Style:** Deep and unhurried, a ferryman who never says more than the crossing needs.
**Combat Role:** a ferry pole and fists like mallets; he grapples a man into the shallows and holds him there
**Relationship Hook:** A huge tattooed ferryman hauling on a chain at dusk while a hooded passenger waits by the bell.
personality: Core: slow and silent; never refuses a crossing; kind to children and to drowned things
Quirk: keeps no honest book

npcs.name: Old Peder
npcs.info:
The keeper of the North City ice house, who stores the winter's ice for the town's cold cellars and the army's meat. He is slow, sure and quiet, and he has kept the ice for forty winters. He knows the town's cold cellars and the soldiers who visit them.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and sure, an old keeper who measures his words the way he measures his ice.
**Combat Role:** none; an ice pick and a long winter's patience
**Relationship Hook:** An old keeper at the door of a stone ice house, lantern in hand, looking at a soldier.
personality: Core: slow, sure and quiet; measures words like ice; has kept the ice forty winters
Quirk: knows the crates he is not supposed to see

npcs.name: Old Ruo
npcs.info:
A caravan master of Xing who has crossed the great desert more times than he can count, leading strings of camels between the eastern trade towns and the Amestrian frontier. He sets the rates at the crossing and measures out the water himself. He is old, shrewd and amused by everything.

**Speaking Style:** Patient and amused, an old caravan master who answers a question with a proverb.
**Combat Role:** an old man with a long staff and a caravan of hard men
**Relationship Hook:** An old caravan master leaning on a staff in a mud-walled yard full of camels.
personality: Core: patient and amused; speaks in proverbs; measures every bucket of water
Quirk: never crosses without a reason

npcs.name: Old Sadaq
npcs.info:
A shrine keeper on the Ishvalan holy hill who climbs the pilgrim path every morning to light the summit fire. He is wiry, stubborn and sour about visitors, and he knows the hill's caves and paths better than any soldier. He has taken pilgrims up and down for forty years and has seen the army come to the foot of the hill.

**Speaking Style:** Rough and slow, a mountain man who speaks to the wind as much as to people.
**Combat Role:** none; he climbs the hill faster than any soldier
**Relationship Hook:** A sour old man at the top of a holy hill lighting a fire on the summit.
personality: Core: stubborn and sour to strangers; sings the path's prayers as he climbs; knows every cave and every crack
Quirk: helps anyone who is truly in need

npcs.name: Old Ysolde
npcs.info:
A shepherd who keeps the hill camp's flock on the pastures above the South City border, a widow of many winters who knows every path and every sheep. She is slow, gentle and wise, and she takes in travellers who need a bed for a night. She is wary of soldiers and kind to everyone else.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and gentle, a shepherd who talks to her sheep before she talks to anyone else.
**Combat Role:** none; a shepherd's crook
**Relationship Hook:** An old shepherd on a hill pasture, talking to a sheep while a dog waits.
personality: Core: slow, gentle and wise; talks to her sheep first; takes in travellers for a night
Quirk: wary of soldiers

npcs.name: Olivier Mira Armstrong
npcs.info:
Major General Olivier Mira Armstrong, thirty-seven, commander of Fort Briggs, the northern wall against Drachma, and eldest of the Armstrong children. Her men call her the wall of the north and the Ice Queen and would die for her; she would rather they lived. She believes in survival of the fittest, fights with the Armstrong family sword, and thinks her brother Alex a coward and her father a windbag.

**Speaking Style:** Cold, clipped and certain; her voice cuts through any room, amused by fools and merciless to them.
**Combat Role:** the Armstrong family sabre, fast and exact, and command of a fortress that has never fallen
**Relationship Hook:** A blonde general on the wall of a snowbound fortress, sabre on her hip, looking down at an army.
personality: Core: cold, precise and cutting; merciless to the weak, fierce for her soldiers; never retreats
Quirk: contemptuous of Central's politics

npcs.name: Omar Qaddour
npcs.info:
The eldest of the priests who stayed in the hermitage caves, a lean old man who keeps the Grand Cleric's cell as he left it: the mat rolled, the lamp trimmed, the prayer stone set square. He climbs the rope ladders like a man half his age.

**Speaking Style:** Gentle and sorrowful, an old priest's soft voice that grows firm on a single word.
**Combat Role:** a warrior priest's art grown old; he fights from the ladders and the ledges where youth means little
**Relationship Hook:** An old priest trimming a lamp in a bare cave cell where no one sleeps.
personality: Core: sorrowful and steady; climbs the ladders every dawn; speaks the Grand Cleric's sayings when he cannot find his own
Quirk: keeps the cell as the Grand Cleric left it

npcs.name: Osric Wynn
npcs.info:
The lineman who winters at the relay hut on stilts beside the pass, with a dog, a stove and a stack of spare wire. He climbs the iced poles alone to clear the line and has the frostbitten fingertips to show for it.

**Speaking Style:** Chatty and amused, a lonely man who has saved up a winter of jokes for the first visitor.
**Combat Role:** a lineman with a climbing spike and wire cutters; he fights from up a pole if he can
**Relationship Hook:** A ginger-bearded lineman halfway up an iced telegraph pole while his dog barks at its foot.
personality: Core: talks to his dog more than to people; taps along to any rhythm he hears; keeps a diary in shorthand
Quirk: laughs at his own jokes

npcs.name: Oswin Treck
npcs.info:
The commandant of the prisoner compound, a major with a gardener's hands and a banker's smile. His compound is the tidiest in the south: whitewashed huts, a vegetable plot and a roll call that is never late. Visiting inspectors leave impressed.

**Speaking Style:** Cool and pleasant, a commandant who makes every bargain sound like a favour.
**Combat Role:** an officer's sabre and a cavalryman's pistol, both well kept and seldom used
**Relationship Hook:** A trim major smiling at a wire gate with gardening gloves in his belt and a clipboard in hand.
personality: Core: pleasant, patient and greedy; keeps a perfect garden
Quirk: never lies on paper when a blank will do

npcs.name: Otmar Feist
npcs.info:
The lieutenant's clerk, a corporal with ink on his cuffs who has not carried a rifle in six years. He writes the notices, sets the levies and keeps the strongbox key on a chain round his neck. He is never rude and never moved.

**Speaking Style:** Precise and bloodless, a clerk who reads out a family's ruin as if it were a weather report.
**Combat Role:** a service pistol he has not cleaned in years, and a locked door
**Relationship Hook:** A spectacled corporal blotting a book page as a queue of miners shuffles past his barred window.
personality: Core: polite and pitiless; never raises his voice; secretly terrified of debt
Quirk: counts everything twice

npcs.name: Ottavio Rinaldi
npcs.info:
The general commanding the Aerugonian army before Fotset, a heavy, white-whiskered man of sixty-five with forty years in the red coat. He has held this front against a larger army by patience and stubbornness. His officers revere him and fear his silences.

**Speaking Style:** Heavy, slow and certain, an old general who has stopped needing to raise his voice.
**Combat Role:** an army at his word; in person, an old sabre and a steady pistol
**Relationship Hook:** A heavy white-whiskered general in a red coat leaning over a map table in a canvas pavilion.
personality: Core: patient and stubborn; speaks little; loves his soldiers as sons
Quirk: carries the blame for orders not his own

npcs.name: Ottmar Fenn
npcs.info:
The master of the city coal yard, who weighs out the coal that keeps every stove in North City burning. He is small, black with dust and always grinning, and everybody in the city has a story about him cheating them.

**Speaking Style:** Sharp, quick and grinning, a coal merchant who laughs at his own bargains.
**Combat Role:** none; a coal shovel, a weighbridge pit, and coalmen who carry for him
**Relationship Hook:** A small coal merchant grinning as he slides a weight along the weighbridge beam.
personality: Core: grinning and greedy; laughs at his own bargains; fears soldiers and loves widows' money
Quirk: never weighs his own coal

npcs.name: Otto Brandl
npcs.info:
The yard foreman has turned engines in the pit for thirty years and can hear a cracked wheel before any fitter finds it. He is a railwayman, not a soldier, and he lets the officers know it; the yard runs on his whistle and his temper, and the troop trains leave on time because he takes it personally when they do not.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and gravelled, every sentence pitched to carry over a hissing engine; he calls each locomotive 'she' and every soldier 'son'.
**Combat Role:** none worth the name; a shunting pole swung like a quarterstaff and the bulk of a man who lifts couplings
**Relationship Hook:** A grey-moustached foreman blowing a whistle as an engine creaks round on the turntable behind him.
personality: Core: gruff with officers and patient with engines; never raises his voice when a whistle will do; remembers the name of every driver who died on the border line
Quirk: keeps his own counts and trusts no book but his

npcs.name: Ottokar Vinn
npcs.info:
A collector from the capital in a linen suit and a pith helmet, who sits in the roofless weighhouse with a set of jeweller's scales and buys every old brass weight the refugee children dig out of the stall drains. He labels each one in a tiny hand and calls the desert 'the field'.

**Speaking Style:** Precise and a little prim; he corrects his own grammar mid-sentence and apologises for the heat.
**Combat Role:** none; a scholar with a walking stick who hides behind the nearest counter
**Relationship Hook:** A man in a linen suit weighing a green brass weight on tiny scales in a roofless hall.
personality: Core: fussy and polite; pays children fairly and writes down their names; cannot resist an argument about dates
Quirk: keeps his collar buttoned in any heat

npcs.name: Ou Jingshan
npcs.info:
Senior warden of the consorts' court. Ou Jingshan writes every visitor down twice, once in the book the palace reads and once in a book of her own, and no caller from any clan has ever seen her smile.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped and exact, spelling out each name as she writes it down.
**Combat Role:** none; a bell cord to the guardhouse and a stare that has stopped princes at the door
**Relationship Hook:** A warden in grey writing a visitor's name for the second time without looking up.
personality: Core: writes every name twice and checks the one against the other; addresses consorts by their clan, never by name; keeps her brush wet even in winter
Quirk: has no friends at court on principle

npcs.name: Ouyang Gen
npcs.info:
A root digger of the ginseng slopes, a gaunt man with a bone pick and a broken arm in a sling, who came down to the camp yesterday with a root shaped like a man wrapped in moss in his good hand.

**Speaking Style:** Rough and tight with pain, a root digger talking through a broken arm.
**Combat Role:** a digger with a bone pick and one good arm; he fights dirty and short
**Relationship Hook:** A gaunt digger with his arm in a sling, clutching a man-shaped root wrapped in moss.
personality: Core: holds the root to his chest; speaks through his teeth; trusts nobody with a bone pick
Quirk: tells the story of the fall differently each time

npcs.name: Pan Jiuling
npcs.info:
The hereditary keeper of the truce bridge, whose family has stood on its steps for generations to count each side's men and see that the numbers match. He is unarmed by law on the bridge and armed to the teeth off it.

**Speaking Style:** Even and slow, a mediator's voice that gives each side the same number of words.
**Combat Role:** a bridge warden with a hooked staff off the bridge and his bare hands on it; he breaks a fight up rather than wins it
**Relationship Hook:** A warden in a white sash standing between two sets of steps on a humped stone bridge, counting.
personality: Core: counts every party twice; gives each side the same number of words; unarmed on the bridge and never off it
Quirk: cannot meet the eye of a widow from the last truce

npcs.name: Pang Shouyi
npcs.info:
The counter-man of the dried-goods house is a pleasant fellow with an abacus and a habit of telling customers that the dates are out of season. Pang Shouyi decides who reaches the back room, and most people never learn there is one.

**Speaking Style:** Pleasant and apologetic, the shop voice of a man sorry the dates are not better.
**Combat Role:** none; a heavy abacus and the bolt on the back-room door
**Relationship Hook:** A counter-man sliding beads on an abacus and apologising that the dates are out of season.
personality: Core: apologises for the thin stock with real feeling; never says the master's name aloud; feeds the guides as if they were his sons
Quirk: taps the abacus when he lies

npcs.name: Paninya
npcs.info:
The most famous thief in Rush Valley, a nimble, tanned girl in her mid teens with short dark hair who lifts pocket watches and wallets and runs over rooftops on two automail legs. She is cheerful, cheeky and nearly impossible to catch, and she sells what she steals to a collector's shop in town.

**Speaking Style:** Bright, bouncy and quick, a thief's cheek that turns serious when she talks about the train.
**Combat Role:** acrobatics on automail legs, a hidden shin blade and a concealed carbine
**Relationship Hook:** A girl on automail legs leaping across a rooftop with a stolen pocket watch.
personality: Core: bright, quick and cheeky; can't be caught on foot; loves Dominic like a father
Quirk: goes serious at the mention of the train

npcs.name: Paolo Brisa
npcs.info:
A sergeant of an Aerugonian patrol that works the gullies between the lines, a lean, laughing man with a pipe and a rifle that has been in the family for two wars. He hates officers of every nation and likes most soldiers.

**Speaking Style:** Easy and amused, an Aerugonian sergeant whose Amestrian is good, slangy and learned in trenches.
**Combat Role:** an old family rifle and a gully fighter's patience; he shoots from cover and moves
**Relationship Hook:** A lean Aerugonian sergeant with a pipe crouched in a red ravine, rifle across his knees.
personality: Core: easy and amused; hates officers of every nation; trades news like tobacco
Quirk: keeps his word

npcs.name: Pavel Sorn
npcs.info:
The apprentice at Frostworks Automail, fourteen, who runs the cold test shed where limbs are left out overnight to see what freezes. He is clumsy everywhere except at a workbench, where his hands go quiet and certain.

**Speaking Style:** Breathless and squeaky, an apprentice whose voice has not quite finished breaking.
**Combat Role:** none; a screwdriver and the fastest legs in the workshop
**Relationship Hook:** An apprentice in a frosty shed fitting a tiny steel leg to a patient dog.
personality: Core: clumsy and cheerful; goes quiet and certain at a bench; names every limb he works on
Quirk: adores his master

npcs.name: Pelle Hagberg
npcs.info:
One of the sentries who stand their hour in the lowest vault beneath the fort with a lamp, a rifle and orders to report any sound from below. He is nineteen, talks too much to stay calm, and draws the duty more than his share because he never complains.

**Speaking Style:** Fast and chatty, filling every silence because the silence is worse.
**Combat Role:** a young rifleman with a steady hand on the range and a shaking one here; he fires fast and keeps the lamp between himself and the hole
**Relationship Hook:** A freckled sentry with a rifle across his chest staring down at a crack in the vault floor, lips moving as he counts.
personality: Core: chatters to fill a silence; counts falling stones under his breath; pats Smith's horse at the stables on his way past
Quirk: cannot stand with his back to the dark

npcs.name: Pepi Sauter
npcs.info:
The lift boy at Brenner's Department Store, fifteen, in a pillbox hat and a jacket with too many buttons, who runs the electric lift from ground to roof and back two hundred times a day. Between rides he slips down to the loading bay to smoke with the porters. He knows every clerk, counter girl and shoplifter in the store.

**Speaking Style:** Quick and cheeky, a boy who talks back to floorwalkers and gets away with it.
**Combat Role:** none; a quick boy who runs, hides and squeezes through gaps no grown man fits
**Relationship Hook:** A freckled lift boy in a pillbox hat crouching behind a stack of sealed crates in a loading bay, watching a basement door.
personality: Core: cheeky, quick and loyal; knows every back stair; pretends nothing scares him
Quirk: keeps a list of everyone who rides the lift

npcs.name: Percy Leddy
npcs.info:
A new private from the latest draft out of Central, given a bunk in the coldest tier and no explanation. He is polite, homesick and badly underdressed, and he writes to his mother every night on the back of the mess menu.

**Speaking Style:** Polite, soft and a little breathless, a city boy apologising before he begins.
**Combat Role:** a city boy with a rifle he cleans better than he fires; he stands his ground because he does not yet know how to run in snow
**Relationship Hook:** A shivering young private writing a letter by lamplight on the top bunk of a cold barrack room.
personality: Core: apologises before he speaks; writes a letter every night; wears every garment he owns at once
Quirk: laughs nervously at barrack jokes he does not understand

npcs.name: Philip Gargantos Armstrong
npcs.info:
The former patriarch of the Armstrong family, a retired general and father of Olivier, Alex and three other daughters. He is tall and broad, with slicked blond hair, a curly beard, the family curl and long lashes, and he sparkles a little like his son. He is a windbag who tells the family's glorious history to anyone trapped near him, and also, under the bluster, a shrewd old soldier.

**Speaking Style:** A grand, rolling, windy voice that turns every remark into a story about his ancestors.
**Combat Role:** an old general's Armstrong strength, slow and heavy
**Relationship Hook:** A bearded old gentleman holding forth about his ancestors to a trapped guest.
personality: Core: grand and courtly; shrewd under the bluster; afraid of his eldest daughter
Quirk: a windbag about the family's glory

npcs.name: Philippa Marsh
npcs.info:
The landlady of the coaching inn on the north road keeps the best cider in the West and the warmest fire on the road. She is a handsome widow of fifty who runs the inn alone and treats every traveller as a guest she has been expecting.

**Speaking Style:** Bright and warm, a landlady's welcome with a faint foreign lilt she has never quite lost.
**Combat Role:** none; a cellar door bolted from inside, and a cider cask rolled down the stairs if it came to that
**Relationship Hook:** A handsome auburn-haired landlady pouring cider in a cool cellar of casks.
personality: Core: welcoming to everyone; keeps the best cider on the road; a faint foreign lilt she cannot lose
Quirk: nervous of soldiers and hides it well

npcs.name: Philippa Sachs
npcs.info:
The landlady of the officers' billet, a widow of a cavalry captain who has rented her house to the army for twenty years. She meets every new arrival in the letter hall, looks at his luggage, and decides on the spot how long he will stay.

**Speaking Style:** Crisp and amused, an old landlady who has heard every excuse an officer can make and enjoys the new ones.
**Combat Role:** none; a heavy brass bell and a voice that can shame a colonel
**Relationship Hook:** An old landlady in black weighing up a young officer's single battered trunk.
personality: Core: sharp-eyed and entertained by everyone; rings her bell for no reason, to see who comes; judges a man by his luggage
Quirk: softens at once for a homesick boy

npcs.name: Piet Lorenz
npcs.info:
The sexton of North City's cemetery, who digs the graves when the snow allows and keeps the yews trimmed. He has buried soldiers from the fort since he was a boy. He is soft-spoken, sad and patient, and he reads the names on the stones every morning as a kind of prayer.

**Speaking Style:** Thin and melancholy, a sexton who speaks softly, as if not to wake anyone.
**Combat Role:** none; an old man with a spade
**Relationship Hook:** A thin sexton leaning on his spade among snowy graves under the yews.
personality: Core: soft-spoken and sad; reads the names every morning; patient with the grieving
Quirk: keeps the yews trimmed

npcs.name: Pim Aldous
npcs.info:
A recruit of seventeen from a beet farm on the plain, big for his age and gentle with it. He enlisted because his elder brother did, and he carries his brother's letters in his tunic though he cannot read them.

**Speaking Style:** Young and careful, a farm boy's slow speech, always asking if he has understood rightly.
**Combat Role:** a green rifleman; he shoots straight on the range and has never fired at a man
**Relationship Hook:** A big freckled recruit holding out a folded letter with an anxious, hopeful face.
personality: Core: shy and earnest; says thank you for everything, even orders
Quirk: ashamed that he never learned his letters

npcs.name: Pim Ardley
npcs.info:
A skinny boy of twelve from Dublith who has rowed himself out to Yock Island with a knife, a ball of string and a heel of bread, to prove he can do what two other boys did years ago. He has been on the island four days, is badly sunburnt and is building a raft out of white driftwood with string that is far too thin.

**Speaking Style:** High and defiant, a boy who shouts to sound brave and cracks when he is tired.
**Combat Role:** none; a pocketknife held the wrong way and a great deal of shouting
**Relationship Hook:** A sunburnt boy tying driftwood together on a stony shore and glaring at the town across the water.
personality: Core: brave out loud, frightened underneath; quotes the old men's story like scripture; talks to the gulls
Quirk: won't admit to being hungry

npcs.name: Pim Lorre
npcs.info:
A private of nineteen from a farm in the east, posted to Youswell because nobody else wanted the post. He guards the lockup, sleeps through most of it and has made more friends in town than the rest of the garrison together.

**Speaking Style:** Cheeky and quick, a young private who cannot keep a grin off his face for long.
**Combat Role:** a rifle he fires badly and a pair of quick legs
**Relationship Hook:** A freckled young private grinning through the bars of a cell he is supposed to be guarding.
personality: Core: cheerful and careless; a terrible liar
Quirk: sides with the miners without thinking about it

npcs.name: Pinako Rockbell
npcs.info:
Winry's grandmother, a tiny old woman with a pipe who runs Rockbell Automail in Resembool and has fitted limbs for half the east. She is blunt, sharp-tongued and fond of the Elric boys in her own way, and she fitted Edward's first automail herself. She once drank with the boys' father, and she is the one adult in Resembool who still calls Hohenheim a friend. Den, the dog with the automail leg, follows her everywhere.

**Speaking Style:** Dry, blunt and old, a gravelly rasp that teases and grumbles round the stem of her pipe; she sounds amused far more often than cross.
**Combat Role:** none; a forge hammer and the authority of a woman nobody argues with
**Relationship Hook:** A tiny old woman with a pipe at a forge door, glaring at a boy who has broken his arm again.
personality: Core: dry, teasing and blunt; hides her affection behind insults; does not suffer fools or slow work
Quirk: never without her pipe

npcs.name: Pu Xiaolan
npcs.info:
She sells noodle soup from a carrying pole on Lantern Street until the last lantern gutters, and she knows which servants slip out of which clan houses after dark, because they all stop at her pot. Pu Xiaolan is round, loud and impossible to embarrass.

**Speaking Style:** Loud and warm, calling the soup over the street noise and dropping to a whisper for gossip.
**Combat Role:** none; a ladle, a pot of scalding broth and a voice that brings the whole street running
**Relationship Hook:** A soup seller lifting the lid of a steaming pot under a row of red paper lanterns.
personality: Core: calls everyone little brother or little sister whatever their rank; remembers how each regular takes the broth; softens at once for anyone who looks hungry
Quirk: sells the same rumour twice and never to the same house

npcs.name: Qiao Dingxiang
npcs.info:
A shipping agent under one of the awnings on the row, a neat woman in her thirties who keeps her passage book in a locked box and her opinions to herself. Her junks carry tea and silk down the coast, and now and then a family.

**Speaking Style:** Crisp and courteous, the cool voice of someone selling something that does not officially exist.
**Combat Role:** none; a sampan at the foot of the steps and the tide tables in her head
**Relationship Hook:** A shipping agent under a canvas awning, a locked book under her arm and her eyes on the harbour tower.
personality: Core: polite to everyone and familiar with nobody; keeps the passage book locked even when she is writing in it; reads the letter from the far shore when business is slow
Quirk: never takes a booking from a family with small children, and has broken that rule twice

npcs.name: Qiao Wen
npcs.info:
A Xingese trader of no fixed clan who keeps a bedroll in the signal tower and a stack of brushwood on its roof. He sells tea and gossip to the diggers and says he is waiting for his cousins' caravan.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth and light, a smuggler who smiles while he lies and smiles more when he tells the truth.
**Combat Role:** a smuggler with throwing knives in his sleeves, who fights only to get to the stair
**Relationship Hook:** A slim Xingese man lighting a fire in a stone bowl on a tower roof at dusk.
personality: Core: charming and evasive; pours tea for everyone; watches the east at dusk
Quirk: keeps his brushwood dry

npcs.name: Qiu Mingyuan
npcs.info:
The court's translator for western guests, a young clerk who learned the Amestrian tongue from smugglers' books and a single Amestrian dictionary he keeps wrapped in silk. He has spoken to perhaps four westerners in his life and remembers every word of every conversation.

**Speaking Style:** Eager and earnest, trying out Amestrian words with visible pride.
**Combat Role:** none; he talks, and when talking fails he runs for the guards
**Relationship Hook:** A young clerk on the courtyard's single bench, reading an Amestrian dictionary aloud to the carp.
personality: Core: practises Amestrian greetings to the carp; wraps his dictionary in silk; nervous with officials and fearless with foreigners
Quirk: longs to see a railway

npcs.name: Qu Fengyan
npcs.info:
The storyteller of the Hall of Nine Cups Teahouse, who sits on the dais every evening with a fan and a wooden clapper and tells the court's scandals dressed as the legends of dead dynasties. Half the capital comes to hear him, and the other half sends servants to take notes.

**Speaking Style:** Rich and theatrical, rising and falling with the tale, then a sudden snap of the clapper.
**Combat Role:** none; a folding fan of iron ribs he has never had to open in anger, and a full room on his side
**Relationship Hook:** A storyteller on a raised dais snapping a wooden clapper while a packed teahouse leans in.
personality: Core: snaps the clapper at the moment a listener leans forward; never tells the same tale twice the same way; flatters his audience and despises the court
Quirk: drinks only cold tea on the dais

npcs.name: Quirin Achenbach
npcs.info:
Chief engineer of the pumping station on the weir, a lean, careful man in a collar and tie under his overalls who keeps the beam engine rocking and the city's drains from backing up in the spring floods. He has walked nearly every tunnel under East City with a lamp and a chalk, and the city's surveyors borrow his maps rather than draw their own.

**Speaking Style:** Calm and methodical, an engineer who explains everything in pressures, valves and what happens next.
**Combat Role:** none; a long spanner, steel nerves and a lever that can flood a tunnel
**Relationship Hook:** A lean engineer with a spanner looking up at a vast rocking beam engine in a brick hall.
personality: Core: calm, methodical, unexcitable; pats the engine's frame when he passes it; trusts a gauge before a man
Quirk: insists he does not believe in anything he cannot measure

npcs.name: Quirin Mauss
npcs.info:
The owner of the alchemy shop in the Booksellers' Arcade, a pale, bony man in a green coat who failed the state examination three times and has been selling the books that defeated him ever since. He knows more alchemy than most who passed, transmutes behind his counter for a fee, and is charming to customers he wants and cold to the rest.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and amused, a dealer who lowers his voice whenever he has something worth selling.
**Combat Role:** an unlicensed alchemist; he claps nothing, draws fast chalk circles on the floor and turns the shelves into walls and spikes
**Relationship Hook:** A bony bookseller in a green coat leaning on his counter, sliding a scorched book toward a customer with one finger.
personality: Core: charming, bitter and greedy; despises State Alchemists and envies them; never gives a straight answer
Quirk: keeps his best books where only he can reach them

npcs.name: Radomir Sava
npcs.info:
The major commanding the Cretan hill fort is a grey, elegant officer of an old tribal family who has held the knoll across from Pendleton for four years. His single mountain gun points at the town, and the Amestrian garrison has learned to fear it.

**Speaking Style:** Deep and courtly, a Cretan major who speaks Amestrian perfectly and very slowly, savouring each threat.
**Combat Role:** a cavalry officer's sabre and a long-barrelled pistol; he duels as if on a parade ground and wins
**Relationship Hook:** A silver-bearded Cretan major on a stone rampart beside a mountain gun, raising a parley flag.
personality: Core: courtly and patient; bluffs with total calm; proud of his family and his tribe
Quirk: cares for his men more than for his orders

npcs.name: Rafiq Samaan
npcs.info:
A young Ishvalan with a satchel of paper and a stub of pencil who comes to the scholar's ruined house and copies the chalk diagrams line by line before the rain can wear them away. He has studied the Amestrian art from stolen books.

**Speaking Style:** Low and precise, a scholar's careful voice with something hard under it.
**Combat Role:** a novice alchemist with chalk and a knife; he draws fast and runs if it fails
**Relationship Hook:** A young man in round glasses copying chalk circles from a crumbling wall before the rain.
personality: Core: studious and fervent; carries the notebooks against his chest; will not let anyone touch the wall
Quirk: copies every line before he tries to understand it

npcs.name: Ragnvald Drav
npcs.info:
A trapper who works the high bowls east of the fort and has never been caught in a whiteout. He is small, bent and secretive, and when soldiers ask how he gets down from the cirque in a blizzard he says he follows his nose.

**Speaking Style:** Thin and wheedling, answering questions with questions and chuckling at other men's mistakes.
**Combat Role:** a trapper's ambush; a snare across the path, a skinning knife, and a fall arranged for the other man
**Relationship Hook:** A small bent trapper setting a stone on a half-buried cairn and glancing back to see if he is watched.
personality: Core: answers questions with other questions; counts cairns aloud on the way down; trusts nobody near his traps
Quirk: laughs a little too long at other men's mistakes

npcs.name: Rahel Daoud
npcs.info:
A young Ishvalan woman of the refugee band who walks to the stranger's temple at dusk to pray, since its dome is the only roof in the ruins that still feels holy to her. She keeps her headwrap on inside and her shoes off, and she prays to Ishvala in a building raised for some older god.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and level, a young woman who chooses each word as if it cost water.
**Combat Role:** none; she keeps still and lets the echo cover her retreat
**Relationship Hook:** A young woman kneeling under a ruined blue dome, a strip of cloth covered in writing across her lap.
personality: Core: devout and private; will not argue about faith with anyone; shares her dates with the pigeons
Quirk: counts the carved names under her breath

npcs.name: Rasha Mansour
npcs.info:
A goat-herding mother of the wandering camp who keeps the tether line and the camp's milk, and whose two sons left a month ago. She goes on milking the goats at the same hour, twice a day, and does not talk about them.

**Speaking Style:** Hard and low, a mother's voice held level by effort.
**Combat Role:** a herder with a knife and a sling; she does not waste a stone
**Relationship Hook:** A mother milking a goat beside a tether line, eyes on the road east.
personality: Core: controlled and fierce; milks the goats at the same hour whatever happens; refuses pity
Quirk: watches the eastern road at dusk

npcs.name: Raven
npcs.info:
Lieutenant General Raven, an elite of Central High Command, a tall, broad-chested old man with tanned skin, short white hair and a silver beard. He is jovial and full of compliments, puts nervous juniors at their ease, and has a weakness for beautiful women.

**Speaking Style:** Jovial, complimentary and oily, an old general who flatters a junior while he decides his fate.
**Combat Role:** none worth the name; the authority of the top brass
**Relationship Hook:** A jovial old general clapping a colonel on the shoulder and leading him into a room full of generals.
personality: Core: jovial and flattering; says too much when provoked; vain about his vigour
Quirk: weak for a beautiful woman

npcs.name: Rebecca Catalina
npcs.info:
Second Lieutenant Rebecca Catalina of the eastern command, Riza Hawkeye's close friend, with long black hair and an endless complaint about her single life. She wants to land a handsome man and retire early, and she says so constantly. She is also as good a soldier as Havoc or Hawkeye, with a rifle, a mortar or a grenade launcher.

**Speaking Style:** Bright, chatty and complaining, a woman who talks about men in the middle of a firefight.
**Combat Role:** a rifle, a pistol and heavy weapons, aimed fire at range
**Relationship Hook:** A lieutenant loading a grenade launcher and complaining that there are no decent men in Central.
personality: Core: Riza's close friend; a far better soldier than she lets on; loves a heavy weapon
Quirk: chatty and complaining about men

npcs.name: Receptionist
npcs.info:
A receptionist in the lobby of Central Command, beside the telephones the officers borrow. She keeps the lobby in order and the visitors in line, and she has heard Maes Hughes describe his daughter down the line more times than she can count. She scolds him for it and likes him anyway.

**Speaking Style:** Brisk and long-suffering, a desk clerk who sighs before she answers.
**Combat Role:** none; a clerk at a desk with a telephone and a first-aid box
**Relationship Hook:** A receptionist sighing at an officer who has borrowed her telephone again.
personality: Core: brisk and tidy; scolds officers who misuse the telephone; secretly fond of the regulars
Quirk: worries more than she shows

npcs.name: Regina Maier
npcs.info:
The senior operator at the South City Telephone Exchange, who runs the board that carries the calls to the front. She is twenty-eight, sharp as a pin and never seems to listen, which is why the generals talk so freely on her lines. She has worked the board since before the war and knows every officer by the first word he speaks.

**Speaking Style:** Crisp and level, an operator's voice that says 'connecting you' and means nothing else by it.
**Combat Role:** none; a headset cord and a quick hand on the alarm bell
**Relationship Hook:** A poised operator plugging a cord into a tall switchboard, eyes on nothing.
personality: Core: never seems to be listening; recognises any voice from one word; sharp-tongued off the board
Quirk: keeps a list of oddities in shorthand

npcs.name: Reinald Steen
npcs.info:
Master of the stone quarry, a short, broad man deafened in one ear by black powder, who cuts a few blocks a month for walls, gateposts and the odd headstone blank for Bertil Sennholz. He works the face with three men and a timber crane and shouts everything. The town's old houses came out of his hill, and he likes to point at them.

**Speaking Style:** Hoarse and blunt, a quarryman who shouts by habit because the drills taught him to.
**Combat Role:** a quarryman's pick, and a stick of black powder he would only ever use on stone
**Relationship Hook:** A short, broad quarryman bellowing up at a crane, pick on his shoulder.
personality: Core: proud of every old wall in town; fond of powder and careful with it; superstitious about the drowned workings
Quirk: shouts everything

npcs.name: Reinhold Gast
npcs.info:
The quarry master of the limestone workings, a huge, dusty man who has cut stone for the south's barracks, churches and memorials for twenty years. He handles blasting powder like bread dough and is proud that his face has never dropped a stone on the wrong man.

**Speaking Style:** A big, dust-choked voice built for shouting warnings down a quarry face.
**Combat Role:** a sledgehammer and a quarryman's strength; he can bring down a wall
**Relationship Hook:** A huge dust-covered quarry master with a sledgehammer at the foot of a pale limestone cliff.
personality: Core: big and boastful; loyal to his quarrymen
Quirk: careful with powder, careless with money

npcs.name: Reinhold Grieg
npcs.info:
The glassmaker of the kilns, a big sardonic man with burn scars on his forearms who turns white sand into bottles, lamp chimneys and panes. His glass is the clearest in the east, and he will not say how.

**Speaking Style:** Dry and sour; every sentence sounds like the end of an argument he won long ago.
**Combat Role:** a former State Alchemist of glass and sand; he melts the ground to a slick and shatters it into blades
**Relationship Hook:** A big scarred glassmaker turning a glowing blob of glass on a blowpipe before a round kiln.
personality: Core: sardonic and proud; works the kilns day and night; despises uniforms
Quirk: kind to apprentices

npcs.name: Reinhold Saxe
npcs.info:
The army's horse buyer for the north, a red-faced captain who chooses the strongest horses at the monthly fair for the supply trains. Dealers love him, farmers curse him, and he has never bought a lame horse in his life.

**Speaking Style:** Hearty and loud, an army buyer who calls every dealer 'my friend' and every horse 'a beauty'.
**Combat Role:** a cavalry officer with a sabre and a pistol; best on horseback, mediocre on foot
**Relationship Hook:** A red-faced captain with a riding crop pointing out a horse in a muddy sale ring.
personality: Core: hearty and loud; knows horses better than men; takes a fee and gives a smile
Quirk: hates cruelty to animals

npcs.name: Reinhold Wehle
npcs.info:
The sergeant in charge of the army post on the east road, a grizzled man in a sweat-stained blue uniform who sits on the porch with his chair tipped against the wall and his rifle across his knees. He signs the passes, breaks up the fights and is called by the townspeople only the sergeant.

**Speaking Style:** Flat and tired, a sergeant's bark worn down to a mutter; he finishes every sentence by looking away.
**Combat Role:** a veteran rifleman; he fires from the porch sandbags and holds the doorway
**Relationship Hook:** A grizzled sergeant tipped back in a chair behind a sandbagged doorway, not looking at the street.
personality: Core: dutiful and ashamed; obeys every written order to the letter; cannot look a townsperson in the eye
Quirk: tips his chair back when he wants to end a talk

npcs.name: Reinhold Weil
npcs.info:
The drill sergeant of the western barracks has turned farm boys into riflemen for eleven years. He shouts because the square is wide, not because he is angry, and every recruit learns by the second week that his worst punishment is a quiet word in private.

**Speaking Style:** A parade-ground bark that drops into a low, almost kind murmur when he corrects a single man.
**Combat Role:** a bayonet drill instructor; textbook thrusts and parries made dangerous by twenty years of practice
**Relationship Hook:** A moustached drill sergeant shouting across a dusty parade square at dawn.
personality: Core: loud on the square and gentle off it; never calls a recruit stupid, only slow; keeps a notebook he will not show anyone
Quirk: eats with his men rather than in the sergeants' room

npcs.name: Reinmar Gaskell
npcs.info:
Captain of railway transport for the eastern command, a hard, sunburnt officer who can put a full battalion and its horses on the rails before the men have finished complaining. He lives in the yard office more than in his quarters, with three telegraph keys, a stove and the loading tables of every regiment in the east chalked on the walls. He was a lieutenant on the trains to Ishval and has never talked about what he loaded on the trains coming back.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped, flat and exact, a transport officer who talks in times, numbers and wagon counts.
**Combat Role:** a field officer with a carbine and a sabre he knows how to use, who fights from behind a wagon wheel and makes every man around him fight the same way
**Relationship Hook:** A hard-faced captain in his shirtsleeves chalking wagon counts on a board while three telegraph keys chatter at once.
personality: Core: exact to the minute and impatient with anyone who is not; respects engine drivers more than majors; smokes only when a train is late; dislikes the capital's officers on principle
Quirk: sleeps four hours and calls it plenty

npcs.name: Resi Klamm
npcs.info:
A hewer's wife who stands at the pithead yard every evening with her apron full of knitting until the cage brings her man up. The other wives have stopped teasing her about it. She knits socks she gives away to the lodging house.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and level, a voice that only shakes when she says her husband's name.
**Combat Role:** none; she has never struck anyone
**Relationship Hook:** A young wife knitting at a pithead yard, eyes fixed on the cable as the cage climbs.
personality: Core: knits without looking; remembers every name on the tally board
Quirk: patient past bearing

npcs.name: Rich Couple
npcs.info:
A wealthy couple who turn up again and again across the country, dressed too well for every town, and who are forever having their car taken from them at gunpoint. They first appear outside a jeweller's in Rush Valley.

**Speaking Style:** Affected and chatty, a lady who complains loudly about everything.
**Combat Role:** none
**Relationship Hook:** A rich couple in fine clothes watching their car drive away with a stranger at the wheel.
personality: Core: vain and chatty; complain loudly; never learn
Quirk: lose their car again and again

npcs.name: Richard
npcs.info:
Richard, an infantryman stationed in East City under Grumman, a veteran who served in Roy Mustang's squad in the Ishval war. He is a staunch family man with a wife back east, steady in a fight and skilled at guerrilla work.

**Speaking Style:** Plain, warm and practical, a family man who talks about home.
**Combat Role:** sidearms and guerrilla tactics
**Relationship Hook:** A soldier showing a comrade a letter from his wife before a fight.
personality: Core: warm and practical; steady in a fight; loyal to Mustang
Quirk: talks about his wife

npcs.name: Rick
npcs.info:
A shrewd fourteen-year-old Ishvalan boy with red eyes, white hair, a bandanna and a missing tooth, who lives in the slums at the edge of East City. Life as an Ishvalan in Amestris has made him hard: he would rob a stranger as soon as look at him, unless the stranger is one of his own people.

**Speaking Style:** Quick, shrewd and street-wise, a boy who scolds an invalid twice his size without fear.
**Combat Role:** none worth the name; quick hands and quicker feet
**Relationship Hook:** A boy with a missing tooth wagging a finger at a huge scarred man doing push-ups too soon.
personality: Core: shrewd and street-wise; fiercely loyal to his own people; impressed by a tattooed arm
Quirk: scolds adults without fear

npcs.name: Ridel LeCoulte
npcs.info:
An automail engineer of Rush Valley, Dominic's son, who lives and works with his father in the hills on the outskirts of town. He is calm and friendly where his father is gruff, and his wife Satella is about to have their first child.

**Speaking Style:** Calm and warm, a craftsman who explains every bolt and panics only when his wife is in labour.
**Combat Role:** none; a fitting bench and a steady hand
**Relationship Hook:** An automail engineer at a fitting bench, glancing at his heavily pregnant wife.
personality: Core: calm and friendly; explains every bolt; keeps the peace with his father
Quirk: devoted to his wife

npcs.name: Ridel's Son
npcs.info:
The infant son of Ridel and Satella LeCoulte, born early in a thunderstorm in the family's house on the outskirts of Rush Valley, with Winry Rockbell as midwife. He has light brown hair and fair skin, and his grandfather dotes on him.

**Speaking Style:** A newborn's cries, loud and bright, and nothing else.
**Combat Role:** none; a newborn
**Relationship Hook:** A newborn wrapped in a blanket, held up by a tearful grandfather.
personality: Core: loud; the family's joy; wakes the house at night
Quirk: sleeps in his grandfather's arms

npcs.name: Riza Hawkeye
npcs.info:
Riza Hawkeye, first lieutenant, Mustang's adjutant and bodyguard and the best shot in the army. She keeps his schedule, makes him do his paperwork and covers his back with a rifle or a pair of pistols. She is calm, disciplined and kind in a dry way, and she trains her dog Black Hayate with warning shots.

**Speaking Style:** Cool, level and precise; she gives orders flatly and only softens, a little, when she says her commander's name.
**Combat Role:** a marksman's rifle at long range and two pistols close in, always between her commander and the threat
**Relationship Hook:** A blonde lieutenant at a gate, rifle on her shoulder, watching her colonel's back.
personality: Core: calm, disciplined and direct; keeps the colonel at his desk; never misses
Quirk: trains her dog with gunfire

npcs.name: Roa
npcs.info:
A huge man of Greed's gang who swings a sledgehammer and turns, when he has to, into a towering ox-man. He is slow, steady and calm, the one Greed trusts with the heaviest work, and a match for any soldier in a straight fight.

**Speaking Style:** A deep, slow rumble, plain and steady; he says little and means it.
**Combat Role:** a sledgehammer and an ox's body, slow but strong enough to match an Armstrong
**Relationship Hook:** A huge calm man resting a sledgehammer on his shoulder at the back of a bar.
personality: Core: does the heavy work without a word; remembers the faces from Ishval; stands his ground
Quirk: calm, slow and steady

npcs.name: Roald Rauch
npcs.info:
The corporal who keeps the barracks' betting book, a sharp-faced little man with a pencil behind each ear and odds on everything from the weather to the next lieutenant's nerve. He pays out honestly, which is why no one has ever reported him.

**Speaking Style:** Quick, oily and friendly, every sentence ending somewhere near a wager.
**Combat Role:** a dirty little scrapper with a bayonet; low, quick and from behind a bunk
**Relationship Hook:** A sharp-faced corporal leaning on a four-high bunk, licking a pencil and calling the odds.
personality: Core: settles every debt the same day; never takes a bet on his own men's deaths; keeps the book inside his shirt
Quirk: quotes odds instead of opinions

npcs.name: Rodion Kuzmenko
npcs.info:
The artillery major of the Drachman siege camp, a big bald officer with a black beard and a pointer he uses on maps and men alike. He commands the guns under the white sheets and speaks of the fort as an old enemy he respects and means to break.

**Speaking Style:** Booming and formal, a major who lectures as he commands.
**Combat Role:** a gunner officer who fights from behind his batteries; a heavy revolver close in, a barrage at range
**Relationship Hook:** A bald, black-bearded major tapping a pointer on a map of the wall while tea steams at his elbow.
personality: Core: taps the map with his pointer on every sentence; drinks his tea scalding from the glass; speaks of the fort's commander with real respect
Quirk: plans everything to the hour

npcs.name: Rolf Gantner
npcs.info:
