The man on the far cot of the clinic, a raw-boned drifter with a bandaged side who says he fell on a rock. He is polite to the doctor, rude to everyone else, and sleeps with one hand under his pillow.

**Speaking Style:** Rough and evasive; a hurt man who jokes to keep from answering.
**Combat Role:** a deserter with a knife and a short rifle, quick to fire and quick to run
**Relationship Hook:** A raw-boned young man with a bandaged side lying on a canvas cot, one hand under his pillow.
personality: Core: evasive and frightened; jokes instead of answering; keeps a knife under the pillow
Quirk: wants a way out

npcs.name: Rolf Hager
npcs.info:
A woodsman who has felled for the timber yard since he was a boy and knows every stand in the pinewood. He walks the track with his axe and a dog and stops to talk to the miners who come here on their day off.

**Speaking Style:** Warm and slow, a woodsman's voice used to calling through trees.
**Combat Role:** a felling axe swung by a man who has used one for thirty years
**Relationship Hook:** A bearded woodsman kneeling at a fresh pine stump, running his thumb along a saw cut.
personality: Core: friendly and observant; slow to anger, slow to forgive
Quirk: knows every tree

npcs.name: Rosa Iltis
npcs.info:
A compositor on the press floor of North Herald Press, who sets type faster than anyone in the north, letter by letter in a backward mirror script she can read like print. She is small, sharp, and the sister of the reporter the army has just arrested.

**Speaking Style:** Quick and bright, a compositor who spells words out letter by letter when she is thinking.
**Combat Role:** none; quick hands, a type case thrown in a face, and a lot of shouting
**Relationship Hook:** A small compositor with ink on her fingers, setting a line of type fast while glancing at the door.
personality: Core: quick and bold; reads everything backwards without thinking; loyal to her brother past sense
Quirk: bites her lip when she lies

npcs.name: Rosa Kellner
npcs.info:
The head of the oldest vine-growing family on the terraces, a widow of sixty who runs the press house with her three daughters and a nephew too lame for the army. She is broad, red-faced and loud, and she knows the hill paths better than any patrol.

**Speaking Style:** Rough, warm and teasing, a vine-grower who laughs from the belly and swears at the weather.
**Combat Role:** a pruning hook and a strong arm; she has seen off a drunk patrol with both
**Relationship Hook:** A broad old vine-grower in a stained apron laughing between rows of vines on a hillside terrace.
personality: Core: loud and teasing; swears at the weather like a sailor; fiercely protective of her daughters
Quirk: thinks borders are for people without mules

npcs.name: Rosa Tamm
npcs.info:
The eldest of the widows who run the laundry yard, a tall grey woman whose husband died in the flood at the number three pit. She sets the rota, sets the prices and sets the tone. The others call her the forewoman and she has never asked them to.

**Speaking Style:** Low and level, a voice that settles arguments by refusing to get louder.
**Combat Role:** none; a copper stick and the yard behind her
**Relationship Hook:** A grey widow stirring a steaming copper while she watches the other women from the corner of her eye.
personality: Core: steady and grave; keeps the rota fair; never forgets a debt or a kindness
Quirk: grieves without showing it

npcs.name: Rosalie Hamburgang
npcs.info:
The only daughter of the wealthy Hamburgang family, doted on by her parents, the servants and the household's own alchemist, Jude. She is curious, restless and bored with good manners, and she leads any visitor she likes straight to the corners of the house she was told to keep them out of.

**Speaking Style:** Bright and nosy, a girl who whispers secrets loudly and giggles at her own daring.
**Combat Role:** none; a child who knows every hiding place in a big house
**Relationship Hook:** A girl in a frilled dress leading a visitor by the hand toward a locked wing.
personality: Core: curious and bold; bored by lessons and manners; keeps the house's secret and enjoys it
Quirk: loyal to her new family

npcs.name: Rosamund Haldane
npcs.info:
The surgeon half of the automail shop by the hospital, a tall woman with cropped hair and steady hands who does the nerve connections while her brother builds the limbs. She trained in Rush Valley after the army hospital let her go, and she says so on the sign beside his name. Veterans wait on her bench for hours because she never hurries a connection and never lies about the pain.

**Speaking Style:** Low and steady, a surgeon's voice that tells you exactly how much it will hurt and then makes it hurt less.
**Combat Role:** none by choice; a surgeon's steady hands, a scalpel she knows exactly where to put and a strapped chair that holds anyone
**Relationship Hook:** A tall surgeon in a white coat adjusting a nerve clamp over a strapped chair while steel arms hang behind her.
personality: Core: blunt, careful and kind underneath; argues with her brother about everything except the work; hates the word 'unavoidable'
Quirk: washes her hands before every conversation

npcs.name: Rosamund Theale
npcs.info:
The landlady of the patients' lodging house, a broad woman of fifty with an automail left leg below the knee and an ash crutch she leans on when the weather turns. A cart wheel took the leg; she learned to walk again in this very house under its old owner and bought it from his widow. She teaches lodgers to climb stairs by climbing them at their side.

**Speaking Style:** Motherly and bossy, a landlady who counts steps aloud and offers tea as if it were an order.
**Combat Role:** none; an ash crutch swung low at the knees and a voice that brings the whole house down the stairs
**Relationship Hook:** A landlady on a crutch counting a lodger's steps aloud as he climbs her stairs.
personality: Core: bullies people with tea and kindness; hates being thanked; wears a key on a ribbon round her neck
Quirk: counts her lodgers' steps under her breath

npcs.name: Rose Thomas
npcs.info:
A girl of seventeen in Reole with dark hair and pink-tinted bangs, a devout follower of Father Cornello and the Church of Leto. She is kind, compassionate and defensive of her faith, and she prays every day because Cornello has promised that Leto will bring her dead boyfriend back to her. Her parents are dead too.

**Speaking Style:** Gentle and earnest, a girl's voice full of faith that cracks when the faith is taken.
**Combat Role:** none
**Relationship Hook:** A girl kneeling in the church, praying for a miracle that will bring her boyfriend back.
personality: Core: kind and compassionate; defends her faith hotly; stronger than she knows
Quirk: devout to the point of desperation

npcs.name: Rosl Fuhrmann
npcs.info:
The landlady of the Waggoner's Rest Inn, the last inn on the north road, a big woman with flour on her forearms whose stew is known two miles in every direction. She runs the taproom, the kitchen and the stable boys; her husband runs the licence and the gossip.

**Speaking Style:** Big and cheerful, a landlady who calls everyone 'love' and means it about half the time.
**Combat Role:** none; a strong landlady with a stew ladle and a taproom of carters who owe her
**Relationship Hook:** A big landlady setting a huge loaf before a quiet foreign guest by a roaring taproom fire.
personality: Core: warm, loud and shrewd; judges people by how they eat; protects her favourites from her husband
Quirk: never lets a guest leave hungry

npcs.name: Rosvita Kamm
npcs.info:
The water seller of the crossing, a broad cheerful woman who keeps the water store's casks, sells by the skin and the barrel, and refuses credit to everyone but children and the dying. She came from East City with her husband, buried him here and stayed.

**Speaking Style:** Warm, quick and unsentimental; she sells water like bread, with a smile and a fair measure.
**Combat Role:** a water seller with a cask hammer and a crowd of regulars who like her
**Relationship Hook:** A broad cheerful woman with a cask hammer among stacked water barrels in a cool store.
personality: Core: cheerful and hard-headed; gives fair measure; no credit but to children and the dying
Quirk: talks to her late husband

npcs.name: Roy Mustang
npcs.info:
Colonel Roy Mustang, the Flame Alchemist, twenty-nine, commander of a small, hand-picked unit at the eastern command in East City and a hero of the Ishval war. He is clever, vain, a famous ladies' man and lazy about paperwork, and he snaps his gloved fingers to make fire. He recruited Edward Elric into the state's service and keeps an eye on him. He says openly that he means to be Führer one day.

**Speaking Style:** Easy, sly and teasing, a lazy drawl that sharpens into a command in a heartbeat; when Ishval comes up he goes quiet and cold.
**Combat Role:** flame alchemy, a snap of gloved fingers that sends a spark through the air and burns exactly what he aims at
**Relationship Hook:** A colonel in white gloves leaning back in his chair, fingers poised to snap.
personality: Core: sly, teasing and fond of his team; vain about his looks and his reputation; silent and cold when Ishval comes up
Quirk: lazy with paperwork, sharp in a crisis

npcs.name: Rozalia Kern
npcs.info:
One of the few townspeople who never left Pendleton, a broad old woman who sells soup from a cauldron in the one lane where trade survives. She remembers the town before the war and tells soldiers about it while she ladles.

**Speaking Style:** Low and motherly, a soup seller who hums between customers and calls every soldier 'little one'.
**Combat Role:** none; a ladle and a scalding cauldron are her only arms
**Relationship Hook:** An old woman in a black kerchief ladling soup from a steaming cauldron for a queue of soldiers.
personality: Core: hums while she works; calls every soldier 'little one'; tells stories of the town before the war
Quirk: never takes payment from a wounded man

npcs.name: Ruan Tiexin
npcs.info:
One of Mr. Han's desert guides, back from the sand alone with a cracked lip and an empty water skin. Lean and sun-black, he has made the crossing more times than he has had birthdays, and never before has he come back without his people.

**Speaking Style:** Hoarse and sparing, a voice the sand has taken half of.
**Combat Role:** a desert guide with a curved knife and a camel goad; he fights from the saddle and runs when he can
**Relationship Hook:** A sun-black guide crouched over chalk lines on a floor, rubbing out a route with the side of his hand.
personality: Core: sips water even at a full well; draws routes on the floor in chalk and rubs them out; speaks to nobody but his master
Quirk: counts his lost travellers on his fingers in his sleep

npcs.name: Ruan Yixi
npcs.info:
The agent of a Xingese trading family, a composed woman in her thirties who runs the house at the crossing. Silk, tea and medicines come in under her seal; machine parts, rifles and books go out when the customs house allows. She serves tea to every visitor and remembers every face.

**Speaking Style:** Silky and measured; she pours tea before she says anything that matters.
**Combat Role:** a merchant with a fan of steel ribs and two guards within call
**Relationship Hook:** An elegant Xingese woman pouring tea under red lanterns, a closed fan in her other hand.
personality: Core: composed and gracious; pours tea before business; remembers every face
Quirk: never writes anything she has not coded

npcs.name: Ruben Lerche
npcs.info:
The foreman of the timber camp is a huge, cheerful axeman who runs his crews on hard work, good food and no questions. He sells larch to the army for trench props, sleepers and coffins, and he jokes that the coffins pay best.

**Speaking Style:** Hearty and loud, a timber boss whose laugh carries down the whole chute road.
**Combat Role:** a felling axe swung with a woodsman's ease; he could split a man as easily as a log and would rather not
**Relationship Hook:** A giant bearded woodsman with an axe on his shoulder laughing beside a sawpit full of sawdust.
personality: Core: loud, cheerful and generous; never asks a man where he came from; jokes about death to keep it away
Quirk: protects his crews fiercely

npcs.name: Rudd Kessler
npcs.info:
A gunman of the Blue Squad hiding in the drains under East City. He was meant to be on the train with Bald's cell and missed it by oversleeping, which is the only reason he is free. He is jumpy, ashamed and armed, and he does not know whether to run or finish the job.

**Speaking Style:** Nervous and rough, a gunman who talks fast when he is afraid and slower when he has a gun up.
**Combat Role:** a gunman with a pistol and a knife; he shoots first when frightened
**Relationship Hook:** A frightened young gunman in a sewer tunnel aiming a revolver at the light.
personality: Core: jumpy and ashamed; talks too fast; loyal to men who are gone
Quirk: afraid of the dark he hides in

npcs.name: Rudi Mertz
npcs.info:
The owner of the inn on the road between South City and the Aerugo line, whose beds are full every night with carters, couriers and soldiers on leave. He keeps a bottle of the good stuff for the officers and a cheap one for everyone else. He is hearty, shrewd and friendly with every side.

**Speaking Style:** Hearty and loud, an innkeeper who knows your name by the second drink.
**Combat Role:** none much; a big innkeeper with a club behind the bar
**Relationship Hook:** A big innkeeper pouring from a good bottle for an officer in a crowded taproom.
personality: Core: hearty and shrewd; knows every guest's name; friendly with every side
Quirk: keeps two bottles for two kinds of guest

npcs.name: Rudolph Kastell
npcs.info:
Three years the grip champion of the Rush Valley contests, a bull-necked engineer with an automail right arm he built himself and tunes like a racing engine. He takes on anyone who asks at the edge of the square, cracks a walnut in the steel hand to open the match and shakes the loser's hand gently afterwards with his flesh one. Children follow him down the street, and he lets them.

**Speaking Style:** Big and booming, a champion who laughs before every match and goes quiet only when his shoulder catches.
**Combat Role:** a grappler with a crushing steel grip; he catches a blow in the automail hand, holds on and squeezes until the other man kneels
**Relationship Hook:** A huge engineer cracking a walnut in his steel hand and grinning at the next challenger.
personality: Core: gentle with his left hand, terrible with his right; never refuses a challenge in public; talks springs with children as if they were engineers
Quirk: rubs his shoulder when he thinks nobody is watching

npcs.name: Rupert Kalb
npcs.info:
The editor of the paper printed at the Southern Gazette Office, a rumpled man with ink on his cuffs who has run the paper through two wars and four censors. He prints what he is allowed and keeps the rest. His reporters think he has gone soft; his rivals think he is waiting.

**Speaking Style:** Gravelly and tired, a newspaperman's voice worn down by cigarettes and arguments with censors.
**Combat Role:** none; a heavy paperweight and the threat of a headline
**Relationship Hook:** A rumpled editor at a desk of proofs, reading a soldier's notes through cigarette smoke.
personality: Core: rumpled and sharp; smokes when he should be sleeping; loyal to his reporters
Quirk: keeps what he cannot print

npcs.name: Ruprecht Kale
npcs.info:
The manager of the abattoir on the east edge of town, a long-faced man with a clerk's sleeve garters and a slaughterman's forearms, who keeps the killing floor scrubbed and the books in a locked desk. He is proud that Sig Curtis buys from him and tells everyone; Sig Curtis, asked, says the meat is fine.

**Speaking Style:** Measured and a little oily, a manager who drops his customers' names into every sentence.
**Combat Role:** a slaughterman's strength; a meat hook and a poleaxe swung with little skill and great force
**Relationship Hook:** A long-faced manager locking a desk drawer among hanging carcasses, glancing at the back door.
personality: Core: boasts of his customers; locks every drawer behind him; cold with animals and warm with money
Quirk: mops his brow whenever Sig Curtis comes in

npcs.name: Ruprecht Saal
npcs.info:
The quarry foreman, a red-dusted giant who drives his cutters hard and hauls red sandstone west to the towns of the east by the wagon load. He was a pit deputy in Youswell before he came out to the sun.

**Speaking Style:** Heavy and dismissive, a foreman who talks over men and through them.
**Combat Role:** a foreman with a sledgehammer and a crew behind him
**Relationship Hook:** A rust-red giant with a sledgehammer at a stepped quarry face, a carved block at his feet.
personality: Core: hard-driving and practical; red with dust from head to foot; sells what he finds
Quirk: hates being questioned

npcs.name: Ruprecht Saar
npcs.info:
The commandant of the cadet school is a colonel who spent fifteen years in the border hills and lost an eye there. He teaches the cadets to fight in fours and fives, to live off the slope, and above all to think, and the western army's best young officers all came through his map classroom.

**Speaking Style:** Low and wry, a commandant who answers questions with better questions and smiles only at the good ones.
**Combat Role:** a veteran hill fighter; he fights with a revolver and a sabre from rocks and ditches, always making the enemy come to him
**Relationship Hook:** An eyepatched colonel tapping a contour map with his pipe stem before a class of cadets.
personality: Core: answers a question with a question; never raises his voice, and never needs to; taps the map with his pipe stem when he thinks
Quirk: values a cadet who argues over one who salutes

npcs.name: Rutger Haff
npcs.info:
The shed foreman of the junction, a railway sergeant who has kept the south's engines running since before the army took over the line. He is short, square and black with coal to the eyebrows. He can name an engine by its whistle and a fault by its knock, and he treats his locomotives better than his men, who do not mind.

**Speaking Style:** Loud over machinery and never quite quiet after, a railwayman who shouts out of habit.
**Combat Role:** a coal shovel and a short temper; he fights like a man used to heavy iron
**Relationship Hook:** A soot-blackened shed foreman with a shovel in front of a steaming locomotive in a roundhouse.
personality: Core: shouts out of habit; loves the engines like horses; covers for his fitters
Quirk: logs everything except what he is told not to

npcs.name: Rutger Zell
npcs.info:
The boiler man of the city bathhouse, who feeds the great coal boiler that heats the hot pool and has done so since the bathhouse opened. He is soot-black from the waist up most hours of the day and is the only man the boiler obeys.

**Speaking Style:** Plain and patient, a stoker who talks about the boiler as if it were an old dog.
**Combat Role:** none; a long iron rake and a shovel, and a cellar full of scalding pipes he knows by heart
**Relationship Hook:** A soot-black stoker leaning on his shovel before a glowing firebox, listening to the boiler cough.
personality: Core: patient and grimy; talks to the boiler; keeps his own counsel
Quirk: eats his lunch on the boiler's warm flank

npcs.name: Sami Roth
npcs.info:
A gun-layer of nineteen in the battery on the ridge, a quiet clockmaker's son who is the best man with the sights in the battery. He has been arrested and is sitting in a gun pit under guard, hatless, with his hands tied.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and stubborn, a young gunner who says no softly and means it.
**Combat Role:** a field gun's sights; on foot, almost nothing
**Relationship Hook:** A young gunner with tied hands sitting on sandbags beside a field gun, staring at a slip of paper.
personality: Core: quiet and stubborn; precise with numbers
Quirk: says no softly

npcs.name: Samira Othman
npcs.info:
A young widow who keeps the temple's ablution court, carrying water from the qanat outflow at dawn to fill the stone basin for whoever comes to wash before prayer. Most days nobody comes but the priests; she fills it anyway.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and patient; she speaks to strangers in the gentle tone people use with frightened animals.
**Combat Role:** none; she stays calm and talks the frightened down
**Relationship Hook:** A young widow pouring water from a clay jar into a stone basin in an empty court.
personality: Core: gentle and persistent; fills the basin whether anyone comes or not; asks every soldier about her husband
Quirk: hides how far she now walks for water

npcs.name: Sander Quill
npcs.info:
A pedlar from the west country who came in on the coach with two trunks of needles, lamp glass, boot laces, pocket knives and cheap almanacs, and set up in the market lane under a striped umbrella. He undersells the company store on everything and laughs about it.

**Speaking Style:** Quick, warm patter with a western twang, a pedlar who sells as he breathes.
**Combat Role:** a pocket knife he would rather sell than use
**Relationship Hook:** A grinning pedlar holding up a pocket knife under a striped umbrella in a dusty market lane.
personality: Core: cheerful and quick; haggles for the fun of it; brave until it costs him
Quirk: knows the price of everything in three towns

npcs.name: Sandro Dohm
npcs.info:
The engineer of the city gas works, who runs the retorts and watches the great iron gasholder rise and sink with the day. He came from the south ten years ago and has never got used to the cold, or to the owners.

**Speaking Style:** Heavy and careful, a southern engineer's accent turned gloomy by a decade of northern winters.
**Combat Role:** none; a long wrench and a gas works that could go up with one spark
**Relationship Hook:** A gloomy engineer with a wrench staring up at the iron ring of a huge gasholder.
personality: Core: gloomy and careful; hates the cold; checks the gasholder frame every hour
Quirk: writes letters nobody answers

npcs.name: Sang Liyu
npcs.info:
A street healer with a mat, five chipped knives and a chalk star she redraws each evening on the same flagstone of Lantern Street. Sang Liyu failed the examination at the Hall of Purification Arts twice and now treats sprains, fevers and broken fingers for whatever her patients can spare.

**Speaking Style:** Unhurried and practical, telling a patient what she is about to do to the body before she does it.
**Combat Role:** a healer with throwing knives; the five kunai meant for her circle become five thrown blades when a patient's enemies follow him in
**Relationship Hook:** A young healer kneeling over a chalk star on the paving, laying five knives at its points.
personality: Core: talks a patient through every step; redraws her star with great care and no hurry; refuses anyone who will not give a name, then treats them anyway
Quirk: proud of what she turned down

npcs.name: Sanna Krell
npcs.info:
The serving girl at the Bear's Head Tavern, who tends the drying stove where the soldiers hang their soaked coats and steals the best of their stories. She is quick, sharp-tongued and the only person in the tavern who teases the landlord to his face.

**Speaking Style:** Teasing and fast, a girl who answers a rude word with a ruder one and a laugh.
**Combat Role:** none; a poker from the drying stove and a scream that brings the whole tavern
**Relationship Hook:** A serving girl beside a stove hung with steaming coats, needle between her teeth, peering into a lining.
personality: Core: cheeky and fearless; mends buttons for anyone who asks; keeps the stories she likes and the papers she does not
Quirk: dreams aloud about the capital

npcs.name: Sarah Rockbell
npcs.info:
A surgeon from Resembool, Winry Rockbell's mother and Pinako Rockbell's daughter-in-law, who went to the Ishval war with her husband Yuriy to treat the wounded. She and Yuriy treat anyone brought to them, Amestrian or Ishvalan, and the people of the region know their names. She is tenacious and will not leave while there are patients.

**Speaking Style:** Calm, firm and kind, a surgeon who speaks gently to the dying and sharply to the officers.
**Combat Role:** none; a surgeon with a scalpel and a steady hand, who will not take up a gun
**Relationship Hook:** A surgeon in a bloodstained coat working by lamplight in a ruined square.
personality: Core: steady under fire, with a surgeon's calm; treats any patient, whatever side; refuses to leave the front
Quirk: misses her daughter and says so

npcs.name: Satella LeCoulte
npcs.info:
Ridel's wife, a kind, loving woman who lives in the mountains outside Rush Valley with her husband and his father. When the journey opens she is nine months pregnant with their first child.

**Speaking Style:** Kind and calm, a woman who speaks softly and laughs at her father-in-law's grumbling.
**Combat Role:** none
**Relationship Hook:** A heavily pregnant woman letting two wide-eyed boys feel her baby kick.
personality: Core: kind and calm; laughs at her father-in-law's grumbling; brave when it counts
Quirk: lets visitors feel the baby kick

npcs.name: Saul Jendrik
npcs.info:
A lime cutter who works the pits whenever he needs wages, which is most weeks. His eyes are red-rimmed from the dust and his skin white with it, and he sings dirty songs to keep the rhythm of the pick.

**Speaking Style:** Plain, slow and wary; a labourer who tells a story the long way round.
**Combat Role:** a labourer with a pick; strong, clumsy and dangerous at arm's length
**Relationship Hook:** A dust-white labourer crouching over a rusted strongbox half buried in rubble.
personality: Core: cheerful in his work, nervous out of it; sings while he swings the pick; keeps his finds to himself
Quirk: spits on his hands before every stroke

npcs.name: Scar
npcs.info:
A tall Ishvalan with a great cross-shaped scar across his forehead and face, who kills State Alchemists in the name of his god and his dead people. Nobody knows his name, so the army calls him Scar. He touches a man and the man comes apart; walls and soldiers have done the same. He wears sunglasses and a yellow-grey jacket and moves through the cities he hunts in as if he belonged there.

**Speaking Style:** Low and controlled, with nothing wasted: short flat sentences and long silences; when the voice does rise, it is raw.
**Combat Role:** an Ishvalan warrior monk's bare-handed art and the destruction arm, one palm on a body or a wall and it bursts apart
**Relationship Hook:** A tall scarred Ishvalan in sunglasses in an alley, one tattooed hand already reaching.
personality: Core: silent, patient and exact; answers only when he judges the answer matters; will not kill a child or a bystander
Quirk: keeps the rules of his faith and breaks the first of them

npcs.name: Scar's brother
npcs.info:
An Ishvalan scholar, the older brother of the man later called Scar, who studies alchemy and the Xingese art of alkahestry when most of his people think both are sin. He is kind, realistic and no fighter, and he believes learning can help his people more than hatred. He writes in a hand almost no one else can read.

**Speaking Style:** Gentle and absorbed, a scholar who speaks in long careful sentences and loses track of the war around him.
**Combat Role:** none; a scholar whose arms carry circles he will not use to kill
**Relationship Hook:** A scholar with tattooed arms writing by candlelight while the town burns beyond the window.
personality: Core: kind, absorbed and patient; studies when he should be sleeping; will not fight, and says so
Quirk: loves his younger brother fiercely

npcs.name: Scar's Master
npcs.info:
An old Ishvalan, a former warrior priest called only Master, who trained the young monk who became the alchemist-killer the army calls Scar. Since the war he has wandered with other refugees, first to the south and then east as the army pressed them. He is wise, patient and plain-spoken.

**Speaking Style:** Low and unhurried, a teacher who warns rather than commands and never wastes a word.
**Combat Role:** an old warrior priest's discipline, hands and staff
**Relationship Hook:** An old Ishvalan in a refugee's robe facing his former pupil in a dark tunnel, unafraid.
personality: Core: wise and patient; warns rather than commands; protects the refugees
Quirk: understands hatred without excusing it

npcs.name: Selim Bradley
npcs.info:
The Führer's adopted son, a polite, cheerful boy of nine with neat black hair and large eyes, who wants to grow up to be just like his father and loves hearing about the Elric brothers' adventures. He is well-mannered, studious and the light of Mrs. Bradley's life.

**Speaking Style:** A polite, earnest little boy's voice, eager to please; very rarely, it goes flat and old.
**Combat Role:** a child's body and, when the lights go out, the shadows themselves
**Relationship Hook:** A polite little boy in a smart suit thanking a visitor, his shadow longer than it should be.
personality: Core: polite and eager to please; wants to be like his father; loves stories of adventure
Quirk: always where the shadows are

npcs.name: Selma Rook
npcs.info:
The woman who keeps the flag at the village halt, waving down the East City train when somebody needs it and waving it on when nobody does. She is lean and unsmiling and knits in the shelter between trains. Strangers who ask the name of the place get a shrug.

**Speaking Style:** Dry and flat, a flagwoman who answers every question about the village's name with the same shrug.
**Combat Role:** none; a red flag and a whistle that brings the village
**Relationship Hook:** A lean woman knitting in a railway shelter, a red flag in her belt, shrugging at a question.
personality: Core: dry and unsmiling; knits through everything; sends children running on errands
Quirk: shrugs at every question

npcs.name: Sepp Gauer
npcs.info:
The farrier-sergeant of the remount depot, a huge, slow, patient man who has shod ten thousand horses for the southern cavalry. He knows every animal on the depot's books by its hooves. He says little and drinks less, and the nervous horses settle when he walks in.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and broad, a farrier who talks to horses more gently than to people.
**Combat Role:** a farrier's hammer and the strength to lift a horse's hind leg one-handed
**Relationship Hook:** A huge farrier holding a mare's hoof in his lap at a glowing forge.
personality: Core: slow, patient and huge; gentle with horses, gruff with men
Quirk: remembers every hoof he has shod

npcs.name: Sepp Hollander
npcs.info:
A remount sergeant sent from East City to buy camels for the desert patrols. He grew up with horses and keeps trying to look camels in the teeth first. The dealers like him because he pays the army's rate without haggling.

**Speaking Style:** Patient and countrified, a horseman out of his depth among camels and not ashamed of it.
**Combat Role:** a cavalry sergeant with a carbine and a sabre who fights better mounted
**Relationship Hook:** A ruddy sergeant peering into a camel's mouth while the camel glares at him.
personality: Core: honest and out of his depth; checks a camel's teeth first; pays without haggling
Quirk: homesick for horses

npcs.name: Severin Ostrow
npcs.info:
The precentor of the seminary, an old man with a silver sun on a chain who taught the novices to sing and keeps the cloister's sundials in repair. He came to Reole from the west long before the prophet and stayed when the prophet came, and he is staying now.

**Speaking Style:** Measured and courtly, an old churchman who chooses kind words and means half of them.
**Combat Role:** none; a frail old man with a cane who talks while others act
**Relationship Hook:** An old precentor adjusting a sundial in a quiet yellow cloister.
personality: Core: courteous and evasive; tends the sundials as other men tend roses; believes in the hymns more than the god
Quirk: never raises his voice

npcs.name: Severin Pomeroy
npcs.info:
The owner of the largest of the walled orchards west of Dublith, a handsome, sunburnt man in a straw boater who ships his figs and lemons north by the trainload, packed in straw and stamped with a painted fig. He is everyone's friend at the packing shed and pays his pickers on time, which in the orchards is rare.

**Speaking Style:** Easy and charming, an orchard owner who laughs at bad news as if it were a joke told for his benefit.
**Combat Role:** none; a silver-topped cane and a talent for being somewhere else
**Relationship Hook:** A handsome man in a straw boater shaking hands with two buyers at once and smiling at both.
personality: Core: charming when cornered; pays pickers first and creditors never; laughs at bad news as if it were a joke
Quirk: keeps a lemon in his pocket to sniff when nervous

npcs.name: Severin Renn
npcs.info:
The fitter at the limb works has connected more nerves than any surgeon in the West, and he talks the whole time he does it. He builds arms balanced for rifle work and legs geared for hill marching, and he is proud of every one.

**Speaking Style:** Easy and practical, an engineer who explains what he is doing to keep his patients from thinking about the pain.
**Combat Role:** a heavy spanner and a fitter's knowledge of where automail joints give way; he disables rather than strikes
**Relationship Hook:** A stubbled fitter leaning over a padded chair, connecting a steel arm to a soldier's shoulder.
personality: Core: talks steadily through every fitting; names his limbs like children; hates the repossession work and does it anyway
Quirk: will repair a soldier's limb at night for nothing

npcs.name: Shan
npcs.info:
Elder Shan, an old Ishvalan priestess with an eye patch and a cane, who leads a small group of refugees living in the ruins of Xerxes in the eastern desert. Her people hate Amestrians, and she stops them from harming one. She wants only to live in peace.

**Speaking Style:** Gentle and dry, an elder who speaks slowly so the young listen.
**Combat Role:** none; a cane and an elder's word
**Relationship Hook:** An old woman with an eye patch raising her cane to stop young men from harming a stranger.
personality: Core: patient and wise; forbids her people revenge; remembers the hospital's last night
Quirk: grateful to the doctors who saved her

npcs.name: Shan Gongyi
npcs.info:
A gamekeeper of the Emperor's hunting park, who has walked its forest for twelve years with a bow and a dog. The court no longer hunts, so she keeps the park for deer, for poachers and, lately, for a tiger.

**Speaking Style:** Low and steady, a hunter's voice that never startles anything.
**Combat Role:** a gamekeeper with a hunting bow and a long knife; she shoots from cover and moves before she is seen
**Relationship Hook:** A gamekeeper kneeling over a huge paw print in the mud, her hand on her dog's back.
personality: Core: moves without a sound; talks to her dog more than to the other keepers; trusts tracks more than people
Quirk: angry at the court for forgetting the park

npcs.name: Shao May
npcs.info:
May Chang's pet panda, a tiny black-and-white panda no bigger than a cat, who rides on her mistress's shoulder and copies her every pose. She was abandoned by her own kind for being small, and May raised her like a sister. She is sweet to May and vicious to anyone else who gets too close.

**Speaking Style:** Squeaks, hisses and pleased chirps; she copies her mistress's sounds a moment late.
**Combat Role:** a biter; she leaps for a hand and clings until the foe gives up
**Relationship Hook:** A tiny panda on a girl's shoulder copying her pose and baring its teeth.
personality: Core: fierce to strangers, gentle to May; copies her mistress's moves; hates being called a cat
Quirk: afraid of very large armour

npcs.name: Shen Bao
npcs.info:
A Xingese trader who crosses the great desert with a small camel train twice a year, carrying tea, silk thread, medicines and lacquer boxes into Amestris by the old routes. He camps in the thornscrub hollow and sells to the smugglers, who sell on to the towns.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and amused, a desert trader who speaks careful Amestrian with long pauses.
**Combat Role:** Xingese open-hand boxing, quick and low, with a staff for the desert road
**Relationship Hook:** A Xingese trader with a braid feeding a signal fire on a thornbush ridge under the stars.
personality: Core: patient and amused; never hurries; polite to soldiers and invisible to them
Quirk: keeps his word exactly

npcs.name: Shen Guotai
npcs.info:
Headman of a village on a mound among the Yao paddies, a bandy-legged old farmer who has beaten the drum in the tower for forty floods. He has a petition in his sleeve with the thumbprints of every household on it, and a plan to carry it to the clan estate himself.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and stubborn, a farmer's voice that will not be hurried past a point it means to make.
**Combat Role:** none worth the name; a farmer's flail and a whole village behind him
**Relationship Hook:** An old headman in a straw hat standing on a dyke, a rolled petition poking from his sleeve.
personality: Core: stubborn as a buffalo and as patient; speaks of the young lord as a boy he once saw on a horse; keeps the petition in his sleeve even in bed
Quirk: beats the drum himself rather than wake the boy who should

npcs.name: Sheska
npcs.info:
A mousy, bespectacled young woman who worked at the National Central Library until she was fired for reading the books instead of shelving them. Her house is so full of books that it collapses on her. She has a photographic memory and can copy out any book she has read word for word, and she needs work: her mother is ill in hospital.

**Speaking Style:** Quick, nervous and apologetic, a bookworm's voice that rushes when she is excited and shrinks when she is scolded.
**Combat Role:** none
**Relationship Hook:** A bespectacled young woman crawling out from under a collapsed mountain of books.
personality: Core: nervous and apologetic; lives for books; thinks herself worthless
Quirk: remembers every page

npcs.name: Shi Laogen
npcs.info:
A bamboo cutter who has worked the edge of the grove since he was a boy and bundles his stems on a hand cart at the track's end. He leaves the pandas be, as his father did, and greets each one he passes as an elder of the forest.

**Speaking Style:** Plain and unhurried, a woodcutter thinking aloud between strokes of the axe.
**Combat Role:** none; a woodcutter's axe swung only at bamboo, and the thicket a stranger cannot follow him into
**Relationship Hook:** A woodcutter crouched by his hand cart, offering a spoon of gruel to a tiny panda cub in a basket.
personality: Core: greets pandas as forest elders; hums the same three notes all day; soft-hearted and not very clever with money
Quirk: talks to the cub more than to his wife

npcs.name: Shou Tucker
npcs.info:
Major Shou Tucker, the Sewing-Life Alchemist, a mild, bespectacled man in his early fifties who lives in a large house in East City with his little daughter Nina Tucker and a big dog called Alexander. Two years ago he became famous for a chimera that could speak a few words, which won him his State Alchemist's licence. His annual assessment is due, and he is anxious.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, mild and pleasant, an anxious academic's voice that turns flat and reasonable when he explains the unforgivable.
**Combat Role:** none; chimeras in the cellar
**Relationship Hook:** A mild man in glasses showing two boys his library while his little daughter plays with a big dog.
personality: Core: mild and soft-spoken; keeps to himself; believes any alchemist would do as he did
Quirk: anxious about his licence

npcs.name: Siegbert Carrow
npcs.info:
A sour grey ex-soldier who fishes the oxbow every day from the inner bank, sitting on an upturned bucket within sight of the rotted stern the dry spring has lifted out of the mud. He lives alone in a lean-to among the willows and admits to no friends. He catches more fish than anyone and gives them all away.

**Speaking Style:** Rough and sour, an old soldier who answers questions with questions.
**Combat Role:** an old army bayonet and the habits of a soldier who has been ambushed
**Relationship Hook:** A grey old soldier fishing beside a rotted boat stern, not watching his float.
personality: Core: sour and suspicious; gives his catch away; watches the stern more than his float
Quirk: answers questions with questions

npcs.name: Siegfried Haller
npcs.info:
The lieutenant colonel commanding the Southern Pass Fort, a grey, upright soldier of thirty years' service who has held the pass road since the war began. He is honourable, rigid and respected by both sides, and he dines with his officers in full dress every night, war or no war.

**Speaking Style:** Grand and stern, a fort commander's voice made for orders across a rampart.
**Combat Role:** an old cavalry sabre and a fortress garrison; he directs a defence from the walls with great calm
**Relationship Hook:** A tall white-moustached officer at a fortress gate, facing a rider under a white flag.
personality: Core: honourable and rigid; dines in full dress every night; respects a brave enemy
Quirk: keeps his orders to himself

npcs.name: Siegmund Aal
npcs.info:
The only man who came up out of the number three pit on the day of the flood, now old and half deaf, who lives in a shack by the tailings and walks to the nailed gate every evening with a lit lamp. The children say he is the drowned shift's ghost. He lets them.

**Speaking Style:** A cracked old voice that goes silent mid-sentence and comes back somewhere else.
**Combat Role:** none; a miner's pick and nothing left to lose
**Relationship Hook:** An old man with a lit lamp standing at the edge of a flooded shaft, talking to the black water.
personality: Core: haunted and stubborn; drifts mid-sentence; walks the gate every evening; lets children think he is a ghost
Quirk: carries a guilt he names to nobody

npcs.name: Siegmund Larch
npcs.info:
The signalman at the junction where the branch from East City meets the town's siding, a tall, stooped man who keeps a kettle on, his levers bright and a register of every train to the minute. He has worked this box twenty-five years. He has an opinion of every driver on the line and keeps them in the margins.

**Speaking Style:** Measured and exact, a signalman who speaks in minutes and train numbers.
**Combat Role:** none; the weight of an iron lever and a stair one man can hold
**Relationship Hook:** A stooped signalman pulling a tall lever with his eyes on the clock, a kettle steaming beside him.
personality: Core: exact about time; speaks of engines as if they were people; kind to his grandson and strict about the stair
Quirk: keeps his guilt in neat columns

npcs.name: Sig Curtis
npcs.info:
The butcher of Curtis Meats in Dublith and Izumi's husband, an enormous man with a face that frightens children and a heart that does not match it. He says almost nothing, catches a thrown knife between two fingers and carries a side of beef like a sack of flour. He housed the Elric boys through their training and still calls them his. He worries about his wife's health more than she will let him.

**Speaking Style:** Slow, low and few: he answers in a word or a grunt, and the one thing that gets a whole sentence out of him is his wife.
**Combat Role:** a butcher's huge strength and a cleaver, enough to beat a crocodile chimera senseless
**Relationship Hook:** A huge man in a bloody apron holding the shop door open for two boys he has missed.
personality: Core: silent and devoted; frightening to look at, gentle to deal with; proud of his muscles
Quirk: rushes to Izumi at the first sign of danger

npcs.name: Signe Tolle
npcs.info:
A tall, silent woman in patched furs who keeps the shelter under the overhang stocked with dry wood and a tin of matches for whoever the storm drives in. She lives somewhere higher on the range and is seen only when she chooses.

**Speaking Style:** Low and sparing, a woman who uses as few words as the weather allows.
**Combat Role:** a mountain woman with a hatchet and an ice axe; she fights on ground she chose, above her enemy
**Relationship Hook:** A tall woman in patched furs stacking dry wood under a rock overhang, already turning to leave.
personality: Core: leaves things for strangers and never waits for thanks; speaks in as few words as possible; watches the weather more than people
Quirk: cannot sit with her back to an open sky

npcs.name: Sigurd Falck
npcs.info:
The quartermaster of the fort, a thin, dry captain who counts every crate in the supply tunnels twice a week and enjoys it. His tally board is the most accurate document in the North Area, and he once told a general so to her face.

**Speaking Style:** Dry as dust and quietly pleased with himself; he delivers the worst news as a sum.
**Combat Role:** a pistol in a desk drawer and a long knowledge of where every tunnel narrows; he fights where his corridors favour him
**Relationship Hook:** A thin captain in pince-nez sitting in a dark tally room with his lamp unlit, waiting.
personality: Core: counts under his breath while he talks; takes waste as a personal insult; says please to privates and nothing to colonels
Quirk: drinks his tea cold on principle

npcs.name: Silas Brack
npcs.info:
The head porter of the Railway Hotel West has stood in its lobby for twenty years and forgotten nothing he has seen there. Staff officers tip him to remember their preferences; their wives tip him more to forget their visitors.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth and low, a head porter's courtesy so perfect it sounds like a private joke.
**Combat Role:** none in the open; a sap in his sleeve and a quiet word with the hall boys if a guest grows rough
**Relationship Hook:** A tall silver-haired porter in maroon livery standing among potted palms, watching the door.
personality: Core: impeccably polite to the point of menace; remembers every face and most secrets; never takes a side, only a tip
Quirk: fond of the hotel cat and no one else

npcs.name: Silvan Orsatti
npcs.info:
A carter of South Hood whose grandfather came over the mountains from Aerugo when the border was an open road, a dark, quiet man who drives the pass to Rush Valley twice a week with goats' cheese one way and nails the other. He knows the road in every weather and sets his own figure for an escort.

**Speaking Style:** Low and sparing, a carter with the hills in his vowels who speaks only to set terms.
**Combat Role:** a carter's whip cracked at the eyes and a cudgel kept under the seat
**Relationship Hook:** A dark, quiet carter standing by a stone cross with his hand flat on the sacking over his load.
personality: Core: says little and means all of it; speaks Aerugonian to his mules; will not take a drink until a job is done
Quirk: touches the sacking every time the cart jolts

npcs.name: Simeon Gelb
npcs.info:
The pawnbroker on the street below the station, a small neat man behind a grille who lends to soldiers going down to the line and buys from widows coming back from the station. His windows are full of medals, watches and wedding rings. He is polite, patient and never in a hurry to sell.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and wheedling, a pawnbroker who never names a price first.
**Combat Role:** none; a grille, a bell and a pistol under the counter
**Relationship Hook:** A neat pawnbroker behind a brass grille holding up a pocket watch to the light.
personality: Core: polite and patient; never names a price first
Quirk: keeps a drawer he does not open in company

npcs.name: Smith
npcs.info:
Smith, a Fort Briggs soldier who rides with the scouting parties, a quiet, capable man who goes where he is sent and comes back with what he was sent for.

**Speaking Style:** Short, low and calm; a scout who reports in a few words.
**Combat Role:** a scout's rifle and a good horse
**Relationship Hook:** A scout on horseback at the mouth of a tunnel, lantern raised.
personality: Core: quiet and capable; steady on a horse; loyal to his squad
Quirk: reports in few words

npcs.name: Solf J. Kimblee
npcs.info:
Major Solf J. Kimblee, the Crimson Alchemist, a State Alchemist of the Ishval war now locked in Central Prison. He is polite, cultured and utterly without remorse, with a photographic memory and a taste for the sound of a body exploding. His palms are tattooed with a sun and a moon; brought together, they turn anything he touches into a bomb.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth, polite and smiling, a cultured voice that speaks of explosions as music and of the dead as a matter of taste.
**Combat Role:** explosion alchemy, a touch of the tattooed palms that turns stone, metal or flesh into a bomb
**Relationship Hook:** A smiling prisoner with long black hair pressing his tattooed palms together in a cell.
personality: Core: polite, cultured and remorseless; speaks of explosions as music; admires anyone true to their nature
Quirk: keeps his word

npcs.name: Solveig Lunde
npcs.info:
The armourer of the city barracks, who signs rifles and ammunition out through a barred window and signs them back in by the round. She has the patience of a clock and the memory of a book, and soldiers who come back a cartridge short learn to come back with an explanation.

**Speaking Style:** Flat and dry, reading back serial numbers as though they were insults.
**Combat Role:** an armourer who shoots like a range officer; a carbine from the rack, braced on the hatch sill, steady and unhurried
**Relationship Hook:** A woman behind a barred hatch running a pencil down a book while a private waits with his cap in his hands.
personality: Core: counts everything twice; says no first and listens afterwards; respects a man who cleans his rifle unasked
Quirk: knits in the armoury between sign-outs

npcs.name: Sten Rauh
npcs.info:
The ferryman of Kessel Ford, who hauls the rope ferry across when the water is high and marks the sledge track when the river is frozen. He is sly, weathered and never without a pipe.

**Speaking Style:** Rough and sly, a ferryman who answers every question with a price.
**Combat Role:** none; a ferry pole and a river he knows
**Relationship Hook:** A sly ferryman with a pipe hauling a rope ferry across a half-frozen river at dusk.
personality: Core: sly and weathered; always has a pipe; never asks a passenger's name
Quirk: knows the river better than anyone

npcs.name: Stepan Barsuk
npcs.info:
A Drachman sergeant who runs a field kitchen in the tent lines, a grey, round man who feeds a company out of one iron pot and keeps its spirits up with soup and gossip. He has been to the border four times in his service and come home every time.

**Speaking Style:** Hoarse and jovial, a field cook's voice roughened by smoke and gossip.
**Combat Role:** an old infantryman with a short rifle and a long ladle; he keeps to the back of an attack and comes home
**Relationship Hook:** A round Drachman sergeant stirring a steaming field pot and telling a joke to a line of cold soldiers.
personality: Core: gossips to keep men cheerful; talks to his soup pot; shares out the last of anything
Quirk: never says the word war

npcs.name: Stojan Mirkov
npcs.info:
The captain of the federal guard at the tribal line keeps the toll gate between two tribes who would cheerfully kill each other over a ram. His guards wear a uniform neither tribe trusts, and he has learned to sleep with one eye open.

**Speaking Style:** Gruff and tired, a federal captain who talks like a man reading a list of complaints.
**Combat Role:** a federal officer's rifle and revolver; he fights to separate, not to kill
**Relationship Hook:** A weary moustached captain in a federal uniform standing between two angry herders at a gatehouse.
personality: Core: tired of everyone; settles quarrels with fines and bribes; loyal to the federal government and bitter about it
Quirk: speaks every tribal dialect badly

npcs.name: Storch
npcs.info:
Lieutenant Colonel Storch, personal secretary to Führer King Bradley in Central, a correct, formal officer who stands at the Führer's shoulder. He was among the officers who wanted Edward Elric disqualified when the boy aimed a spear at the Führer during his exam.

**Speaking Style:** Correct, formal and cold; he says what the Führer wants said and nothing more.
**Combat Role:** a sidearm and a platoon
**Relationship Hook:** A stiff secretary at the Führer's door, handing a lieutenant her transfer orders.
personality: Core: correct and formal; loyal to the office; cold with juniors
Quirk: pragmatic when the wind changes

npcs.name: Su Wanqing
npcs.info:
A letter-writer at a folding table on Inkstone Lane, who writes for servants, soldiers' mothers and lovers who cannot write. Her hand is neat rather than beautiful, and she charges less than the men at the next tables.

**Speaking Style:** Bright and precise, every word pronounced as if it were being written down.
**Combat Role:** none; a heavy ink stone and a lane full of neighbours
**Relationship Hook:** A letter-writer pausing over her ink stone to glance at the empty table beside hers.
personality: Core: writes every letter as if it mattered most; reads the sender's face while she takes dictation; keeps the seal-copier's table dusted
Quirk: too honest to lie well and too clever to lie badly

npcs.name: Sverre Eckholt
npcs.info:
The welder in charge of the assembly floor, a broad, scorched man with goggles pushed up on a bald head and old burns on both forearms. Every plate on the new machine went on under his own torch, and he swears at it in a low, fond growl.

**Speaking Style:** A low growl full of affection for machines and short patience for people; he swears softly and constantly.
**Combat Role:** a welder's brawl; a torch flare in the face, a hammer to the knee, and a grip that has bent iron
**Relationship Hook:** A bald welder with goggles on his forehead running a gloved thumb along a seam and scowling.
personality: Core: talks to steel as if it could hear; pushes his goggles up to look a man in the eye; refuses help with the fuel lines
Quirk: shares his tobacco and nothing else

npcs.name: Tam Hollins
npcs.info:
A private on the spur gate, nineteen and talkative, who has been told the depot is the safest posting in the West and believes it. He waves trains under the fence, chats to the drivers and whistles to keep himself awake.

**Speaking Style:** Cheerful and loud, a young sentry who talks to fill every silence on a long watch.
**Combat Role:** a sentry's rifle and bayonet, used enthusiastically and badly
**Relationship Hook:** A gangly red-haired sentry with a lantern waving a goods wagon toward a fenced gate.
personality: Core: talks to anyone and everyone; bluffs when he is out of his depth; eager to be useful
Quirk: afraid of the dark and ashamed of it

npcs.name: Tao Lingshu
npcs.info:
A senior student who runs the infirmary room at the side of the hall, where the poor of the capital come to be treated by students for nothing. He is earnest, thin from skipped meals and better with frightened patients than with examiners.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and kind, a voice that tells a patient the truth slowly.
**Combat Role:** a student alkahestrist; a circle drawn fast and a patient's attacker sent stumbling, and then he panics
**Relationship Hook:** A thin student bending over a cot in a lamplit room, a bandage half wound round a stranger's arm.
personality: Core: earnest to the point of foolishness; forgets to eat when the room is full; talks a frightened patient into stillness
Quirk: freezes in front of an examiner

npcs.name: Tao Ruyi
npcs.info:
A Xingese healer who came to bathe at the springs a month ago and has not left. She sits in the hottest pool with her eyes closed for hours, and treats the herders' old men for their joints in exchange for bread.

**Speaking Style:** Light and drifting; she pauses mid-sentence to listen to something no one else can hear.
**Combat Role:** an alkahestrist with throwing darts and a circle drawn at a distance, healing herself as she fights
**Relationship Hook:** A Xingese woman with closed eyes sitting in a steaming pool among yellow sulphur crust.
personality: Core: serene and distracted; listens to the ground; heals for bread
Quirk: frightened of the west

npcs.name: Tarek Osman
npcs.info:
An Ishvalan father walking the old exiles' track north to the ruins with his wife and two children, years after the war, having hidden in the southern hills until the hills got too dangerous. He reads the names on the cairns aloud as he passes.

**Speaking Style:** Gentle and exhausted; a father who keeps his voice low so his children do not hear him fear.
**Combat Role:** none; a father who stands between his family and anything
**Relationship Hook:** A weary Ishvalan father with a child on his back resting by a cairn with names scratched into it.
personality: Core: gentle and exhausted; reads every cairn aloud; shields his children
Quirk: will not run and leave the weak behind

npcs.name: Tariq Mahdar
npcs.info:
The leader of the Ishvalans who hold the Ishvalan Red Canyon and will not stop fighting: a tall, scarred man in his thirties who walks the ledges as if they were a street. He fought through the war and has never surrendered.

**Speaking Style:** Cool and low, a commander's voice that weighs every word before letting it go.
**Combat Role:** a desert guerrilla with a rifle and a long knife; ambush from the ledges, then gone
**Relationship Hook:** A tall scarred man standing on a canyon ledge with a rifle on his back, watching a patrol far below.
personality: Core: cold-headed and protective; spares soldiers who can be spared; sleeps on the ledge, never the floor
Quirk: listens to every man in council before speaking

npcs.name: Tarrin
npcs.info:
The foreman of the Youswell coal mine's headframe, who runs the lifts and counts the shifts in and out. He is hard-handed, careful with the lifts and suspicious of every man the lieutenant sends. He knows which tunnels are safe and which have gone bad.

**Speaking Style:** Blunt and hoarse, a foreman who shouts over the machinery and then mutters when nobody is listening.
**Combat Role:** none; a foreman's hands and a hammer for the signal bell
**Relationship Hook:** A foreman at a mine headframe, shouting orders over the sound of the lift.
personality: Core: hoarse, blunt and careful; counts every man in and out; distrusts the owner's men
Quirk: knows which tunnels hold gas

npcs.name: Tarvo Rinne
npcs.info:
The head groom of the remount stables, a slow, soft-voiced man who talks to horses in a hill dialect and to officers as little as he can. He can tell which animal will face a blizzard by watching it eat.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and soft in a hill accent, the voice he uses on frightened horses and rarely on men.
**Combat Role:** a groom's defence; a pitchfork, a stable door slammed, and a horse taught to rear at a whistle
**Relationship Hook:** A soft-spoken groom leading a shaggy, blanketed horse down a row of stalls, murmuring to it.
personality: Core: talks to horses as people and to people as weather; grooms Smith's horse before his own supper; reads with a finger under each word
Quirk: goes out into any storm after a loose horse

npcs.name: Tassilo Kemmerich
npcs.info:
Second lieutenant and the general's aide-de-camp, a slim, tidy young officer who guards the outer office with an appointment book and a smile that never quite reaches his eyes. He brews Grumman's tea, files the papers the old man will not read and knows to the minute how long a colonel can be kept waiting before he takes offence. He plays chess badly on purpose when the general asks him to.

**Speaking Style:** Dry, careful and very polite, an aide who answers a question with exactly the words it needs and no more.
**Combat Role:** a trained officer with a service pistol; he would rather close a door than fight through one
**Relationship Hook:** A neat young lieutenant at a desk outside a general's door, pen poised, watching the stairs.
personality: Core: courteous to everyone and close to nobody; remembers every face and every brand of cigarette; straightens the coat stand whenever he walks past it
Quirk: loses at chess on purpose

npcs.name: Teodor Sill
npcs.info:
The ganger of the platelayers, an old man in charge of four older ones, who walk the spur every morning with bars and shovels and know every sleeper by its knots. They are slow and never wrong.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and rumbling, a ganger who talks in the rhythm of a hammer on a spike.
**Combat Role:** a platelayer's crowbar, swung slowly and very hard
**Relationship Hook:** An old ganger on a bench by a stove writing a number in a notebook while the kettle boils.
personality: Core: slow and certain; loyal to the gang before the company
Quirk: writes everything in a notebook

npcs.name: Tetsu
npcs.info:
A young boy of Rush Valley with an automail right leg, lost in an accident nobody talks about, who keeps Atelier Garfiel busy with repairs. He is cheeky, cheerful and much happier to have a pretty girl working on his leg than the chief engineer.

**Speaking Style:** Cheeky and eager, a boy who flirts outrageously with any girl holding a wrench.
**Combat Role:** none
**Relationship Hook:** A small boy swinging his steel leg on a workshop stool, grinning at the new mechanic.
personality: Core: flirts with any pretty mechanic; hard on his automail; eager
Quirk: cheeky and cheerful

npcs.name: Teuta Marku
npcs.info:
A goatherd of the unmapped ranges, a strong, sun-blackened woman who drives her goats along the high ledges where neither army goes. She belongs to no country and says so, and she trades cheese and news down the mountains.

**Speaking Style:** Rough and few-worded, a mountain goatherd who speaks as if the wind might steal her words.
**Combat Role:** a goatherd's sling and staff; she fights from the ledges where an enemy cannot follow
**Relationship Hook:** A weathered goatherd holding an old dented helmet on a mountain ledge, goats behind her.
personality: Core: belongs to no country; speaks little and listens much; fearless on the ledges
Quirk: honest in trade and suspicious of soldiers

npcs.name: Thaddeus Brock
npcs.info:
A drover who walks flocks down the green road to East City in a week with three dogs, a long staff and a pack on his back, and swears the sheep sell better for the walk. He is huge, bearded and good-humoured, and carries letters and small parcels for anyone who distrusts the post office. He has never lost a sheep or a letter.

**Speaking Style:** Big and rolling, a drover's voice that carries over a thousand sheep.
**Combat Role:** a long drover's staff and three dogs; he wades in and knocks men flat
**Relationship Hook:** A huge bearded drover on a green road, staff in hand, three collies at his heels.
personality: Core: big-voiced and good-humoured; avoids the corner by the station; fights hard and forgives fast
Quirk: never opens a letter he carries

npcs.name: Thea Achterberg
npcs.info:
A widowed sheep farmer on the east lane who runs four hundred ewes with two hired boys and her own two hands. She is square, weathered and blunt, and her fleeces have been the best on her side of the river for a decade. This year the army's clerk marked them third grade, and she has come to the office with a sample under each arm.

**Speaking Style:** Low and hard, a farmer who speaks slowly so nobody can say they misheard.
**Combat Role:** a sheep farmer's strength and a crook worked like a quarterstaff
**Relationship Hook:** A square-built farmer slapping a fleece down on an army desk and waiting, arms folded.
personality: Core: blunt and slow-spoken; counts her ewes twice a day; loyal to her hired boys
Quirk: never raises her voice, never backs down

npcs.name: Theobald Glaser
npcs.info:
The head steward of the officers' club, a former sergeant major with a chest like a cask and a bad left knee from Ishval. He runs the club's servants as he once ran a company and keeps the card room himself. Members tip him well, call him by his surname and forget that he can hear.

**Speaking Style:** Slow, deep and correct, a sergeant major's voice wrapped in a steward's manners.
**Combat Role:** an old infantry brawler; heavy hands, a steward's tray used like a shield and a service knife he has not drawn in years
**Relationship Hook:** A huge steward in a white jacket standing outside a closed card-room door, a silver tray held like a shield.
personality: Core: correct, patient and watchful; loyal to the club, not to any member; protects the young servants
Quirk: remembers who sat where at every dinner

npcs.name: Theodor Hask
npcs.info:
The manager of the Northern Savings Bank, a thin precise man who knows every debt in the city by heart and keeps his counting house as warm as a church and as quiet. Soldiers send their pay home through him; farmers borrow from him and hate him for it.

**Speaking Style:** Precise and quiet, every figure spoken as though it were a small private joke.
**Combat Role:** none; a strongroom door, a guard on the step and a list that would ruin six officers
**Relationship Hook:** A thin banker in pince-nez comparing two receipts under a green lamp and not liking the answer.
personality: Core: precise to the last cen; never forgets a debt or a favour; keeps his voice low in his own hall
Quirk: eats the same lunch at the same minute every day

npcs.name: Thilo Vey
npcs.info:
The senior clerk of the customs hall, who reads every pass, stamps every trunk and writes every name that crosses the border into a book as thick as a doorstep. His handwriting is beautiful and his patience is endless, and he uses both as weapons.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, precise and unhurried; he reads every word aloud as if tasting it.
**Combat Role:** a clerk who does not fight; he presses the bell under the counter and steps behind the stamp press
**Relationship Hook:** A neat clerk in spectacles turning a pass over in the lamplight, pen hovering above an enormous book.
personality: Core: never raises his voice above the stove's crackle; admires good forgery even when it is aimed at him; keeps two pens and never confuses them
Quirk: reads a pass three times before he looks up

npcs.name: Tian Ruoxi
npcs.info:
A retainer girl of fifteen with quick hands and a quicker temper, the best of the hall's young students with the throwing knife. She touches Lan Fan's empty peg before every bout and has not yet lost a bout after touching it.

**Speaking Style:** Quick and sure, every sentence a little ahead of her manners.
**Combat Role:** a young retainer with kunai and a short blade; fast, accurate and too eager to close
**Relationship Hook:** A girl reaching up to touch an empty peg on a wall of masks, a kunai already in her other hand.
personality: Core: throws before she thinks and is usually right; argues with her elders and apologises afterwards; keeps a list of desert dangers whose names she cannot pronounce
Quirk: touches the empty peg before every bout

npcs.name: Tibor Gans
npcs.info:
A gangly corporal from the farm country of the east who keeps the keys to the post's two cells and spends more time talking to the drunks in them than to his own sergeant. He knows everyone in Reole by their first name, which is more than the rest of the post can say.

**Speaking Style:** Easy, quick and a little sly; a young soldier who makes a joke of everything and a deal of the rest.
**Combat Role:** a green soldier with a rifle he cleans more than he fires; he talks before he shoots
**Relationship Hook:** A gangly young corporal leaning on a cell's bars, sharing a loaf with the drunk inside.
personality: Core: friendly and careless; trades anything for anything; laughs when he is frightened
Quirk: shares his bread with the prisoners

npcs.name: Tibor Lask
npcs.info:
A copper digger in the green-stained pits, a slow careful man who washes thin ore in a sluice that runs only after rain. He stays for the stones an alchemist pays him to bring, not for the copper.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and thoughtful, a digger who chooses his words like ore.
**Combat Role:** a digger with a pick and good sense; he backs into his pit and swings
**Relationship Hook:** A stooped man in a battered hat leaning on a pick in a shallow pit of green-stained rock.
personality: Core: careful and slow; never asks his buyer questions; talks to the rock
Quirk: a little greedy

npcs.name: Tilde Vass
npcs.info:
A peat cutter on Hollin Peat Moor, one of the poor families who cut peat to burn instead of buying coal. She is grim, strong and practical, and she sold something she found in the peat to an alchemist for more money than she has seen in her life.

**Speaking Style:** Flat and grim, a peat cutter who never smiles at good news because there has never been any.
**Combat Role:** none; a peat spade and a moor she knows
**Relationship Hook:** A grim peat cutter with a spade standing over a black pool with broken ice.
personality: Core: never smiles; strong as a man; regrets the money
Quirk: grim and practical

npcs.name: Till Ahrend
npcs.info:
A deserter of twenty from a southern infantry regiment, a month gone from the line and living in a hollow olive trunk. He is thin, filthy and polite, and he jumps at every snapping twig. He walked away from Fotset one night and has not decided where he is walking to.

**Speaking Style:** Hoarse and hurried, a deserter who keeps his voice below the wind in the leaves.
**Combat Role:** an infantryman's training and a knife; his rifle is buried in the grove
**Relationship Hook:** A filthy young deserter crouched in the hollow of an old olive tree, holding his breath.
personality: Core: polite even when starving; ashamed and not sorry; grateful to the goat girl
Quirk: jumps at every sound

npcs.name: Tilo Wandt
npcs.info:
The corporal who keeps the army's register of the refugee tents: names, ages, villages and tent numbers. He is bespectacled, polite and conscientious, and he believes the register is for food and blankets. The refugees think he is the worst man in the camp.

**Speaking Style:** Polite and careful, a clerk soldier who reads names off a list as if apologising for each.
**Combat Role:** a clerk's rifle, rarely loaded
**Relationship Hook:** A bespectacled young corporal with a clipboard standing awkwardly between rows of grey tents.
personality: Core: polite and conscientious; loves a neat list; frightened of his lieutenant
Quirk: beginning to lie on paper

npcs.name: Tim Marcoh
npcs.info:
The village doctor of a nameless hamlet on the road between East City and Resembool, who goes by Dr. Mauro and treats everyone for almost nothing. He is a kind, hardworking, broad-shouldered old man with a heavy jaw and grey at his temples. The villagers swear he can cure anything. He flinches at uniforms and at the name Marcoh.

**Speaking Style:** A soft, careful old doctor's voice, courteous and tired, that trails into long silences when the past comes near.
**Combat Role:** alchemy through a circle tattooed on his right palm, and a doctor's precision
**Relationship Hook:** An old village doctor in a white coat bent over a child, who stiffens when a soldier walks in.
personality: Core: kind, courteous and careful; treats everyone the same; thinks his own death would be justice
Quirk: never speaks of Ishval

npcs.name: Timofei Barsuk
npcs.info:
The sergeant of the Drachman blockhouse facing the fort, a broad, bearded man with a broken nose and a tobacco habit he feeds by trading at the barrier with Briggs patrols. He and the Amestrian corporals who meet him there have about a hundred words in common and use every one.

**Speaking Style:** Rough and warm, a belly laugh behind every few words of broken Amestrian.
**Combat Role:** a frontier sergeant with a rifle at the loophole and a log axe at the door
**Relationship Hook:** A broad Drachman sergeant with a broken nose peering through a rifle loophole, chewing.
personality: Core: laughs from the belly; trades before he talks; keeps a list of Amestrian words inside his cap
Quirk: chews tobacco when he cannot smoke

npcs.name: Tobi Larch
npcs.info:
The signalman's grandson, eleven, who runs up the outside stair with his grandfather's dinner every day and stays to pull a lever when nobody is looking. He is quick, nosy and in love with engines. He keeps a notebook of locomotive numbers and a pocketful of things found beside the line.

**Speaking Style:** Breathless and eager, a boy who tells a secret in the same breath he swears to keep it.
**Combat Role:** none; quick feet and a gap under the signal box he can hide in
**Relationship Hook:** A red-haired boy on a signal box stair, a folded paper hidden in his notebook.
personality: Core: eager and nosy; collects engine numbers; adores his grandfather
Quirk: keeps secrets badly

npcs.name: Toghan Sechen
npcs.info:
Chief of the herders who raise the guard's horses on the northern grassland, a broad, quiet man of the steppe families who has paid his tribute in horses to the Emperor for thirty years. He lives in a felt tent and counts his herds by name.

**Speaking Style:** Deep and unhurried, a herder's voice that carries across a grassland without shouting.
**Combat Role:** a steppe horseman with a bow and a lasso; he fights from the saddle and never dismounts
**Relationship Hook:** A broad herder in a fur-trimmed hat at the door of a felt tent, looking out over a grassland of horses.
personality: Core: counts his horses by name; quiet and immovable; proud of the steppe and patient with the court
Quirk: pours milk on the ground for luck before every count

npcs.name: Tom
npcs.info:
An Ishvalan boy of East City's slums and Rick's friend, who runs at his side through the alleys and the drains and does whatever Rick decides.

**Speaking Style:** Small and cheerful, a boy who echoes his friend and laughs at everything.
**Combat Role:** none
**Relationship Hook:** A small boy keeping watch at an alley mouth while his friend works.
personality: Core: cheerful and loyal; laughs at everything; keeps a secret
Quirk: follows Rick everywhere

npcs.name: Tomas
npcs.info:
The town crier of Asbec, who reads the army's notices in the square and adds his own comments in a louder voice. He is young, cheeky and brave enough to say what the notices leave out, and the soldiers have warned him more than once.

**Speaking Style:** Loud and proud, a crier who reads the notices as if they were poems.
**Combat Role:** none; a bell and a loud voice
**Relationship Hook:** A town crier in a square reading a notice aloud while a soldier glares.
personality: Core: loud, cheeky and brave; reads notices as poems; adds what the notices leave out
Quirk: warned by soldiers more than once

npcs.name: Tong Weiran
npcs.info:
Captain of the western gate of the capital, where the caravans from the sand come in under his eye. Tong Weiran reads a travel pass the way other men read faces: slowly, twice, and with his thumb over the seal. He has stood this gate for eleven years and has an opinion about every camel driver on the road.

**Speaking Style:** Short and flat, a gate captain's voice that asks a question once and waits.
**Combat Role:** a gate guard's halberd and a short sword; he plugs the gateway and lets the narrow arch do half the fighting
**Relationship Hook:** A gate captain holding a travel pass up to the sun while a whole caravan waits behind it.
personality: Core: reads every pass twice and every face once; calls camels by name and drivers by their clan; pays his debts and expects the world to pay its own
Quirk: loathes being watched while he works

npcs.name: Torben Kjeld
npcs.info:
The sergeant of the north rampart watch, roped to the rail in a gale with frost on his field glasses. He counts the Drachman cooking fires every night and chalks the number on the wall of the watch shelter, so the next watch can see the column grow.

**Speaking Style:** Hard and clipped, rising against the wind; quieter only when he is truly angry.
**Combat Role:** a rampart fighter; rifle from the parapet, grenade over the edge, and a rope rail he can move along faster than a man can climb
**Relationship Hook:** A frost-bearded sergeant roped to a rail on top of the wall, field glasses to his eyes, the snow coming sideways.
personality: Core: ties his own rope before checking anyone else's; writes everything in chalk where everyone can read it; scrapes the snow off the walk himself at dawn
Quirk: grows angrier the quieter he gets

npcs.name: Torvald Mikkelsen
npcs.info:
The kennelman of the fort's sled teams, a short, cheerful man in a fur coat who knows every dog by name and most soldiers by number. He breeds the teams, trains them and goes out with them when the lorries cannot move.

**Speaking Style:** Cheerful and fond, a voice that drops to a coax whenever a dog is near.
**Combat Role:** a kennelman with a sled whip and a team that obeys him; the dogs strike first
**Relationship Hook:** A short man in furs whistling three anxious notes at an empty dog run, a broken harness in his hands.
personality: Core: calls dogs by name and men by number; feeds the teams before he eats; whistles three notes when he is worried
Quirk: keeps the Drachman word on a scrap of paper in his glove

npcs.name: Trude Haas
npcs.info:
The cook of the railhead camp's tent lines, a big cheerful woman who volunteered when her husband's bakery closed. She feeds three hundred men a day from two field kitchens and a bad temper. Every soldier going up the line passes her stove.

**Speaking Style:** Loud and motherly, a camp cook who feeds you before she asks your name.
**Combat Role:** none; a ladle and a cauldron of boiling stew
**Relationship Hook:** A big camp cook ladling stew from a steaming cauldron in a tent camp.
personality: Core: loud and motherly; feeds everyone first
Quirk: notices empty places in the queue

npcs.name: Trudel Rusch
npcs.info:
The furnaceman's daughter, fourteen and fierce, who has carried coal up the scrub rise every day since her father went missing, to keep the furnace at the foot of the air shaft burning. She knows the furnace keeps the men below breathing, and nobody else seems to care.

**Speaking Style:** Bright and breathless, a girl who talks to keep herself brave.
**Combat Role:** none; a poker and a temper
**Relationship Hook:** A soot-smeared girl raking a dying furnace at the foot of a lone brick chimney in the scrub.
personality: Core: talks to herself to stay brave; trusts nobody in uniform
Quirk: fierce and frightened

npcs.name: Trudi Marrow
npcs.info:
The senior of Garfiel's three apprentices, seventeen and certain she will have her own sign over a door within five years. She came down from a farm near South Hood with a bag of her father's broken clocks and talked her way onto a bench by mending one in the window while Garfiel watched. She files finger joints all day, eats lunch standing and keeps a pencil behind each ear in case one snaps.

**Speaking Style:** Quick and chattering, an apprentice who names each tool as she reaches for it and laughs at her own burns.
**Combat Role:** none worth the name; a bench file swung like a club and a loud shout for the master
**Relationship Hook:** An apprentice in an oily apron filing a steel knuckle and chattering to it under her breath.
personality: Core: jealous of talent and too honest to hide it; eats the sweets meant for the tea corner when nobody looks; offers to fix things that are not broken
Quirk: talks to the joint she is filing, never to the customer
