items.info: A heavy key to the storeroom behind the counter.
items.where: Back Room Hand, Havoc General Store

items.name: Balance Scale
items.info: A brass beam scale in a wooden case, with a set of weights from one gram to a kilo. A careful alchemist weighs everything before a transmutation and again after. 55 Cens, sold at Market Row.

items.name: Bar Hand's Apron
items.info: A stained apron worn by the bar staff.

items.name: Bar Tab Chit
items.info: A worn chit from the bar's tab book.

items.name: Believer's Charm
items.info: A small carved charm of the god's symbol.

items.name: Birth Register Copy
items.info: A certified copy of a birth entry in the register, with a family's name and the date written in a clerk's careful hand. The State Military asks for one before it will take a recruit. Found, never sold: Parliament House.

items.name: Black Tea Tin
items.info: A tin of loose black tea with a paper label, brewed strong in a teapot and drunk with sugar. Every kitchen has a tin. 8 Cens, sold at any town market.

items.name: Blowpipe Lamp
items.info: A brass lamp with a tube and a bellows, which turns a small flame into a hot point for melting solder and sealing glass. 15 Cens, sold at Forge Street.

items.name: Blue Armband
items.info: A strip of blue cloth the squad's men tie on when they act.

items.name: Bodyguard's Pin
items.info: A pin of the crew, worn on a jacket.

items.name: Bolt Cutters
items.info: A pair of long-handled cutters with hardened jaws that snap a padlock or a steel wire at a stroke. 22 Cens, sold at Old Garrison Yard.

items.name: Book of Accounts
items.info: A thick account book bound in green cloth, ruled in red and black for the day's sales and the month's debts. Its owner trusts no one who does not keep one. 12 Cens, sold at Market Row.

items.name: Border Crossing Papers
items.info: A folded sheet with a seal and a signature, stamped at the checkpoint and read again at every post along the road. A traveller without it waits in the queue until someone decides to care. Found, never sold: Ishval Border Gate.

items.name: Bottle of Fresh Milk
items.info: A glass bottle of milk still cold from the cellar, with the cream rising to the neck. It goes sour within two days in summer. 2 Cens, sold at Barn Yard.

items.name: Bottled Spring Water
items.info: A glass bottle of cold spring water, corked and sold at the station kiosk to passengers who do not trust the tap. 2 Cens, sold at Central Rail Yard.

items.name: Branch Keeper's Key Ring
items.info: A ring of keys to the branch's stacks and cases.

items.name: Brass Chart Case
items.info: A long brass case that holds a set of rolled survey charts for a road or a railway, sold empty or with its charts still inside. 55 Cens, sold at Clock Room.

items.name: Brass Compass
items.info: A round brass compass with a glass lid and a needle that shivers when it settles, taken on any road where the map runs out. 22 Cens, sold at any town market.

items.name: Brass Knuckles
items.info: A bar of brass with four ring-holes and a flat grip, slipped over the fingers for a punch that breaks noses. Bar fights in the cities go the way of whoever wears them. 9 Cens, sold at Front Bar.

items.name: Brass Ring
items.info: A plain band of brass worn by a man who wants a ring and cannot afford gold, sold in a box of twelve. 15 Cens, sold at Pawn Corner.

items.name: Brass Telescope
items.info: A long brass telescope in a leather sleeve, with three draw tubes and a lens that shows a distant chimney in sharp detail. 210 Cens, sold at Lookout Bench.

items.name: Brigadier's Dark Ring
items.info: A dark ring cut with a blank seal.

items.name: Brigadier's Dog Tag
items.info: A dark steel tag with a general's name stamped in full.

items.name: Brigadier's Star
items.info: A star of rank on a dark collar, the mark of a general's staff.

items.name: Briggs Leggings
items.info: Thick padded leggings with a fur cuff at the ankle, worn over woollen trousers on the high passes. They keep the cold from the knee down and stop the snow getting in. 140 Cens, sold at Fort Briggs.

items.name: Briggs Parka
items.info: A heavy parka of sealskin and wool with a fur-lined hood and a windproof outer shell, sewn to keep the wearer alive on the mountain roads. Its inner lining is changed each season. 320 Cens, sold at Fort Briggs.

items.name: Bronze Mirror
items.info: A round bronze mirror with a polished face and a knob handle, its back cast with a pattern of animals. 90 Cens, sold at Jade Row.

items.name: Brothers' Keepsake
items.info: A small token of the journey, given to each companion.

items.name: Brown Bread Loaf
items.info: A dense round loaf with a hard crust and a grey crumb, the bread every household buys on the way home. It fills a stomach for a day. 3 Cens, sold at any town market.

items.name: Buckler
items.info: A small round shield with a central boss and a leather strap, light enough to parry with and handy in a crowded street. 28 Cens, sold at Reole Market Hall.

items.name: Butcher's Cleaver
items.info: A heavy square-backed blade on a beech handle, the knife of every butcher's back room. It takes a bone in one stroke and is nearly as deadly as a sword in an untrained hand. 5 Cens, sold at Shop Counter.

items.name: Calibration Gauge Set
items.info: A box of brass gauges and a dial that measures the travel of a joint against its spec, used to set an arm before it goes on a customer. 60 Cens, sold at Fitting Bench.

items.name: Canned Beef Ration
items.info: A square tin of salted beef and fat, sealed by the army's canners and issued to every soldier on a long march. The tin opens with a key on its side. 8 Cens, sold at Supply Depot.

items.name: Canvas Tent
items.info: A two-man tent of waxed canvas with wooden pegs and a ridge pole, taken on the long roads and in the army's field camps. 40 Cens, sold at Old Caravan Track.

items.name: Captain's Border Map
items.info: A worn map of the northern passes, marked in ink.

items.name: Captain's Lacquered Bar
items.info: A lacquered bar of rank, worn at the collar.
items.where: Captain of the Guard, Yao clan

items.name: Captain's Notebook
items.info: A notebook of orders and duties, bound in brown leather.

items.name: Carbolic Wash
items.info: A brown liquid that stings when poured on a cut, used to kill what the blade carried in. Doctors swear by it, and most patients remember the smell. 9 Cens, sold at any herbalist.

items.name: Carbon Fibre Sheet
items.info: A stiff black sheet of woven carbon fibre bound in resin, cut for the frames of a cold-climate limb. It is light, it resists the frost and it is hard to work without the right saw. 180 Cens, sold at Automail Row.

items.name: Carbon Frame Leg
items.info: A leg with a carbon frame, lighter than steel and stronger under a twist. Its joints are sealed against grit, which makes it a favourite of the wandering mechanics. 1300 Cens, sold at Rush Valley.

items.name: Carpenter's Hammer
items.info: A claw hammer with an ash handle and a steel head, the first tool in any kit. 7 Cens, sold at Market Row.

items.name: Carved Ivory Seal
items.info: A small square seal of carved ivory with a name cut into its face, used to sign letters and papers in the Xingese way. 110 Cens, sold at Jade Row.

items.name: Cataloguer's Index Cards
items.info: A bundle of blank index cards tied with string.

items.name: Cavalry Lance
items.info: An ash shaft with a pennant below the steel point. Lancers use it at the charge, and a sergeant on foot is glad to have one in the square. 75 Cens, sold at Commander's Keep.

items.name: Cell Hand's Timetable
items.info: A railway timetable with certain trains marked in pencil.

items.name: Cell Leader's Cipher Card
items.info: A small card that turns the squad's letters into plain words.

items.name: Cens
items.info: The nation's money: paper bills for the large sums and metal coins for the small, the coins that the common markets use. Every price in Amestris is named in cens, from a loaf to a train ticket to an automail limb, and a foreign coin must be changed before it buys anything here.

items.name: Ceramic Teapot
items.info: A teapot of white porcelain with blue cranes painted on its belly and a jade handle. Xingese families keep one for guests. 150 Cens, sold at Silk Street.

items.name: Certification Pin
items.info: A small enamel pin with the programme's dragon in a hexagram.

items.name: Chain Vest
items.info: A vest of riveted steel rings lined with padded cloth, worn under a coat by guards and bodyguards who expect a knife. It stops a blade but not a bullet, and it is heavy to sleep in. 180 Cens, sold at Automail Row.

items.name: Chalk Stick Set
items.info: A bundle of white and grey chalk sticks in a cardboard sleeve, sold for drawing circles on the spot. The chalk marks stone, wood and cloth, and a careful hand can draw a small circle in a minute. 12 Cens, sold at Stall Lane.

items.name: Chang Clan Tassel
items.info: A red silk tassel in the clan's knot, given to its servants.

items.name: Chang Elder's Seal
items.info: A small jade seal of the Chang clan, used on letters to the court.

items.name: Charge Satchel
items.info: A canvas satchel of demolition charges with a length of fuse.

items.name: Cheese Wheel
items.info: A hard round cheese in a grey rind, sold by the wedge. Farmers make it in the spring and it lasts through the winter. 12 Cens, sold at Produce Row.

items.name: Chess Set
items.info: A set of carved wooden pieces in a folding board, one side stained dark and one side pale, used on the park benches. 70 Cens, sold at Bandstand.

items.name: Chief Librarian's Seal
items.info: A brass seal that marks a book as the nation's property.

items.name: Chief Researcher's Gold Pen
items.info: A heavy fountain pen with a gold nib, used to sign the team's reports.

items.name: Chimera's Vial
items.info: A vial of a red fluid, drunk to speed healing.

items.name: Chocolate Bar
items.info: A bar of dark chocolate in a paper wrapper, bitter and rich, carried on the march for a quick lift of the spirits. 5 Cens, sold at Stall Lane.

items.name: Chopper's Cleaver
items.info: A heavy cleaver used for the guards' work.

items.name: Chrome Plate
items.info: A bright chrome-finished steel plate, cut for the outer shell of a showy limb. A fitter who wants to impress a customer buys one. 95 Cens, sold at Forge Street.

items.name: Church Pin
items.info: A small enamelled pin of a plain cross, bought at the chapel door by parishioners who wear it to services. 3 Cens, sold at Dublith Chapel.

items.name: Cinnabar Pills
items.info: Red pills of cinnabar and herbs in a tin, bought by porters who want a cure for aches. Cinnabar is poison, and the wise taker takes a single pill. 60 Cens, sold at Porters' Quay.

items.name: Circle Board
items.info: A smooth slate board with a rule scored along one edge and a compass hole at its centre, for drafting a circle before it is drawn on the floor. 45 Cens, sold at Eastern Market.

items.name: Circle Theory Volume
items.info: A heavy volume of diagrams and close notes on how a rune's shape changes the weight of a circle, found tucked among the restricted books. Its margins are full of corrections in a second hand. Found, never sold: Restricted Stacks.

items.name: Clan Elder's Seal
items.info: A seal of the clan's council.

items.name: Clan Guard's Bracer
items.info: A leather bracer with the clan's knot burned into it.

items.name: Clan Heir's Jade
items.info: A piece of jade carved with the house's dragon.

items.name: Clan Retainer's Pin
items.info: A jade pin of the clan's crest.

items.name: Clan Retainer's Ring
items.info: A ring of the clan's crest.

items.name: Clerk's Date Stamp
items.info: A rubber date stamp worn smooth at the corners.

items.name: Clerk's Pencil Stub
items.info: A short pencil tied to a string.

items.name: Climbing Spikes
items.info: A pair of steel spikes that strap to the boots for climbing a pole or a tree. They are a sure grip on bark and a bad trip on stone. 18 Cens, sold at Old Lumber Camp.

items.name: Cloth Slippers
items.info: Soft slippers of black cloth with a thin sole and a stitched fabric top, worn indoors and at the temple. 3 Cens, sold at Jade Row.

items.name: Coal Briquettes
items.info: Pressed bricks of coal dust and pitch, cheap fuel for the cottage stove. They burn longer than raw coal and throw less smoke. 3 Cens, sold at Miners' Row.

items.name: Coal Shovel
items.info: A broad iron shovel with a short handle, for loading the tub at the bottom of the shaft. 9 Cens, sold at Miners' Row.

items.name: Coil of Rope
items.info: Thirty metres of hemp rope, tarred and coiled, carried by travellers and boatmen for every knot a road can ask for. 6 Cens, sold at Lakeside Pier.

items.name: Cold-Climate Carbon Arm
items.info: A carbon-fibre arm with a frost-proof seal on the joints and a shell that keeps the nerves warm. The cold does not stiffen it the way it stiffens steel. 1400 Cens, sold at Fort Briggs.

items.name: Colonel's Epaulette
items.info: A gold epaulette of a colonel, worn on the right shoulder.

items.name: Colonel's Flame Pin
items.info: A small red flame pin, the sign of the Colonel's own unit.

items.name: Colonel's Map Case
items.info: A leather case with a map of the Briggs passes.

items.name: Combat Automail Arm
items.info: A steel arm built for the fight, with a blade in the forearm.

items.name: Commander's Ring
items.info: A ring of iron, worn by the commander of the northern army.

items.name: Commander's Seal
items.info: A seal cut with the garrison's mark, kept in the commander's coat.

items.name: Contest Ribbon
items.info: A cloth ribbon from one of the street's weekly contests.

items.name: Contest Winner's Medal
items.info: A brass medal with a gear and a hand on its face.
items.where: Contest Winner, Rush Valley automail trade

items.name: Copper Filings Vial
items.info: A small glass vial of fine copper filings stoppered with cork, the cheapest material in a student's kit. It transmutes well and is easy to buy in quantity. 6 Cens, sold at Stall Lane.

items.name: Copper Wire Coil
items.info: A coil of fine copper wire on a wooden spool, used by the forges to carry the signal in an automail limb and by the telephone men to string the lines. 14 Cens, sold at Forge Street.

items.name: Cotton Trousers
items.info: Plain cotton trousers with a button fly and a belt loop, the everyday wear of a labourer. 8 Cens, sold at Market Row.

items.name: Cough Syrup
items.info: A sweet red syrup with a sharp taste of honey and horehound, sold for a cough that will not stop in winter. 7 Cens, sold at Receiving Ward.

items.name: Council Pass
items.info: A plain card with no name, shown to the inner door.

items.name: Counter Boss's Book
items.info: A thick book with two sets of figures for the same goods.

items.name: Court Servant's Token
items.info: A small lacquered tag of the court.

items.name: Cretan Captain's Map
items.info: A hand-drawn map of a border valley, with Amestrian posts marked.

items.name: Cretan Colonel's Sash
items.info: A coloured sash worn by the western army's senior officers.

items.name: Cretan Corporal's Mirror
items.info: A small signal mirror in a leather case.

items.name: Cretan Recruit's Badge
items.info: A tin badge of the western army, rough at the edges.

items.name: Cretan Soldier's Short Spear
items.info: A short spear for the narrow passes.

items.name: Crew Leader's Ring
items.info: A diamond ring worn by the crew's leader.

items.name: Crew Mark
items.info: A diamond-shaped mark, scratched into a wall.

items.name: Crocodile Armour Plate
items.info: A shoulder plate of carbon-fibre sheet with a leather harness, made to carry the weight of a heavy automail arm and shield the back from a hard fall. 250 Cens, sold at Rush Valley.

items.name: Crowbar
items.info: A flat-ended iron bar with a claw at one end, used to lever a door, a stone or a crate open. 16 Cens, sold at Miners' Row.

items.name: Crucible Set
items.info: Three clay pots of graduated size, glazed inside and fired hard, for melting metal over a flame. They last a year of steady use if they are not dropped. 35 Cens, sold at Eastern Market.

items.name: Cup of Coffee
items.info: A small cup of strong black coffee, served in a thick white mug at a stall or a city counter. Clerks drink it to get through the afternoon. 100 Cens, sold at Market Row.

items.name: Deacon's Staff
items.info: A staff of carved wood with a sun at its head.

items.name: Decree Copy Number 3066
items.info: A printed copy of a presidential decree that strips Ishvalan soldiers of their place in the army, jails them as traitors and sends alchemists to the front. Clerks file it under the orders of the day, and nobody reads it aloud. Found, never sold: Parliament House.

items.name: Delivery Cart Tag
items.info: A tag for the shop's cart.

items.name: Desert Cloak
items.info: A long hooded cloak of undyed cloth, wound against the sand, with a loose lower hem that can be gathered into the belt. Ishvalan travellers wear it on the roads of the east. 30 Cens, sold at Ishvalan Bazaar.

items.name: Desert Pottery Shard
items.info: A curved piece of painted clay with a band of red lines, picked from the sand at a well. Travellers pocket them and forget them. Found, never sold: Dry Well Waystation.

items.name: Desert Scimitar
items.info: A broad, light sword with a tapering point, forged for the sand and sold to travellers on the caravan roads. Its edge is thin and keen, and it wants frequent honing. 60 Cens, sold at Ishvalan Bazaar.

items.name: Doctor's Hand Ring
items.info: A gold ring of the Doctor's team.

items.name: Drachman Tag
items.info: A dark iron tag stamped with the army's mark.

items.name: Drafting Set
items.info: A brass compass, a pair of dividers and a set of curved rulers in a walnut box, the instruments a student uses to set out a circle's rings and runes to the hair. 60 Cens, sold at Eastern Market.

items.name: Dragon's Pulse Tonic
items.info: A clear amber drink made from river water blessed in a temple and boiled with ginger and root. Xingese healers say it wakes the body's pulse and it does leave the drinker warm. 45 Cens, sold at Silk Street.

items.name: Dried Fruit Packet
items.info: A paper packet of dried apricots, figs and plums, sweet and chewy, bought for the children and for the road. 3 Cens, sold at Dried Goods Row.

items.name: Dynamite Stick
items.info: A paper tube of blasting powder packed with a fuse, bought for the mines and used by anyone who wants a wall gone. A stick left too long in the sun is unsafe to move. 12 Cens, sold at Mine Road Depot.

items.name: Eastern Officer's Map Case
items.info: A leather map case with the east's rail lines inked inside the lid.

items.name: Eastern Private's Canteen
items.info: A dented canteen that has been to the desert and back.

items.name: Eastern Recruit's Papers
items.info: Enlistment papers stamped at East City headquarters.

items.name: Eastern Sergeant's Whistle
items.info: A brass whistle on a lanyard, for calling the squad.

items.name: Eastern Staff Cord
items.info: A braided shoulder cord worn by the eastern command's staff officers.

items.name: Edward's Pocket Watch
items.info: A worn watch, kept as a reminder of the road.

items.name: Elder's Prayer Book
items.info: A small book of the order's rites.

items.name: Elder's Staff
items.info: A staff of desert wood, carried by the elders.

items.name: Elixir of Long Life
items.info: A red pill in a silk-wrapped box, mixed by a Xingese master from herbs, cinnabar and the art of the Dragon's Pulse. Its promise is long life, and the seller makes no promise about what it costs the one who swallows it. 380 Cens, sold at Silk Street.

items.name: Enforcer's Brass Knuckles
items.info: A pair of brass knuckles, used in a fight.

items.name: Engineer's Caliper
items.info: A caliper for measuring limbs and joints.

items.name: Engineer's Toolkit
items.info: A leather roll of drills, files, a set of pliers and a small vise that folds open on a bench, the full kit of a field engineer. 120 Cens, sold at Old Garrison Yard.

items.name: Engineer's Wrench
items.info: A heavy wrench for the shop's bolts.

items.name: Enlistment Tag
items.info: A stamped steel tag on a cord, worn by every enlisted soldier.

items.name: Etching Chalk
items.info: A hard red chalk that cuts into stone, so a circle etched into a floor stays put for days. Its dust clogs the lungs if a student works in a shut room. 18 Cens, sold at Stall Lane.

items.name: Exam Admission Card
items.info: A stamped card admitting the bearer to the state certification exam.

items.name: Family Crest
items.info: A brass crest of the house, worn on the coat.

items.name: Father's Hand
items.info: A ring of the order, given to Father's hand.

items.name: Favourite's Seal
items.info: A seal cut with the Emperor's mark, given to a favourite.

items.name: Felt Cap
items.info: A soft grey cap with a short peak, the everyday hat of the labouring men. 5 Cens, sold at Market Row.

items.name: Fence's Loupe
items.info: A jeweller's loupe in a worn leather cap.

items.name: Field Bandage Roll
items.info: A roll of boiled linen wrapped in waxed paper, cut and bound onto a wound. It keeps a cut clean on the road until a doctor can see it. 6 Cens, sold at any herbalist.

items.name: Field Binoculars
items.info: A pair of brass binoculars with a leather strap, good for watching a road or a railway line from a hill. 130 Cens, sold at Eastern Market.

items.name: Field Cap
items.info: A wool cap with a fold-down flap for the ears and a cloth badge at the front, the everyday headgear of the barracks. 9 Cens, sold at Eastern Barracks.

items.name: Field Kit
items.info: A leather kit of chalk, gloves and tools for field repairs.

items.name: Field Ration Pack
items.info: A paper pack of hard cheese, dry biscuit and a bar of chocolate, meant to last a patrol for a day. The chocolate is the only part anyone eats first. 4 Cens, sold at Supply Depot.

items.name: Field Shotgun
items.info: A double-barrelled shotgun with an ash stock, loaded with buckshot for boar and for doors. It spreads wide at close range and kicks like a mule. 240 Cens, sold at Miners' Row.

items.name: Fine Kid Gloves
items.info: Gloves of soft pale leather, buttoned at the wrist and cut close to the hand, for dinners and church and for a lady's ride. 25 Cens, sold at Pawn Corner.

items.name: Fitter's Calipers
items.info: A pair of fine calipers for limb measures.

items.name: Fitter's Measuring Tape
items.info: A cloth tape marked for limb lengths and socket widths.

items.name: Flintlock Musket
items.info: An old smoothbore musket with a flint lock and a long barrel, the army's weapon before the rifle came in. It is slow, unreliable in damp weather, and still loads with a ramrod. 35 Cens, sold at Old Garrison Yard.

items.name: Folding Camera
items.info: A wooden box camera on a folding bellows, with a brass lens and a plate holder for glass negatives. It takes a clear picture of a square and makes a fine record of a crime scene. 260 Cens, sold at Radio Capital.

items.name: Foreman's Deed Copy
items.info: A copy of the mine's deed, folded small and carried close.

items.name: Fossil Shell
items.info: A spiral shell of stone found in the cliffs of the lake shore, the kind children collect and carry in a pocket. Found, never sold: Pebble Beach.

items.name: Fragmentation Grenade
items.info: A round iron shell packed with powder and steel fragments, primed with a short fuse. Its fragments reach far enough to kill a man in the open, and the throw needs a steady arm. 40 Cens, sold at Shell Store.

items.name: Fried Dough Twist
items.info: A twist of dough fried in fat and rolled in sugar, sold hot from a pan in the tenement yard. The grease soaks through the paper in a minute. 1 Cens, sold at Tenement Yard.

items.name: Front Commander's Manifesto
items.info: A folded copy of the squad's demands, signed by its leaders.

items.name: Front-line Orders Book
items.info: A notebook of front-line orders.

items.name: Frostbite Ointment
items.info: A thick grey ointment of tallow and camphor, rubbed into the skin of a frostbitten finger or toe. It stings and then warms, and it brings the feeling back in an hour. 19 Cens, sold at Fort Gate.

items.name: Fur Hat
items.info: A warm cap of wolf fur with flaps for the ears, the hat of northern farmers and drivers. It holds its warmth in the wet and dries quickly by a fire. 30 Cens, sold at Fur Row.

items.name: Fuse Cord
items.info: A coil of slow-burning cord with a black core, cut to length for the blasting crews. The burn runs at a steady pace that a careful man can count. 5 Cens, sold at Youswell Square.

items.name: Garrison Tag
items.info: A steel tag stamped with the fort's number, worn on a cord.

items.name: Gatekeeper's Keys
items.info: A ring of keys for the outer doors.

items.name: Gauntlet Shield
items.info: A steel-faced plate strapped to the forearm, with a short spike at the knuckle. It is awkward on a rifle and a fine guard for a man with a sword in the other hand. 90 Cens, sold at Fort Briggs.

items.name: General's Standard
items.info: A small standard of the southern command.

items.name: Generalissimo's Medal
items.info: A heavy medal of the command, hung on a black ribbon.

items.name: Gilded Music Box
items.info: A walnut box with a gilt lid that opens to a small tune on a brass drum. The mechanism is still good, and the tune is one every child in the country knows. 240 Cens, sold at Glotz Pawn Shop.

items.name: Glass Pane
items.info: A square pane of window glass, wrapped in straw for the trip home and set in a frame by the glazier's boy. 8 Cens, sold at Market Row.

items.name: God's Model Arm
items.info: An expensive arm with a high polish, an ornate upper plate and a shine that catches the eye across a room. The makers sell it as the finest work in the country, and the price says it is meant for the rich. 2500000 Cens, sold at Rush Valley.

items.name: God's Model Leg
items.info: A leg of the expensive line, plated in chrome-finished steel and fitted with a bearing that does not whine. A full set of four limbs from this maker costs more than most families see in a lifetime. 2500000 Cens, sold at Rush Valley.

items.name: Gold Leaf Sheet
items.info: A book of thin gold leaves between tissue, sold to gilders and to students who want a rich metal to practise on. 75 Cens, sold at Stall Lane.

items.name: Grain Sack
items.info: A coarse sack of ground grain, the staple of every poor household and the bulk of every ration. 6 Cens, sold at Grain Mill Quarter.

items.name: Gramophone Record
items.info: A black shellac disc with a paper sleeve, recording a dance band and a singer with a bright voice. 12 Cens, sold at Broadcast Studio.

items.name: Grappling Hook
items.info: A four-tined iron hook on a short chain, thrown over a ledge or a wall and pulled taut. It catches on stone better than on wood. 25 Cens, sold at Old Quarry Road.

items.name: Ground Bone Powder
items.info: A pale powder of ground animal bone sold as the dragon's own, for mixing into medicine. Most of it is cattle bone, and the seller will not say otherwise. 30 Cens, sold at Jade Row.

items.name: Ground Red Stone Dust
items.info: A pinch of red powder sold in a paper twist as stone dust. It is ground glass with a red dye, and the dealers who sell it know exactly what it is. 300 Cens, sold at Glotz Pawn Shop.

items.name: Guard's Badge
items.info: A plain iron badge with a number.

items.name: Gunman's Cartridge Belt
items.info: A canvas belt with loops for spare rounds, worn under a coat.

items.name: Gunpowder Keg
items.info: A small oak keg of black powder, sealed with a tar stopper and banded in iron. It is heavy, dangerous and sold only to men with the right papers. 150 Cens, sold at Commander's Keep.

items.name: Hand Axe
items.info: A short-hafted axe with a broad bit, good for splitting kindling and for a fast blow in a fight. Lake fishers keep one in the boat for the nets. 10 Cens, sold at Lakeside Pier.

items.name: Hand Drill
items.info: A brass hand drill with a crank and a set of bits, used to bore holes in wood and in thin steel. 14 Cens, sold at Forge Street.

items.name: Hand Saw
items.info: A saw with a long blade and a wooden handle, good for timber and for cutting a rope clean. 11 Cens, sold at Market Row.

items.name: Hand's Gloves
items.info: Thick leather gloves for handling metal.

items.name: Hand-Built Automail Arm
items.info: A steel right arm fitted to the shoulder socket, with a wire nerve and a locking joint.

items.name: Hand-Built Automail Leg
items.info: A steel left leg fitted to the hip socket, with a wire nerve and a locking knee.

items.name: Hard Ship's Biscuit
items.info: A square of dry flour and water, baked hard enough to keep a year. Boatmen soak it in tea before they eat it. 1 Cens, sold at Lakeside Pier.

items.name: Head Guard's Lantern
items.info: A lantern for night watches.

items.name: Heavy Combat M1913-A
items.info: A combat arm for cold country with no fingers at all, replaced by a chainsaw with a jaw clamp and a clean exhaust that keeps frost off the wearer's nerves. The soldiers call it the Crocodile. 2400 Cens, sold at Rush Valley.

items.name: Heavy Machine Gun
items.info: A water-cooled gun on a tripod, fed by a belt of cartridges and served by a crew of two or three. It holds a line for as long as the belt runs, and its crew is the first target in any fight. Found, never sold: Ishval War Ruins.

items.name: Heavy Rifle
items.info: A long military rifle with a heavy stock, issued to the line.

items.name: Heavy Steel Leg
items.info: A thick steel leg for a heavy man who works the forges or the mines. It is slow on the stair and hard to knock over. 900 Cens, sold at Rush Valley.

items.name: Hewer's Pick Head
items.info: A worn steel pick head, sharpened many times.

items.name: High Father's Relic
items.info: A relic of the sun god, claimed to be genuine.

items.name: Holy Elder's Band
items.info: A band of brass, worn by the faith's highest elders.

items.name: Hostess's Compact
items.info: A small mirror compact with a note folded inside the lid.

items.name: House Boss's Ring
items.info: A heavy ring worn by the bar's boss.

items.name: House Matchbook
items.info: A matchbook printed with the bar's name.

items.name: House Whiskey
items.info: A measure of brown spirit in a thick tumbler, drunk neat by men who want the taste to hurt. The bar keeps it under the counter for the regulars. 18 Cens, sold at Front Bar.

items.name: Household Guard's Sash
items.info: A sash of the household, worn across the chest.

items.name: Household Ring
items.info: A heavy ring of the family's crest, passed from one member to the next.

items.name: Hunter's Knife
items.info: A plain knife of the vigil, sharpened often.

items.name: Hunter's Knives
items.info: A bandolier of balanced throwing knives.

items.name: Hunting Crossbow
items.info: A steel-limbed bow on a wooden stock with a windlass for drawing the string, built for deer and boar in the mountain forests. It is slow to reload and very quiet in the trees. 110 Cens, sold at any gunsmith.

items.name: Hunting Rifle
items.info: A single-shot rifle with a brass sight and a walnut stock, bought by hunters and mine guards who need one clean shot at a distance. It is heavy to carry and light to aim. 190 Cens, sold at Mine Road Depot.

items.name: Hunting Spear
items.info: A spear with a leaf-shaped steel head and a crossbar below it to stop the thrust going too deep. Hunters use it on boar and bear, and the crossbar keeps a wounded animal from climbing the shaft. 30 Cens, sold at Mine Road Depot.

items.name: Ice Pick
items.info: A narrow steel spike on a wooden grip with a hook at the back, used to climb ice and to test a crevasse lid before a foot goes on it. It bites well in frozen stone as well as in ice. 8 Cens, sold at Fort Briggs.

items.name: Infantry Bayonet
items.info: A steel spike with a socket that locks onto a rifle's muzzle. Off the rifle it is a short stabbing knife, and soldiers keep it sharp because the drill sergeant checks it. 18 Cens, sold at Veterans' Row.

items.name: Infantry Rifle
items.info: A bolt-action rifle with a long wooden stock and a five-round internal magazine, the standard arm of the State Military's foot soldiers. It is accurate to a few hundred paces in a steady hand. 260 Cens, sold at Drill Ground.

items.name: Inner Voice's Cipher
items.info: A cipher card for the council's messages.

items.name: Insulated Mitts
items.info: Thick mittens of wool and felt with a fur back, cut so the fingers can still pull a trigger or a rope in the cold. 18 Cens, sold at Fur Row.

items.name: Iron Bar
items.info: A square iron bar, the raw stock of every smith's shop, sold by the weight. 12 Cens, sold at Forge Street.

items.name: Iron Filings Vial
items.info: A stoppered vial of dark iron filings, drawn with a magnet to show the grain. Iron takes a circle well and holds its shape after the work is done. 7 Cens, sold at Stall Lane.

items.name: Iron Flail
items.info: Two wooden staves joined by a short chain, which swings hard and folds away into the sleeve. It is easy to hide and hard to block cleanly, and a clumsy user hits himself first. 40 Cens, sold at Jade Row.

items.name: Iron Ring
items.info: A heavy iron band hammered by a smith, rough at the seam and worn by men who work with their hands. 3 Cens, sold at Forge Street.

items.name: Iron-Shod Club
items.info: A knotted hardwood club with an iron band around its head. Miners use it to break up ore, and it breaks ribs as well. 8 Cens, sold at Youswell Square.

items.name: Ishvala Prayer Beads
items.info: A string of wooden beads for the daily rites.

items.name: Ishvalan Curved Knife
items.info: A hooked blade with a bone grip and a cord wound round the handle, carried by Ishvalan men as a working knife and a weapon. The curve catches cloth and rope, which makes it useful well beyond the fight. 22 Cens, sold at Reole Market Hall.

items.name: Ishvalan Date Cakes
items.info: Small cakes of pressed dates and flour, sold wrapped in leaves at the bazaar. They keep for a long road and a hot day. 3 Cens, sold at Ishvalan Bazaar.

items.name: Ishvalan Life Tonic
items.info: A brown tonic in a stoppered bottle, sold in the Ishvalan markets as a remedy that keeps the old strong. Its taste is bitter and its smell is of herbs and grease. 45 Cens, sold at Reole Market Hall.

items.name: Ishvalan Painted Bowl
items.info: A clay bowl glazed in ochre and blue with a simple geometric band, made in the desert towns and carried on the roads as a keepsake. 60 Cens, sold at Ishvalan Bazaar.

items.name: Ishvalan Sandals
items.info: Leather sandals with a woven strap over the instep and a thick sole that holds up on hot stone. 6 Cens, sold at Ishvalan Bazaar.

items.name: Ishvalan Shield
items.info: A round shield of hide over a wooden core, its face painted with a dull ochre pattern. Desert men carry it on the roads, and it is light enough to use with a sword in the other hand. 35 Cens, sold at Ishvalan Bazaar.

items.name: Izumi's Notebook
items.info: A notebook of old transmutation notes.

items.name: Jade Hairpin
items.info: A long pin of green jade with a carved flower head, worn in a bun by the women of the Xingese courts. 130 Cens, sold at Jade Row.

items.name: Jade Pill
items.info: A small green pill that smells of pine and clove, sold to travellers who want to hold off a fever on the desert roads. The dose is one pill at a time, never two. 90 Cens, sold at Jade Row.

items.name: Journeyman's Knife Roll
items.info: A roll of tools for the trade.

items.name: Journeyman's Wrench Set
items.info: A set of wrenches in graded sizes, stamped with a shop's mark.
items.where: Bench Journeyman, Rush Valley automail trade

items.name: Kunai Bundle
items.info: A bundle of Xingese kunai on a ring of cord.

items.name: Kunai of the Five Points
items.info: Five kunai of Xingese steel, each wrapped in red cord for the pentagram's points.

items.name: Lamb Stew
items.info: A slow stew of mutton, chickpeas and cumin, cooked in a clay pot over a hearth that is never let go out. It tastes better on the second day. 7 Cens, sold at Holy Ground.

items.name: Lantern
items.info: A tin lantern with a glass pane and a hook at the top, filled with paraffin and carried on the road after dark. 12 Cens, sold at any town market.

items.name: Leather Gloves
items.info: Thin tanned leather gloves with stitched seams and a soft lining, the common glove of carters, clerks and labourers. 11 Cens, sold at Market Row.

items.name: Leather Shoes
items.info: Black leather shoes with a lace and a square toe, polished for church and for the office. 13 Cens, sold at Market Row.

items.name: Leather Work Apron
items.info: A thick leather apron that hangs from the neck to the knee, worn by smiths, miners and butchers to keep the sparks and the sharp things out. 40 Cens, sold at Mine Road Depot.

items.name: LeCoulte Arm
items.info: An arm of the Rush Valley pattern, with a light frame and a wrist that turns full circle. The fitter's house takes pride in the bearings and sells the arm with a guarantee. 640 Cens, sold at LeCoulte Automail.

items.name: LeCoulte Leg
items.info: A leg of the Rush Valley pattern with a hinged hip and a foot that rolls over rough ground, sold with a full set of fitting straps. 610 Cens, sold at LeCoulte Automail.

items.name: LeCoulte Tag
items.info: A small iron tag stamped with the shop's name.

items.name: Lemonade Bottle
items.info: A bottle of sweet sour lemonade, fizzing from the stopper, sold from a cart on the walks in summer. 2 Cens, sold at Plane Walk.

items.name: Lesser Sin's Glove
items.info: A black glove worn by the order's servants.

items.name: Leto Medallion
items.info: A brass sun medallion, sold to every believer.

items.name: Liege's Crown Pin
items.info: A small crown pin, given by Ling to his closest followers.

items.name: Lieutenant General's Dagger
items.info: A slim blade carried by the council's aides.

items.name: Lieutenant General's Signet
items.info: A signet ring cut with the command's seal.

items.name: Lieutenant's Cap Badge
items.info: A badge of the unit, worn on the front of the cap.

items.name: Lieutenant's Greatcoat Clasp
items.info: A heavy clasp of northern silver.

items.name: Lieutenant's Pin
items.info: A small pin of the southern army.

items.name: Lieutenant's Sidearm Permit
items.info: A signed permit to carry a sidearm on duty, with the army's stamp.

items.name: Linen Apron
items.info: A cotton apron with two deep pockets and a strap that ties at the back, worn by stallholders and cooks in the markets. 6 Cens, sold at Produce Row.

items.name: Long Axe
items.info: A two-handed axe with a long haft and a heavy bit, used to clear timber and tunnel props. A miner who can swing it can also carve through a barricade. 22 Cens, sold at Miners' Row.

items.name: Lucky Coin Pendant
items.info: An old coin pierced and hung on a chain, carried by sailors and gamblers who think it turns the luck. 6 Cens, sold at Dublith Market.

items.name: Madame's Cigarette Holder
items.info: A long holder of black lacquer, the house's own mark.
items.where: Right Hand of the House, Madame Christmas's house

items.name: Major General's Cuff
items.info: A cuff band of black and gold, worn by the general's staff.

items.name: Major General's Letter
items.info: A sealed letter that opens an inner door.

items.name: Marching Boots
items.info: Plain black leather boots with hobnails in the sole and a reinforced heel, issued for long marches on the drill grounds. 35 Cens, sold at Veterans' Row.

items.name: Master Fitter's Seal
items.info: A seal of the shop, used for signed work.

items.name: Master Mechanic's Key
items.info: The key to the workshop's locked drawer.

items.name: Master's Bead
items.info: A single bead of the order's rosary.

items.name: Master's Gauge
items.info: A fine brass gauge for joint clearances, kept in a velvet box.
items.where: Master of the Atelier, Atelier Garfiel

items.name: Master's Ring
items.info: A ring of the licence office, given to the one who runs a licensing post.
items.where: Master of the Licence, State Alchemists

items.name: Matriarch's Brooch
items.info: A brooch of the house, worn by the matriarch at every gathering.
items.where: Head of the House, Armstrong Family

items.name: Mauser C96
items.info: A long-barrelled semi-automatic pistol with a box magazine and a wooden holster stock that doubles as a shoulder rest. It is expensive, rare in the cities, and the mark of a man who can pay for something beyond the issue sidearm. 420 Cens, sold at Glotz Pawn Shop.

items.name: Maxim M1910
items.info: A heavy machine gun with a corrugated water jacket and a wide tripod, the gun the old resistance brought from Aerugo. It is team-served and too heavy to carry far, so the crew drags it on a sled. Found, never sold: Ishval War Ruins.

items.name: Meat Pie
items.info: A pastry shell packed with minced meat and gravy and baked until the crust blisters, sold hot from a tin at the market. 4 Cens, sold at Stall Lane.

items.name: Mechanic's Spanner
items.info: A spanner for automail bolts.

items.name: Mechanic's Toolroll
items.info: A roll of spanners, pliers and fine wire for fitting and tuning automail.

items.name: Microphone Clip
items.info: A clip for a studio microphone.

items.name: Military Issue Coat
items.info: A heavy grey coat with the State Military's buttons and a sewn-in rank patch.

items.name: Military Saber
items.info: A long, gently curved cavalry sword with a plain steel guard and a stiff grip. Officers carry it on parade, and it cuts well from horseback, though the infantry find it awkward in a trench. 140 Cens, sold at Drill Ground.

items.name: Military Shoulder Mark Set
items.info: A set of cloth rank marks with a stitched border, bought by a soldier who has been promoted and needs the new marks sewn onto his jacket by the next parade. 14 Cens, sold at Veterans' Hall.

items.name: Mine Spirit Flask
items.info: A flask of raw spirit bought by the miners at the end of a shift, drunk to take away the grit. It burns the throat and the gallery dust with it. 14 Cens, sold at Mine Road Depot.

items.name: Miner's Helmet
items.info: A steel helmet with a lamp bracket at the front and a padded band inside, worn in the Youswell galleries against falling rock. 22 Cens, sold at Miners' Hall.

items.name: Miner's Tally Tag
items.info: A brass tag with a number, hung on the board when a man goes down.

items.name: Mining Lamp
items.info: A brass lamp with a hook for a helmet and a stub of wick for the gallery's bad air, the lamp every miner in Youswell carries. 20 Cens, sold at Mine Road Depot.

items.name: Model 24 Stielhandgranate
items.info: A stick grenade with a wooden handle and a tin head, thrown by the hand and set off by a pull cord at the handle's end. It is one use, and whoever throws it has a few seconds to get behind cover. Found, never sold: Fort Briggs.

items.name: Modified M1910
items.info: A lightweight carbon-fibre arm for the cold, nicknamed "Mad Bear G" by the soldiers who wear it. Its fingertips are diamond-hardened, so the hand can slice as well as hold. 1800 Cens, sold at Fort Briggs.

items.name: Mortar and Pestle
items.info: A heavy stone bowl with a rounded stone pestle, the first tool of every apothecary's back room. The grinding never stops in a busy house. 10 Cens, sold at Market Row.

items.name: Mountain Honey Pot
items.info: A clay pot of thick dark honey gathered from the hives on the pine shore, sweet and smoky with the bark it was taken from. 9 Cens, sold at Pine Shore.

items.name: Mountain Tea Brick
items.info: A brick of pressed tea leaves and twigs, broken off and boiled in a pot on the road. The taste is smoky and thin. 7 Cens, sold at Tea Terraces.

items.name: Mourning Veil
items.info: A black lace veil pinned to a comb, worn at funerals in the cities and at the graves on the edge of town. 12 Cens, sold at Western Cemetery.

items.name: Nerve Harness Kit
items.info: A harness of fine wire, pads and a set of plugs that let a fitter read the nerve signals of a new arm before the customer tries it on. 150 Cens, sold at Fitting Bench.

items.name: Nerve Port Cuff
items.info: A ring of leather and brass that seals the port where the nerves meet an automail socket, keeping the damp and the dust from getting in. It is worn under the sleeve and checked every few months. 80 Cens, sold at Rockbell Automail.

items.name: Newspaper of the Day
items.info: A broadsheet printed on grey paper with the day's news, the official notices and the price of bread on the back. The official view comes first, and the rest is left to the reader. 2 Cens, sold at Stall Lane.

items.name: Notebook of Sketches
items.info: A sketchbook of hard grey paper, filled with drawings of faces, machines and the ruins of towns, in a hand that looks trained. 25 Cens, sold at Stall Lane.

items.name: Novice's Cord
items.info: A cord of the order, given to a new member.

items.name: Officer's Greatcoat
items.info: A long double-breasted coat of heavy grey wool, cut for an officer who stands in the snow for hours. Its collar turns up over the ears and its lining keeps out the wind. 260 Cens, sold at Commander's Keep.

items.name: Officer's Saber
items.info: A straight military saber with a brass guard and a leather grip.

items.name: Officer's Sash
items.info: A red sash tied at the waist, a sign of the household's officers.
items.where: Officer of the Family, Armstrong Family

items.name: Official's Brush Case
items.info: A lacquered case for the court's brush and seal.

items.name: Oil Can
items.info: A tin oil can with a long spout, for the gears of a press or the hinges of a gate. It rusts when left in the wet. 4 Cens, sold at Forge Street.

items.name: Oil Lamp
items.info: A brass oil lamp with a round wick and a glass chimney, the lamp of a cottage kitchen and a train carriage. 8 Cens, sold at any town market.

items.name: Opium Tincture
items.info: A dark syrup that dulls pain and brings on a heavy sleep, given after a bad operation and sold quietly to people who want to forget. Its habit takes hold quickly. 22 Cens, sold at Surgical Wing.

items.name: Orderly's Gloves
items.info: Rubber gloves stiff with washing.

items.name: Painkiller Powder
items.info: A grey powder in a paper fold, stirred into water for a headache or a sprained arm. It takes the edge off and leaves the stomach sour. 13 Cens, sold at Dispensary.

items.name: Painted Fan
items.info: A folding fan of thin paper painted with mountains and a river, its ribs of lacquered bamboo. It is a gift, not a tool. 45 Cens, sold at Silk Street.

items.name: Pamphlet of the Field Medic
items.info: A slim guide to dressing wounds, setting bones and recognising the signs of a poisoning, written for the nurses of the field hospitals. 5 Cens, sold at Central Hospital.

items.name: Parade Medal
items.info: A medal from a parade, given to the family's best.

items.name: Parry Dagger
items.info: A short dagger with a wide hand guard and a stout blade, held in the off hand to catch a sword and turn it aside. 22 Cens, sold at Veterans' Row.

items.name: Pawn Ticket
items.info: A numbered pawn ticket with the shop's stamp.

items.name: Pearl Necklace
items.info: A strand of pale pearls strung on silk and clasped in gold, the kind a rich widow sells when the money runs out. 500 Cens, sold at Glotz Pawn Shop.

items.name: Peppermint Drops
items.info: A paper twist of white peppermint drops, sold to children on the park bench. They cool the mouth and stick to the teeth. 1 Cens, sold at Bandstand.

items.name: Pickaxe
items.info: A heavy iron head on a hickory handle, swung by the gallery men to break the coal face. 15 Cens, sold at Miners' Row.

items.name: Pickled Eggs Jar
items.info: A glass jar of boiled eggs in vinegar and pepper, bought by the handful from the bar with a drink. They are sharp and cheap. 2 Cens, sold at Front Bar.

items.name: Pickled Vegetables
items.info: Strips of radish and cabbage pickled in brine and chilli, eaten with rice or with bread. The jar lasts a winter. 3 Cens, sold at Lantern Street.

items.name: Plain Pocket Watch
items.info: A nickel watch in a worn case, its face scratched and its hands still keeping time. Clockmakers sell them to railwaymen and clerks who need the hour without a station clock. 75 Cens, sold at Clock Room.

items.name: Pleated Skirt
items.info: A long skirt of dark cloth, pleated at the waist and falling to the ankle, worn by women on the railway and in the offices. 15 Cens, sold at Stall Lane.

items.name: Plum Wine Bottle
items.info: A green glass bottle of plum wine, sweet and strong, sealed with red wax and sold to travellers on the Xing road. 40 Cens, sold at Inn Row.

items.name: Pocket Charm
items.info: A brass disc stamped with a plain cross and worn on a cord for luck on a long journey. 5 Cens, sold at any town market.

items.name: Pocket Knife
items.info: A folding knife with a bone handle and a single blade, carried by almost every man in the country. It cuts string, bread and the odd hand that gets too close. 4 Cens, sold at any town market.

items.name: Police Baton
items.info: A short cane of hard wood with a leather-wrapped grip, carried by the city's constables. The baton is meant to stun, and a constable who uses it on a drunk is expected to answer for the bruises. 12 Cens, sold at Eastern Market.

items.name: Potato Stew Bowl
items.info: A thick stew of potato, onion and whatever meat the cook could find, served in a chipped bowl from a tenement kitchen. It is hot and cheap and fills the stomach. 5 Cens, sold at Back Alleys.

items.name: Pressed Flower Book
items.info: A small book of pressed flowers under thin paper, each one labelled in a careful hand with a name and a date. 18 Cens, sold at Bandstand.

items.name: Priest's Incense
items.info: A bundle of sweet incense, burnt at every service.

items.name: Priest-Warrior's Gauntlet
items.info: A leather gauntlet of the order.

items.name: Producer's Clipboard
items.info: A clipboard with the day's schedule.

items.name: Proprietor's Key
items.info: A key to the shop's back room.

items.name: Proprietor's Shop Bell
items.info: The brass bell that hangs over the shop's door.

items.name: Pulse Charm
items.info: A carved jade disc on a red cord, marked with a ring of small characters, worn by clan children to keep them mindful of the Dragon's Pulse, the flow of life that runs through the earth. 55 Cens, sold at Clan Halls.

items.name: Pulse Student's Chart
items.info: A painted chart of the body's flows, the first one a student copies.

items.name: Quarterstaff
items.info: A plain length of ash, oiled and worn smooth at the middle by hands that have used it for years. Travellers and farm boys carry one, and a practised user can hold off three men with it. 6 Cens, sold at any town market.

items.name: Quartz Lens
items.info: A clear quartz lens ground for a watchmaker's loupe, the kind of piece a clockmaker treasures and an alchemist can use to read a material's grain. 48 Cens, sold at Clock Room.

items.name: Quicksilver Flask
items.info: A small iron flask of heavy liquid metal, cold and bright and poisonous to the touch. It is a prized material for a wealthy alchemist and a danger to anyone who breathes its fumes. 35 Cens, sold at Eastern Market.

items.name: Quinine Powder
items.info: A bitter white powder in folded paper, taken in water against the marsh fever. Soldiers in the desert swear it saves their lives. 30 Cens, sold at Ward Three.

items.name: Rail Timetable
items.info: A printed card of the day's departures and arrivals for the main lines, sold for a few cens at every station. 2 Cens, sold at East Station.

items.name: Ration Card
items.info: A ration card with a row of stamped squares, given to families in the hard months. Each stamp is a loaf of bread that the shopkeeper can no longer sell for coin. Found, never sold: Youswell Square.

items.name: Reader's Ticket
items.info: A card ticket for the public reading halls.

items.name: Red Stone Fragment
items.info: A chip of dark red stone that glints in lamplight and is said to undo the price of any transmutation. The believers who carry it talk about the glow, and nobody has ever shown a chip that did what the rumour says. Found, never sold: Ruined Cistern.

items.name: Red Wine Glass
items.info: A glass of dark red wine from the southern vineyards, poured from a bottle with a cork stamped by the grower. It warms the cold traveller on the northern road. 25 Cens, sold at North Inn Taproom.

items.name: Reinforced Trousers
items.info: Heavy canvas trousers with leather patches at the knee and seat and a stiffened shin, worn in the mines and on the railway lines. 60 Cens, sold at Miners' Row.

items.name: Reporter's Notebook
items.info: A small notebook for interviews.

items.name: Research Notebook in Cipher
items.info: A notebook of dense pages written in a substitution cipher, with diagrams beside the cipher text. Its owner kept careful dates, and the last entries are scratched out. Found, never sold: Records Vault.

items.name: Researcher's Gloves
items.info: Rubber gloves stained with a dark fluid.

items.name: Researcher's Readings Book
items.info: A notebook of temperatures and pulse counts in a cramped hand.

items.name: Retainer's Kunai Set
items.info: A wrapped set of plain kunai with the clan's mark on each ring.

items.name: Ring-Fight Wraps
items.info: Cloth wraps for the fists, weighted at the knuckles.

items.name: Riot Helmet
items.info: A close-fitting steel helmet with a visor of wire mesh and a flared neck guard, issued to the gate guards on the eastern road. 55 Cens, sold at Eastern Gatehouse.

items.name: Riot Shield
items.info: A tall curved board of laminated wood with a steel rim and a grip at the back, used by the constables to hold a crowd back. It stops a club well and a bullet not at all. 60 Cens, sold at Veterans' Row.

items.name: Road Map of Amestris
items.info: A folded map of the nation's roads and railways, printed on thin paper and marked with the main towns, the borders and the rail lines. 9 Cens, sold at Market Row.

items.name: Roast Chicken
items.info: A whole bird roasted over a fire until the skin splits, carved by the stallholder and wrapped in paper. Two people eat it and call it a meal. 9 Cens, sold at Produce Row.

items.name: Rock Salt Block
items.info: A grey block of rock salt, sold to cooks and to the mines that need to salt the meat. It must be scraped before use. 4 Cens, sold at Market Row.

items.name: Rockbell Standard Arm
items.info: A steel-framed arm with a plated forearm and five working fingers, fitted and tuned in the workshop by the family. It is the arm a boy is given when he has lost his own and has no money for more. 600 Cens, sold at Rockbell Automail.

items.name: Rockbell Standard Leg
items.info: A steel-framed leg with an articulated knee and an ankle that flexes on the stride, fitted to the stump with a cuff of padded leather. It takes a month to learn to walk on without a limp. 550 Cens, sold at Rockbell Automail.

items.name: Runner's Calling Card
items.info: A plain card with a telephone number and a girl's name.

items.name: Runner's Key
items.info: A brass key to a cellar door.

items.name: Runner's Map
items.info: A map of a crew's escape routes.

items.name: Runner's Sack
items.info: A plain canvas sack with a drawstring.

items.name: Rush Valley Competition Arm
items.info: A light arm built for the forge contests that the town holds each year, with a lighter frame and a hardened hand for a grip that wins prizes. It is too delicate for the mines. 1100 Cens, sold at Rush Valley.

items.name: Saffron Rice Parcel
items.info: A paper parcel of yellow rice cooked with saffron and raisins, sold at the market hall in Reole and eaten with the fingers. 6 Cens, sold at Cloth Aisle.

items.name: Saltpeter Sack
items.info: A sack of white crystalline saltpeter, sold to the mines and the quarries. It is the base of any blasting powder and the first thing a careful buyer checks for damp. 20 Cens, sold at Mine Road Depot.

items.name: Sap
items.info: A leather pouch of shot on a short strap, swung at the back of the head to drop a man without marking his face. Thieves carry it, and so do guards who want a quiet arrest. 10 Cens, sold at Pawn Counter.

items.name: Sausage Link
items.info: A coil of pork sausage in a casing, spiced with pepper and fennel and grilled over charcoal at the market stall. 4 Cens, sold at Fur Row.

items.name: Sawn-Off Shotgun
items.info: A double-barrelled shotgun with the barrels cut short and the stock taken off at the grip. It is hidden under a coat and fired from the hip in a crowded room. 150 Cens, sold at Devil's Nest.

items.name: Scar's Tattoo Rubbing
items.info: A cloth copy of the alchemical tattoo, carried by those who follow the vigil.

items.name: Sealed Glass Retort
items.info: A thick-walled glass flask with a long neck and a stopper of ground glass, used to heat a material until it changes. Its neck is easy to crack on a cold table. 70 Cens, sold at Eastern Market.

items.name: Sealed Letter Paper
items.info: A pad of cream writing paper with a wax seal and an envelope to match, sold to anyone who wants to write to a distant family. 4 Cens, sold at East Station.

items.name: Second Lieutenant's Bar
items.info: A silver bar pinned to the collar.

items.name: Senior Chalk Case
items.info: A worn case of fine chalk, given to a senior licensee.

items.name: Senior Hostess's Brooch
items.info: A brooch Madame Christmas gives to the girls she trusts.

items.name: Senior Researcher's Pen
items.info: A pen with a gold nib, used for the programme's signed records.

items.name: Senior Researcher's Syringe Case
items.info: A steel case of glass syringes, each in its slot.

items.name: Sergeant's Band
items.info: A bronze band worn around the upper arm.

items.name: Sergeant's Chevron
items.info: A cloth chevron sewn to the sleeve of a sergeant's uniform.

items.name: Sergeant's Pennant
items.info: A small blue pennant on a short staff.

items.name: Service Pistol
items.info: A military pistol with a long barrel and a full magazine.

items.name: Service Revolver
items.info: A six-chambered revolver with a wooden grip and a short barrel, issued to officers who need a sidearm and carried by the constables who can afford one. Its action is simple, which keeps it working in the rain. 180 Cens, sold at Veterans' Row.

items.name: Sewing Kit
items.info: A tin of needles, thread and buttons with a pair of brass scissors, for mending a torn coat on the road. 6 Cens, sold at any town market.

items.name: Shift Captain's Lamp
items.info: A safety lamp with a brass top and a gauze chimney.

items.name: Shop Apron
items.info: A white apron with the shop's name in red.

items.name: Shop Engineer's Blueprint
items.info: A blueprint of a joint, with the margins full of notes.
items.where: Shop Engineer, Rush Valley automail trade

items.name: Shop Hand's Rag
items.info: An oily rag with the shop's name stitched in one corner.

items.name: Shot-Firer's Fuse Tin
items.info: A small tin of fuse cord kept dry with wax paper.

items.name: Signal Flare
items.info: A cardboard tube with a striker cap that throws a red light high into the sky for a few seconds. Ships and patrols use it to call for help across open water. 8 Cens, sold at Lakeside Pier.

items.name: Silk Robe of Xing
items.info: A long robe of dyed silk with a wide sleeve and a high collar, embroidered at the hem with cranes and clouds. 220 Cens, sold at Silk Street.

items.name: Silk Scarf
items.info: A square of pale silk printed with a bird on a branch, tied loose at the throat by people who can afford the look. 40 Cens, sold at Silk Street.

items.name: Silver Chain
items.info: A fine silver chain with a clasp shaped like a leaf, sold by the yard and cut to the buyer's length. 30 Cens, sold at Glotz Pawn Shop.

items.name: Silver Locket
items.info: A small oval locket of silver with a hinged lid and a faded picture inside, sold by a pawnbroker who has taken it from the last owner. 80 Cens, sold at Glotz Pawn Shop.

items.name: Silver Spoon Set
items.info: A set of six silver spoons in a velvet case, each engraved with a different initial, the wedding gift of a family that has since lost its money. 95 Cens, sold at Pawn Corner.

items.name: Sin's Sigil
items.info: A sigil cut into a gold disc, held by a sin.

items.name: Sleeping Roll
items.info: A canvas bag with a wool blanket inside, rolled and strapped to the pack. It keeps the cold out better than a bare floor. 15 Cens, sold at any town market.

items.name: Smelling Salts
items.info: A small bottle of ammonia salts on a cotton wick, held under the nose to rouse a fainting person. Its smell brings tears to the eyes at once. 4 Cens, sold at any herbalist.

items.name: Smoke Canister
items.info: A tin tube that throws out a thick grey cloud when lit, enough to cover a retreat across an open yard. It burns bitter and makes the eyes stream. 15 Cens, sold at Shell Store.

items.name: Smoked Fish
items.info: A river fish split, salted and smoked over willow, dark and oily and good with bread. The lake fishers carry them in bundles. 5 Cens, sold at Lakeside Pier.

items.name: Smoked Trout
items.info: A whole trout hung over a smoky fire until the flesh is firm and pink. The ferrymen sell it wrapped in leaves for the trip across the lake. 10 Cens, sold at Kauroy Ferry Pier.

items.name: Sniper Rifle
items.info: A long, scoped bolt rifle with a heavy barrel, made for a single patient shooter on a ridge. A good marksman can drop a man at half a kilometre, and the scope is kept in a felt case so the glass stays clear. 900 Cens, sold at Commander's Keep.

items.name: Snow Boots
items.info: Tall leather boots with a felt liner and a rubber sole cut with grips, made for walking in deep snow without slipping. They are a little heavy on the foot. 75 Cens, sold at Fort Briggs.

items.name: Snow Goggles
items.info: Dark-lensed goggles issued to every garrison soldier.

items.name: Snowshoes
items.info: A pair of wooden frames laced with rawhide, strapped to the boots to keep the wearer on top of the snow instead of through it. 35 Cens, sold at Fort Briggs.

items.name: Soldering Iron
items.info: A copper bit on an iron rod with a wooden grip, heated over a lamp and used to join wire and sheet metal. 35 Cens, sold at Forge Street.

items.name: Staff Aide's Pass
items.info: A stiff card with the compound's stamp, shown at the outer gate.

items.name: State Alchemist's Silver Watch
items.info: A silver pocket watch engraved with the state's dragon in a hexagram, the state's identification.

items.name: State Military Trousers
items.info: Dark wool trousers with a reinforced seat and a stripe down the outer leg, cut to go under the boot and out of the way of the belt. 40 Cens, sold at Veterans' Row.

items.name: State Military Uniform Jacket
items.info: A dark wool jacket with a high collar, brass buttons and shoulder marks for rank. The State Military issues it to every recruit, and it is the cloth people look at when they decide how much to trust a man. 90 Cens, sold at Veterans' Row.

items.name: Station Badge
items.info: A card badge with the station's call sign.

items.name: Station Chief's Key
items.info: The key to the station's studio.

items.name: Steamed Dumplings
items.info: Soft dumplings of pork and cabbage, steamed in bamboo baskets and served with a dip of soy and vinegar. A basket is a cheap full meal. 4 Cens, sold at Lantern Street.

items.name: Steel Canteen
items.info: A dented steel flask with a cloth cover and a screw cap, for water on the road and tea in the morning. 4 Cens, sold at any town market.

items.name: Steel Fan
items.info: A folding fan with steel ribs and a sharpened outer rib, which lets a dancer or a guard strike with a single snap of the wrist. Its paper is painted with cranes and sealed to keep out the damp. 35 Cens, sold at Silk Street.

items.name: Steel Gauntlets
items.info: Gloves of riveted steel plate over a leather core, with a hinged back and padded palms. A man can hold a rifle in them, though he cannot feel the trigger. 80 Cens, sold at Forge Street.

items.name: Steel Helmet
items.info: A shallow steel bowl with a brim and a leather liner, the helmet the infantry wears on the march and under fire. It deflects a fragment well and a rifle round badly. 70 Cens, sold at Drill Ground.

items.name: Steel Rivet Pack
items.info: A paper packet of steel rivets in three sizes, the bolts that hold plate to frame in any honest piece of metalwork. 9 Cens, sold at Miners' Row.

items.name: Steel-Toed Boots
items.info: Heavy work boots with a steel cap over the toe and a thick rubber sole. The forges of Rush Valley sell them by the pair, and a dropped plate will not break the foot inside. 45 Cens, sold at Automail Row.

items.name: Stiletto
items.info: A slim, needle-pointed blade with a short cross guard, the kind a gambler hides in a boot and a debtor hides in a sleeve. It goes between ribs without much noise. 25 Cens, sold at Card Room.

items.name: Stimulant Tonic
items.info: A sweet cordial in a squat glass bottle that the guards drink on a long night watch. It keeps the eyes open and the hands steady for a few hours. 16 Cens, sold at Eastern Gatehouse.

items.name: Stock Hand's Crate Hook
items.info: A steel hook for dragging crates off a cart.

items.name: Store Receipt Book
items.info: A carbon receipt book with the store's name printed at the top.

items.name: Submachine Gun
items.info: A short automatic carbine with a drum magazine that fires pistol rounds in a fast stream. The army keeps the few it has under lock, and the stores that hold them are fenced. Found, never sold: Old Arsenal.

items.name: Sulphur Block
items.info: A yellow block of native sulphur that smells sharply of eggs. Miners sell it cheap at the coal fields, and it burns blue in the right flame. 14 Cens, sold at Youswell Square.

items.name: Surgeon's Saw
items.info: A bone saw with a fine blade and a fitted handle, used to cut away a limb the body has lost to gangrene. A surgeon keeps it wrapped in cloth between cases. 85 Cens, sold at Surgical Wing.

items.name: Surgeon's Stitch Kit
items.info: A roll of silk thread, a curved needle and a pair of tweezers in a leather case, for closing a cut that will not wait for a hospital. 26 Cens, sold at Ward B.

items.name: Tank Crew's Badge
items.info: A badge of a tank crew, stitched in red wool.

items.name: Team Lead's Chart
items.info: A chart of a candidate's progress.

items.name: Telegram Form
items.info: A blank form with spaces for the address, the message and the sender's name, sold at the telegraph desk for the price of a cup of tea. 1 Cens, sold at Transmitter Hall.

items.name: Throwing Knives
items.info: A set of four balanced knives in a canvas roll, each with a wrapped grip and a point that sticks in wood. A thrower needs practice before the knives come back to the hand straight. 28 Cens, sold at Glotz Pawn Shop.

items.name: Tin of Silver Dust
items.info: A tin of fine silver powder for the careful alchemist who needs a precious metal to work with. Pure silver is hard to find in a city and takes a circle well. 60 Cens, sold at Stall Lane.

items.name: Tinderbox
items.info: A tin box with a flint, a steel and a char cloth. A traveller who can light a fire in the rain is worth his weight. 3 Cens, sold at any town market.

items.name: Trail Ration Bar
items.info: A compressed bar of oats, nuts and dried fruit, wrapped in wax paper and carried by hikers and miners who have to eat on the move. 4 Cens, sold at any herbalist.

items.name: Transit Pass
items.info: A card stamped with the dates and the route, bought at the station window and shown at the barrier to board a train. 6 Cens, sold at East Station.

items.name: Transmutation Chalk
items.info: A stick of chalk for drawing transmutation circles on stone, wood and floor.

items.name: Trench Knife
items.info: A broad, heavy blade with a knuckle bow and a short, blunt back. It is built for close work in narrow ditches, where a long sword only gets caught on the walls. 25 Cens, sold at Veterans' Row.

items.name: Tunnel Guide's Lantern
items.info: A small lantern for the sewer routes.

items.name: Valley Master's Hammer
items.info: A small hammer with a worn handle, passed down from master to master.
items.where: Valley Master, Rush Valley automail trade

items.name: Velvet Evening Coat
items.info: A dark velvet coat with silver buttons and a satin lining, worn to dinners and the theatre by men with money to spare. 180 Cens, sold at Pawn Corner.

items.name: Vigil Token
items.info: A small carved stone marked with a cross.

items.name: Violin
items.info: A violin of maple and spruce with a worn varnish and a bow with a loose hair, sold by a family who can no longer play it. 260 Cens, sold at Glotz Pawn Shop.

items.name: Wanted Poster
items.info: A printed bill with a rough drawing of a face and a reward in cens, pasted on the gatehouse wall. Half the faces on the posters are never caught. Found, never sold: Eastern Gate Road.

items.name: Warden's Whistle
items.info: A whistle used to call the prison's guards.

items.name: Warrior Priest's Cord
items.info: A red cord worn across the chest by the faith's warriors.

items.name: Warrior Priest's Stole
items.info: A plain stole of undyed cloth, worn by the order.

items.name: Waterproof Cape
items.info: A rubberised cape with a hood and a pair of ties at the throat, sold to anyone caught in a sudden rain on the road. 22 Cens, sold at any town market.

items.name: Wide-Brimmed Hat
items.info: A straw hat with a wide brim and a ribbon, worn to keep the sun off the face on the park walks. 14 Cens, sold at Plane Walk.

items.name: Willow Bark Tablets
items.info: Pale tablets pressed from powdered willow bark, taken for a fever or an ache. They are cheap, bitter and mostly effective. 5 Cens, sold at any herbalist.

items.name: Winry's Spare Bolt
items.info: A spare automail bolt, always carried.

items.name: Winter Coat
items.info: A heavy wool coat with a fur-trimmed collar and horn buttons, cut long enough to cover the knee on a cold day. 58 Cens, sold at Stall Lane.

items.name: Wolf Fur Pelt
items.info: A thick grey pelt of arctic wolf, cured and soft, sold to rich buyers who want a rug or a collar. 85 Cens, sold at Fur Row.

items.name: Wooden Monk's Staff
items.info: A plain staff of hard wood, worn smooth by the forms.

items.name: Wool Dress
items.info: A dress of grey wool with a high neck and long sleeves, the sunday wear of a respectable woman in the city. 35 Cens, sold at Stall Lane.

items.name: Wool Scarf
items.info: A long scarf of grey wool knitted by hand, wound twice round the throat against the wind. 7 Cens, sold at Market Row.

items.name: Wool Work Shirt
items.info: A plain cotton shirt with a wool-lined collar and a double seam at the shoulder, worn under a jacket by every working man. 9 Cens, sold at Market Row.

items.name: Workshop Badge
items.info: A brass badge stamped with the house's gear mark.

items.name: Xing Fan Guard
items.info: A slim folding fan with a bamboo frame and a thin steel edge, the second weapon of a Xingese stick-fighter. It blocks a strike and then closes into a jab. 20 Cens, sold at Silk Street.

items.name: Xing Glaive
items.info: A long pole with a curved blade at its end, the weapon of the old imperial guard. It keeps an enemy at the length of a sword and lets its wielder cut at the legs from a step away. 180 Cens, sold at Xing Barracks.

items.name: Xingese Dao
items.info: A single-edged blade with a wide, heavy tip and a wrapped grip, made for cutting from a spinning stance. Porters and guards both favour it on the river roads. 80 Cens, sold at Silk Street.

items.name: Xingese Green Tea
items.info: A pale green tea of whole leaves, sold in a paper tube and steeped in clear water. It is bitter at first and sweet at the end of the cup. 14 Cens, sold at Silk Street.

items.name: Xingese Healing Balm
items.info: A soft green balm in a porcelain jar, rubbed on bruises and sprains. Its scent is of camphor and mountain herbs. 16 Cens, sold at Inn Row.

items.name: Xingese Jian
items.info: A straight, double-edged sword in a lacquered sheath with a tassel at the hilt. Xingese duellists carry it as a mark of learning, and the blade is balanced to point rather than to chop. 95 Cens, sold at Xing Market.

items.name: Xingese Training Wraps
items.info: Cloth wraps for the forearms and shins, worn for the clan yard's forms.

items.name: Yoki's Soldier's Tag
items.info: An old military tag, kept on a cord.

abilities.name: Above Suspicion
abilities.info:
Nobody has ever had a reason to look at you twice. Greatly improves the next action to pass a checkpoint or an inquiry without being questioned.
[Trait: Clean Record]

abilities.name: Air Roll
abilities.info:
A roll from a height that puts you back on your feet and ready. Greatly improves the next agility action from a height.
[Skill: agility 24]

abilities.name: All In
abilities.info:
You stake everything on one throw and play it with a straight face. Greatly improves the next negotiation action as a bluff.
[Trait: Gambler]

abilities.name: Alley Contacts
abilities.info:
The thieves of the valley know your door. Greatly improves the next action to find who stole something in Rush Valley.
[Trait: Glotz Pawn Shop: Appraiser]

abilities.name: Apprentice Smith Habit
abilities.info:
A habit from the life before. Greatly improves the next action to judge or mend metal by sound and feel.
[Trait: Apprentice Smith]

abilities.name: Apprentice's Circle
abilities.info:
The first circle you learn to draw true, every time, under a master's eye. Greatly improves the next alchemy action at the workshop bench.
[Skill: alchemy 6]

abilities.name: Arm Guard
abilities.info:
The steel arm takes a blow and turns it aside. Greatly improves the next automail-engineering action to guard with the arm.
[Skill: automail-engineering 12]

abilities.name: Armstrong Bellow
abilities.info:
A habit of this place. Greatly improves the next action that needs raw strength or a voice that carries across a field.
[Trait: Armstrong Family Born]

abilities.name: Armstrong Embrace
abilities.info:
You crush a friend or a foe in arms meant for boulders, and nobody gets out of it. Greatly improves the next unarmed action to grapple and hold.
[Trait: Armstrong Stock]

abilities.name: Automail Arm Fighting Opening
abilities.info:
The first move your training gives you, from the first lesson of the art. Greatly improves the next automail arm fighting action to open a fight on your terms.
[Trait: Automail Arm Fighting]

abilities.name: Automail Burst
abilities.info:
A burst of fire from a steel forearm into a line of foes. Greatly improves the next firearms action with a burst.
[Skill: firearms 18]

abilities.name: Automail Fitting
abilities.info:
A limb fitted to the body and kept working. Greatly improves the next action to fit, repair or adjust an automail limb.
[Trait: Rockbell Automail: Customer]

abilities.name: Automail Patient Habit
abilities.info:
A habit from the life before. Greatly improves the next action to bear pain, adjust a fitting or read a mechanic's work.
[Trait: Automail Patient]

abilities.name: Automail Trigger
abilities.info:
A trigger you built into the steel fires when you need it to. Greatly improves the next firearms action with a built limb.
[Skill: firearms 12]

abilities.name: Back Room Deal
abilities.info:
You know who to pay and who to avoid. Greatly improves the next action to bargain or buy something without a record.
[Trait: Devil's Nest: Regular]

abilities.name: Back Room Keeper
abilities.info:
You know what to keep out of sight. Greatly improves the next action to hide or store something without notice.
[Trait: Curtis Meats: Assistant]

abilities.name: Back to Back
abilities.info:
You and your sibling cover each other's blind side without a word. Greatly improves the next defence action fought beside a sibling.
[Trait: Brother's Bond]

abilities.name: Bar Book
abilities.info:
The house remembers who drank with whom. Greatly improves the next action to recall who met whom in the capital.
[Trait: Madame Christmas's house: Runner]

abilities.name: Bar Fighter
abilities.info:
You can handle yourself in a crowded room. Greatly improves the next action to brawl or hold a door.

traits.name: Silver Tongue

traits.name: Smuggler

Gives: Stealth +1, Trade +1; technique Smuggler Habit (A habit from the life before. Greatly improves the next action to hide goods, pass a patrol or slip across a border).

traits.name: South City Born

traits.name: Spear and Staff
