Lines run from Central City to every regional capital and on to most towns of any size, from Resembool's little platform to the long northern line toward the Briggs foothills. Trains are how soldiers, mail, wool and coal move, and how most people travel at all; a ticket and a timetable are part of every traveller's pocket. Passenger cars are plain wooden benches or upholstered compartments by class. Hijackings, derailments and bombs are not unknown, and the army guards the lines it cares about.

lore.name: Transmutation arrays
lore.info: A transmutation array is a cousin of the circle in which the runes spill outside the ring, or where there is no ring at all and the pattern itself carries the energy. Arrays suit the shape of the human body, so they turn up as tattoos more often than as drawings, and scholars think their open shape favours the breaking-down step over the rebuilding one. They are rare, hard to design and unpredictable in the wrong hands. An alchemist who sees one inked on a stranger's skin should assume the stranger knows exactly what it does.

lore.name: Transmutation chalk
lore.info: Every working alchemist carries chalk. A circle can be drawn in pencil, ink, paint or blood, scratched in dirt or sewn into cloth, but chalk is cheap, quick and shows up on almost anything, so it is what apprentices learn with and masters still keep in a coat pocket. Alchemists who fight carry their circles ready-made instead, etched on gauntlets, sewn into gloves or tattooed into skin, because nobody waits for you to finish drawing.

lore.name: Transmutation Circle
lore.info: No machine is needed to perform alchemy, but a circle is. The ring itself channels the energy that already moves through the earth and through matter, and stands for the cycle of the world; the runes drawn inside it tell that energy what to do. A circle can be chalked on the spot, scratched in dirt, inked, sewn into cloth, painted in blood, or etched into a glove or a blade ahead of time. Without one, transmutation is generally impossible. A simple circle in skilled hands does many jobs; the hardest work needs circles so intricate they take an hour to draw.

lore.name: Transmuting without a circle
lore.info: A handful of alchemists transmute without drawing anything. They press their palms together, as if in prayer, and use the ring of their own arms and body as the circle. It is not a technique anyone can teach; those who can do it cannot explain how they learned, and those who cannot do it never manage it by practice. Rumour says a few masters need not even clap. Most alchemists go their whole lives without meeting one, and the Fullmetal Alchemist's habit of clapping is one reason his name spread so fast.

lore.name: Twenty years of war
lore.info: An Amestrian born in 1894, the year King Bradley took office, has not lived a single year when the country was at peace. The Aerugo front, the Creta border, the Drachma standoff and the long agony of Ishval overlap so neatly that the newspapers keep a standing column for each. Taxes, conscription and uniforms are part of the furniture of daily life. Shops in Central sell toy soldiers in every regiment's colours; shops in the East sell automail. Most people do not argue with it, because they cannot remember anything else.

lore.name: Uniform of the State Military
lore.info: Amestrian soldiers wear blue: a blue coat and trousers, black boots and a yellow cord at the shoulder, with medals and badges as earned and sometimes a blue beret; the rank sits on the epaulettes. In snow or hostile country troops add white coats, hats and gloves. Police guards wear black. Specialists may be excused the uniform altogether; the youngest State Alchemist famously wears a red coat everywhere, and nobody has managed to make him change it.

lore.name: Van Hohenheim
lore.info: Resembool remembers a tall, bespectacled, bearded stranger named Van Hohenheim who settled with Trisha Elric, fathered her two boys and then, when they were small, walked out without a word. He was an alchemist and kept a study full of books, which his sons read to pieces. Nobody knows where he went or why. His elder son will not say his name.

lore.name: Wanted alchemists
lore.info: The army keeps a list of alchemists it wants back. Deserters who walked away from their certificates after Ishval, alchemists who broke the gold law, alchemists who meddled with what they should not, and the occasional State Alchemist who simply vanished. Notices go up at stations and headquarters with a sketch and a title. Most of the faces on them are older than the paper. Bounty hunters rarely bother with alchemists; it is hard to arrest someone who can turn the floor under you into a cage.

lore.name: Wanted posters
lore.info: Wanted posters go up on station walls and headquarters noticeboards across Amestris: a sketch, a name or alias, a list of crimes and the office to contact. Deserters from Ishval, Blue Squad bombers, escaped prisoners and fugitive alchemists all appear. The sketches are often poor, and more than one innocent traveller has been dragged into a guardhouse because he had the same scar as the drawing.

lore.name: Weapons of the State Military
lore.info: The Amestrian infantry carries bolt-action rifles and semi-automatic pistols, the standard handgun holding about a dozen rounds. Machine guns, mortars and field artillery support it, and dynamite charges are planted on roads and bridges, and small tanks go where the ground allows. The army has no navy, since the country touches no sea, and no aircraft. The research workshops at Fort Briggs are said to be building heavier tanks for the snow. Its best weapons, everyone agrees, are the State Alchemists.

lore.name: West City
lore.info: West City is the military headquarters of the western area, and it is the least known of the regional capitals outside the West itself. Its forces fight Creta over the border and are many, well drilled and adept at guerrilla war. The western command is said to keep close ties with Central's own forces. Officers posted west write fewer letters home than most; the front around Pendleton keeps them busy.

lore.name: What a human body is made of
lore.info: Every first-year alchemist learns the list by heart: thirty-five litres of water, twenty kilograms of carbon, four litres of ammonia, a kilogram and a half of lime, eight hundred grams of phosphorus, two hundred and fifty grams of salt, a hundred of saltpetre, eighty of sulphur, seven and a half of fluorine, five of iron, three of silicon, and traces of fifteen elements more. Any child could buy the lot with pocket money at a market. Teachers recite it to make a point: the ingredients of a person are cheap and easy to find, and still no one can put them together into a life.

lore.name: Wildlife of Yock Island
lore.info: Yock Island in Kauroy Lake has no large predators. Rabbits, foxes, toads, snakes, birds and a great many insects live there, and fish swarm in the shallows around it. A hungry person with patience and no tools can survive a month on it, as two boys from Resembool once proved, although they will tell you the foxes were the hardest to catch and the fish the hardest to keep.

lore.name: Winry Rockbell
lore.info: Winry Rockbell is Pinako's granddaughter, a teenage automail engineer in Resembool who builds and maintains Edward Elric's arm and leg. Her parents, both doctors, died in the Ishval war when she was small. She is brilliant with a spanner, swings it at people who break her work, and dreams of the workshops of Rush Valley. The Elric brothers are as close to family as she has left besides her grandmother.

lore.name: Xing
lore.info: Xing is a great empire far to the east, across the Eastern Desert. It is a monarchy of fifty clans under one Emperor, with its own language, its own medicine and its own alchemy. Amestrians know it from smuggled goods, a few books and stories of warriors who can sense a man through a wall. Very few have been there. Xingese travellers in Amestris are rare, and stand out in any crowd.

lore.name: Xing and Amestris
lore.info: Xing is the only neighbour Amestris has never fought, mostly because the Eastern Desert stands between them, a great waste of sand that makes an invasion senseless. Official relations barely exist. What trade there is runs through smugglers who carry goods, books, weapons and people across the sands, legally or otherwise, and a long sea route around through the south. Automail is a fairy tale in Xing; alkahestry is a rumour in Amestris. Each country thinks the other a little backward and very far away.

lore.name: Xing imperial house
lore.info: The ruling house of Xing, a monarchy across the Eastern Desert from Amestris. The Emperor rules fifty hereditary clans, and the clans compete for the throne through heirs and envoys. The house sends its princes and envoys abroad to find the means to succeed. A stranger meets the court as an envoy or a suppliant; a clan rival meets it as a blade in the dark. One who serves the house rises by serving a clan well.

lore.name: Xingese martial arts
lore.info: Xing's warriors do not fight like western soldiers. Their styles blend acrobatics with blades, kunai, swords and fists, and their senses are trained far past the ordinary, sight and hearing and the sixth sense for living energy they call reading the Dragon's Pulse. They also carry grenades unknown in Amestris: smoke bombs, flash bombs and capsicum gas that blinds and chokes. Bodyguards of the royal clans are trained from childhood, and a clan's retainers serve for life, often generation after generation.

lore.name: Yao clan
lore.info: The well-to-do Yao clan of Xing, led by Ling Yao, twelfth son of the Emperor and liege of the clan. With the Emperor failing and the heirs at one another's throats, Ling crossed the desert to Amestris after the secret of immortality, and the Philosopher's Stone above all; his bodyguards Lan Fan and her grandfather Fu travel with him. A stranger meets the clan as a prince's party; a rival clan meets it as a threat. One who serves the clan rises by serving Ling's cause and by Lan Fan's test.

lore.name: Yock Island
lore.info: Yock Island is a small wooded isle in the middle of Kauroy Lake. Nobody lives there: no buildings, no wells, no lamps. Birds, toads, snakes, rabbits, foxes and insects do, and the lake around it is full of fish, but there is nothing on it that will kill you, if you are careful. A teacher in Dublith is known to send would-be students out there alone for a month, forbidden their alchemy, to see if they come back.

lore.name: Yoki
lore.info: Lieutenant Yoki is the officer who holds the land under Youswell's coal mines, and the most hated man in the town. A greedy, cowardly, moustachioed bully, he squeezes the miners with taxes and cuts their wages, and hopes to buy his way to promotion with the profits. He does not walk the town alone.

lore.name: Youngest State Alchemist
lore.info: In the autumn of 1911 a twelve-year-old boy from Resembool passed the State Alchemist examination, the youngest ever to do it. The Führer himself chose his title: the Fullmetal Alchemist. Edward Elric has been in the newspapers on and off since, usually for something he broke. He travels the country with his younger brother Alphonse, who is never seen out of a towering suit of armour, and the pair report to the Flame Alchemist at East City. Most people who meet them assume the armour is the famous one.

lore.name: Youswell
lore.info: Youswell is a coal-mining town on the eastern frontier, the last inhabited place before the desert. The town and its mines stand on land held by an army officer, Lieutenant Yoki, who keeps raising the taxes and cutting the miners' wages. Shops and inns charge travellers outrageous rates just to pay him, and the townsfolk hate soldiers with a passion. The mine foreman, Halling, keeps the inn and speaks for the miners in negotiations that never get anywhere. Coal dust is in every crease of every face.

lore.name: Youswell miners
lore.info: The coal miners of Youswell, a frontier town near the desert border, black to the elbows and loyal to one another before anyone else. For years the land under them belonged to Lieutenant Yoki, who raised their taxes and cut their wages, and they learned to distrust any uniform. A stranger meets them as a hard stare in the town's inn; a friend meets them as men who will dig all night to get one of their own out. One who joins rises by work and by trust.

starts.name: (Party) The Hungry Prince
starts.info:
PARTY · the Promised Day · 2-5 players · Ling Yao, Lan Fan and Fu · guided
📍 Rush Valley, Amestris and its neighbours. The city just north of Dublith that grew fast as the centre of automail making, nicknamed the boomtown of the broken-down.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Quiet ground; trouble here is social before it is lethal. (Recommended Level 2-10)

A young man collapsed from hunger in the middle of Rush Valley's main street, and the party fed him. Now he says he is the twelfth prince of Xing and that he will be travelling with them, and his bodyguards are not asking.
🎭 Brutus and Barker, Male, a pair of Rush Valley hustlers who run an arm-wrestling challenge in the street. (military uniform:-1.2). Two hustlers at an arm-wrestling table in the street, one with giant steel arms.
🎭 Fu, Male, Ling Yao's senior bodyguard and Lan Fan's grandfather. Spiky grey hair, grey shoulder armour. A small old man in black at a gatehouse, kunai already in his hand.
🎭 Lan Fan, Female, a young bodyguard of the Yao clan, Fu's granddaughter and Ling's personal guard. Dark eyes, light grey shoulder armour. A masked girl in black dropping from a roof between her prince and a stranger.
🎭 Ling Yao, Male, the twelfth prince of Xing. Narrow closed smiling eyes, goldenrod shirt with white trim. A smiling prince collapsing in the street from hunger and asking a stranger for lunch.
🎭 Gil Haddon, Male, a bookie who takes wagers on Forge Street in Rush Valley. Slicked-back black hair, a striped waistcoat. A bookie on a bench on Forge Street taking a wager from a mechanic.
🎭 Paninya, Female, the most famous thief in Rush Valley. Blue eyes. A girl on automail legs leaping across a rooftop with a stolen pocket watch.

starts.name: (Party) The Road East
starts.info:
PARTY · after the Promised Day · 2-5 players · Alphonse, Jerso and Zampano · guided
📍 Oasis Palms, Amestris and its neighbours. A small oasis of date palms and a green pool, with clay huts for the families who keep the palms and sell the fruit to the caravans.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🔴 Severe. Deadly to the unready; the top of this band eats mid-level parties. (Recommended Level 16-30)

Alphonse Elric has his body back and has set out east across the desert to learn alkahestry in Xing. Two chimera soldiers who owe him their lives have come along to keep him out of trouble, and they are failing.
🎭 Jerso, Male, a soldier who looks quiet and dangerous on duty and turns out to be friendly. White eyes, (military uniform:-1.3). A stocky soldier with a deadpan face, then a sudden grin at his partner's expense.
🎭 Zampano, Male, a solid man in his late thirties. (military uniform:-1.3). A heavy-set man in an army coat lying smoothly to a sentry.

starts.name: (Party) The Road North
starts.info:
PARTY · the Promised Day · 2-5 players · Scar, May Chang and Yoki · guided
📍 Baschool, Amestris and its neighbours. An abandoned mining town east of Fort Briggs, its houses empty and its rail line rusted.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 10-22)

A scarred Ishvalan, a girl from Xing with a panda on her shoulder and a former officer who complains about everything are heading north with half the army looking for them. They have room for a few more.

starts.name: (Party) The Road West
starts.info:
PARTY · after the Promised Day · 2-5 players · Edward · guided
📍 Creta Border Post, Amestris and its neighbours. The post on the Amestris side of the border with Creta, a fence of wire and sandbags with a gate that opens for patrols and traders alike.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 14-26)

Edward Elric gave up his alchemy to bring his brother back, and now he is going west into Creta to learn what the rest of the world knows. The border post is not sure what to do with a famous ex-State Alchemist who cannot clap.
🎭 Bram Holt, Male, the sergeant of the Amestrian post on the Creta border. Short sandy hair, blue uniform faded by sun. A scarred sergeant crouched behind sandbags with his rifle trained on a hillside.

starts.name: (Party) The Stranger at Central Station
starts.info:
PARTY · the Promised Day · 2-5 players · Van Hohenheim · guided
📍 Central City, Amestris and its neighbours. The capital of Amestris and the seat of its government: the legislature, the military's top command, the national libraries and laboratories and the great rail terminal all sit within its walls.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🔴 Severe. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 12-30)

A tall, bearded old man with spectacles has been waiting on a bench at Central Station all morning, watching the trains come and go. He says he is the father of two boys who do not want to see him, and that he needs help with an errand.
🎭 Van Hohenheim, Male, the father of Edward and Alphonse. Golden eyes, white shirt and tie. A tall bearded man in spectacles on a station platform, not turning to look at the boys behind him.

starts.name: (Party) The Sun God's Town
starts.info:
PARTY · the brothers' journey · 2-5 players · Edward and Alphonse · guided
📍 Reole, Amestris and its neighbours. A poor town of the east with a fierce faith in Leto, the sun god.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 10-22)

Two travellers have come to Reole looking for a stone: a short boy in a red coat and a huge suit of armour that speaks like a child. The town's priest is working miracles, and the brothers think they know how.
🎭 Alphonse Elric, Male, the younger Elric brother, fourteen, who has no body. (giant suit of plate armour:1.3). A giant suit of armour kneeling to offer a stray cat a hand.
🎭 Edward Elric, Male, the Fullmetal Alchemist. Golden eyes, red hooded coat with black Flamel cross on back. A short boy in a red coat clapping his hands together, the street rising into a wall in front of him.
🎭 Rose Thomas, Female, a girl of seventeen in Reole with dark hair and pink-tinted bangs. Purple eyes, plain dress. A girl kneeling in the church, praying for a miracle that will bring her boyfriend back.

starts.name: (Party) The Teacher's Kitchen
starts.info:
PARTY · the Promised Day · 2-5 players · Edward and Alphonse · guided
📍 Curtis House, Amestris and its neighbours. The home of the Sig Curtis household in Dublith, a plain house with a herb garden and a kitchen where the bread is baked each morning.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 2-10)

The Elric brothers have come back to Dublith to face the teacher they disobeyed, confess what they tried, and ask what she knows of the Gate. She has not decided yet whether to hit them or hug them.
🎭 Alphonse Elric, Male, the younger Elric brother, fourteen, who has no body. (giant suit of plate armour:1.3). A giant suit of armour kneeling to offer a stray cat a hand.
🎭 Edward Elric, Male, the Fullmetal Alchemist. Golden eyes, red hooded coat with black Flamel cross on back. A short boy in a red coat clapping his hands together, the street rising into a wall in front of him.
🎭 Izumi Curtis, Female, a housewife of Dublith. Sharp dark eyes, long white sleeveless button coat-dress. A stern woman at a butcher's counter, cleaver in hand, staring down two boys who have come back.

starts.name: (Party) The Train Into East City
starts.info:
PARTY · the brothers' journey · 2-5 players · Roy Mustang and Riza Hawkeye · guided
📍 Eastern Command Headquarters, Amestris and its neighbours. The headquarters of the eastern military command, a squat block of offices with a guarded gate and a parade ground in front.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟡 Moderate. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 10-18)

Gunmen have taken the night train from the west, and a general and his family are on board. The Flame Alchemist has been told to meet the train at East City and make it go away quietly.
🎭 Roy Mustang, Male, Colonel Roy Mustang. Short messy black hair falling over eyes, blue military uniform. A colonel in white gloves leaning back in his chair, fingers poised to snap.
🎭 Riza Hawkeye, Female, Riza Hawkeye. Light brown eyes, blue military uniform over black turtleneck. A blonde lieutenant at a gate, rifle on her shoulder, watching her colonel's back.
🎭 Halcrow, Male, Major General Halcrow. Blue eyes, blue general's military uniform with medals. A peevish general berating a colonel for taking too long to catch a killer.
🎭 Rebecca Catalina, Female, Second Lieutenant Rebecca Catalina of the eastern command. Black eyes, (military uniform:-1.2). A lieutenant loading a grenade launcher and complaining that there are no decent men in Central.

starts.name: A Month on the Island
starts.info:
ELRIC RUN · the Ishval war · the brothers' own story · guided
📍 Yock Island, Amestris and its neighbours. A small island in the middle of Kauroy Lake, near Dublith, with rocky shores and pine scrub.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Quiet ground; trouble here is social before it is lethal. (Recommended Level 2-10)

Your teacher left you on an island in Kauroy Lake with no food, no tools and one riddle: all is one, and one is all. You and your sibling are children from Resembool, and you have a month to understand it or go home.

starts.name: Automail Row Apprentices
starts.info:
HOOK · before the journey · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Rush Valley, Amestris and its neighbours. The city just north of Dublith that grew fast as the centre of automail making, nicknamed the boomtown of the broken-down.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Quiet ground; trouble here is social before it is lethal. (Recommended Level 2-10)

Rush Valley sells automail to anyone who walks in, and every workshop on Automail Row wants an apprentice who will work for nothing. The best engineer on the row will take nobody at all.
🎭 Tullio Scarpa, Male, an Aerugonian engineer with a cramped shop at the end of Automail Row. Grey eyes, rolled shirt sleeves. A tall grey-eyed engineer turning a steel knee joint in a scarred hand, saying nothing about where he is from.
🎭 Garfiel, Male, the owner of Atelier Garfiel in Rush Valley. Purple shirt. A muscular mechanic clasping his hands in delight over a beautifully made automail arm.
🎭 Mira Kessel, Female, an automail engineer of Rush Valley who runs a small shop on Automail Row and enters. A young engineer grabbing a stranger's sleeve on a busy street of workshops.

starts.name: Clearing the Rail Yard
starts.info:
HOOK · after the Promised Day · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Central Rail Yard, Amestris and its neighbours. The freight yard behind Central Station: sidings full of wagons, the engine sheds and the cargo cranes that move supplies to the fronts.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 12-22)

The fighting in the capital left Central's rail yard full of wrecked engines and craters, and the city cannot eat until the trains run. The yard foreman is hiring anyone with hands.
🎭 Bertram Kohl, Male, the yardmaster of the capital's freight yard. Dark coat with brass buttons. A yardmaster with a lantern directing an engine in a cloud of steam.

starts.name: Frostline Watch
starts.info:
ERA · after the Promised Day · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Frostline Outpost, Amestris and its neighbours. A small outpost high on the range, a hut and a flag pole that watch the road to Drachma.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 10-22)

Briggs still answers to Olivier Mira Armstrong, and she has decided that the peace with Drachma will be held by watching it closely. The outpost on the frostline is the loneliest post on the mountain.

starts.name: Guns from the South
starts.info:
ERA · the Ishval war · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Ishval Border Gate, Amestris and its neighbours. The checkpoint where the road from East City enters the Ishval country.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 10-22)

The Ishvalan fighters are still shooting, and the army wants to know where their rifles come from. The checkpoint at the border gate has started opening every cart, and the carters have started to vanish.

starts.name: Ishval Rebuilt
starts.info:
ERA · after the Promised Day · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Ishval, Amestris and its neighbours. The south-eastern region of the Ishvalans, who follow Ishvala, a hard country of rock and sand on the edge of the great desert.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 10-22)

The new government has opened Ishval to its people again, and an officer who fought in the war has asked to be posted there to help rebuild it. The Ishvalans who have come home do not trust him, and they have every reason.
🎭 Roy Mustang, Male, Colonel Roy Mustang. Short messy black hair falling over eyes, blue military uniform. A colonel in white gloves leaning back in his chair, fingers poised to snap.
🎭 Scar, Male, a tall Ishvalan with a great cross-shaped scar across his forehead and face. Red eyes, open yellow jacket. A tall scarred Ishvalan in sunglasses in an alley, one tattooed hand already reaching.
🎭 Riza Hawkeye, Female, Riza Hawkeye. Light brown eyes, blue military uniform over black turtleneck. A blonde lieutenant at a gate, rifle on her shoulder, watching her colonel's back.
🎭 Tim Marcoh, Male, the village doctor of a nameless hamlet on the road between East City and Resembool. Dark tired eyes, white lab coat over collared shirt. An old village doctor in a white coat bent over a child, who stiffens when a soldier walks in.

starts.name: Papers at the Eastern Gate
starts.info:
HOOK · the brothers' journey · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Eastern Gate Road, Amestris and its neighbours. The road that leaves East City for the east and the north, with a gatehouse where papers are checked and every cart is searched.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟡 Moderate. Real fights at the edges; walk in with your eyes open. (Recommended Level 8-18)

East City's gates are checking every traveller for a scarred man, and the queue at the eastern checkpoint stretches back down the road. Everyone in it has a reason to get through today.

starts.name: Reole Without a Prophet
starts.info:
ERA · after the Promised Day · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Cornello's Manor, Amestris and its neighbours. The manor of the man who ruled Reole, a big house with guards at the gate and a garden of roses that is still tended by his old gardener.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 10-22)

Reole tore itself apart after its priest fell, and the town that is left is rebuilding without anyone telling it what to believe. Rose Thomas has become the one people go to, and she is tired.

starts.name: Repairs at the Rockbells'
starts.info:
HOOK · the brothers' journey · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Rockbell Automail, Amestris and its neighbours. The Rockbell family home and its automail atelier, run by Pinako Rockbell and her granddaughter Winry, where limbs are made, fitted and mended.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 2-10)

A boy came home to Resembool with his automail arm smashed to scrap and a suit of armour in a crate. The workshop on the hill is working through the night, and the village is curious.
🎭 Pinako Rockbell, Female, Winry's grandmother. Dark long-sleeved work dress. A tiny old woman with a pipe at a forge door, glaring at a boy who has broken his arm again.
🎭 Winry Rockbell, Female, an automail engineer of fifteen who learned her craft in her grandmother's workshop. Blue eyes. A girl with a wrench at a workshop door, arms crossed, waiting for a boy who broke his arm again.

starts.name: Steel for the Veterans
starts.info:
HOOK · after the Promised Day · 1-5 players · guided
📍 LeCoulte Automail, Amestris and its neighbours. The automail shop of Ridel and Dominic LeCoulte, set in the mountains near Rush Valley, where the materials are plentiful and the shop has regular customers from Rush Valley.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Quiet ground; trouble here is social before it is lethal. (Recommended Level 2-10)

The battle in the capital left a great many soldiers without arms or legs, and Rush Valley has more orders than it can fill. The workshops are hiring anyone who can hold a spanner.
🎭 Dominic LeCoulte, Male, a gruff, anti-social old automail engineer who lives in the mountains outside Rush Valley. Grey hair, dark green t-shirt. A scowling old mechanic slamming the door on a girl who wants to be his apprentice.
🎭 Ridel LeCoulte, Male, an automail engineer of Rush Valley. Short black hair, teal work jacket over a black shirt. An automail engineer at a fitting bench, glancing at his heavily pregnant wife.
🎭 Ridel's Son, Male, the infant son of Ridel and Satella LeCoulte. Tiny tuft of light brown hair. A newborn wrapped in a blanket, held up by a tearful grandfather.
🎭 Satella LeCoulte, Female, Ridel's wife. Green eyes, white top under pink apron straps. A heavily pregnant woman letting two wide-eyed boys feel her baby kick.

starts.name: The Broadcast
starts.info:
ERA · the Promised Day · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Radio Capital, Amestris and its neighbours. The capital's radio station, syndicated across the whole country.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 12-22)

The capital is under a solar eclipse, soldiers are fighting in the streets, and nobody knows which side the radio is on. The staff of Radio Capital have locked the doors and are deciding what to say to the country.
🎭 Nel Garrow, Female, a radio announcer at Radio Capital's broadcast studio in Central City. A radio announcer at a microphone, reading from a script with a line crossed out.

starts.name: The Brother Who Gave It Up
starts.info:
ELRIC RUN · after the Promised Day · the brothers' own story · guided
📍 Resembool, Amestris and its neighbours. A quiet rural town in the south-east of Amestris on the banks of the Rain River, known for its sheep and the wool it sends away for army uniforms.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 2-10)

You gave your Gate to bring your sibling's body back, and you will never clap your hands to change the world again. Resembool is green, your sibling is home and recovering, and you have no idea what to do with the rest of your life.
🎭 Erwin Gosse, Male, the farmer who has chaired the town meeting on the village green for eleven years. Thinning brown hair, good brown waistcoat with a watch chain. A big farmer in his best waistcoat banging a stick on a trestle to bring a meeting to order.

starts.name: The Butcher's Counter
starts.info:
HOOK · before the journey · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Curtis Meats, Amestris and its neighbours. A narrow butcher's shop in Dublith run by Izumi and Sig Curtis, with Mason their one hand behind the counter.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 2-10)

The butcher's shop on Dublith's main street is run by a huge quiet man and a housewife who coughs blood and can throw a grown man across the room. Every few months someone walks in asking her to teach them alchemy.
🎭 Mason, Male, Sig Curtis's assistant at Curtis Meats. Short spiky black hair, dark eyes, white butcher's apron. A cheerful shop hand hauling a side of meat out of the cold store and waving at the boys.
🎭 Sig Curtis, Male, the butcher of Curtis Meats in Dublith and Izumi's husband. Slicked-back black hair, dark green work shirt. A huge man in a bloody apron holding the shop door open for two boys he has missed.

starts.name: The Caravan From the East
starts.info:
HOOK · the brothers' journey · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Desert Crossing, Amestris and its neighbours. The last walled stop before the great desert: a caravan yard of mud-brick walls, wells and pens, where traders gather to cross east toward Xing or to come back west.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🔴 Severe. Deadly to the unready; the top of this band eats mid-level parties. (Recommended Level 16-30)

A caravan has come in across the Eastern Desert with silk, tea and passengers, and one of the passengers is a young man in Xingese clothes who keeps asking about ruins and immortality.
🎭 Mr. Han, Male, a Xingese smuggler with glasses and a goatee who specialises in moving people across. Short black hair, loose Xingese travelling coat. A bespectacled smuggler checking water skins in a caravan yard at dusk.
🎭 Old Ruo, Male, a caravan master of Xing who has crossed the great desert more times than he can count. An old caravan master leaning on a staff in a mud-walled yard full of camels.

starts.name: The Chimera That Spoke
starts.info:
ERA · before the journey · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Canal Ward, Amestris and its neighbours. The old quarter by the canals, with its footbridges, laundry boats and houses that lean over the water.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟡 Moderate. Real fights at the edges; walk in with your eyes open. (Recommended Level 8-16)

An alchemist in a shabby house has made a chimera that can speak, and the state has given him a licence for it. His neighbours say the house was louder before the licence, and quieter since his wife went away.
🎭 Shou Tucker, Male, Major Shou Tucker. Very short cropped light brown hair, blue eyes, faded olive green open-collared shirt with sleeves rolled to elbows. A mild man in glasses showing two boys his library while his little daughter plays with a big dog.
🎭 Bald, Male, a ranking man of the Blue Squad. Dark coat. A man with an eyepatch holding a carriage at gunpoint, his steel arm open to show the barrel.
🎭 Lem, Male, a canal boatman who carries cargo and passengers along the Main Canal in East City. A sleeveless canvas jacket. A boatman poling a flat barge under a footbridge while a soldier watches from above.

starts.name: The Coal Tax
starts.info:
ERA · before the journey · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Youswell, Amestris and its neighbours. A coal-mining town on the eastern frontier of Amestris, the nearest inhabited place to the desert.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟡 Moderate. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 6-16)

The officer who owns the mine at Youswell has raised the miners' tax again and cut their pay to match. The miners' row has started talking about a strike, and the officer has started talking about soldiers.
🎭 Kyle Halling, Male, the young son of Mr. Messy dark hair, blue eyes, patched work jacket. A boy steering two travellers toward his father's tavern, grinning at what they will pay.

starts.name: The Collapse at Youswell
starts.info:
ERA · the Promised Day · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Youswell Coal Mine, Amestris and its neighbours. The main coal mine of Youswell, with its headframe over the shaft and the galleries that run under the hills.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟡 Moderate. Real fights at the edges; walk in with your eyes open. (Recommended Level 6-16)

A shaft at the Youswell mine has collapsed with men inside, and the rescue has stopped because the timbers will not hold. A girl from Xing who arrived on the morning cart says she can fix it.
🎭 May Chang, Female, the seventeenth princess of Xing. Big black eyes, (military uniform:-1.3). A tiny princess with a panda on her shoulder, kunai fanned in one hand, lecturing a man twice her size.

starts.name: The Colonel's Fishing Trip
starts.info:
ERA · the Promised Day · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Laboratory 3, Amestris and its neighbours. One of the alchemical laboratories inside the capital, among the nearest to Central Command and the Führer's residence.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🔴 Severe. Deadly to the unready; the top of this band eats mid-level parties. (Recommended Level 18-30)

A murderer who should be dead is loose in Central, and the colonel newly posted to the capital means to use him as bait to catch whoever let him out. The trail leads under the city, into the third laboratory.

starts.name: The Creta Wire
starts.info:
ERA · before the journey · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Creta Border Post, Amestris and its neighbours. The post on the Amestris side of the border with Creta, a fence of wire and sandbags with a gate that opens for patrols and traders alike.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 14-26)

The war on the western border has gone on for years, and the wire at the border post is the only thing everyone agrees on. Tonight a patrol from Creta has cut it.

starts.name: The Crimson Line
starts.info:
ERA · the Ishval war · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Ishval War Ruins, Amestris and its neighbours. The ruined towns of the old Ishval, left as the war made them.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 10-22)

The State Alchemists have been given a district each, and the one the party serves under treats the war like a craft. Every house on Blackened Lane is to be emptied by morning.
🎭 Envy, Male, a slim, androgynous young man with long spiky black hair and a black crop top and skort. Violet eyes, (military uniform:-1.3). A grinning youth in black on a rooftop above the avenue, wearing a stranger's face for a moment.
🎭 Roy Mustang, Male, Colonel Roy Mustang. Short messy black hair falling over eyes, blue military uniform. A colonel in white gloves leaning back in his chair, fingers poised to snap.
🎭 Scar, Male, a tall Ishvalan with a great cross-shaped scar across his forehead and face. Red eyes, open yellow jacket. A tall scarred Ishvalan in sunglasses in an alley, one tattooed hand already reaching.
🎭 Solf J. Kimblee, Male, Major Solf J. Narrow golden eyes, white waistcoat. A smiling prisoner with long black hair pressing his tattooed palms together in a cell.
🎭 Alex Louis Armstrong, Male, Major Alex Louis Armstrong. Tight blue military uniform. A giant bald major with a blond moustache, weeping openly and flexing at the same time.
🎭 Giolio Comanche, Male, Major Giolio Comanche. Blue military uniform. A tiny old man on a peg leg grinning at a killer in the dark.

starts.name: The Defenders of Kanda
starts.info:
ERA · the Ishval war · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Mountain Hideout, Amestris and its neighbours. The caves and gorges in the red hills east of Ishval, where the survivors of the war who refuse the army's rule keep their camps.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 12-22)

The last Ishvalan fighters of the Kanda district have pulled back into the mountains with the families they could carry. The army is coming up the gorge, and the warrior monks have one night to choose between the pass and the people.

starts.name: The Doctor in the Nameless Village
starts.info:
ERA · before the journey · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Nameless Village, Amestris and its neighbours. A small village between East City and Resembool whose station placards are left blank, so the maps call it a town with no name.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Quiet ground; trouble here is social before it is lethal. (Recommended Level 4-10)

A village between East City and Resembool has a new doctor who can cure what no doctor should, and asks for nothing but silence. A girl named Kiri brings him flowers every morning, and strangers have started asking for him by another name.
🎭 Tim Marcoh, Male, the village doctor of a nameless hamlet on the road between East City and Resembool. Dark tired eyes, white lab coat over collared shirt. An old village doctor in a white coat bent over a child, who stiffens when a soldier walks in.

starts.name: The Doctor's Last Stone
starts.info:
HOOK · after the Promised Day · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Nameless Village, Amestris and its neighbours. A small village between East City and Resembool whose station placards are left blank, so the maps call it a town with no name.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Quiet ground; trouble here is social before it is lethal. (Recommended Level 4-10)

The doctor of the nameless village has come home with a red stone he swears is his last, and a list of people who need it. He has not decided whose name comes first.
🎭 Kiri, Female, a little girl of the Nameless Village. Short brown hair, plain country dress. A little girl at a clinic door with a bunch of wildflowers.

starts.name: The Doctors' Tent
starts.info:
ERA · the Ishval war · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Ishval War Ruins, Amestris and its neighbours. The ruined towns of the old Ishval, left as the war made them.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 10-22)

Two doctors from Resembool have pitched a tent in the ruins and treat anyone who is carried in, Ishvalan or Amestrian. The army thinks they are fools and the Ishvalans think they are a trick, and the wounded keep coming.
🎭 Dr. Knox, Male, Dr. Grey jacket over white mandarin-collar shirt. A tired old doctor bent over a burned body, signing a false report.
🎭 Sarah Rockbell, Female, a surgeon from Resembool. Bright blue eyes, dark long-sleeved dress. A surgeon in a bloodstained coat working by lamplight in a ruined square.
🎭 Shan, Female, Elder Shan. Red eyes, a long brown robe and shawl. An old woman with an eye patch raising her cane to stop young men from harming a stranger.
🎭 Yuriy Rockbell, Male, a surgeon from Resembool. Short light brown hair, dark kind eyes, collared shirt with necktie. A doctor in round glasses bandaging a wounded man in a ruined square.

starts.name: The Drachman Attack
starts.info:
ERA · the Promised Day · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Fort Briggs, Amestris and its neighbours. Amestris' first garrison against Drachma: a single immense wall stretched across the narrow valley where the mountains leave a gap, holding labs, a prison, gun positions, quarters, supply tunnels and one great tunnel down its length.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 10-22)

Drachma has broken the pact on the northern border, and its army is marching on Fort Briggs at the end of the year. The commander's keep is full of maps, and the commander has no patience left for anyone.
🎭 Olivier Mira Armstrong, Female, Major General Olivier Mira Armstrong. Sharp narrow blue eyes, dark military greatcoat with white fur collar. A blonde general on the wall of a snowbound fortress, sabre on her hip, looking down at an army.
🎭 Miles, Male, Major Miles. Black military greatcoat with white fur collar. A goggled major at the general's shoulder, already carrying out an order she has not finished giving.
🎭 Fort Briggs Doctor, Female, the doctor and automail engineer of Fort Briggs. Short dark hair, blue eyes, white doctor's coat. A doctor in a white coat refitting a soldier's steel arm while the wind howls.

starts.name: The Emperor's Court
starts.info:
ERA · after the Promised Day · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Imperial Palace, Amestris and its neighbours. The Emperor's palace in the heart of the capital, with gilded roofs, terraces of stone and gates guarded by men in lacquered armour.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 14-26)

The prince who went to Amestris for immortality has come home with something better, and the court of Xing is deciding whether to crown him. His bodyguard has a steel arm now, and the clans are watching her.
🎭 Ling Yao, Male, the twelfth prince of Xing. Narrow closed smiling eyes, goldenrod shirt with white trim. A smiling prince collapsing in the street from hunger and asking a stranger for lunch.

starts.name: The Empty Laboratory
starts.info:
ERA · the brothers' journey · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Laboratory 5, Amestris and its neighbours. A state laboratory on the outskirts of the capital, beside Central Prison, said to have closed years ago.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🔴 Severe. Deadly to the unready; the top of this band eats mid-level parties. (Recommended Level 16-28)

The laboratory beside Central Prison was closed years ago, the army says. Then why is there a guard on its gate every night, and why did a light go on in its corridors last week?
🎭 Barry the Chopper, Male, a suit of armour with a cleaver and a butcher's cheer. (hulking suit of plate armour:1.3). An empty suit of armour swinging a cleaver down a dark corridor, giggling.

starts.name: The Freezing Alchemist's Notice
starts.info:
ERA · before the journey · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Central Rail Yard, Amestris and its neighbours. The freight yard behind Central Station: sidings full of wagons, the engine sheds and the cargo cranes that move supplies to the fronts.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 12-22)

A State Alchemist who served in Ishval has torn up his certificate and vanished, and there are notices for him on every post in the rail yard. The army says he is a traitor; the men who have met him say he is grieving.
🎭 Isaac McDougal, Male, Isaac McDougal. Green eyes, dull hooded cloak over an open State Alchemist jacket with torn right sleeve. A cloaked man freezing a whole avenue of soldiers solid with his hand on the ground.

starts.name: The Frontier Road
starts.info:
HOOK · the Promised Day · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Drachma, Amestris and its neighbours. The large country to the north, behind the Briggs range: a belligerent state that has fought Amestris on and off for generations.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 12-22)

On the Drachman side of the Briggs range, the frontier town is filling with soldiers and the inns are full of rumours that the pact is dead. Anyone with Amestrian papers is being watched.
🎭 Vagner, Male, a clerk in the Drachman frontier town who keeps the border register and the trade books. A grey waistcoat over a white shirt. A frontier clerk at a desk, writing names in a heavy register by lamplight.

starts.name: The Grand Cleric's Walk
starts.info:
ERA · the Ishval war · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Priests' Shrine, Amestris and its neighbours. A shrine of the Warrior priests of Ishvala, cut from red stone and carved with verses of the faith.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 10-22)

Ishvala's Grand Cleric has hidden in the wilderness since the war began, and now he means to come out and offer his life to the Führer in exchange for his people's. His priests are begging him not to, and the hidden camp is holding its breath.
🎭 Scar's Master, Male, an old Ishvalan. Short white hair, red eyes, plain Ishvalan refugee robe and shawl. An old Ishvalan in a refugee's robe facing his former pupil in a dark tunnel, unafraid.

starts.name: The House on the Hill
starts.info:
ELRIC RUN · before the journey · the brothers' own story · guided
📍 Elric House, Amestris and its neighbours. The Elric family's house on the edge of Resembool, where Trisha Elric raised her two sons after their father left.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 2-10)

You passed the state exam last week and came home with a silver watch and a title. Tonight you and your sibling are burning the house you grew up in, so that there is nothing to come back to until you have your bodies back.

starts.name: The Lake After the Raid
starts.info:
HOOK · the Promised Day · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Kauroy Ferry Pier, Amestris and its neighbours. The jetty from which the small ferry runs out to the island and back, with its boat, its ropes and its ticket board.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Quiet ground; trouble here is social before it is lethal. (Recommended Level 2-10)

The army raided a bar in Dublith last night and the sewers ran with soldiers until dawn. This morning the ferry pier is crawling with military police, and the lake is giving up bodies.

starts.name: The Military Festival
starts.info:
ERA · before the journey · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Central Gardens, Amestris and its neighbours. The public gardens at the middle of the capital, clipped hedges and plane trees around a bandstand.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 12-22)

The capital is holding its Military Festival, and the rumour in the crowd is that the Flame Alchemist and the youngest State Alchemist in history are going to fight in front of the Führer. The bandstand is already ringed with soldiers.
🎭 Philip Gargantos Armstrong, Male, the former patriarch of the Armstrong family. Slicked-back blond hair, blue eyes, (military uniform:-1.2). A bearded old gentleman holding forth about his ancestors to a trapped guest.
🎭 Mrs. Hamburgang, Female, the lady of the wealthy Hamburgang household. Fine dress with lace collar. A red-haired lady watching from a window as her adopted daughter leads a blind man through the garden.
🎭 Rosalie Hamburgang, Female, the only daughter of the wealthy Hamburgang family. Long wavy auburn brown hair, dark eyes, blue coat-dress with white collar. A girl in a frilled dress leading a visitor by the hand toward a locked wing.

starts.name: The Miracles of the Sun God
starts.info:
ELRIC RUN · the brothers' journey · the brothers' own story · guided
📍 Reole Church, Amestris and its neighbours. The church of Reole, a tall building with a spire and old glass.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 10-22)

You and your sibling have heard that the priest of a desert town can do alchemy without the rules, and you need that more than anyone. Tonight you are in his church after dark, and his miracle is on the altar.
🎭 Cornello, Male, Father Cornello. Short receding dark hair, small eyes, (military uniform:-1.2). A priest in white robes on a church balcony, arms spread, a red ring glinting as a statue rises from the stones.

starts.name: The New Führer's Parliament
starts.info:
ERA · after the Promised Day · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Parliament House, Amestris and its neighbours. The Parliament building of Amestris, a columned hall of benches and committees where the nation's laws are argued and passed.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 12-24)

The Führer is dead and General Grumman holds the office, promising a parliament that means something. The chamber is sitting again for the first time in years, and nobody in it is sure of the rules.
🎭 Grumman, Male, Lieutenant General Grumman. Blue general's military uniform with medals and gold aiguillette. An old general moving a chess piece and suggesting the colonel should marry.

starts.name: The Northern Wall
starts.info:
ELRIC RUN · the Promised Day · the brothers' own story · guided
📍 Briggs Pass, Amestris and its neighbours. The gorge that cuts through the Briggs range near the fort, the only road a cart can take in winter.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 10-22)

You and your sibling came north to find a general who might know something, and the mountain nearly killed you on the way up. The pass to Fort Briggs is blocked by snow, and something under the mountain is digging.

starts.name: The Order on the Drill Ground
starts.info:
ERA · the Ishval war · 1-5 players · guided
📍 East City, Amestris and its neighbours. The military command base of the eastern area, on the Marl River.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟡 Moderate. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 8-18)

The Führer has signed Executive Order Number 3066, and the State Alchemists are being put on trains for the east. East City's drill ground is full of soldiers, crates and officers who will not say what the order means.

starts.name: The Patient in Room Five
starts.info:
ERA · the brothers' journey · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Central Hospital, Amestris and its neighbours. The state hospital of the capital, where soldiers and civilians injured in the fighting are taken.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 12-24)

An abandoned laboratory beside the prison blew apart last night, and the young State Alchemist who was inside it is in the hospital with two guards on his door. The guards have been told nobody gets in.

starts.name: The Pawn Shop Thief
starts.info:
HOOK · the brothers' journey · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Glotz Pawn Shop, Amestris and its neighbours. A pawn shop in the West Alley of Rush Valley, crowded with costly things beside old tools, where the owner knows stolen goods when he sees them and buys them anyway.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Quiet ground; trouble here is social before it is lethal. (Recommended Level 2-10)

A girl with automail legs runs the rooftops of Rush Valley and lifts wallets from visitors faster than they can blink. The pawn shop at the end of the row buys whatever she brings and asks nothing.
🎭 Glotz, Male, the owner of the pawn shop in Rush Valley's west alley. Thinning oiled hair, embroidered waistcoat. A round pawnbroker peering through a loupe at a pocket watch across his counter.

starts.name: The Records Office
starts.info:
ERA · the brothers' journey · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Central Prison, Amestris and its neighbours. The capital's great prison, run by the State Military: hundreds of felons and court-martialed soldiers behind its walls, and Central Command leaning on its warders whenever it wants a man held or forgotten.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 12-24)

An officer from military intelligence has been spending his nights in the prison's records office, reading old files nobody else wants. He needs someone to fetch, copy and keep quiet.

starts.name: The Recruiting Table
starts.info:
HOOK · the Ishval war · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Central Command, Amestris and its neighbours. The top of the military government of Amestris: the head of state and his generals keep their offices in a moated compound on a pyramid-like structure at the heart of the capital.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🔴 Severe. Deadly to the unready; the top of this band eats mid-level parties. (Recommended Level 14-30)

Central City wants more soldiers for the east, and the recruiting table outside Central Command is offering pay, boots and a train ticket. The crowd around it is half volunteers and half people who were told to come.
🎭 Cremin, Male, Brigadier General Cremin of Central Command. Greying hair, blue military general's uniform with gold braid. A cold general ordering artillery onto a residential street.
🎭 Gardner, Male, Lieutenant General Gardner. Swept-back grey hair, narrow eyes, blue military general's uniform with braid. A grey-haired general leading a colleague down into a vault of motionless soldiers.
🎭 Gärtner, Male, Major General Gärtner of Central Command. Short grey hair, blue general's military uniform under black greatcoat with white fur collar. A bespectacled general reading out his orders to a hall of hostile Briggs soldiers.

starts.name: The Refugees of Asbec
starts.info:
HOOK · the Promised Day · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Asbec, Amestris and its neighbours. A town near the Briggs range with a slum of Ishvalan refugees on its edge.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 10-22)

Asbec's Ishvalan slum has taken in more people than it can feed this winter, and soldiers have started searching it for a scarred man. The slum's elders want strangers either useful or gone.
🎭 Lina Saffi, Female, an Ishvalan refugee in the Asbec slum outside Fort Briggs. A faded blue shawl over a grey dress. A seamstress in a refugee slum sewing a child's coat by a fire.

starts.name: The Road Home to Ishval
starts.info:
HOOK · after the Promised Day · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Ishvalan Refugee Camp, Amestris and its neighbours. A camp of tents and shacks on the edge of the ruined land, where Ishvalans who lost their homes scrape a living and wait for news of kin.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 10-22)

The camps are emptying as the Ishvalans go home, and the road east is full of families with carts. Not everyone on the road wants them to arrive.
🎭 Elder Halim, Male, the headman of an Ishvalan refugee camp on the edge of the war zone. Red eyes, a patched brown coat over a plain white shirt. A headman at a water cart counting names in the morning light.

starts.name: The Rockbell Fitting Room
starts.info:
HOOK · before the journey · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Rockbell Automail, Amestris and its neighbours. The Rockbell family home and its automail atelier, run by Pinako Rockbell and her granddaughter Winry, where limbs are made, fitted and mended.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 2-10)

The Rockbell workshop on the hill fits automail for half the veterans of the east, and the waiting room is full. The old woman who runs it is short with everyone, and her granddaughter is better than anyone admits.
🎭 Winry Rockbell, Female, an automail engineer of fifteen who learned her craft in her grandmother's workshop. Blue eyes. A girl with a wrench at a workshop door, arms crossed, waiting for a boy who broke his arm again.
🎭 Den, Female, the Rockbell family's dog, a black-and-white dog with an automail front left leg. Dark eyes, harness. A black and white dog with a steel leg sitting at the workshop door, watching the road.

starts.name: The Scarred Man in the Rain
starts.info:
ERA · the brothers' journey · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Canal Ward, Amestris and its neighbours. The old quarter by the canals, with its footbridges, laundry boats and houses that lean over the water.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟡 Moderate. Real fights at the edges; walk in with your eyes open. (Recommended Level 8-16)

State Alchemists are being killed across the country, and the killer has come to East City. Witnesses say only that he has a scar on his face and that his right arm glows when he touches a man.
🎭 Shou Tucker, Male, Major Shou Tucker. Very short cropped light brown hair, blue eyes, faded olive green open-collared shirt with sleeves rolled to elbows. A mild man in glasses showing two boys his library while his little daughter plays with a big dog.
🎭 Alexander, Male, the Tucker family's dog, an enormous white dog with a loud bark and a soft heart. Small dark eyes, (military uniform:-1.2). A huge white dog bounding at a visitor in a house full of books.
🎭 Nina Tucker, Female, the young daughter of Shou Tucker. Big deep blue eyes, pale green pinafore dress with silver buttons. A small girl with long braids hugging a huge white dog in a library full of books.

starts.name: The Sewing-Life House
starts.info:
ERA · the brothers' journey · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Eastern Tenements, Amestris and its neighbours. The poor streets of the capital's east, a crush of brick tenements where the families of clerks and labourers live and where soldiers are rarely seen after dark.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 12-20)

The Sewing-Life Alchemist's yearly assessment is due, and he has promised the state another speaking chimera. His daughter's dog has not been seen for two days, and neither has his daughter.
🎭 Ina Stroud, Female, a tenement landlady in Central City's Eastern Tenements. A faded brown shawl over a dark dress. A landlady in a tenement yard collecting rent under a line of washing.
🎭 Elicia Hughes, Female, the three-year-old daughter of Maes and Gracia Hughes. Green eyes, pink dress with white frilly hem. A tiny girl in pigtails holding up three fingers at her own birthday party.
🎭 Gracia Hughes, Female, the kind-hearted wife of Lieutenant Colonel Maes Hughes and mother of little Elicia. Green eyes, cream cardigan over a blue dress with embroidered neckline. A kind woman at her door with a pie, a toddler clinging to her skirt.

starts.name: The Station Rebuilt
starts.info:
HOOK · the Ishval war · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Resembool, Amestris and its neighbours. A quiet rural town in the south-east of Amestris on the banks of the Rain River, known for its sheep and the wool it sends away for army uniforms.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 2-10)

A year ago a bomb blew the front off Resembool's station, and the village is still rebuilding it. Now the trains carry soldiers east every week, and the village's patience with strangers is short.
🎭 Lambrecht Tilney, Male, Resembool's stationmaster. Dark blue railway uniform with brass buttons. A stationmaster holding his watch up to an arriving engine, one hand cupped behind his ear.

starts.name: The Toll Post on the Rain River
starts.info:
HOOK · the Ishval war · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Rain River Bridge, Amestris and its neighbours. A wooden bridge over the Rain River on the road to East City, with a toll post at one end and a lamp that lights itself on dark nights.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Quiet ground; trouble here is social before it is lethal. (Recommended Level 2-10)

Ishvalan families have been crossing the Rain River at night, heading west to anywhere the war is not. The toll keeper on the bridge has started charging more than any of them can pay, and the army has started asking him who crosses.

starts.name: The Trenches at Fotset
starts.info:
ERA · before the journey · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Aerugo Front Line, Amestris and its neighbours. The line where the armies of Amestris and Aerugo face each other across scrub and ruin.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟡 Moderate. Real fights at the edges; walk in with your eyes open. (Recommended Level 8-18)

The southern war is in its long middle, with the trenches at Fotset neither won nor lost. Rations are short, the summer is long, and the enemy across the scrub has been singing every night this week.

starts.name: The Winter Exercise
starts.info:
ERA · before the journey · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Briggs, Amestris and its neighbours. The mountain range at the far north of Amestris, a natural wall against Drachma: snow the year round, winters far below zero and blizzards with no warning.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 10-22)

Fort Briggs runs its winter exercises in the worst weather the mountain can throw, and the garrison usually wins them. This year a company from the capital has come up to lose, and the commander has ordered that nobody goes easy on them.

starts.name: Veterans' Row
starts.info:
HOOK · the Ishval war · 1-5 players · guided
📍 East City, Amestris and its neighbours. The military command base of the eastern area, on the Marl River.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟡 Moderate. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 8-18)

The men back from the front drink on Veterans' Row and do not talk to anyone who was not there. Tonight one of them is talking, too loudly, about orders and alchemists.

starts.name: Ward Three
starts.info:
ERA · the Ishval war · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Eastern Military Hospital, Amestris and its neighbours. The military hospital of East City, where the garrison's wounded and sick are treated.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟡 Moderate. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 8-16)

The trains back from Ishval are full of wounded men, and the eastern military hospital has run out of beds. A State Alchemist doctor from the front has come to help, and he will not say what he did out there.
🎭 Edda Marten, Female, a military nurse at the eastern hospital who runs Ward Three like a drill sergeant. Stern eyes, white apron over a blue military dress. A stern nurse standing between a sick bed and an officer at the ward door.

starts.name: Write Your Own
starts.info:
MAKE IT YOURS · open-ended
Write your own beginning anywhere in Amestris and its borders. Say who you are, which trade or service made you, whether you can alchemy, which year it is, and where your road starts.

modes.name: Alchemist of the People
modes.info:
POWER · Easy
The party are prodigies of their arts, strong enough to change a town's fate, with the state taking notice.
Expect · big transmutations, quick growth, heroic wins
Lighter on · slow training

modes.name: Apple Pie in Resembool
modes.info:
GENTLE · Very easy
A slower, kinder road: green hills, workshops, good food and small troubles, with the war far away.
Expect · warm scenes, kind neighbours, small stakes
Lighter on · battles and loss

modes.name: Briggs Garrison
modes.info:
ROLE · Hard
The party hold the northern wall at Fort Briggs, where the strong survive and the weak are buried in the snow.
Expect · cold, discipline, a border war
Lighter on · comfort

modes.name: Broken Gate
modes.info:
RUN · Very hard
A human transmutation failed in this world before the start, and someone else paid the Gate's toll.
Expect · the Gate's echo, a stranger's sin, forbidden knowledge
Lighter on · safety

modes.name: Brothers Apart
modes.info:
RUN · Hard
The Elric brothers part at Reole and take separate roads, and the party travel with one of them.
Expect · split stories, a brother missing, a reunion that may not come
Lighter on · the canon's order

modes.name: Chaos
modes.info:
CHAOS · Very hard
One failed transmutation tears the Gate open, and every player character is pulled through at once and comes back changed.
Expect · the Gate for everyone, a frightened country, a hunt for all of you
Lighter on · the canon's order

modes.name: Chimera Outlaws
modes.info:
ROLE · Hard
The party are chimeras and their friends, made by the state's experiments and living outside its law.
Expect · outlaw life, loyalty, a hunted body
Lighter on · respectability

modes.name: Dog of the Military
modes.info:
ROLE · Hard
The party serve the state as its alchemists and soldiers, sent wherever Central Command points.
Expect · orders, duty, moral pressure
Lighter on · freedom

modes.name: Envoys from Xing
modes.info:
ROLE · Medium
The party are envoys of a Xingese clan, sent across the desert to find the secret of immortality for their emperor.
Expect · a foreign land, clan rivalry, a deadline
Lighter on · settling down

modes.name: Multiplayer
modes.info:
TABLE · Medium
A party of alchemists, soldiers and travellers from different corners of the country, on one road.
Expect · shared scenes, a spotlight for everyone, mixed callings
Lighter on · solo arcs

modes.name: Rush Valley Workshop
modes.info:
ROLE · Medium
The party run or work in an automail workshop in the automail country, where every customer has a story.
Expect · craft, customers, trade rivalries
Lighter on · wars

modes.name: Scar's Reckoning
modes.info:
RUN · Hard
The scarred man's hunt for State Alchemists begins at the end of the war, years early, and the bounties begin with it.
Expect · a hunter in the dark, fear in the state, the war's debt
Lighter on · a peaceful middle

modes.name: Steel and Nerve
modes.info:
SPECIALIST · Medium
An automail engineer or a fighter with steel limbs, in a country where the best weapon is the one you wear.
Expect · craft, combat automail, the cost of steel
Lighter on · magic

modes.name: The Canon Road
modes.info:
RUN · Medium
The brothers' story as the series tells it, with the party living alongside it.
Expect · the canon's great events, the cast at their canon points
Lighter on · what-ifs

modes.name: The Colonel's Officers
modes.info:
ROLE · Medium
The party serve under an ambitious officer who means to reach the top and change the country from there.
Expect · loyalty, intrigue, ambition
Lighter on · open war

modes.name: The Dragon's Pulse
modes.info:
SPECIALIST · Medium
An alkahestrist from Xing, reading the life-flow of the land in a country that does not know it exists.
Expect · healing, sensing, a foreign art
Lighter on · brute force

modes.name: The Ishvalan Road
modes.info:
ROLE · Hard
The party are Ishvalans and their friends, scattered by the war and hunted under the state's order.
Expect · survival, faith, hidden kindness
Lighter on · safety

modes.name: The Other Elric
modes.info:
ELRIC RUN · Hard
The players are two siblings from Resembool in the Elric brothers' place, with the brothers' sin, their bodies and their road.
Expect · the Gate's toll, the Philosopher's Stone, the state's work
Lighter on · a quiet life

modes.name: The State Exam
modes.info:
SPECIALIST · Hard
Alchemists climbing toward the state's certificate, through the written test, the evaluation and the practical, and what comes after.
Expect · study, rivalry, the price of the silver watch
Lighter on · freedom

quests.name: A Bar Without a Mill Stamp
quests.info: Every honest bar carries its mill's stamp, and these carry none. They came in on the freight, and the stationmaster keeps a book of what came in. He is in no hurry to open it, and keeps glancing at the tin on his desk.
quests.goal: Learn who signed for it on the platform
steps: Find the iron in the freight book.
Learn who signed for it on the platform.

quests.name: A Bed Above the Café
quests.info: The last courier who carried the merchant's letters is in the garrison cells with a forged pass, and the café keeper who gave him a bed is being asked questions.
quests.goal: Get the courier out of the cells or his letter out of reach
steps: Learn what the garrison captain knows.
Get the courier out of the cells or his letter out of reach.

quests.name: A Bench Among the Mounds
quests.info: The buyer rents a hut at the edge of the charburners' clearing, and its chimney runs hotter and later than any charcoal mound has need of.
quests.goal: Get into his hut while he is out and look at the bench
steps: Get the charburners talking about their lodger.
Get into his hut while he is out and look at the bench.

quests.name: A Bench of One's Own
quests.info: A journeyman holds a bench in someone's shop. A shop owner will give the party a bench if a whole crate of returned joints is mended by sundown.
quests.goal: Claim the bench
steps: Mend the joints.
Claim the bench.
Tell Mira Kessel the job is done.

quests.name: A Call About a Girl
quests.info: A runner passes the news. Something heard last night must reach a friend of the house before noon, in a call that sounds like a date.
quests.goal: Keep it sounding like a date
steps: Make the call.
Keep it sounding like a date.
Tell Madame Christmas the job is done.

quests.name: A Call to East City
quests.info: The widow's letter to her husband's old employer went out with a drover and was stolen on the road. The postmistress offers to put a call through to the firm's office instead, if somebody sits beside the widow while it rings.
quests.goal: Hear what the firm's clerk remembers
steps: Get the call put through to East City.
Hear what the firm's clerk remembers.

quests.name: A Cap Too Large
quests.info: An eleven-year-old orphan walked into the barracks with his dead father's cap pulled down to his ears and hid himself among the new recruits waiting for tonight's troop train.
quests.goal: Get him out before the train is boarded
steps: Find the boy among the new recruits.
Get him out before the train is boarded.

quests.name: A Circle Drawn Right
quests.info: The smith has decided the boy is going to learn whether he is taught or not. He would rather it happened in daylight, on the schoolmistress's slate, with the rules before the chalk.
quests.goal: Stand by while the boy draws his first true circle
steps: Win Clara Wedekind's leave for an hour after lessons.
Stand by while the boy draws his first true circle.

quests.name: A Circle on the Scree
quests.info: An alchemist up from North City has offered to mend the wall with blocks raised straight out of the scree at its foot, faster than any quarry can cut them. The fort has said yes. The quarrymen have lost a summer's work, and their master thinks the new blocks are rotten.
quests.goal: Bring back a chip of the new stone
steps: Watch the alchemist draw his circle and raise a block.
Bring back a chip of the new stone.

quests.name: A Circle That Bit Back
quests.info: A student trying a simple transmutation in a corner of the arcade had his circle snap back and scorch his wrists. The jar of salts he used carries the old proprietor's label.
quests.goal: Carry the jar to the old proprietor
steps: Speak with the burned student.
Carry the jar to the old proprietor.

quests.name: A Cot Behind the Stove
quests.info: The country doctor on the back lane has a cot behind his stove and a book that has carried other names than true ones. He wants the boy's whole story before he lends either.
quests.goal: Tell the doctor why the boy ran
steps: Bring the boy to the back lane clinic.
Tell the doctor why the boy ran.
quests.line: The Boy Who Would Not Sign

quests.name: A Crate the Gate Turns Back
quests.info: Children in the refugee camp have the flux, and Karim Mirza has packed a crate of salts, carbolic and clean cloth for them. The checkpoint turned his boy back twice for having the wrong pass. A party with business on the road may fare better.
quests.goal: Deliver it to the tent rows of the camp
steps: Carry the crate through the Ishval Border Gate.
Deliver it to the tent rows of the camp.
quests.line: A Crate the Gate Turns Back
quests.next: Every Sick Tent Drinks From One Barrel

quests.name: A Day and a Half
quests.info: The depot's pump engine broke this morning. The tanks hold a day and a half, the fort's patrol is due tomorrow, and the sergeant would sooner eat sand than wire for help.
quests.goal: Get the pump running before the tanks run dry
steps: Find what broke in the engine.
Get the pump running before the tanks run dry.

quests.name: A Dray on the Iron Bridge
quests.info: Each week the barrels cross the river under a load of barley sacks on a brewery dray, and the sentries on the road deck never ask to look under the sacks.
quests.goal: Learn who pays the sentries
steps: Stop the dray on the bridge.
Learn who pays the sentries.

quests.name: A Drover Who Stopped Stopping
quests.info: The drover who told her he had seen her husband alive in East City has not stopped in town since. She wants him asked again, by someone he has no reason to walk round.
quests.goal: Hear what he saw at the station in East City
steps: Find Thaddeus Brock on the green road.
Hear what he saw at the station in East City.

quests.name: A Fifth Too Heavy
quests.info: For eleven years the weighman has written every wagon into two books, and for eleven years the black one has come out heavier than the red. He wants someone off the spur's payroll to lay the pair open on his counter and read them against each other.
quests.goal: Pick out the nights the gap is widest
steps: Compare the two books page by page.
Pick out the nights the gap is widest.

quests.name: A File Mark in the Frost
quests.info: Somebody has been filing at the rivets on the ravine end of the trestle by night, and the sentry posted on the deck has seen nothing but footprints in the snow.
quests.goal: Track the footprints under the girders
steps: Climb down to the ravine end and read the marks.
Track the footprints under the girders.
quests.line: A File Mark in the Frost

quests.name: A Fleece Under the Skylight
quests.info: Twenty farmers are at the office door with sample fleeces, and the clerk sits inside with the typed list in one hand and his stripes in the other. What Thea Achterberg wants is small and impossible: one fleece, any fleece, graded honestly in front of them all.
