quests.goal: Talk the corporal into grading the samples on their merits, in public
steps: Keep the crowd at the door from breaking it down.
Talk the corporal into grading the samples on their merits, in public.

quests.name: A Forged Certificate
quests.info: A metal-mender came to the registrar's counter to renew a licence to practise that the registry never issued; the paper is good, the stamp is right, and the signature is wrong.
quests.goal: Learn where the metal-mender bought it
steps: Study the forged licence.
Learn where the metal-mender bought it.

quests.name: A Friend of the Brothers
quests.info: A friend is trusted with the brothers' story. The party must keep it from a curious reporter.
quests.goal: Keep the brothers' story
steps: Turn the reporter aside.
Keep the brothers' story.
Tell Edward Elric the job is done.

quests.name: A Glass Left Full
quests.info: An officer left the bar last night with his glass full and his briefcase behind, and the madame would like to know why he was so frightened.
quests.goal: Learn what scared him off
steps: Find the officer.
Learn what scared him off.

quests.name: A Hundred Words
quests.info: The sergeant of the blockhouse is the one man on the far side the trader trusts, but he is being watched and will only speak at the loophole after dark, in the hundred words the two sides share.
quests.goal: Get the sergeant to name the buyer on his side
steps: Reach the blockhouse wall unseen with tobacco in hand.
Get the sergeant to name the buyer on his side.

quests.name: A Knife That Knew the Place
quests.info: Three pages are gone from the chained book on the counter, cut so close to the stitching that nobody noticed for weeks. Only a handful of people have stood at that end of the counter long enough to do it.
quests.goal: Find which of them had the time alone
steps: Go through the gunsmith's callers this season.
Find which of them had the time alone.
quests.line: A Knife That Knew the Place

quests.name: A Lantern on the Sand
quests.info: The boats have found another way: a lantern hung on a pole at the bathing beach on moonless nights, set to lead them in past the respectable piers. A fishing boat that steers by it in a squall will end on the rocks.
quests.goal: Put it out before a boat steers by it
steps: Find the false light.
Put it out before a boat steers by it.

quests.name: A Load Sent Openly
quests.info: Nasreen has decided the wall should be finished properly, with fired brick from her own kiln, and sent by daylight so nobody can call it stolen. The patrols on the Ishval road stop every cart, and her driver has heard what they do to carts bound for the ruins.
quests.goal: Bring the cart to Gunja past the patrols
steps: Load a fired course of bricks onto the cart.
Bring the cart to Gunja past the patrols.

quests.name: A Load Too Cheap
quests.info: The fellmonger has offered her a whole cart of mutton for the festival pies, cheaper than any butcher in the district would sell bones. She has baked for thirty years and has never once been offered a bargain that turned out to be a kindness.
quests.goal: Find a farm that will own to selling it
steps: Look the meat over before she pays for it.
Find a farm that will own to selling it.

quests.name: A Mark Filed Off
quests.info: The mark on the port leads to a stall in the crooked alley that sells joints with the makers' names scratched out. The man who sold the arm still works there, and he does not remember the farmer.
quests.goal: Make the seller answer for it
steps: Find the stall.
Make the seller answer for it.

quests.name: A Month Alone
quests.info: She rows the party to the island, takes away their chalk, and leaves them a riddle: all is one, and one is all. They are not to use alchemy for a month.
quests.goal: Answer the riddle
steps: Live a month on the island without alchemy.
Answer the riddle.

quests.name: A Nail in the Road
quests.info: The grey mare that draws the milk cart came home lame with a horseshoe nail in her hoof. She is the third horse on the north road this week, and all three stopped at the same trough.
quests.goal: Learn who is scattering the nails
steps: Search the road and the inn's stable yard.
Learn who is scattering the nails.

quests.name: A Note in a Cartridge
quests.info: The note, in bad Amestrian, asks for one quiet hour at the ruined farmhouse so that both sides can carry their dead out of the crater field before the summer heat.
quests.goal: Agree the hour with the Cretan who wrote it
steps: Carry the lieutenant's answer to the ruined farmhouse.
Agree the hour with the Cretan who wrote it.

quests.name: A Note in the Drawer
quests.info: A parent's complaint about the schoolmistress's evening lessons sits in a drawer at the police post. After the accident at the kilns, somebody is bound to open it.
quests.goal: Speak for the schoolmistress at the post
steps: Find out what the complaint says.
Speak for the schoolmistress at the post.

quests.name: A Note That Smudged
quests.info: The brewery's draymen took their wages in notes that ran when the rain caught them, and the sergeant wants to know who passed those notes before word gets round the barracks.
quests.goal: Bring a sample note to the sergeant
steps: Find out who paid the draymen.
Bring a sample note to the sergeant.

quests.name: A Pebble in the Yard
quests.info: Out by the bell post four children crouch over a ring drawn with a stick, a grey stone sitting at its heart, holding their breath. Nothing has happened yet. Something might.
quests.goal: Show the children what it would really take
steps: Look the circle over.
Show the children what it would really take.

quests.name: A Petition for the Grant
quests.info: The home is sold out of silver and nearly out of coal. The council can restore the grant if the officers' wives speak for it, and after the station they may.
quests.goal: Carry the petition into the council chamber
steps: Win over the officers' wives on the committee.
Carry the petition into the council chamber.

quests.name: A Pier That Groans
quests.info: Twice he has written to the railway's district office about the crack along the patched pier, and twice his letter has come back with the seal unbroken. He wants another pair of ears at the footings when the evening goods comes over, so that it is not only his word.
quests.goal: Mark the crack in chalk and measure it with knotted string
steps: Wait at the footings while the evening goods crosses.
Mark the crack in chalk and measure it with knotted string.

quests.name: A Pistol on the Grille
quests.info: One of the pistols on the missing pages has been pledged across the grille at the pawnbroker's, by a young man who gave a name the broker did not believe.
quests.goal: Learn who pledged it
steps: See the pledged pistol.
Learn who pledged it.
quests.line: A Knife That Knew the Place

quests.name: A Polite Captor
quests.info: Kuai Lianhu has the courier sitting comfortably on the lookout rock with tea and a blanket. He took the man because couriers read the post, and this one read something about the chief's paymaster. He will trade him for a straight answer to a question.
quests.goal: Bring the courier down off the rock alive
steps: Hear what the bandit chief wants to know.
Bring the courier down off the rock alive.

quests.name: A Present for the Schoolmistress
quests.info: Mina Lutt brought her teacher a finger bone tied up in a hair ribbon, and she is very proud of it.
quests.goal: Have the surgeon at the dispensary look at the bone
steps: Ask the child, gently, where she found it.
Have the surgeon at the dispensary look at the bone.

quests.name: A Price Too High
quests.info: The lawyer wants a single volume of the old trade books and offers more than the whole loft is worth, which Ambros Lenz finds insulting.
quests.goal: Keep the volume in the loft meanwhile
steps: Learn who the lawyer is working for.
Keep the volume in the loft meanwhile.

quests.name: A Report Sent Twice
quests.info: The lieutenant's report must reach someone who outranks the quartermaster, and the telegraph clerk listens to everything that passes his counter.
quests.goal: Carry the other copy safely to the train
steps: Get a copy past the telegraph counter.
Carry the other copy safely to the train.

quests.name: A Report That Leaves Town
quests.info: The sergeant has written his report on the kegs, signed it and sealed it. This one he means to watch go out over the wire to East City himself, not leave in a drawer.
quests.goal: See the report wired to Eastern Command
steps: Stand with the sergeant at the telegraph desk.
See the report wired to Eastern Command.

quests.name: A Right Lost at Cards
quests.info: Men from the caravanserai have come to the cistern with a paper that says a drover's family water right now belongs to Marlene Dross. Aysel will not open the tally wall to them, and they are not leaving.
quests.goal: Get the paper off the collectors
steps: Hold the cistern steps without a fight.
Get the paper off the collectors.

quests.name: A Scroll for the East
quests.info: Tao Ruyi has drawn the earth's flow under the desert on a long scroll, and she wants it carried to the well tower, where the garrison's couriers can take it to her teachers in Xing. A patrol of another clan has been asking what she is drawing.
quests.goal: See it into a courier's hands
steps: Carry the scroll to the well tower.
See it into a courier's hands.

quests.name: A Seat at the Table
quests.info: A colonel speaks in the commanders' room. Grumman puts the party in charge of a dispute between two regiments over the same billets, and both colonels outrank good sense.
quests.goal: Settle it so neither loses face
steps: Hear both regiments out.
Settle it so neither loses face.
Tell Grumman the job is done.

quests.name: A Shop That Sells Pest-Killer
quests.info: The grey dust is a pest-killer the apothecaries grind for granary rats, and Zou Bingwen admits, after a long look at his drawers, that he is the only one on the street who still makes it. He remembers the buyer: a large order, paid without haggling, which no rat-catcher has ever done.
quests.goal: Learn where the order was carried
steps: Get the buyer's description out of Zou.
Learn where the order was carried.

quests.name: A Son in Uniform
quests.info: The chief's son ran off this spring to enlist. Bahadur has not said his name since, but he has asked, without asking, whether the party is riding past the fort.
quests.goal: Carry a word between father and son
steps: Find the herder's son among the recruits.
Carry a word between father and son.

quests.name: A Spade and a Lawyer's Letter
quests.info: The schoolmaster's widow will not leave her husband's grave until it is opened, and the cemetery office has sent for a military policeman to move her.
quests.goal: Learn what the grave holds
steps: Stand with the widow when the policeman comes.
Learn what the grave holds.

quests.name: A Stall in the Square
quests.info: His mother sells eggs from a stall in the market's outer square, and the military police have already been to ask her about him twice. She does not know he is alive.
quests.goal: Tell her where her son is
steps: Find the mother's stall without leading the police to it.
Tell her where her son is.

quests.name: A Stop Not on the Timetable
quests.info: The engines pause at the little halt in the larches longer than the water tank needs, and the stove hut there has a padlock bigger than the hut.
quests.goal: See what is handed down from the footplate
steps: Wait at the halt for the next of the three engines.
See what is handed down from the footplate.

quests.name: A Tunnel Too Neat
quests.info: Somebody has dug a tidy tunnel into the second mound and left a palace-workshop lamp inside it. Ge Lianshou knows exactly what is in the elixir cabinets the emperors were buried with, and he knows, from his own shaking hands, what the soil does to a digger.
quests.goal: Take the diggers before they reach the cabinets
steps: Watch the tunnel through a night.
Take the diggers before they reach the cabinets.
quests.next: A Word With the Chief Physician

quests.name: A Wagon Consigned South
quests.info: The bullocks were loaded into a cattle wagon at the rail yard and consigned to a butcher in a southern town, under the same barracks stamp.
quests.goal: Learn whose stamp it carries
steps: Find the wagon's consignment note.
Learn whose stamp it carries.

quests.name: A Widow at the Counter
quests.info: A widow has come to the registry for her husband's certificate so she can draw his pension, and there is no entry for him at all, though she buried him herself.
quests.goal: Search the registry for any trace of her husband
steps: Hear the widow's account of the burial.
Search the registry for any trace of her husband.

quests.name: A Word to the Board
quests.info: Every State Alchemist in the capital buys chalk from this shop. The old proprietor wants the examining board told plainly, before a rumour undoes three generations of trust.
quests.goal: Clear the shop's good name
steps: Bring the forged jars before a clerk of the board.
Clear the shop's good name.

quests.name: A Word With the Chief Physician
quests.info: Xun Baizhi has heard the whole story from her student, and she has decided that a tonic made of dead emperors' quicksilver is a matter for the court's own physicians. She will speak to Yan Shoude, but she wants the party to carry the evidence past the guard who empties every basket.
quests.goal: Get the chief physician to test it
steps: Carry the red dust and the tonic to the pavilion.
Get the chief physician to test it.

quests.name: A Wrist That Snapped
quests.info: A veteran came into the automail fitters with his forearm hanging off its socket, bought cheap from a man in a bar. The surgeon says the steel is wrong all through, and wants an alchemist's supplier to tell her why.
quests.goal: Learn where the veteran bought it
steps: Look at the broken limb.
Learn where the veteran bought it.

quests.name: Alone at the Counter
quests.info: A clerk keeps the store open. The owners are away for the day, and the party runs the store alone through market day.
quests.goal: Balance the till
steps: Serve the market-day crowd.
Balance the till.
Tell Jean Havoc the job is done.

quests.name: An Ally on the Road
quests.info: An ally keeps faith. The brothers' old house holds what is left of their research, and someone has been in it.
quests.goal: Keep what is left safe
steps: Find who has been in the house.
Keep what is left safe.
Tell Edward Elric the job is done.

quests.name: An Arm Paid in Cheese
quests.info: The boy still needs an arm, and a proper fitting is beyond the farm. Garfiel's workshop is known to do odd things for customers it likes, but the farmer is too proud to ask.
quests.goal: Settle a way the farm can pay
steps: Plead the boy's case at the workshop.
Settle a way the farm can pay.

quests.name: An Empty Den
quests.info: Three winters back the old hunter fired too fast and put a ball in a grizzly's shoulder instead of its heart. The bear has carried it ever since, and this year the ache has driven it out of its den a month before any sane bear wakes.
quests.goal: Track it down through the clawed pines
steps: Climb to the den mouth and read what the bear left behind.
Track it down through the clawed pines.

quests.name: An Empty Music Stand
quests.info: The only full score of the season's new opera has vanished from the conductor's room overnight, and the copyists have written out barely half the parts.
quests.goal: Question the night doorman
steps: Search the wings and the conductor's room.
Question the night doorman.

quests.name: An Honest Trade in Stone
quests.info: The alchemist is not a cheat, only a man who made stone from gravel and never thought about what the cold does to it. The quarry master would rather have him working than ruined.
quests.goal: Strike a bargain between his circles and the quarry's saws
steps: Bring the alchemist out to the quarry face.
Strike a bargain between his circles and the quarry's saws.

quests.name: An Hour at the Pump
quests.info: Until the ditch well runs clear the camp needs clean water, and the only clean water in reach comes up through Jorin Kessel's engine. He will give the camp's cart one hour each dawn, but his boiler is already eating chairs, and an extra hour wants fuel he does not have.
quests.goal: See the first clean barrel to the camp
steps: Bring the pump house fuel for the extra hour.
See the first clean barrel to the camp.
quests.line: A Crate the Gate Turns Back

quests.name: An Offer of Work
quests.info: A well-dressed man has offered to take the two eldest boys north for work and a wage, and he has come back twice for an answer. The matron wants his offer looked at by someone who has not been begging for money all week.
quests.goal: Ask him for his employer's letter
steps: Meet the man when he calls again.
Ask him for his employer's letter.

quests.name: Arms for the Old Men
quests.info: Thirty bad limbs were sold to veterans before anyone noticed, and every man wearing one is walking about on a fracture waiting to happen.
quests.goal: Get them to the fitters before the steel gives
steps: Find the men wearing the cheap limbs.
Get them to the fitters before the steel gives.

quests.name: Attached to the Unit
quests.info: A second lieutenant earns the unit's trust. The colonel hands the party a missing-persons file nobody else wants.
quests.goal: Bring the answer to the colonel
steps: Follow the file to its end.
Bring the answer to the colonel.
Tell Roy Mustang the job is done.

quests.name: Backs of Old Waybills
quests.info: The goods clerk has been copying waybills onto the backs of her letters for weeks. Her copies show three wagons a week reaching the rail yard short, and always the same three engines drawing them in.
quests.goal: Learn which crews drive the three engines
steps: Match the clerk's copies to the yard's own books.
Learn which crews drive the three engines.
quests.next: A Stop Not on the Timetable

quests.name: Bad Air Below
quests.info: A shift captain brings every man home. Bad air is rising in the lower gallery with a shift still below.
quests.goal: Bring every man up
steps: Reach the shift.
Bring every man up.
Tell Mr. Halling the job is done.

quests.name: Barrels Held Below the Terraces
quests.info: A cart of Rosa Kellner's barrels has been stopped at the checkpoint below the terraces, and one of the bungs carries a letter that is not hers.
quests.goal: Carry the hidden letter to the man it is meant for
steps: Get the cart released before the bungs are drawn.
Carry the hidden letter to the man it is meant for.

quests.name: Barrels in the Lime
quests.info: On the quay that night the liar was rolling barrels out of the tannery, and the tanner swears they never held a single hide.
quests.goal: Learn what is packed in the barrels
steps: Get into the lime pits after dark.
Learn what is packed in the barrels.
quests.next: A Dray on the Iron Bridge

quests.name: Before the Council
quests.info: Rumour says rifles will stand between the frames by the end of the week. The council sits tomorrow, and the mayor will not refuse a uniform unless someone hands him a reason in public.
quests.goal: Lay the cut bolt before the mayor
steps: Get the girls' case heard in the council chamber.
Lay the cut bolt before the mayor.

quests.name: Before the Ferry Crosses
quests.info: The gold-maker knows he has been found out. He means to cross at Kessel Ford tonight on the rope ferry that carries anyone without a lantern and without a name.
quests.goal: Settle what becomes of him and his crucibles
steps: Reach the ford before the ferry casts off.
Stop the gold-maker crossing.
Settle what becomes of him and his crucibles.

quests.name: Before the Night Freight
quests.info: The freight from the capital is due across the trestle tonight, the ravine end is worse than anyone has admitted, and the halt will not hold a train on an inspector's word alone.
quests.goal: Help the inspector make the ravine end sound
steps: Get word to the halt and have the freight held.
Help the inspector make the ravine end sound.
quests.line: A File Mark in the Frost

quests.name: Behind the Cookhouse
quests.info: The sergeant major feeds his men from his own garden and is ashamed to hear they have been eating stolen meat. He will not believe it of any man without proof, and will not protect any man once he has it.
quests.goal: Name the men who took the goats
steps: Find the hides behind the cookhouse.
Name the men who took the goats.

quests.name: Behind the Organ Pipes
quests.info: A clerk from South Command Headquarters has come for the sexton's book, and the second copy is hidden in the organ, where the organist keeps finding it.
quests.goal: Decide where the book of the dead belongs
steps: Keep the clerk from the hidden copy.
Decide where the book of the dead belongs.

quests.name: Bids Nobody Collects
quests.info: The auctioneer has sold sheep in this ring for thirty years and has never before watched a dealer run a farm's lots up to silly money and then leave them standing in the pens. He will talk about it, between lots, to anyone who is not a farmer and not the dealer.
quests.goal: Find out whose credit bought the cousin's motor car
steps: Hear the auctioneer out in his box while the ring is busy.
Watch Eckhart Varnhagen's money go from the ring to the cousin's pocket.
Find out whose credit bought the cousin's motor car.

quests.name: Boards in the Dark
quests.info: Somebody has to watch the weir after the mill's lamps go out. The man the town sent found the boards untouched, with a fine coat of dust on them, and went home satisfied.
quests.goal: Catch the boards being lowered
steps: Watch the weir through a night.
Catch the boards being lowered.

quests.name: Bolts Without a Stamp
quests.info: The stripped cloth turns up on a draper's stall in the market hall, cheap and good and with its selvedge freshly trimmed. A bolt of it with the trimming showing would be worth more to the girls than any speech.
quests.goal: Get one bolt that shows where the stamp was cut
steps: Find the draper selling the trimmed cloth.
Get one bolt that shows where the stamp was cut.

quests.name: Boot Prints in the Flour
quests.info: An old passage runs from the baker's flour cellar under the street to the mill quarter, dug when flour was taxed at the gate. Someone other than the baker has been walking it at night.
quests.goal: Wait in the dark for whoever comes through
steps: Search the passage under Oven Street.
Wait in the dark for whoever comes through.

quests.name: Boring Beside the Palms
quests.info: The borer says the old bore is finished, and the best place for a new one is beside the palms, where a trader already claims every drop. Kalm wants the drill set before the trader can raise a crowd against it.
quests.goal: Keep the trader's crowd off it
steps: Set the drill beside the palms.
Keep the trader's crowd off it.

quests.name: Borrowed Blue at the Club
quests.info: Grown bold, the false lieutenant now dines as a guest at the officers' club. The master tailor wants him taken there quietly, before a real officer notices that the coat was cut for a broader man.
quests.goal: Take the false lieutenant without a scene
steps: Get into the officers' club.
Take the false lieutenant without a scene.

quests.name: Brass on the Hooks
quests.info: Every miner took a brass tally from the lamp room going down and hung it back coming up. The old lamp man never took down the tallies of the last shift, and those hooks are the only list of who was below that day.
quests.goal: Check them against the shift in the torn pages
steps: Copy the names from the brass tallies.
Check them against the shift in the torn pages.

quests.name: Candle in the Back Office
quests.info: The clerk tore the last month's pages out of the company book himself. They show that the company knew the props in the lower gallery were rotten and sent the shift down anyway. A man from the head office in Central is on his way for the books.
quests.goal: Hide them where the company's man will never look
steps: Read the torn pages by the clerk's candle.
Hide them where the company's man will never look.

quests.name: Captain of the Guard
quests.info: A captain brings the clan's people home. A caravan of the clan is late from the western pass.
quests.goal: Bring it home
steps: Find the caravan.
Bring it home.
Tell Yao Clan Steward the job is done.

quests.name: Carts in the Drift
quests.info: The smuggler who runs his carts through the old drift swears he hauls cheese, letters and coal and never powder, and wants the party to look over his load before the guardhouse does.
quests.goal: Learn who paid for the last load
steps: Search the carts in the inner gallery.
Learn who paid for the last load.

quests.name: Cattle Cars South
quests.info: Somewhere in the yard office there is a waybill for every cattle car that leaves Dublith, and the cars that carry the burned beasts are billed to a quartermaster's depot in South City.
quests.goal: Learn whose signature is on them
steps: Find the waybills.
Learn whose signature is on them.

quests.name: Cavalry Horses at the Plough
quests.info: The widow of the cypress lane has bought a team of fine, depot-branded horses from a dealer in Sanvento, and she is not pleased to learn what she paid for.
quests.goal: Learn the dealer's name from her bill of sale
steps: Show her the depot brand under the dealer's mark.
Learn the dealer's name from her bill of sale.

quests.name: Chalk on the Mains
quests.info: Someone has been sealing cracked mains at the gasworks with transmutation circles, quick work and no solder, and one of the seals on the retort house has started to hiss.
quests.goal: Make the retort house safe
steps: Find the failing seal before the night shift lights the retorts.
Make the retort house safe.

quests.name: Chalk on the Rampart
quests.info: The first of the alchemist's blocks went into the north rampart a month ago. The watch sergeant has noticed nothing, because he looks outward. He agrees to look down.
quests.goal: Get the sergeant to put the cracks into his report
steps: Walk the rampart and chalk every crack in the new blocks.
Get the sergeant to put the cracks into his report.

quests.name: Chalk on the Wagon Sides
quests.info: The biggest loader at the Mine Road Depot has taken to chalking a small cross on each wagon he fills after dark. One of his crosses rolled back from the junction empty, a whole day before any train had been due to bring it.
quests.goal: Watch the next night load go out
steps: Find the marked wagon in the depot sidings.
Learn from the loader who pays for the night loading.
Watch the next night load go out.

quests.name: Chalk on the Wash Banks
quests.info: Mahmud Kassar knows the wash better than anyone alive, and someone has been chalking marks on its banks that lead people the long way, away from the round-stone bed. He thinks the marks and the thieves are one problem.
quests.goal: Follow the boot prints out of the wash
steps: Read the false marks against the true road.
Follow the boot prints out of the wash.

quests.name: Charges at the Outcrop
quests.info: The survey lieutenant has found holes bored into the overhang above his camp, packed and fused. The page of his map that shows the seam's eastern edge went missing two nights ago.
quests.goal: Find the hired man who bored the holes
steps: Draw the charges before anyone can light them.
Find the hired man who bored the holes.

quests.name: Coats for the Children
quests.info: The slum's children have no coats, and the first snow is coming.
quests.goal: Get the coats sewn and given
steps: Find cloth and fur.
Get the coats sewn and given.

quests.name: Coffee at the Striped Barrier
quests.info: The merchant and the mayor are to meet at the barrier, and the customs officer is paid by both governments to report what he hears.
quests.goal: See the two men face to face
steps: Keep the meeting at the barrier private.
See the two men face to face.

quests.name: Coin That Rings Wrong
quests.info: Theodor Hask has taken in gold coin from farmers who swear they were paid it for hides and firewood, and some of it gives the wrong note when he drops it on the counter.
quests.goal: Learn who has been paying the farmers in gold
steps: Trace the false coin back through the farmers who paid it in.
Learn who has been paying the farmers in gold.

quests.name: Cold Ovens
quests.info: Flour is no use without fire. The coal train is late, the coal yard holds the only heaps in the city, and the bakers swear its weighbridge has been giving them short sacks all winter.
quests.goal: See the bakers' coal weighed honestly
steps: Find out how the weighbridge gives short weight.
See the bakers' coal weighed honestly.

quests.name: Corporal's Chevrons
quests.info: A good corporal keeps a section together. The party is handed a section that has failed every inspection this month and has a week to turn it round.
quests.goal: Pass the next inspection with it
steps: Learn why the section keeps failing.
Pass the next inspection with it.
Tell Grumman the job is done.

quests.name: Counting the Floor
quests.info: The boards say every storehouse is full. Chu Wenbo has walked the rows at night with a lamp and does not believe them. The palace inspector comes in three days, and the senior clerks have started saying the junior's hand is on the boards.
quests.goal: Find the oldest board with a false count
steps: Count the sacks on the storehouse floors.
Find the oldest board with a false count.

quests.name: Dawn on the Crown
quests.info: Two clans' stewards meet on the truce bridge at dawn, each with the same number of men, and each has asked Pan Jiuling for a witness from outside the fifty clans. He has heard where a crate of flash bombs was carried: to the bank under his own bridge.
quests.goal: Stop the flash and the knives before the truce breaks
steps: Stand witness on the bridge at dawn.
Stop the flash and the knives before the truce breaks.
quests.next: Where the Grey Man Drinks Tea

quests.name: Dead Goats at the Wall
quests.info: Two nannies lie dead against the boundary wall with green at their mouths, and the herb that killed them does not grow on this side of the hills.
quests.goal: Find who threw it over the wall
steps: Find what the goats ate.
Find who threw it over the wall.

quests.name: Delivery Hand
quests.info: A delivery hand is never late. The shop's biggest customer wants a wedding feast's meat by noon.
quests.goal: Deliver it by noon
steps: Prepare the order.
Deliver it by noon.
Tell Sig Curtis the job is done.

quests.name: Down in the Dark
quests.info: Night has fallen before the sled starts back, and the kennelman has come out on skis to meet it. The way down is steep, the dogs are tired, and the man on the sled is getting worse.
quests.goal: Carry the sick man into the infirmary ward
steps: Bring the sled down the crag path by lamplight.
Carry the sick man into the infirmary ward.

quests.name: Drovers by Night
quests.info: The burned cattle do not come in by train. They are walked down from the mountains after dark, past the toll house whose keeper writes down everything with wheels and nothing with hooves.
quests.goal: Meet the next herd on the road
steps: Talk the toll keeper into remembering.
Meet the next herd on the road.

quests.name: Duds Over the Wire
quests.info: The battery on the ridge has fired a week of shells that thumped into the mud and lay there, and its captain wants one brought back to show what is inside it.
quests.goal: Open it with the captain watching
steps: Go out to the Wire Fields after one of the duds.
Open it with the captain watching.
quests.line: The Clerk at the Works Gate
quests.next: The Signature on the Batch Sheet

quests.name: Eleven Certificates
quests.info: The registrar has the names now, but a death certificate for a soldier needs a signature from the command. She means to stand at the headquarters gate until she has it.
quests.goal: See the eleven certificates signed
steps: Get the registrar in front of an officer who can sign.
See the eleven certificates signed.

quests.name: Eleven Unbooked
quests.info: The old signalman keeps a pencil tally of every wagon that rolls past his box. On the last dark night he counted eleven that belong to no timetable, and the railway has twice told him he cannot count.
quests.goal: Follow the lampless train beyond the points
steps: Read the signalman's tally against the railway's sheets.
Follow the lampless train beyond the points.

quests.name: Every Sick Tent Drinks From One Barrel
quests.info: Nadira Asfour has noticed what the druggist could not from Reole: the tents that are sick buy their water from one carter, and the weavers, who fetch their own, are well. She has sent for the carter twice. He does not come.
quests.goal: Find what fouls that water
steps: Follow the carter to where he fills his barrels.
Find what fouls that water.
quests.line: A Crate the Gate Turns Back

quests.name: Ewes Over the Wall
quests.info: A night of sleet drove forty ewes over the ridge wall and down the windward slope into Cretan country, and both armies watch that slope through glasses.
quests.goal: Count the ewes still living
steps: Find a way down the windward slope unseen.
Count the ewes still living.

quests.name: Eyes in Central
quests.info: A captain watches the watchers. The unit needs to know who in the capital is reading its letters.
quests.goal: Feed them something false
steps: Find who reads the unit's letters.
Feed them something false.
Tell Roy Mustang the job is done.

quests.name: Fever in the Cheese Room
quests.info: The farmer's son lies on the cheese-room floor, burning with fever, his cheap steel arm hot where it meets the shoulder. The farm's only cart has a cracked axle, and the clinic that can help is up the valley road.
quests.goal: Bring the boy to the nerve clinic
steps: Get a cart that will take the climb.
Bring the boy to the nerve clinic.

quests.name: Fever on the Crag
quests.info: The corporal of the post has kept the telescope manned alone for two days with his mate shivering in the bunk. He will not leave the glass, and his mate will not go down without him.
quests.goal: Get the sick spotter strapped on and the corporal to stay at his glass
steps: Haul the sled up the last pitch to the spotting post.
Get the sick spotter strapped on and the corporal to stay at his glass.

quests.name: Fever Ward Admissions
quests.info: The eleven men died in the hospital, so the hospital must have written them in. The orderlies say that book went to the stores, and the stores say it never came.
quests.goal: Learn why the eleven were never reported
steps: Find the missing admissions book.
Learn why the eleven were never reported.

quests.name: Five Points
quests.info: Alkahestry needs five points around the work. May sets the party to throw five kunai into a ring in the sand, true and even.
quests.goal: Draw water up from the dry basin through them
steps: Throw the five points true.
Draw water up from the dry basin through them.

quests.name: Flashes From the Crag
quests.info: Word of the truce has reached West City, and an inspecting officer is riding up to learn who agreed to it. The lookout on the crag will flash the moment he passes the cemetery.
quests.goal: Get the company's account written and signed before he arrives
steps: Read the heliograph's warning.
Get the company's account written and signed before he arrives.

quests.name: Folded Into the Laundry
quests.info: The Chang consort sends her notes home folded into the washing, and the washerwoman who carried them has been replaced by a stranger who smiles too much. Ning Cuifen has today's note in her basket and nobody to give it to.
quests.goal: Learn who placed the new washerwoman
steps: Carry the consort's note out past the wardens.
Learn who placed the new washerwoman.

quests.name: Forged Labels
quests.info: Jars bearing his label are on sale at a stall on Market Row, the copperplate hand imitated well enough to fool anyone except the man who wrote the real ones.
quests.goal: Learn where the stallholder gets them
steps: Find the stall selling the jars.
Learn where the stallholder gets them.

quests.name: Forty Beds and One Empty
quests.info: One of the older boys slipped out before breakfast with the benefactor's visiting card, and the younger ones know more than they are telling.
quests.goal: Win the other children's trust
steps: Search the dormitory for what he left behind.
Win the other children's trust.

quests.name: Forty Less Three
quests.info: Ayub counts his goats twice at every waterhole, and three have gone in a fortnight, the last a kid whose bell he found with its strap cut clean. He wants the thieves found before he loses the will to count.
quests.goal: Find where the thieves came in
steps: Count the flock with Ayub at the marked waterhole.
Find where the thieves came in.

quests.name: Forty Short
quests.info: The spring count on the grassland is forty horses short, and some of the missing colts are carrying red-banner riders. Toghan Sechen sits in his felt tent and does not deny the sales. He asks the party to count the herd with the guard's officer before the officer counts it alone.
quests.goal: Show where the officer's own six went
steps: Count the herds with the guard's officer.
Show where the officer's own six went.

quests.name: Fourteen Hours a Frame
quests.info: The shifts have grown by an hour twice this year and the wage has not moved. Before anyone walks out, the girls want the overseer to hear it from someone who is not one of them, because he dismisses the ones who complain.
quests.goal: Put the girls' complaint to the overseer
steps: Walk the spinning floor at the end of a shift.
Put the girls' complaint to the overseer.

quests.name: Freeze and Thaw
quests.info: The captain of the research shop tests steel plate against cold and shot; he can test stone the same way. Given a night, a cold box and a stove, he will make a chip live through a month of winter.
quests.goal: Stay up through the night of freezing and thawing
steps: Bring the chip to the drawing office.
Stay up through the night of freezing and thawing.

quests.name: Frontier Scout
quests.info: A scout learns the enemy's ground. The commander wants the paths around the great fort mapped.
quests.goal: Bring the map back unseen
steps: Map the paths around the fort.
Bring the map back unseen.
Tell Vagner the job is done.

quests.name: Gaps in the Racks
quests.info: Every morning there are holes in the drying racks, a dozen bricks at a time, always from the end nearest the east road. Nasreen does not want soldiers. She wants to see the face of the man before she decides what he owes.
quests.goal: Follow the brick carrier out of town
steps: Watch the racks through the night.
Follow the brick carrier out of town.

quests.name: Gone From the Balance Bench
quests.info: Somebody took the first unmarked knife off Lei Datong's bench in the night. Nothing else in the forge was touched, and the shutters were barred from inside. The smith suspects one of his own boys, and he hates himself for it.
quests.goal: Get the unmarked knife back
steps: Question the forge boys.
Get the unmarked knife back.
quests.next: The Girl in the Pepper Shed

quests.name: Green Hands at Market Row
quests.info: Freshly stripped copper leaves a green stain, and a pot-mender on Market Row has noticed that the boys who sell him scrap come in with their palms gone green.
quests.goal: Learn who pays them for the wire
steps: Find the boys with the green hands.
Learn who pays them for the wire.

quests.name: Grit in the Sable
quests.info: For as long as anyone remembers, the trappers of both sides have swapped coffee and tobacco for furs at the barrier, and the fort has looked the other way. Now a bale has come over with blasting powder worked into the fur, which means something is going the other way that would shut the border for everybody.
quests.goal: Learn which trapper carried it over
steps: Go through the bale with the trader.
Learn which trapper carried it over.

quests.name: Guard of the Graves
quests.info: A warrior keeps the dead in peace. Someone has been digging in the graves at night.
quests.goal: Stop the digging
steps: Watch the graves.
Stop the digging.
Tell Elder Halim the job is done.

quests.name: Guest of the House
quests.info: Kin of the house are trusted with its doors. The family's garden party is the season's event, and the party must see it through without a scandal.
quests.goal: End the night without a scandal
steps: Keep the guests in hand.
End the night without a scandal.
Tell Philip Gargantos Armstrong the job is done.

quests.name: Hands for the Hay
quests.info: The hay is ready and the sky is turning, but the men the farm hires every summer have gone to the locomotive works for a better wage.
quests.goal: Get the hay in ahead of the rain
steps: Find hands willing to cut hay.
Get the hay in ahead of the rain.

quests.name: Heavy Trains
quests.info: The signalman at the junction keeps every train in his register to the minute and knows which run heaviest. He will hold a driver to walking pace over the river if he has a reason he can write in the margin, and none of his own.
quests.goal: Give the signalman a reason he will write down
steps: Go through the register for the heaviest trains on the branch.
Give the signalman a reason he will write down.

quests.name: Her Mother's Roof
quests.info: Liesl Grau wants every coin back in the tin before the next washday. The one thing she owns that is worth money is the wedding ring she has not taken off since the cage cable snapped.
quests.goal: Get her a fair valuation and terms she can carry
steps: Go with her to the pawn counter.
Get her a fair valuation and terms she can carry.

quests.name: Hired Men by Camel
quests.info: Ida Brenning of the post station has seen a telegram for the salt works' owner: a party of hired men is coming out from East City by camel, to work the pans while the rakers sit. They change mounts at her station tomorrow.
quests.goal: Turn them back without blood
steps: Meet the hired men at the station.
Turn them back without blood.

quests.name: Hold the Morning Lorries
quests.info: The supply lorries leave the railhead at first light and pass the pinewood an hour later. The lieutenant in charge has a mountain to feed and no patience for a hunter's story.
quests.goal: Carry his orders up the line to the lead driver
steps: Persuade the railhead lieutenant to hold the convoy back an hour.
Carry his orders up the line to the lead driver.
quests.next: Where the Road Meets the Trees

quests.name: Hold the Wool Special
quests.info: The wool special is loading in the goods yard, the heaviest train of the year, due out at first light. The platelayer needs it held one night to set the new stone, and the yard foreman is the only man in Resembool who can find a fault on a wagon that the railway will believe.
quests.goal: Ride the footplate across when the special finally runs
steps: Persuade the foreman to find a fault on the wool special.
Work the night through with the platelayer, setting the blocks under the pier.
Ride the footplate across when the special finally runs.

quests.name: Holding the Line
quests.info: A lieutenant holds a trench. The Amestrian guns have found the range of the party's sector.
quests.goal: Hold the trench until night
steps: Move the sector's men under fire.
Hold the trench until night.
Tell Bren Tolley the job is done.

quests.name: Holding the Ridge
quests.info: A soldier holds his ground. An Amestrian patrol is climbing toward the summit hut, and the party has three rifles to stop it.
quests.goal: Turn the patrol back
steps: Take the high ground.
Turn the patrol back.
Tell Davor Kresnik the job is done.

quests.name: Hoofprints Over the Saddle
quests.info: The smuggler on the high saddle says strings of shod horses have gone over his track at night, led by men who do not lay or read cairns.
quests.goal: Keep Nino Garra's cairns from being used against him
steps: Find the horse thieves' route over the saddle.
Keep Nino Garra's cairns from being used against him.

quests.name: Horse Boxes on the Night Siding
quests.info: The shed foreman has seen horse boxes coupled on at midnight to a train that does not appear on any timetable he keeps.
quests.goal: Find where the train set the horses down
steps: Watch the siding through the night.
Find where the train set the horses down.

quests.name: Horses in Harness
quests.info: The coach team trotted into the inn's stable yard alone, still in harness, the traces cut clean through. The landlord would much rather the party asked the horses than asked him.
quests.goal: Get the landlord to say who was aboard
steps: Look over the cut traces in the stable yard.
Get the landlord to say who was aboard.

quests.name: Household Guard
quests.info: A household guard keeps the estate safe. Masked men were seen on the wall last night.
quests.goal: Take one of the masked men alive
steps: Watch the wall.
Take one of the masked men alive.
Tell Yao Clan Steward the job is done.

quests.name: Into the Charge Book
quests.info: The engraver will talk, but only to the desk sergeant, and only once his name is written in the charge book where no one can quietly take it out.
quests.goal: See the charge written into the book
steps: Bring the engraver to the precinct.
See the charge written into the book.

quests.name: Into the Kiln
quests.info: The carcasses must be burned past any use, and the only fire in the district hot enough is the lime kiln on the hill road. Its old burner hates to fire out of season and does not mean to start a habit of it, but he will do it once, for the flocks.
quests.goal: Keep the kiln fed through the night
steps: Carry the carcasses up the hill road before the town wakes.
Keep the kiln fed through the night.

quests.name: Into the Mail Sack
quests.info: Hana has written to East City every month for help: coal for the pump, a doctor, a count of the families on her blackboard. She has never had an answer. This time she wants someone she trusts to see the letter leave Reole.
quests.goal: Watch it go into the mail sack
steps: Carry the council's letter to the station.
Watch it go into the mail sack.

quests.name: Iron From the Railhead
quests.info: The mended pump needs a new rod, and the only good iron within three days' ride lies in the rail stacks that Dora Wickham hauls off by night. She will part with some, at her own terms, if nobody says her name at the depot.
quests.goal: Bring back iron without giving her up
steps: Find Dora at the rail stacks.
Bring back iron without giving her up.

quests.name: Keeper of the Licence
quests.info: A master of the licence sits on the board that judges the others. The party must judge whether a famous alchemist's research is real or copied.
quests.goal: Give the board a verdict
steps: Study the alchemist's notes.
Give the board a verdict.
Tell Alex Louis Armstrong the job is done.

quests.name: Keeper of the Water
quests.info: A believer serves the camp first. The well the camp draws from is failing.
quests.goal: Bring the water back
steps: Find why the well is failing.
Bring the water back.
Tell Elder Halim the job is done.

quests.name: Lacquer on Jade Row
quests.info: The clan's lacquer screen, pawned last winter, is in a shop window on Jade Row with a card on it, and the creditor's clan has sent a servant twice to look at it. If that clan owns the Chang screen, the whole court will know by spring.
quests.goal: Keep it out of the creditor's hands
steps: Find the pawnbroker who holds the screen.
Keep it out of the creditor's hands.

quests.name: Ladle and Mould
quests.info: Soft steel has to come from somewhere. The foundry pours most of the valley's stock, and its owner can read a fracture the way a clerk reads a book.
quests.goal: Find who sold the bad stock to the stall
steps: Show the broken spring to the foundry.
Find who sold the bad stock to the stall.

quests.name: Lamps on the Siding
quests.info: Crates leave the siding after the night shift has gone home, loaded by her own crew on orders nobody puts a signature to. She wants a witness who is not on the depot's payroll.
quests.goal: Follow the night wagon out of the depot
steps: Keep watch on the loading siding through a night shift.
Follow the night wagon out of the depot.

quests.name: Light on the Scrap Pile
quests.info: The garrison number belongs to the Ishval depot, where broken rifle barrels and old wagon tyres wait for the scrap train. Ludwig Haberl has noticed the pile getting smaller and his book saying otherwise. The inspector is coming, and the sergeant would very much like the difference to be someone else's.
quests.goal: Find out who carts the scrap away by night
steps: Weigh the scrap pile against the depot book.
Find out who carts the scrap away by night.

quests.name: Light Sledges
quests.info: The customs clerk has written the trapper into his great book every week, sledge declared empty both ways. He has never been asked to look harder, and he would enjoy it.
quests.goal: Find what the false floor was cut to hold
steps: Go back through the book with the clerk.
Search the trapper's sledge at his next crossing.
Find what the false floor was cut to hold.
quests.next: The Night Shift at the Powder Store

quests.name: Light Under the Door
quests.info: Someone has told the guardhouse about a blue light flickering under the forge door after dark. The sergeant would very much rather not write it down, and needs a reason he can live with.
quests.goal: Give the sergeant something true to write instead
steps: Learn who made the report.
Give the sergeant something true to write instead.

quests.name: Like Kin
quests.info: Kin share what they lost. The brothers ask the party to stand with them at the grave on the hill and say what they have given up.
quests.goal: Say what was given up
steps: Stand at the grave.
Say what was given up.
Tell Edward Elric the job is done.

quests.name: Listening to the Ground
quests.info: May takes the party into the mine and asks them to feel which tunnel the flow avoids.
quests.goal: Name the tunnel the flow avoids
steps: Sit in the dark and listen.
Name the tunnel the flow avoids.

quests.name: Loaves for Tanners' Lane
quests.info: The old baker has noticed loaves going missing three doors down: Klara Faber sets them aside for the tanners' families and writes them off as burnt, and her husband has started counting. He asks the party to carry the week's bread down the lane and turn the kindness into a bargain before it costs her a marriage.
quests.goal: Tell the baker the truth about his burnt loaves
steps: Carry the bread down Tanners' Lane.
Agree a fair trade of hides or labour for the bread.
Tell the baker the truth about his burnt loaves.

quests.name: Lot Fourteen
quests.info: Two beasts in the next lot carry brands that have been burned over with a hot iron, and the lieutenant cannot stop the sale without warning everyone he is watching.
quests.goal: See who bids and who sells
steps: Look the burned beasts over.
See who bids and who sells.

quests.name: Marked Tails
quests.info: A pair of skis and the patrol's only true map of the bad snow are gone from the rack, and the sergeant of the ski patrol has a week before he must report the loss and send men after it. He would rather the skis came back without a search party, if the man on them can be talked down.
quests.goal: Learn from him where a man on those skis could hide all winter
steps: Win a day's grace from the patrol sergeant.
Learn from him where a man on those skis could hide all winter.

quests.name: Marks on the Loft Post
quests.info: The old net-mender has cut a notch on the loft's corner post for every flood and every drought since he was a boy. This summer the water has dropped below his lowest notch, and it has not rained less than usual.
quests.goal: Measure where the water stands now
steps: Read the old man's notches.
Measure where the water stands now.

quests.name: Marks the Caravans Knew
quests.info: The Xingese trader camped in the thornscrub has crossed the desert by the old roads for twenty years, and the old roads cut their own marks into wells and waystations.
quests.goal: Carry his reading back to the schoolhouse
steps: Bring the copied marks to his camp.
Hear what the marks say.
Carry his reading back to the schoolhouse.

quests.name: Milk Before Questions
quests.info: A survey officer has ridden to the black tents twice now, asking about wells. The chief gave him milk both times and nothing else. He would like to know what the army means to do with a well once it has one on paper.
quests.goal: Learn what the army wants with the wells
steps: Talk to the survey officer's riders.
Learn what the army wants with the wells.

quests.name: Minutes of the Hall
quests.info: The last word belongs to the engineers' hall, where the secretary will let a matter be settled in the room if somebody brings it there honestly. The seller is the widow's own brother-in-law, and he has friends on the committee.
quests.goal: See the bad stock withdrawn without a riot
steps: Bring the springs before the hall.
See the bad stock withdrawn without a riot.

quests.name: Moved in the Night
quests.info: Someone has dug up the old boundary stones where the pasture meets the forest and reset them twenty paces into the grazing, and a timber agent has turned up with a map that agrees with them.
quests.goal: Prove the true line to the timber agent
steps: Find where the stones first stood.
Prove the true line to the timber agent.

quests.name: Nails From Scrap
quests.info: The girl wants to practise on something that will not drown her. The farrier will lend his anvil corner and a heap of scrap iron if someone stands by with a bucket, and if someone stops her trying for more than the scrap in front of her can give.
quests.goal: Stop her reaching past what the iron can give
steps: Help her practise her circles on the farrier's scrap.
Stop her reaching past what the iron can give.

quests.name: Oil and a Long Night
quests.info: Tonight is one of the nights the bad side has paid for, and the keeper means to keep the lamp burning anyway. Men will row out to the spit to ask him why.
quests.goal: Turn the boatmen away from the tower
steps: Keep the lamp lit till dawn.
Turn the boatmen away from the tower.

quests.name: On the Air
quests.info: The programme is ready, and the censor's men are in the building.
quests.goal: Put the programme on the air
steps: Hold the studio.
Put the programme on the air.

quests.name: One Brick for Each
quests.info: The track ends in the stepped courts of Gunja, at a low wall beside a row of beans. An old woman sits by it with her lips moving. She says each brick is set for a name, and that she cannot keep the names any longer without something to set them in.
quests.goal: Learn who brings the bricks
steps: Hear Nura Haddani out beside the wall.
Learn who brings the bricks.

quests.name: One Quiet Question
quests.info: Half the coins are gone from the tin the widows hid under the yard copper, savings for a lawyer that took them four years to put by. The forewoman has asked every woman in the yard the same quiet question, all but the last few.
quests.goal: Find who took the coins
steps: Hear the widows out, copper by copper.
Find who took the coins.

quests.name: One Tunic Short
quests.info: A finished lieutenant's tunic has gone from the rail, and the officer it was cut for has not been told it was ready.
quests.goal: Learn who could have carried it out
steps: Check the rails against the order book.
Learn who could have carried it out.

quests.name: Over the Army's Wire
quests.info: Gideon is willing to send it all now, but the civil line runs through his own key and nobody will believe it. The army post has its own wire to East City. Reinhold Wehle obeys every written order and has none about this.
quests.goal: Wait out the answer at the post
steps: Persuade the sergeant to send the council's message on the army line.
Wait out the answer at the post.

quests.name: Pages Among the Sheet Music
quests.info: A music seller in the arcade bought three loose pages of handwritten orchestral score from a young man who wanted cash and no questions.
quests.goal: Recover the pages
steps: Find the shop that bought the pages.
Recover the pages.

quests.name: Paid to Leave the Markers
quests.info: The timber sledges cross the frozen river at Kessel Ford, and the ferryman's markers still show the old track as sound, though the woodcutter has heard the ice talking under it.
quests.goal: Get the sledge track moved before the timber crosses
steps: Find out who paid the ferryman to leave his markers.
Get the sledge track moved before the timber crosses.

quests.name: Poles to the Break
quests.info: The merchant's complaint could go to East City by wire, but the relay's line went dead an hour after the operator agreed to send it. Felix Bramm is sure someone cut it, and he is frightened of who.
quests.goal: See the complaint sent to East City
steps: Ride the poles until the break.
See the complaint sent to East City.

quests.name: Powder Paid in Silver
quests.info: The powder taken out of the shells has to have gone somewhere, and the quarry master admits he has been buying powder cheap from a man who pays him back in Aerugonian silver.
quests.goal: Bring the whole chain to someone who will act on it
steps: Wait at the quarry for the buyer's next visit.
Follow the powder to where it leaves the country.
Bring the whole chain to someone who will act on it.
quests.line: The Clerk at the Works Gate

quests.name: Prints Under the Window
quests.info: The lamp she leaves burning for her son was out one morning, and there were boot prints in the snow beneath the window. She swept them away before anyone else came down. Since then a round of cheese and a loaf go missing from the cellar every few nights.
quests.goal: Follow the fresh tracks up the slope before the wind fills them
steps: Sit up in the cheese cellar through a night.
Follow the fresh tracks up the slope before the wind fills them.

quests.name: Proper Stone
quests.info: The patch was laid in soft stone off a passing cart because nobody would wait for better. The quarry master bellows that his hill holds a bed hard enough to carry the line for a century and that he will cut two blocks of it, if somebody else does the lifting.
quests.goal: Bring the blocks down to the river on the wheelwright's heaviest wagon
steps: Help the quarrymen cut and dress two blocks from the hard bed.
Bring the blocks down to the river on the wheelwright's heaviest wagon.

quests.name: Raided Stores
quests.info: The bear has torn the door off the burners' turf hut and eaten a winter's salt pork. Gunhild Sotberg watched it go from the top of a mound, and she can say which way it went, but first she wants her door hung again before the snow gets in.
quests.goal: Hear from the old burner which way the bear went
steps: Rehang the turf hut's door.
Hear from the old burner which way the bear went.

quests.name: Ransom in the Palm Court
quests.info: The men with the score want the exchange made over afternoon tea in the hotel's palm court, beneath the string trio, where nobody would dare make a scene.
quests.goal: Bring the score back whole
steps: Keep the appointment in the palm court.
Bring the score back whole.

quests.name: Reading the Apron Book
quests.info: Halvard has taken his wife's debt book out of her apron while she slept. He wants it read aloud at the water store, in front of every caravan master in the crossing, before he loses his nerve.
quests.goal: Return the wells written in the book
steps: Gather the caravan masters at the water store.
Return the wells written in the book.

quests.name: Reading the Flow
quests.info: A pulse student learns to feel the flow of the earth. The elder sends the party to a quiet shrine to read the land and mend what is hurt there.
quests.goal: Heal what is hurt
steps: Read the flow.
Heal what is hurt.
Tell Chang Xu the job is done.

quests.name: Red Clay, Red Hands
quests.info: Her oldest pupil did not come to school today. He went to the kilns with a page torn from her primer, to turn a barrow of raw clay into bricks for his father, and the diggers have heard a crack and a shout.
quests.goal: Get his burned hands seen to
steps: Reach the boy at the clay pit.
Get his burned hands seen to.

quests.name: Remounts for the Guard
quests.info: The guard is short of horses, the bandits are riding them, and the officer who should have counted them has been caught selling his own. Ba Tuoshan wants it all put before the guard's commander, his own couriers' habit of reading the post included. He says an old man should not die owing a lie.
quests.goal: See the stolen remounts brought back to the guard
steps: Lay the brands and the count before the guard's commander.
See the stolen remounts brought back to the guard.

quests.name: Reports in a Drawer
quests.info: The inspector has written five reports on the loosening rivets, and the railway office at the halt answered only one, to tell him to stop writing. He wants to know who has been putting the rest in a drawer.
quests.goal: Learn who ordered them set aside
steps: Find the inspector's reports in the railway office.
Learn who ordered them set aside.
quests.line: A File Mark in the Frost

quests.name: Room Twelve
quests.info: The man is staying at the best hotel in the east, which is odd for an agent hiring boys for wages. The porters know everything that goes in and out of his room.
quests.goal: See what he keeps in his room
steps: Talk to the porters about the guest.
See what he keeps in his room.

quests.name: Rope at the Shaft Head
quests.info: The priest who holds Musa Kareem's rope has a fever, and the fallen shaft will not clear itself. The digger needs someone at the top who will not let go when the earth shifts, and someone else to haul the baskets.
quests.goal: Haul up the baskets of fallen earth
steps: Hold the rope through the descent.
Haul up the baskets of fallen earth.

quests.name: Run-Off From the Vat Row
quests.info: The vat row empties its spent dye into the ditch, as it always has. Hu Zhenyi, who rents the last pole, says that in her country a dyer who poisoned a village's water would be shamed before her clan, and she is willing to dig if someone will help her and the vat row will let her.
quests.goal: Dig the run-off into a soak pit away from the well
steps: Trace where the vat row drains.
Dig the run-off into a soak pit away from the well.
quests.line: A Crate the Gate Turns Back

quests.name: Runner of the West Alley
quests.info: A runner knows which goods are hot. A crate in the back came from somewhere the police are watching, and it must be out of the alley tonight.
quests.goal: Leave no trail to the shop
steps: Move the crate.
Leave no trail to the shop.
Tell Glotz the job is done.

quests.name: Ruts Too Deep
quests.info: The coach lies on its side in the ditch beside the night gate, empty. The roadmender swears the gate was shut at dusk, though the ruts of something far heavier than a coach run straight through it.
quests.goal: Make the roadmender admit he opened the gate
steps: Search the overturned coach for what was taken.
Make the roadmender admit he opened the gate.

quests.name: Salts Cut With Ash
quests.info: Fine ash from the retort house looks like good salts in a jar, and it spoils a circle the moment any weight is put through it. Someone is carrying sacks of it out of the gasworks.
quests.goal: Catch the forger mixing it
steps: Find where the ash is being taken.
Catch the forger mixing it.

quests.name: Scorched Palms
quests.info: Kaspar Linn has burnt both his palms trying a circle he copied through a crack in the forge door. He is hiding in the grindstone shed rather than let the smith see his hands.
quests.goal: Find the copied circle and mark its wrong line
steps: Coax the boy out of the grindstone shed.
Find the copied circle and mark its wrong line.

quests.name: Scuffs Under the Eaves
quests.info: The night sentry has found fresh boot scuffs behind the magazine three nights running. Six kegs of blasting powder have been written off as spoiled by a damp that never got under that roof.
quests.goal: Follow the scuffs away from the eaves
steps: Count the kegs against the magazine book.
Follow the scuffs away from the eaves.

quests.name: Seals Unbroken
quests.info: A relay horse came in at a walk with its saddle empty and its dispatch bag still buckled, every seal whole. Ba Tuoshan has ridden that road for thirty years and never known a robber leave the bag. Somebody wanted the rider, not the post.
quests.goal: Find where the courier was taken
steps: Ride the horse's trail back west.
Find where the courier was taken.

quests.name: Sensing the Presence
quests.info: A warrior of Xing feels where people are before seeing them. Lan Fan blindfolds the party in the barracks.
quests.goal: Avoid every one of them
steps: Find the soldiers by their presence.
Avoid every one of them.

quests.name: Servant of the Court
quests.info: A court servant is invisible and everywhere. A minister's seal has gone missing in the inner hall.
quests.goal: Return it before it is missed
steps: Find the seal.
Return it before it is missed.
Tell Feng Mao the job is done.

quests.name: Shaking Hands, Bleeding Gums
quests.info: An apothecary's apprentice was carried into the infirmary at dawn with every sign the old tomb guides describe: bleeding gums, a tremor, a taste of metal. Tao Lingshu can draw the poison out of him through the earth's flow, but the student needs to know what the boy swallowed and how much.
quests.goal: Keep the circle clear while Tao Lingshu works
steps: Bring a sample of what the boy tasted.
Keep the circle clear while Tao Lingshu works.

quests.name: Shearing Day
quests.info: Shearing has started at the fold, and the army's wool buyer has come up the hill to say that every fleece on the station belongs to the western command this year.
quests.goal: Settle what the army takes and what the station keeps
steps: Hear out the wool buyer.
Settle what the army takes and what the station keeps.

quests.name: Shoes on His Account
quests.info: The lieutenant's cart is due in Reole again, and Mattias Brennig wants him met at the forge door rather than at the army post, where the matter would vanish into a drawer. What the smith asks for is plain: every carter shod again, at no cost to the carters.
quests.goal: Get the carters' mules reshod at his expense
steps: Meet the lieutenant's cart at the forge.
Get the carters' mules reshod at his expense.

quests.name: Shoes She Never Wore Down
quests.info: The depot books say the mare was shot at the front, but her shoes are the ones Sepp Gauer nailed on a year ago and they have never seen a road.
quests.goal: Find who signed her off as killed
steps: Look the mare over with the farrier.
Find who signed her off as killed.
quests.next: Horse Boxes on the Night Siding

quests.name: Shunted in the Night
quests.info: A sealed goods wagon was shunted onto the dead siding overnight without an order, and when the station master walked down at first light its seal was new and its waybill gone.
quests.goal: Find who pressed the new seal
steps: Look over the wagon on the dead siding.
Find who pressed the new seal.

quests.name: Sickness at the Bothy
quests.info: Two lads at the lambing bothy bought a cheap leg at a back door downriver and have lain in the straw shaking ever since. The head shepherd cannot leave the ewes and will not leave the boys.
quests.goal: Get them down the hill to the country surgery
steps: Sit with the sick lads and learn where the leg was bought.
Get them down the hill to the country surgery.

quests.name: Six Bullocks for the Barracks
quests.info: A young lieutenant came to the sale ring with a requisition chit for the barracks kitchens, drove off six bullocks, and has not been seen by any quartermaster since.
quests.goal: Follow the bullocks
steps: Examine the chit he left behind.
Follow the bullocks.

quests.name: Sledges With Deep Floors
quests.info: The barn's crates are to go north by sledge, and Mattis Ekdahl has worked out that some of the sledges the depot bought from his yard are the ones built with floors a hand deeper than they look.
quests.goal: Find those sledges in the depot yard and mark them
steps: Get the sledwright to say which of his sledges are hollow.
Find those sledges in the depot yard and mark them.

quests.name: Smoke on the Far Slope
quests.info: Maren Aske has seen smoke rising from a hut on the far slope, where no flock has wintered since the autumn, and the shepherd who owned it is in the ground.
quests.goal: Learn who is wintering there
steps: Cross the hills to the smoking hut.
Learn who is wintering there.

quests.name: Sold Twice Over
quests.info: The lad confesses that his master sells the same rye to the barracks wagon and to the bakers, and weighs neither load.
quests.goal: Make the miller give the bakers honest weight
steps: Check the mill's sacks against its book.
Make the miller give the bakers honest weight.

quests.name: Spoiling in the Sun
quests.info: Wei Shunde's camels have stood loaded at the barrier for nine days. The tea in their packs will not last another week in this heat, and the old man refuses, on principle, to pay what the clerk has not even had the courage to ask.
quests.goal: Learn what the clerk is waiting for
steps: Get the tea string into shade and water.
Learn what the clerk is waiting for.

quests.name: Staff Courier
quests.info: A staff aide carries what nobody else may read. The party must take a locked case across the capital at night with two strangers following.
quests.goal: Deliver the case unopened
steps: Lose the strangers.
Deliver the case unopened.
Tell Storch the job is done.

quests.name: Stakes Across the Shafts
quests.info: The survey line crosses the qanat's chain of shafts at a slant, and Arno Fiedler, who loves flat ground, has marked the shaft mouths as holes to be filled for the embankment. He does not know what they are. Musa would rather he never did.
quests.goal: Get the line bent or bridged over the qanat
steps: Show the lieutenant what the holes are.
Get the line bent or bridged over the qanat.

quests.name: Stolen Stock
quests.info: The false notes are printed on a heavy rag paper that only one press in the capital buys, and the press hall has been losing a few reams a week since the winter.
quests.goal: Follow him to his buyer
steps: Learn who carries the reams out of the press hall.
Follow him to his buyer.
quests.next: The Kiln That Is Never Cold

quests.name: Stretchers at Noon
quests.info: The hour has brought in more than the dead: a dozen men who lay out in the craters still breathing, and the field hospital must take every one before the guns start again.
quests.goal: Keep the triage tent from overflowing
steps: Carry the wounded down the ambulance track.
Keep the triage tent from overflowing.

quests.name: Struck From the Roll
quests.info: The roll of new recruits is kept by Gottfried Wexler, the senior sergeant, who has buried enough young soldiers to listen when a matron comes to his square.
quests.goal: Get the boy's name struck from the recruits' roll
steps: Show the sergeant the grant's true terms.
Get the boy's name struck from the recruits' roll.
quests.line: The Boy Who Would Not Sign

quests.name: Sums in Chalk
quests.info: The store at the pans changes its prices every time a delivery comes in, always upward, and every raker owes it more than a season's pay. Magda Fenn has been keeping a tally of her own. She needs the store's own bills to make them stick.
quests.goal: Check them against the rakers' board
steps: Get a look at the store's delivery bills.
Check them against the rakers' board.

quests.name: Supper in the Schoolroom
quests.info: The teacher means to hold one good supper in the schoolroom before the winter: the children, the veterans from the home, and any soldier willing to bring a loaf.
quests.goal: See the supper through without a fight
steps: Gather the food and the guests.
See the supper through without a fight.

quests.name: Survival Exercise
quests.info: A sergeant of Briggs teaches survival. The party leads a squad of new arrivals on a three-day exercise in the snow and must bring every one of them back.
quests.goal: Bring all of them back
steps: Lead the squad through the exercise.
Bring all of them back.
Tell Olivier Mira Armstrong the job is done.

quests.name: The Acolyte's Vigil
quests.info: An acolyte keeps the night vigil. Something moves in the crypt after the doors are locked.
quests.goal: Find what moves in the crypt
steps: Keep the vigil.
Find what moves in the crypt.
Tell Brother Tobin the job is done.

quests.name: The Apprentice's Bench
quests.info: An apprentice learns to file a joint true. Pinako gives the party a broken wrist joint and a day.
quests.goal: Have it pass Pinako's eye
steps: File the joint.
Have it pass Pinako's eye.
Tell Pinako Rockbell the job is done.

quests.name: The Apprentice's Joint
quests.info: An apprentice learns at the master's bench. Garfiel sets the party one joint to build alone, start to finish, and will judge it in the morning.
quests.goal: Show it to Garfiel
steps: Build the joint.
Show it to Garfiel.
Tell Garfiel the job is done.

quests.name: The Arsenal After Dark
quests.info: The last thread leads to the Old Arsenal, where lamps burn after the guard has gone home.
quests.goal: See who works there at night
steps: Get into the arsenal after dark.
See who works there at night.

quests.name: The Artistry Passed Down
quests.info: The family's alchemy and its fighting arts are taught only to those who can carry them. The party must stand the family's old test before the gathered house.
quests.goal: Pass the test before the house
steps: Train under the family's eldest.
Pass the test before the house.
Tell Philip Gargantos Armstrong the job is done.

quests.name: The Assistant
quests.info: An assistant learns the trade. The butcher teaches the party to break down a carcass without waste.
quests.goal: Break down a carcass without waste
steps: Learn the cuts.
Break down a carcass without waste.
Tell Sig Curtis the job is done.

quests.name: The Atelier's Name
quests.info: A master's work carries the shop's name. The street holds its contest, and the atelier's name rides on the party's limb against the best of Rush Valley.
quests.goal: Win the street's verdict
steps: Build the contest limb.
Win the street's verdict.
Tell Garfiel the job is done.

quests.name: The Auditor's Week
quests.info: The auditor from East City rides in with the morning convoy. Augustin Raddeck, grey and sweating, asks the party to his desk and unlocks the bottom drawer. He has kept two books for eleven years, and he wants to know what they would do.
quests.goal: Decide whose hands it ends in
steps: Take the second book.
Decide whose hands it ends in.

quests.name: The Axe and the Dog
quests.info: Arvo Hakala went into the deep pines with an axe and a dog and came out with neither, and he will not say what he met in there. He asks the party to go back in with him and fetch both, with nobody killed over an axe.
quests.goal: Decide what is to be done about whoever took them
steps: Follow the woodcutter into the deep pines.
Get the axe and the dog back.
Decide what is to be done about whoever took them.

quests.name: The Back Door
quests.info: Farmers pay Gideon Sauerbrey to take the carcasses of sheep that die of the sickness and burn them in lime. The pie woman would like to see with her own eyes whether he burns any of them at all.
quests.goal: Find the carcasses that should have gone into the lime
steps: Watch the yard's back door through the dusk.
Find the carcasses that should have gone into the lime.

quests.name: The Bad Air
quests.info: Miners are fainting in the lower tunnel, and the foreman says it is laziness.
quests.goal: Find what is in the air
steps: Go down to the lower tunnel.
Find what is in the air.

quests.name: The Bar Hand
quests.info: A bar hand keeps the peace. Two crews have chosen the bar to settle a quarrel.
quests.goal: End the night with nobody dead
steps: Keep the quarrel outside.
End the night with nobody dead.
Tell Mrs. Teague the job is done.

quests.name: The Bare Circles
quests.info: She means to do the real thing where the town's famous brothers learned theirs, on the bare round patches by the river, and she wants witnesses who will set down in writing exactly what she did.
quests.goal: Witness the transmutation and write it down for her application
steps: Keep the crowd of children back from her circle.
Witness the transmutation and write it down for her application.

quests.name: The Barge Without a Pennant
quests.info: Lou Dachun moved a barge up his board ahead of its turn, for a little something, and now wishes he had not. It flew no clan's pennant and carried mulberry leaves upriver in fresh baskets, more than the sheds had ever ordered.
quests.goal: Find who hired the barge
steps: Get the barge's name off Lou's board.
Find who hired the barge.

quests.name: The Basin Fills From Below
quests.info: The last plug of clay between the old tunnel and the temple is a wall's thickness from the scripture, and if the water breaks through too fast it will take the lower lines with it. Samira Othman has filled the basin by hand every day. She would like to see it fill by itself once.
quests.goal: Keep the flood off the scripture walls
steps: Break the last plug of clay.
Keep the flood off the scripture walls.

quests.name: The Biscuit Tin
quests.info: Hana did not think Gideon Harkwell had it in him. She wants to know what he did in the back room, and she would rather the party asked him than the army post.
quests.goal: Read what is inside
steps: Get Gideon to open the tin on his desk.
Read what is inside.

quests.name: The Board Becomes a Book
quests.info: The officer from East City will want names on paper, not chalk on a board that the rain from the bell loft has already smudged once. Hana Belkacem has the names. She needs hands to copy them, and someone beside her when she reads them out.
quests.goal: Stand with Hana Belkacem when the officer hears the list
steps: Copy the blackboard list into a bound book.
Stand with Hana Belkacem when the officer hears the list.

quests.name: The Boat Shed
quests.info: The coach's passengers are tied up in a boat shed on the oxbow while their captors wait for a boat and full dark. The sergeant has two privates, an old revolver and a quiet posting he would like to keep.
quests.goal: Stop the captors before their boat comes in
steps: Get the passengers out of the shed.
Stop the captors before their boat comes in.

quests.name: The Book Made Whole
quests.info: The cut pages were never burned: the sergeant keeps them in his locker at the stockade as a guarantee against the men who pay him. The gunsmith wants them back before the military police arrive at his counter.
quests.goal: Recover the three pages
steps: Get into the stockade's guard room.
Recover the three pages.
quests.line: A Knife That Knew the Place

quests.name: The Book Under the Counter
quests.info: The proprietor keeps the book of hot sales. The police have come asking, and the party must decide what the book shows them.
quests.goal: Decide what they see
steps: Hear what the police want.
Decide what they see.
Tell Glotz the job is done.

quests.name: The Boomtown
quests.info: In Rush Valley the engineers sell on the street, and Winry wants to see how the best of them work.
