quests.goal: Learn one trick from them
steps: Find the best engineer in the valley.
Learn one trick from them.

quests.name: The Border Inn
quests.info: The crates are carried on to the inn on the border road, where buyers from across the border meet.
quests.goal: Learn who buys
steps: Watch the inn.
Learn who buys.

quests.name: The Border Patrol
quests.info: A lieutenant commands a patrol on the Drachman line. Tracks have been seen on the Amestrian side of the ice road.
quests.goal: Deal with whoever made them
steps: Follow the tracks.
Deal with whoever made them.
Tell Olivier Mira Armstrong the job is done.

quests.name: The Border Post
quests.info: The post on the Xing side has a new officer who has not been paid.
quests.goal: Get the passengers through
steps: Learn what the officer wants.
Get the passengers through.

quests.name: The Box Under the Counter
quests.info: Under her counter the cable widow keeps a box of springs she bought a year ago and never sold; bend one and it stays bent. A young engineer is working his way down the stalls with a cracked forearm in his hands, asking where the spring inside it came from.
quests.goal: Learn which stall sold both
steps: Compare the cracked spring with hers.
Learn which stall sold both.

quests.name: The Boy Who Would Not Sign
quests.info: One of the older boys ran away rather than sign his enlistment papers. An army clerk comes back at the end of the week to collect him, and the matron has run out of things to tell him.
quests.goal: Find him and bring him in from the cold
steps: Learn from the children where the boy is hiding.
Find him and bring him in from the cold.
quests.line: The Boy Who Would Not Sign

quests.name: The Bridge in Flood
quests.info: The river is high, the bridge is shaking, and the wool carts must cross before the market.
quests.goal: See the carts across
steps: Shore up the bridge.
See the carts across.

quests.name: The Broken Thing
quests.info: Her last lesson is to rebuild a shattered vase so that nobody can see where it broke, and to say what was lost in the mending.
quests.goal: Say what the mending cost
steps: Rebuild the vase.
Say what the mending cost.

quests.name: The Bundle of Letters
quests.info: The camp has written letters to its scattered families for years with nobody to carry them.
quests.goal: Learn where each one must go
steps: Gather the letters.
Learn where each one must go.

quests.name: The Butcher's Counter
quests.info: Izumi's first lesson is to fight her bare-handed in the yard behind the shop, and nobody has ever landed a blow.
quests.goal: Land one blow
steps: Fight her in the yard.
Land one blow.

quests.name: The Butcher's Wife
quests.info: Only one person in Dublith can say whether the boy should go on, and she frightens the schoolmistress more than the police do. Izumi Curtis has heard everything already.
quests.goal: Hear what Izumi Curtis makes of him
steps: Bring the boy to the Curtis house.
Hear what Izumi Curtis makes of him.

quests.name: The Buyer at the Hall
quests.info: The foreman speaks for the town. A man with money has come to the hall with an offer for the town's coal, and the miners must hear it straight.
quests.goal: Put it to the miners
steps: Hear the offer.
Put it to the miners.
Tell Mr. Halling the job is done.

quests.name: The Cage Hook
quests.info: The hook that holds the cage to its cable at Mine Number Eight has cracked right through. The whole shift is standing idle in the pithead yard, and a slow weld will keep them up there all day without a wage.
quests.goal: See the cage run safely with men in it
steps: Bring the cracked hook up from the shaft to the forge.
Settle with the smith whether it is mended by fire or by chalk.
See the cage run safely with men in it.

quests.name: The Camp Fever
quests.info: A fever is in the camp, and the doctor cannot go himself.
quests.goal: Nurse the sick through it
steps: Carry the medicine to the camp.
Nurse the sick through it.

quests.name: The Captain's Bargain
quests.info: A captain speaks with the generals. Talk of a truce has started, and the party must carry the army's terms to the people who will decide.
quests.goal: Bring back an answer
steps: Carry the terms.
Bring back an answer.
Tell Bren Tolley the job is done.

quests.name: The Caravan Track
quests.info: Bandits on the old track have robbed the refugees' water caravan twice.
quests.goal: Drive the bandits off the track
steps: Guard the next caravan.
Drive the bandits off the track.

quests.name: The Cave Under the Copper
quests.info: A copper pit has broken into a cave, and Tibor Lask has covered the hole with planks. Tao Ruyi felt the ground there groan from the springs. She says the roof will come down within days, and two of his men have already gone in.
quests.goal: Seal the cave before it falls
steps: Get the diggers out of the cave.
Seal the cave before it falls.

quests.name: The Cellar Runner
quests.info: A private of the line learns the tunnels. The party must take a message through the broken town to the forward post.
quests.goal: Deliver the message
steps: Find a way through the cellars.
Deliver the message.
Tell Bren Tolley the job is done.

quests.name: The Certificate
quests.info: A State Alchemist is made by the board's examination: a written test, a psychological evaluation, and a practical before the board with the Führer watching.
quests.goal: Pass the practical before the board
steps: Pass the written test and the evaluation.
Pass the practical before the board.
Tell Alex Louis Armstrong the job is done.

quests.name: The Chewed Strap
quests.info: The wolf hunter found an army rifle at the rim of the hollow last month, its sling gnawed through by her dogs' wild cousins. The army has its owner down as lost on the range. She has since found the same man's tracks, and they are not a dead man's tracks.
quests.goal: Keep her from selling the story at the fort for the bounty
steps: Get the wolf hunter to show where the rifle lay.
Learn whose rifle it is from the number on the stock.
Keep her from selling the story at the fort for the bounty.

quests.name: The Chisel in the Basket
quests.info: She has carried a chisel in her sewing basket for weeks, and now she has her proof. Tonight she means to take the name off the plate, whatever the town meeting voted.
quests.goal: Stand with her when the town sees the plate in the morning
steps: Decide with her what becomes of the name.
Stand with her when the town sees the plate in the morning.

quests.name: The Church Steps
quests.info: The poor sleep on the church steps, and the town is arguing whether to move them on.
quests.goal: Find them somewhere to sleep
steps: Hear the poor out.
Find them somewhere to sleep.

quests.name: The Circle in the Sand
quests.info: She draws a circle in the sand of the cove and asks the party to name every material within ten paces before they touch any of it.
quests.goal: Transmute only what was named
steps: Name the materials of the cove.
Transmute only what was named.

quests.name: The Cistern of Xerxes
quests.info: The ruins hold an old cistern that nobody has opened in centuries.
quests.goal: Open it for the people
steps: Find the cistern.
Open it for the people.

quests.name: The Cistern Road
quests.info: A companion knows the hidden roads. The cistern under the ruins is the only way out of a cordon, and it has been flooded.
quests.goal: Bring the way out to the others
steps: Find a way through the flooded cistern.
Bring the way out to the others.
Tell Scar the job is done.

quests.name: The Clan Envoy
quests.info: A retainer speaks for the court among the clans. Two clans are close to a feud over a marriage.
quests.goal: Head off the feud
steps: Hear both clans.
Head off the feud.
Tell Feng Mao the job is done.

quests.name: The Clean Bench
quests.info: A shop hand keeps the shop running. The master is out on calls all day, and the bench must be clean and every order written up when he comes back.
quests.goal: Write up the day's orders
steps: Clear the bench.
Write up the day's orders.
Tell Garfiel the job is done.

quests.name: The Clerk at the Works Gate
quests.info: Lene Dorn, yellow to the eyebrows from the powder, says a clerk has been at the works gate asking where she lives.
quests.goal: Hide Lene Dorn somewhere he will not find her
steps: Keep watch on the gate for the clerk.
Hide Lene Dorn somewhere he will not find her.
quests.line: The Clerk at the Works Gate

quests.name: The Clock Tower Meeting
quests.info: The buyers meet at the Clock Tower when the bell rings ten, and the boatman knows one of their faces.
quests.goal: Learn who is buying
steps: Get close to the meeting.
Learn who is buying.

quests.name: The Coal Train
quests.info: The coal must still go out, or the town will not eat this month, and the train crew will not move without a guard.
quests.goal: Bring it past the cut in the hills
steps: Guard the coal train.
Bring it past the cut in the hills.

quests.name: The Cold Arm
quests.info: In the north, automail freezes to the skin and the springs crack. The fort needs a limb that works in the snow.
quests.goal: Build one that works in the cold
steps: Learn why the northern limbs fail.
Build one that works in the cold.

quests.name: The Cold Kiln Chamber
quests.info: One chamber of the ring kiln at the brickworks has been left cold for a month, and the night watchman has been paid to keep away from it. Somebody draws circles there.
quests.goal: Face the unlicensed alchemist at work there
steps: Get into the cold chamber.
Face the unlicensed alchemist at work there.

quests.name: The Colonel's Errand
quests.info: A lieutenant carries the colonel's quiet business. A veteran of the eastern war wants to talk, but only to someone the colonel trusts.
quests.goal: Carry his account back to the colonel
steps: Win the veteran's trust.
Carry his account back to the colonel.
Tell Roy Mustang the job is done.

quests.name: The Colonel's Letter
quests.info: Mustang will put his name to a candidate only after he has seen what they can do, and he wants to see the party's alchemy first.
quests.goal: Earn his letter
steps: Show the colonel your alchemy.
Earn his letter.

quests.name: The Colonel's Order
quests.info: A colonel weighs the whole front. An attack on the Amestrian post has been planned, and the party must say whether it goes ahead.
quests.goal: Decide the attack
steps: Scout the post.
Decide the attack.
Tell Davor Kresnik the job is done.

quests.name: The Colonel's Right Hand
quests.info: A colonel's right hand gives orders in his name. The unit needs friends in the western command, and the party must make them.
quests.goal: Win them for the colonel
steps: Find the officers worth having.
Win them for the colonel.
Tell Roy Mustang the job is done.

quests.name: The Comb She Never Wears
quests.info: The owning clan's steward is coming up from the capital to ask why a shed was lost, and the dyer's agent rides with him, full of sympathy and an offer. Cao Sihua has put on the silver comb the clan once gave her. She wants the proof in the steward's hand before the agent opens his mouth.
quests.goal: See the dyer's agent sent off the hill
steps: Lay the proof before the clan steward.
See the dyer's agent sent off the hill.

quests.name: The Commander's Cut
quests.info: The difference between the customs house's two books goes somewhere, and the merchant has watched a fort rider collect a satchel from the clerk every tenth day. He would like to know what the fort does with it.
quests.goal: Find where the fort's share is kept
steps: Follow the satchel to the fort.
Find where the fort's share is kept.

quests.name: The Commander's Plan
quests.info: A colonel plans the war. The commander wants a plan to take the fort that does not end like the last one.
quests.goal: Present a new plan
steps: Study why the last attack failed.
Present a new plan.
Tell Vagner the job is done.

quests.name: The Companion
quests.info: A companion stands with them. Soldiers have come to Resembool looking for the brothers.
quests.goal: Send them the wrong way
steps: Meet the soldiers at the bridge.
Send them the wrong way.
Tell Edward Elric the job is done.

quests.name: The Corporal's Letter
quests.info: One of the cracked forearms belongs to a corporal home from the southern front, lying on the clinic ward with pencil and paper. His complaint, once posted, will bring an inspector down on the whole market.
quests.goal: See his arm made sound before the letter goes
steps: Hear the corporal out.
See his arm made sound before the letter goes.

quests.name: The Corporal's Patrol
quests.info: A corporal brings his patrol home. The party leads four men through the hills to look at a new Amestrian camp and back.
quests.goal: Bring every man back
steps: Scout the camp.
Bring every man back.
Tell Davor Kresnik the job is done.

quests.name: The Cracked Bell
quests.info: The temple's dawn bell has cracked, and the city says it is an omen.
quests.goal: Hang the bell again
steps: Find a bell maker who can mend it.
Hang the bell again.

quests.name: The Crate From Abroad
quests.info: A back room hand moves goods that never sit on a shelf. A crate the store would rather nobody opened waits to be collected, and the market is full of soldiers.
quests.goal: Get it to the back room unseen
steps: Collect the crate.
Get it to the back room unseen.
Tell Jean Havoc the job is done.

quests.name: The Customer in Mufti
quests.info: A soldier out of uniform has bought iron filings by the sack three times this month and paid in notes that crackle. The garrison wants the supplier to report him, and the supplier would sooner know what he is reporting first.
quests.goal: Follow him home with his sacks
steps: Be in the shop when the soldier comes back.
Follow him home with his sacks.

quests.name: The Damp Stack
quests.info: A branch keeper keeps the branch whole. Water has come into a lower stack, and the books must be saved and the leak found.
quests.goal: Find the leak
steps: Save the books.
Find the leak.
Tell Margit Sauer the job is done.

quests.name: The Deacon's Rounds
quests.info: A deacon visits the faithful. A family has stopped coming to the church and the town talks.
quests.goal: Learn why they stopped
steps: Visit the family.
Learn why they stopped.
Tell Brother Tobin the job is done.

quests.name: The Dead Line
quests.info: The slum burns scrap iron to keep warm, and the scrapper at Baschool has stopped selling to it.
quests.goal: Bring a load of iron back
steps: Learn why he stopped.
Bring a load of iron back.

quests.name: The Dead Section
quests.info: For the third time this month a stretch of overhead wire has gone dead between two stops; the line crew found it cut clean and carried off before the first car ran.
quests.goal: Work out how the thieves reached the wire
steps: Walk the dead section with the line crew.
Work out how the thieves reached the wire.

quests.name: The Depot Ambush
quests.info: The rifles are to be used on a tram carrying officers out of the depot at dawn.
quests.goal: Stop the ambush
steps: Warn the depot.
Stop the ambush.

quests.name: The Dismissed Ganger
quests.info: Hugo Brandt knows the boot that made those prints: it belongs to a ganger he turned off last winter for drinking on the line, who swore the railway would be sorry.
quests.goal: Learn why he has been at the rivets
steps: Find where the ganger lodges near the sheds.
Learn why he has been at the rivets.
quests.line: A File Mark in the Frost

quests.name: The Doctor's Debt
quests.info: The doctor asks the party to take a letter to Resembool, to the family of a soldier he treated in the eastern war.
quests.goal: Deliver the letter
steps: Find the family.
Deliver the letter.

quests.name: The Door-to-Door Search
quests.info: A cell leader keeps his men alive. The army has a list of the squad's safe houses, and the old quarter is being searched door by door.
quests.goal: Move the men out in time
steps: Learn which houses are on the list.
Move the men out in time.
Tell Rudd Kessler the job is done.

quests.name: The Dry River Ambush
quests.info: A sergeant chooses the ground. An Amestrian column will cross the dry riverbed at dawn.
quests.goal: Spring the ambush and get out
steps: Prepare the ground.
Spring the ambush and get out.
Tell Bren Tolley the job is done.

quests.name: The Dry Well
quests.info: The waystation's well has gone dry, and the caravans will stop coming.
quests.goal: Bring the water back
steps: Find why it went dry.
Bring the water back.

quests.name: The Dyke Road
quests.info: Out on the Yao paddies the overseers have been taking a second levy and selling the rice by night to fill a granary that ought to have been full already. Shen Guotai has their tally sticks and a petition, and the overseers' men are standing on the only road out of his village.
quests.goal: Put the petition in the clan steward's hand
steps: Walk the headman past the overseers' men.
Put the petition in the clan steward's hand.

quests.name: The Eastbound Timetable
quests.info: A cell hand plans the work. The cell wants to know which eastbound train carries an officer worth a trade.
quests.goal: Bring the timetable to the cell
steps: Learn the officer's train.
Bring the timetable to the cell.
Tell Rudd Kessler the job is done.

quests.name: The Eastern Voice
quests.info: In East City the veterans of the war talk at the Clock Tower.
quests.goal: Record what he says
steps: Find a veteran who will speak.
Record what he says.

quests.name: The Elder's Answer
quests.info: An elder decides for the clan. A larger clan offers to take the Chang clan under its roof, and the clan stands too low at court to refuse it lightly.
quests.goal: Give the clan's answer
steps: Weigh the offer.
Give the clan's answer.
Tell Chang Xu the job is done.

quests.name: The Elder's Word

Pass the evaluation.

Persuade her to hand the form over.

See the exchange through without a shot.

Open the gate for good.

quests.info: The ferryman has doubled his fare, and the fishermen cannot reach the market.
quests.goal: Get the fare back down

Get the fare back down.

quests.name: The Field Reporter
quests.info: A reporter brings back the street. The station wants an honest account of the capital's mood.

Hurt nobody.

Fit legs she can race on.

See it work in the snow.

Do it with her listening.

Bring the house to one answer.

Bring the temple's healers.

Get a fair price for the growers.

quests.info: A trader claims the oasis as his own and charges travellers to drink.
quests.goal: Open the water to all
steps: Hear the trader's claim.
Open the water to all.

quests.name: The Official's Tally
quests.info: A court official counts the Emperor's soldiers. The barracks' rolls carry names that nobody has seen.
quests.goal: Name who profits
steps: Check the rolls against the men.
Name who profits.
Tell Feng Mao the job is done.

quests.name: The Old Fort's Lights
quests.info: Lights have been seen in the old lake fort, which has been empty for years.
quests.goal: Find who is living there
steps: Row out to the fort.
Find who is living there.

quests.name: The Old Man's Deed
quests.info: Wenzel Hader is sitting on his doorstep with a deed in his lap, and a patrol has ordered him out of his own farm by sundown.
quests.goal: Read the deed against the customs books
steps: Talk the patrol out of moving him today.
Read the deed against the customs books.

quests.name: The Old Water Road
quests.info: The wells near the tents are failing in the dry season, and the herders must cross the old lake bed to the far wells their grandfathers used. Only the painter Jasper Corwin, who has stared at it for months, knows where the far shore really is.
quests.goal: Bring the herds over to the far wells
steps: Find the old marker stones across the lake bed.
Bring the herds over to the far wells.

quests.name: The Order
quests.info: A Briggs soldier has written for an arm that will not freeze, and the master will not go north himself.
quests.goal: Pack it for the road
steps: Help finish the arm.
Pack it for the road.

quests.name: The Organist's Ear
quests.info: After evensong the church organist heard a stranger pick out a tune on his instrument that he had never heard before. He hummed it to a friend in the opera chorus, and the friend went white.
quests.goal: Find the copyist in the quarter
steps: Speak with the organist.
Find the copyist in the quarter.

quests.name: The Pale Wall
quests.info: The row of graves runs straight into the west corner of the brickworks clay, where the kiln master struck a buried wall of pale stone and quietly covered it again.
quests.goal: Copy the carved marks onto paper
steps: Clear the face of the buried wall.
Copy the carved marks onto paper.

quests.name: The Paper on the Chapel Door
quests.info: The old priest of Fotset took down every order nailed to the church doors of the border villages and keeps them in his prayer book.
quests.goal: Find the order with the benefactor's name on it
steps: Reach the chapel ruin.
Find the order with the benefactor's name on it.

quests.name: The Passenger List
quests.info: Han has a boat full of passengers bound for Amestris and one of them is not who he says.
quests.goal: Decide what to do with him
steps: Find the false passenger.
Decide what to do with him.

quests.name: The Patrol Grudge
quests.info: Two soldiers of rival companies came to blows over a patrol one of them swears the other abandoned, and each says the other is the liar.
quests.goal: Find out which of them is lying
steps: Hear both men's account of the patrol.
Find out which of them is lying.

quests.name: The Petition Drum
quests.info: The creditor has been reading a consort's letters, which is a crime even in Xing. Chang Boqin has decided, for the first time in his life, to beat the drum at the magistrate's gate and have the debt heard by law instead of by whispers.
quests.goal: Get the debt's terms set by law
steps: Bring the creditor's steward before the magistrate.
Get the debt's terms set by law.

quests.name: The Pin-Pricked Card
quests.info: A young drover keeps shouting in the caravanserai yard that the cellar game is crooked. Rosvita believes him, but a drover's word against the innkeeper's wife will not stand, and she wants the proof in somebody's hand before the boy gets his throat cut.
quests.goal: Put it in front of Halvard Dross
steps: Get the marked card from Murad Sef.
Put it in front of Halvard Dross.

quests.name: The Pipe From the West
quests.info: No rain has fallen, the caravans drink no more than usual, and still the level drops every morning. Aysel Tumar has rationed the tally wall to half skins and wants to know where her water is going before the drovers decide she is the thief.
quests.goal: Find who is drawing the water off
steps: Find what feeds the cistern.
Find who is drawing the water off.

quests.name: The Port Comes Out
quests.info: The rusted port has to come out tonight, and the boy will have to be held still through it. Afterwards the doctor wants the name of whoever sold a farmer a port made of that metal.
quests.goal: Get the seller's mark from the old port
steps: Stay with the boy through the night.
Get the seller's mark from the old port.

quests.name: The Practical
quests.info: The last test is alchemy before the board, with the Führer himself watching.
quests.goal: Receive the watch
steps: Perform before the board.
Receive the watch.

quests.name: The Prayer on the Hill
quests.info: A priest leads the prayer. The faithful have not climbed the hill since the war, and the party must lead them up.
quests.goal: Lead the prayer at the summit
steps: Gather the faithful.
Lead the prayer at the summit.
Tell Elder Halim the job is done.

quests.name: The Programme
quests.info: A producer makes the programmes. The station needs a new evening programme that the whole city will listen to.
quests.goal: Put it on the air
steps: Find the programme.
Put it on the air.
Tell Nel Garrow the job is done.

quests.name: The Proprietor's Word
quests.info: A proprietor answers for the shop. Soldiers come to the counter with questions about the butcher's wife.
quests.goal: Send them away
steps: Hear the soldiers out.
Send them away.
Tell Sig Curtis the job is done.

quests.name: The Quiet Month
quests.info: An officer writes reports the general reads. The terrorists of the east have been quiet for a month, and headquarters wants to know why.
quests.goal: Write the report
steps: Learn why.
Write the report.
Tell Joss Harlan the job is done.

quests.name: The Rail Yard
quests.info: The arm must change trains in the capital, and the yard's porters steal whatever looks valuable.
quests.goal: Keep it from the thieves
steps: Change trains with the arm.
Keep it from the thieves.

quests.name: The Rail Yard Crates
quests.info: A porter swears that crates marked for the hospital are unloaded at the rail yard and never reach it.
quests.goal: Follow them to where they go
steps: Watch the crates come off the train.
Follow them to where they go.

quests.name: The Request Book
quests.info: A clerk keeps the request book. An officer wants the names of everyone who asked for a certain book this year.
quests.goal: Decide whether he gets them
steps: Find the names.
Decide whether he gets them.
Tell Margit Sauer the job is done.

quests.name: The Research Grant
quests.info: A field alchemist must show research. The party has a month to bring the board a finding that nobody in the library has written down yet.
quests.goal: Present the finding to the board
steps: Choose a question and work at it.
Present the finding to the board.
Tell Alex Louis Armstrong the job is done.

quests.name: The Retainer's Bow
quests.info: A retainer carries the clan's dignity. The Chang clan has been summoned to a greater clan's hall and must not leave it smaller than it came.
quests.goal: Keep the clan's dignity
steps: Answer the summons.
Keep the clan's dignity.
Tell Chang Xu the job is done.

quests.name: The Roadside Repair
quests.info: A shop engineer keeps customers. A traveller's leg has failed at the rail yard, and the party must mend it there before a rival shop's runner arrives.
quests.goal: Mend the leg on the spot
steps: Reach the traveller first.
Mend the leg on the spot.
Tell Mira Kessel the job is done.

quests.name: The Rope Fence
quests.info: The flock has strayed onto the divided pasture, and the federal guards at the toll gate will not let it go back without a paper that nobody on the Amestrian side can write.
quests.goal: Get the flock back through the rope fence
steps: Talk with the federal guards at the toll gate.
Get the flock back through the rope fence.

quests.name: The Rotten Prop
quests.info: Pages can be called forgeries. A prop from the fallen gallery cannot. The miner's daughter knows the way down, and her father is one of the names on the hooks.
quests.goal: Bring up a length of the rotten prop with the company's mark burned in
steps: Follow her through the low crawl to the fallen gallery.
Bring up a length of the rotten prop with the company's mark burned in.

quests.name: The Ruins at Night
quests.info: The caravan rests in the ruins of Xerxes, and something walks the colonnade at night.
quests.goal: Keep the passengers together
steps: Keep watch in the ruins.
Keep the passengers together.

quests.name: The Ruins of the East
quests.info: Some of the families went into the desert with the old priestess.
quests.goal: Deliver the letters
steps: Reach the ruins.
Deliver the letters.

quests.name: The Runner
quests.info: A runner knows the town. The cook needs a message carried across Dublith before the soldiers' curfew.
quests.goal: Get back before curfew
steps: Carry the message.
Get back before curfew.
Tell Mrs. Teague the job is done.

quests.name: The Salt Road
quests.info: The salt carts from the flats have not come in, and the town needs salt for the season's meat.
quests.goal: Bring them to town
steps: Find the salt carts.
Bring them to town.

quests.name: The Search Line
quests.info: Soldiers in field order have been sweeping the wood for three days, a line of them abreast, and the camp in the hollow has moved closer to the burner's clearing than she likes.
quests.goal: Warn the hollow before the line gets there
steps: Learn which way the search line is sweeping.
Warn the hollow before the line gets there.

quests.name: The Sergeant's Week
quests.info: A sergeant keeps a squad together. A squad of new privates must be brought up to the standard of the east's veterans within a week.
quests.goal: Pass the inspection
steps: Train the squad.
Pass the inspection.
Tell Joss Harlan the job is done.

quests.name: The Shearing Shed Fire
quests.info: Someone set a fire in the wool sheds, and the farmers blame the newcomers who took the empty farm.
quests.goal: Keep the farmers from the newcomers' door
steps: Find who set the fire.
Keep the farmers from the newcomers' door.

quests.name: The Shepherd's Flock
quests.info: The army wants the hill shepherd's flock for the front, and she will not sell.
quests.goal: Settle the flock's fate
steps: Hear the shepherd out.
Settle the flock's fate.

quests.name: The Shopkeeper's Book
quests.info: Set the typed list beside the town's gossip and a pattern shows: the farms marked down owe the dry goods store nothing, and the farms marked up owe it a great deal. She will not say so at the town meeting until she has seen the debts written in the shopkeeper's own hand.
quests.goal: Copy the account book's debtors against the army's grades
steps: Get into the back store after the shutters go up.
Copy the account book's debtors against the army's grades.

quests.name: The Short Allowance
quests.info: The army's allowance for the orphanage has come in short every quarter for a year, though the depot's books say it leaves the depot whole.
quests.goal: Find where the difference goes
steps: Get a look at the depot's books for the orphanage.
Find where the difference goes.

quests.name: The Short Count
quests.info: Every barge from the north is a few crates short, and Varda's crews are blamed.
quests.goal: Find where the crates go
steps: Count the next barge.
Find where the crates go.

quests.name: The Shrine Above the Clouds
quests.info: May's last lesson is at a shrine where the flow of the whole land can be felt at once.
quests.goal: Feel the land's flow whole
steps: Climb to the shrine.
Feel the land's flow whole.

quests.name: The Signal Station
quests.info: The officer behind it all sends his orders through the signal station.
quests.goal: Take his orders to the western command
steps: Get into the station.
Take his orders to the western command.

quests.name: The Signature on the Batch Sheet
quests.info: The batch sheet that changed the filling order is signed by an officer at headquarters, and its carbon still lies in a file there.
quests.goal: Copy the batch sheet and its signature
steps: Get into the records room.
Copy the batch sheet and its signature.
quests.line: The Clerk at the Works Gate

quests.name: The Snow Field Inn
quests.info: A family from the slum went to the inn in a blizzard and has not come back.
quests.goal: Bring the family home
steps: Reach the inn through the snow.
Bring the family home.

quests.name: The Socket at the Cairn
quests.info: Her sons dug at the foot of the surveyors' cairn and turned up the old socket where the brass benchmark used to sit, a long way south of the stone it sits on now.
quests.goal: Put the measurement to the surveyor
steps: Measure how far the benchmark was moved.
Put the measurement to the surveyor.

quests.name: The Southern Outpost
quests.info: A captain holds a post. The watch post above the Aerugo line is short of men, short of water and expecting a probe from across the border.
quests.goal: Hold it until the relief comes
steps: Ready the post for the probe.
Hold it until the relief comes.
Tell Grumman the job is done.

quests.name: The Southern Voice
quests.info: On the southern market, the families of the soldiers at the front have plenty to say.
quests.goal: Record what she says
steps: Find a mother who will speak.
Record what she says.

quests.name: The Split Shoe
quests.info: A carter's mule went down on the salt road yesterday with a shoe broken clean across, and the carter has been telling the whole goat market whose forge made it. Mattias made it. He does not dispute that; he disputes the iron.
quests.goal: Watch a bar from the last delivery tested on the anvil
steps: Bring back the broken shoe from the goat market.
Watch a bar from the last delivery tested on the anvil.
quests.next: A Bar Without a Mill Stamp

quests.name: The Station Chief
quests.info: A station chief decides what the station is for. Men in uniform arrive with an order to read a statement that is not true.
quests.goal: Decide what goes on the air
steps: Hear the order out.
Decide what goes on the air.
Tell Nel Garrow the job is done.

quests.name: The Strike Meeting
quests.info: The miners vote tonight on whether to stop work until the wages are paid.
quests.goal: See the vote held fairly
steps: Hear both sides of the hall.
See the vote held fairly.

quests.name: The Strong Arm's Charge
quests.info: A senior alchemist goes where the army cannot. A rockfall has closed the pass and a column is stranded on the far side.
quests.goal: Clear the pass by alchemy
steps: Reach the rockfall.
Clear the pass by alchemy.
Tell Alex Louis Armstrong the job is done.

quests.name: The Stubborn Band
quests.info: A shot-firer sets the charges. A band of hard rock blocks a new gallery, and only a careful charge will move it.
quests.goal: Clear every man before it fires
steps: Set the charge.
Clear every man before it fires.
Tell Mr. Halling the job is done.

quests.name: The Sun's Keeper
quests.info: The church's highest servant decides what it is for. The manor holds the church's books, and the party must decide whether they are opened to the town.
quests.goal: Decide whether the town sees them
steps: Read the church's books.
Decide whether the town sees them.
Tell Brother Tobin the job is done.

quests.name: The Supply Wagons
quests.info: The wagons that carry the city's food to the front are being robbed.
quests.goal: Find who robs them
steps: Guard the next wagons.
Find who robs them.

quests.name: The Tag on the Nail
quests.info: The eel traps have brought up a soldier's identity tag, and the old woman of the weir has hung it among the smoking eels. It carries a name from the plate, and she will not give it to anyone who laughs at her stories of the red spring.
quests.goal: Persuade her to part with the tag
steps: Hear her out about that spring without laughing.
Persuade her to part with the tag.

quests.name: The Taproom Fight
quests.info: Soldiers from the city and soldiers from Briggs fight in the taproom every night.
quests.goal: Make a peace that lasts a week
steps: Learn what they are fighting about.
Make a peace that lasts a week.

quests.name: The Tea Dispute
quests.info: Two clans claim the same terrace, and the tea master is caught between them.
quests.goal: Settle the terrace
steps: Hear both clans.
Settle the terrace.

quests.name: The Tenement Rumour
quests.info: The girls hear that soldiers have been taking men out of the tenements at night, and nobody has seen them since.
quests.goal: Find where the men were taken
steps: Talk to the tenants who saw it.
Find where the men were taken.

quests.name: The Terms at City Hall
quests.info: The grant that keeps the orphanage open is a paper on file at city hall, and nobody has read its terms in years. The matron wants to know whether the enlistment clause is law or only habit.
quests.goal: Have the mayor read its terms aloud
steps: Find the grant papers in the city's files.
Have the mayor read its terms aloud.
quests.line: The Boy Who Would Not Sign

quests.name: The Testing Floor
quests.info: The fitter sends word that he will come in and be examined, if the major swears to test him fairly on the registry floor and not hand him to the stockade for what he did without a licence.
quests.goal: Stand witness at his test
steps: Bring the fitter to the registry.
Stand witness at his test.

quests.name: The Torn Nets
quests.info: Something has been tearing the fishermen's nets in the deep water.
quests.goal: Deal with it
steps: Find what tears the nets.
Deal with it.

quests.name: The Tunnel Guide
quests.info: A guide knows the way under the town. The tunnels below the bar have flooded, and someone is trapped down there.
quests.goal: Bring them out
steps: Go into the tunnels.
Bring them out.
Tell Mrs. Teague the job is done.

quests.name: The Twin Vase
quests.info: An appraiser is never fooled. A stranger brings in a vase he swears is the twin of the costly one on the top shelf.
quests.goal: Name its price
steps: Test the vase.
Name its price.
Tell Glotz the job is done.

quests.name: The Unarmed Road
quests.info: A priest-warrior protects without killing. Raiders are crossing the salt flats toward a caravan of pilgrims.
quests.goal: Turn the raiders without a death
steps: Reach the caravan.
Turn the raiders without a death.
Tell Scar's Master the job is done.

quests.name: The Veterans' Mind
quests.info: Staff officers are the command's eyes. Headquarters wants to know what the men who drink in the Veterans' Hall truly think of the capital, and the party must hear them out over a drink.
quests.goal: Report to headquarters
steps: Hear the veterans.
Report to headquarters.
Tell Joss Harlan the job is done.

quests.name: The Village Clinic
quests.info: The doctor's clinic is full and his stores are low.
quests.goal: Find out what he needs
steps: Help him through a day's patients.
Find out what he needs.

quests.name: The Voice of the Camps
quests.info: An elder speaks for the people. The army's officer at the gate will hear one Ishvalan about the camps, and the party is chosen.
quests.goal: Speak it at the gate
steps: Prepare the camps' case.
Speak it at the gate.
Tell Elder Halim the job is done.

quests.name: The Wall's Recruit
quests.info: Briggs keeps only those who survive it. The party must cross the pass in a blizzard and reach the fort by its own legs.
quests.goal: Report at the gate on time
steps: Cross the pass in the blizzard.
Report at the gate on time.
Tell Olivier Mira Armstrong the job is done.

quests.name: The Washed-Out Road
quests.info: A stock hand keeps the shelves full when the road is bad. Rain has cut the farm road and the store is running out of flour.
quests.goal: Restock the flour
steps: Get the wagon through.
Restock the flour.
Tell Jean Havoc the job is done.

quests.name: The Watcher
quests.info: A sympathiser keeps watch. Soldiers are combing the hills, and the hideout must be warned in time.
quests.goal: Warn the hideout in time
steps: Watch the soldiers' sweep.
Warn the hideout in time.
Tell Scar the job is done.

quests.name: The Water Tower
quests.info: The town's water tower is leaking, and the town has no money to mend it.
quests.goal: Get the town's water running again
steps: Find a way to mend the tower.
Get the town's water running again.

quests.name: The Week's Contest
quests.info: A contest winner is the name the street repeats. The party enters the week's contest against the street's best.
quests.goal: Win it
steps: Enter the contest.
Win it.
Tell Mira Kessel the job is done.

quests.name: The Western Signal
quests.info: A lieutenant keeps the wires open. The signal station on the Creta line has gone silent, and the western command wants to know whether it is weather or sabotage.
quests.goal: Get the wire working and name the cause
steps: Reach the silent station.
Get the wire working and name the cause.
Tell Grumman the job is done.

quests.name: The Western Voice
quests.info: In the west the border war never ends, and the traders know it better than the generals.
quests.goal: Record what he says
steps: Find a trader who will speak.
Record what he says.

quests.name: The Widow's Door
quests.info: Two years ago a fishing boat struck the spit on a dimmed night, and a man drowned. The keeper wants his widow to hear the truth from him and not from the wharf, and he does not trust his legs to carry him to her street.
quests.goal: Stay while he tells her
steps: Walk the keeper to the widow's house.
Stay while he tells her.

quests.name: The Widows' Delegate
quests.info: The widows meet in the Miners' Hall to choose one of their own to carry the pump man's statement and the mended tin to a lawyer in East City. The yard has not agreed on anything since the theft.
quests.goal: See a delegate chosen and sent on her way
steps: Bring the whole yard into one room.
See a delegate chosen and sent on her way.

quests.name: The Wire Party
quests.info: The wire in front of the clay trench was cut in the dark, and the gap has to be closed before the Cretan patrols find it or the next attack order comes down the telephone.
quests.goal: Close the gap in the wire
steps: Go out with the wire party after dark.
Close the gap in the wire.

quests.name: The Withdrawal List
quests.info: The chief librarian decides what the nation keeps. The command has sent a list of titles to be withdrawn, and the party must answer it.
quests.goal: Give the library's answer
steps: Read the list.
Give the library's answer.
Tell Margit Sauer the job is done.

quests.name: The Workbench
quests.info: Winry hands the party a bag of parts and asks them to build a working hand on the bench.
quests.goal: Make all five fingers move
steps: Build the hand.
Make all five fingers move.

quests.name: The Written Test
quests.info: The written test covers everything, and the library is the only place to study for it.
quests.goal: Pass the written test
steps: Study in the library.
Pass the written test.

quests.name: The Wrong Man Tried
quests.info: The stockade has arrested the honest soldier from the brawl for the theft, and his court martial sits in the morning.
quests.goal: See the right man in the dock
steps: Bring the proof to the court martial hut.
See the right man in the dock.

quests.name: The Yard Door After Dark
quests.info: A man knocks at the shop's yard door after dark and never comes to the counter. He buys reagents in pairs that no honest alchemist she serves would want together, and pays without haggling.
quests.goal: Follow the buyer to where he works
steps: Watch the yard door after dark.
Follow the buyer to where he works.

quests.name: Theft or Debt
quests.info: Nasreen has told the council clerk, because the yard's bricks are partly the town's. Hana Belkacem says a theft goes to the army post and a debt stays with the council, and the minutes will say whichever the party can argue for before the members vote.
quests.goal: Get the bricks written down as a debt
steps: Bring Faris Sefir before the council.
Get the bricks written down as a debt.

quests.name: Third Grade, Best Fleece
quests.info: Her ewes gave the finest wool on the east lane this year and the card came back marked third. The young corporal at the grading table would not look up while he wrote it, and she has begun to think the grade was settled before he ever pulled a lock apart.
quests.goal: Get a look inside the drawer he keeps locked
steps: Watch the clerk grade a farm's fleeces under the skylight.
Get a look inside the drawer he keeps locked.

quests.name: Three Hidden Reports
quests.info: Kalm finally unlocks his footlocker: three reports, each saying the bore is failing, none of them sent. The last sergeant who wrote such news was posted to the northern border. He wants them carried to the fort by someone whose career they cannot ruin.
quests.goal: Get the fort to send a well-borer
steps: Carry the reports to the fort.
Get the fort to send a well-borer.

quests.name: Through the Eel Channels
quests.info: The others mean to leave the district through the reed marsh, where the eel-catcher knows a way past the road checkpoint. The search has brought dogs down to the bank.
quests.goal: See them past the checkpoint or talk them into giving themselves up
steps: Get the deserters to the eel-catcher's hide.
See them past the checkpoint or talk them into giving themselves up.

quests.name: Tomatoes and Milk
quests.info: The youngest has been sleeping in a glasshouse on the river flats, and the widow who keeps it leaves bread and milk on the bench for him instead of sending for the police.
quests.goal: Bring him out before the farm carts start
steps: Find the boy in the glasshouses.
Bring him out before the farm carts start.

quests.name: Tomatoes for Kids
quests.info: Bertram Lusk would rather trade for goats than have his men steal them, and has sent word that he will pay in vegetables and flour. Ayub will deal, but not at any waterhole, and not with a soldier who can then find his way back.
quests.goal: Settle the trade and where it is made
steps: Bring the sergeant major and the herder to a meeting away from the waterholes.
Settle the trade and where it is made.

quests.name: Twelve Dogs and No Lead
quests.info: The spotting post on Eaglehead Crag has flashed a signal down: one of its two men is burning with fever. No lorry can climb to the crag in snow like this, and the best lead dog in the kennels has a split paw.
quests.goal: Fetch the medicine chest from the infirmary and lash it on
steps: Help the kennelman choose and harness a team without the old lead.
Fetch the medicine chest from the infirmary and lash it on.

quests.name: Two Arts at One Bench
quests.info: Tao Ruyi wants to compare her art with an Amestrian one, and the glassmaker at the kilns once held a State Alchemist's licence. He will talk, but only if somebody keeps the lieutenant who keeps pressing him for rifle lenses off his bench for a night.
quests.goal: Sit in on the two alchemists' talk
steps: Keep the lieutenant from the kilns for a night.
Sit in on the two alchemists' talk.

quests.name: Two Boats in One Hour
quests.info: Jia Manchuan rowed two clan stewards out onto the willow lake in the same hour, to opposite sides of the island, and heard both of them haggling over the same palace inspector. One of them has started asking who else hired a boat that evening. The boatman would like to sell what he heard before he is made to give it away.
quests.goal: Keep the steward off the boatman
steps: Hear what the boatman heard over the water.
Keep the steward off the boatman.

quests.name: Two Buyers
quests.info: The counter boss decides who in the east gets what. A farmer and a stranger who pays three times over both want the store's last scarce goods.
quests.goal: Decide who gets the goods
steps: Hear both buyers.
Decide who gets the goods.
Tell Jean Havoc the job is done.

quests.name: Under the Bandstand
quests.info: The bandmaster has noticed a boy sleeping under the bandstand and has been leaving the ends of his supper there.
quests.goal: Hear why he ran
steps: Coax the boy out.
Hear why he ran.
quests.next: The Paper on the Chapel Door

quests.name: Under the Barrow Ramp
quests.info: The clay digger keeps a skull wrapped in sacking beneath his barrow ramp, and there is a row of graves in the yellow clay that the kiln master told every digger to forget.
quests.goal: Count them without disturbing them
steps: Uncover the line of graves on the pit floor.
Count them without disturbing them.

quests.name: Under the Coal
quests.info: The scrap buyer loads his copper into an empty barge, rakes a skin of coal over the top and lets the weighman wave it through with the rest of the morning's loads.
quests.goal: Keep the barge from leaving
steps: Search the barge before it casts off.
Keep the barge from leaving.

quests.name: Under the Fallen Giant
quests.info: Her son is living in a dugout beneath a fallen pine, half starved and jumping at every branch. Brita will not go to him herself; she says if he is to come home it must be his own feet that bring him.
quests.goal: Talk Kasper Haugen into walking down to the steading
steps: Find the dugout without being shot at.
Talk Kasper Haugen into walking down to the steading.

quests.name: Under the Planks
quests.info: The night wagon unloads into a barn by the sawmill, under stacks of fresh planks that the mill's owner says he has never once lifted.
quests.goal: Copy the stamps off the crates
steps: Get into the barn by the river without the mill hands raising a shout.
Lift the planks and see what lies beneath them.
Copy the stamps off the crates.

quests.name: Under the Station Master's Seal
quests.info: The company's man has hired help in North City, and the clerk wants the pages, the copied names and the prop on the southbound train to a court in the capital before anyone stops them at the halt.
quests.goal: See it into the mail van under the station master's seal
steps: Get the parcel to Asbec Halt ahead of the company's hired men.
See it into the mail van under the station master's seal.

quests.name: Wagons Without a Note
quests.info: A counting-house clerk says the mill weaves far more army cloth than the garrison takes, and the rest leaves by the eastern road after dark on wagons no delivery note mentions. Elfriede wants to know where it goes before she says a word about it.
quests.goal: Learn who takes the cloth off them
steps: Wait by the eastern road for the night wagons.
Learn who takes the cloth off them.

quests.name: Walking the True Line
quests.info: With the old map and the old socket in hand, Marta Geiss means to walk her boundary in front of witnesses all the way to the desert well, and set stones where the chain should have run.
quests.goal: Keep the walk peaceful when the chainmen come
steps: Gather witnesses from Kessel Hamlet and the town.
Walk the line to the well and set the stones.
Keep the walk peaceful when the chainmen come.

quests.name: Watches in the Window
quests.info: A widow has found her husband's watch for sale behind the pawnbroker's grille, and the man who sold it is a sergeant of the burial detail who comes back after dark.
quests.goal: Get the dead men's effects back to their families
steps: Wait at the shop for the sergeant's bundle.
Get the dead men's effects back to their families.
quests.next: A Spade and a Lawyer's Letter

quests.name: Water Belongs to the Lake
quests.info: The fishermen, the dairy farms and the miller all have to live on the same lake. If the truth reaches the wharves as a rumour there will be boats burned; if it goes nowhere the shallows will be mud by autumn.
quests.goal: Fix the weir at its summer height
steps: Bring the fishermen and the miller face to face.
Fix the weir at its summer height.

quests.name: Water in the Churns
quests.info: Housewives on Market Row say the farm's milk has gone thin, yet it leaves her gate as rich as it ever did. Somewhere between the two it is being stretched.
quests.goal: Find who waters the milk on the way
steps: Follow the churns from the gate to the stalls.
Find who waters the milk on the way.

quests.name: Weather Under the Overhang
quests.info: Halfway to the crag a squall closes in. The only shelter is the overhang where a tall woman in patched furs keeps dry wood for strangers, and she is already there when the dogs come in.
quests.goal: Learn from the woman in furs which slope will not slide
steps: Get the team under the overhang before the squall breaks.
Learn from the woman in furs which slope will not slide.

quests.name: What the Pump Man Saw
quests.info: The tin was always meant to pay a lawyer over the flood at the number three pit. Only one man came up out of it alive, the old pump man, and every evening he walks to its nailed gate with a lamp.
quests.goal: Persuade him to set his name to it
steps: Find the pump man at the nailed gate.
Hear what he saw on the day of the flood.
Persuade him to set his name to it.

quests.name: What the Steam Hides
quests.info: The soldier who cut the pages meets a stockade sergeant in the hot room every week. Whatever passes between them is said where nobody can write it down.
quests.goal: Learn what the two of them trade
steps: Sit in the hot room through their meeting.
Learn what the two of them trade.
quests.line: A Knife That Knew the Place

quests.name: What the Veranda Knows
quests.info: The quartermaster swears the missing money feeds the widows of men the pensions office lost track of, and the old soldiers on the long veranda will know if he is lying.
quests.goal: Decide what is done about the green ink
steps: Hear the veterans out.
Decide what is done about the green ink.

quests.name: What the Walls Remember
quests.info: Yaqub Sennar has carved these walls from memory for years, and one line near the ablution court speaks of water rising under the feet of the faithful. He took it for a figure of speech. Now he is not sure.
quests.goal: Walk the old tunnel until you meet Musa Kareem's lamp
steps: Find the old stair under the ablution court.
Walk the old tunnel until you meet Musa Kareem's lamp.

quests.name: Where the Grey Man Drinks Tea
quests.info: The man in grey came back to the forge for his batch, found it not ready, and walked off without a word. Lei Datong followed him to a teahouse with a dark lantern and stopped at the door, as anyone sensible would.
quests.goal: Learn whose paper he carried
steps: Follow the man in grey into the teahouse.
Learn whose paper he carried.

quests.name: Where the Road Meets the Trees
quests.info: The bear has bedded down under the pines above the road, hurt, hungry and too close to the lorries. The old man means to end it himself, cleanly this time, but his eyes are not what they were.
quests.goal: See the bear finished cleanly or turned back to the high gully
steps: Take a stand beside the old hunter where the bear will cross.
See the bear finished cleanly or turned back to the high gully.

quests.name: Where the Shallows Die
quests.info: The fish hall's chalk boards show which boats come back light. The weigher keeps the tallies, and he is not keen to lend them, but the light boats all fish the east end, toward the river.
quests.goal: Work out which water is failing
steps: Get a look at the hall's tallies.
Work out which water is failing.

quests.name: Wolves on the Saddle
quests.info: The quiet road home runs over the snowfield saddle, and a pack of hill wolves has been pacing the flock since dawn, waiting for the weak ones to fall behind.
quests.goal: Keep the wolves off the stragglers
steps: Drive the flock over the saddle.
Keep the wolves off the stragglers.

quests.name: Wolves on the Track
quests.info: The hard weather has brought the wolves down off the range, and they have taken to waiting on the woodcutters' track at dusk. No timber reaches the mill until they are driven off.
quests.goal: Drive the wolves back toward the range
steps: Find where the pack lies up.
Drive the wolves back toward the range.

quests.name: Words at the One-Lamp Den
quests.info: Mattea Corvo pays for the dark nights, and she will not be told by message that they are over. Somebody has to walk into her den and say it to her face.
quests.goal: Leave with the keeper's debt called square
steps: Get a hearing in the den.
Leave with the keeper's debt called square.

quests.name: Worms That Will Not Eat
quests.info: The far shed has gone silent. Its worms lie on the racks with the leaves untouched, and the old reeler has wiped a fine grey dust off the underside of a leaf with her thumb. The rest of the sheds feed from the same baskets tomorrow.
quests.goal: Find which baskets brought the dust in
steps: Strip the dusted leaves from every rack.
Find which baskets brought the dust in.

text.homeSay: The exact words that set off travel, alchemy, faction work and atonement.
text.homeMap: Every district on one map: find a place, show one district.
text.ledePeople: Everyone Amestris introduces you to, with where to find them.
text.ledePlaces: Cities, towns, forts and wilds of Amestris and its neighbours.
text.ledeCreatures: Beasts, chimeras and the kinds of people Amestris sends against you.
text.ledeLore: History, alchemy, society and places of Amestris and its neighbours.
text.ledeMechanics: How the world works, as the guide books every new character carries explain it.
text.ledeMusic: The soundtrack of Amestris, by the mood of the scene.
text.ledeDistricts: The districts of Amestris, all on the one map.
text.ledeSay: The lines that set off the world's systems.
text.ledeFactions: The commands, armies, families and crews you can swear to, work for or cross.
text.ledeItems: Weapons, armour, remedies, tools, treasures and goods: what each gives, the slot it takes and how you get it.
text.guideSay: Most of the world's systems listen for plain lines.
text.plannerLede: Every pick the creator offers, in its order, with the same unlocks and exclusions. The totals add up what your picks give.
text.benchLede: Build the exact line to type, then run it through the world's own crafting triggers, the same code the game runs, to see what the narrator will be told.
